verses.translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, the Supreme Lord, and was therefore not at all fearful, He still acted like a human being to teach neophytes how to act.

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ চরণ বন্দি’ গেলা দুইজন ।\\nপ্রভুর সেই গ্রাম হৈতে চলিতে হৈল মন ॥২২৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' caraṇa vandi' gelā dui-jana\\nprabhura sei grāma haite calite haila mana
verses.translation: Having spoken thus, the two brothers offered prayers to the lotus feet of the Lord and returned to their homes. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu then desired to leave that village.

verses.devanagari: প্রাতে চলি’ আইলা প্রভু ‘কানাইর নাটশালা’ ।\\nদেখিল সকল তাহাঁ কৃষ্ণচরিত্র-লীলা ॥২২৭॥
verses.transliteration: prāte cali' āilā prabhu 'kānāira nāṭaśālā'\\ndekhila sakala tāhāṅ kṛṣṇa-caritra-līlā
verses.translation: In the morning, the Lord left and went to a place known as Kānāi Nāṭaśālā. While there, He saw may pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In those days in Bengal there were many places known as Kānāi Nāṭaśālā, where pictures of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa were kept. People used to go there to see them. This is called
kṛṣṇa-caritra-līlā.
In Bengal there are still many places called
hari-sabhā,
which indicates a place where local people gather to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
and discuss the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. The word
kānāi
means "Lord Kṛṣṇa's," and
nāṭaśālā
indicates a place where pastimes are demonstrated. So those places which at the present moment are called
hari-sabhā
may previously have been known as Kānāi Nāṭaśālā.

verses.devanagari: সেই রাত্রে প্রভু তাহাঁ চিন্তে মনে মন ।\\nসঙ্গে সংঘট্ট ভাল নহে, কৈল সনাতন ॥২২৮॥
verses.transliteration: sei rātre prabhu tāhāṅ cinte mane mana\\nsaṅge saṅghaṭṭa bhāla nahe, kaila sanātana
verses.translation: That night the Lord considered Sanātana Gosvāmī's proposal that He should not go to Vṛndāvana followed by so many people.

verses.devanagari: মথুরা যাইব আমি এত লোক সঙ্গে ।\\nকিছু সুখ না পাইব, হবে রসভঙ্গে ॥২২৯॥
verses.transliteration: mathurā yāiba āmi eta loka saṅge\\nkichu sukha nā pāiba, habe rasa-bhaṅge
verses.translation: The Lord thought, "If I go to Mathurā with such crowds behind Me, it would not be a very happy situation, for the atmosphere would be disturbed."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nŚrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu confirms that visiting a holy place like Vṛndāvana with so many people is simply disturbing. He would not find the happiness He desired by visiting such holy places in that way.

verses.devanagari: একাকী যাইব, কিম্বা সঙ্গে এক জন ।\\nতবে সে শোভয়ে বৃন্দাবনেরে গমন ॥২৩০॥
verses.transliteration: ekākī yāiba, kimvā saṅge eka jana\\ntabe se śobhaye vṛndāvanere gamana
verses.translation: The Lord concluded that He would go alone to Vṛndāvana or, at most, would take only one person as His companion. In that way, going to Vṛndāvana would be very pleasant.

verses.devanagari: এত চিন্তি প্রাতঃকালে গঙ্গাস্নান করি’ ।\\n‘নীলাচলে যাব’ বলি’ চলিলা গৌরহরি ॥২৩১॥
verses.transliteration: eta cinti prātaḥ-kāle gaṅgā-snāna kari'\\n'nīlācale yāba' bali' calilā gaurahari
verses.translation: Thinking like this, the Lord took His morning bath in the Ganges and started for Nīlācala, saying "I shall go there."

verses.devanagari: এই মত চলি’ চলি’ আইলা শান্তিপুরে ।\\nদিন পাঁচ-সাত রহিলা আচার্যের ঘরে ॥২৩২॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata cali' cali' āilā śāntipure\\ndina pāṅca-sāta rahilā ācāryera ghare
verses.translation: Walking and walking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at Śāntipura and remained at the house of Advaita Ācārya for five to seven days.

verses.devanagari: শচীদেবী আনি’ তাঁরে কৈল নমস্কার ।\\nসাত দিন তাঁর ঠাঞি ভিক্ষা-ব্যবহার ॥২৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: śacī-devī āni' tāṅre kaila namaskāra\\nsāta dina tāṅra ṭhāñi bhikṣā-vyavahāra
verses.translation: Taking this opportunity, Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu sent for mother Śacīdevī, and she remained at His house for seven days to prepare the meals for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর আজ্ঞা লঞা পুনঃ করিলা গমনে ।\\nবিনয় করিয়া বিদায় দিল ভক্তগণে ॥২৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra ājñā lañā punaḥ karilā gamane\\nvinaya kariyā vidāya dila bhakta-gaṇe
verses.translation: Taking permission from His mother, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu started for Jagannātha Purī. When the devotees followed Him, He humbly begged them to remain and bade them all farewell.

verses.devanagari: জনা দুই সঙ্গে আমি যাব নীলাচলে ।\\nআমারে মিলিবা আসি’ রথযাত্রা-কালে ॥২৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: janā dui saṅge āmi yāba nīlācale\\nāmāre milibā āsi' ratha-yātrā-kāle
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, although requesting all the devotees to go back, allowed two people to follow Him. He requested all the devotees to come to Jagannātha Purī and meet Him during the car festival.

verses.devanagari: বলভদ্র ভট্টাচার্য, আর পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।\\nদুইজন-সঙ্গে প্রভু আইলা নীলাচল ॥২৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: balabhadra bhaṭṭācārya, āra paṇḍita dāmodara\\ndui-jana-saṅge prabhu āilā nīlācala
verses.translation: Two persons named Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya and Dāmodara Paṇḍita accompanied Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala].

verses.devanagari: দিন কত তাহাঁ রহি’ চলিলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nলুকাঞা চলিলা রাত্রে, না জানে কোন জন ॥২৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: dina kata tāhāṅ rahi' calilā vṛndāvana\\nlukāñā calilā rātre, nā jāne kona jana
verses.translation: After remaining at Jagannātha Purī for a few days, the Lord secretly started for Vṛndāvana at night. He did this without anyone's knowledge.

verses.devanagari: বলভদ্র ভট্টাচার্য রহে মাত্র সঙ্গে ।\\nঝারিখণ্ড-পথে কাশী আইলা মহারঙ্গে ॥২৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: balabhadra bhaṭṭācārya rahe mātra saṅge\\njhārikhaṇḍa-pathe kāśī āilā mahā-raṅge
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left Jagannātha Purī for Vṛndāvana, only Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya was with Him. Thus He traveled on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa and arrived in Benares with great delight.

verses.devanagari: দিন চার কাশীতে রহি’ গেলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nমথুরা দেখিয়া দেখে দ্বাদশ কানন ॥২৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: dina cāra kāśīte rahi' gelā vṛndāvana\\nmathurā dekhiyā dekhe dvādaśa kānana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Benares only four days and then left for Vṛndāvana. After seeing the town of Mathurā, He visited the twelve forests.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThose who visit the Vṛndāvana area today also generally visit twelve places, known as the twelve forests. They start at Mathurā, where there is Kāmya-vana. From there they go to Tāla-vana, Tamāla-vana, Madhu-vana, Kusuma-vana, Bhāṇḍīra-vana, Bilva-vana, Bhadra-vana, Khadira-vana, Loha-vana, Kumuda-vana and Gokula-mahāvana.

verses.devanagari: লীলাস্থল দেখি’ প্রেমে হইলা অস্থির ।\\nবলভদ্র কৈল তাঁরে মথুরার বাহির ॥২৪০॥
verses.transliteration: līlā-sthala dekhi' preme ha-ilā asthira\\nbalabhadra kaila tāṅre mathurāra bāhira
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited all twelve places of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, He became very agitated because of ecstasy. Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya somehow or other got Him out of Mathurā.

verses.devanagari: গঙ্গাতীর-পথে লঞা প্রয়াগে আইলা ।\\nশ্রীরূপ আসি’ প্রভুকে তথাই মিলিলা ॥২৪১॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā-tīra-pathe lañā prayāge āilā\\nśrī-rūpa āsi' prabhuke tathāi mililā
verses.translation: After leaving Mathurā, the Lord began to walk along a path on the bank of the Ganges, and finally He reached the holy place named Prayāga [Allahabad]. It was there that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met the Lord.

verses.devanagari: দণ্ডবৎ করি’ রূপ ভূমিতে পড়িলা ।\\nপরম আনন্দে প্রভু আলিঙ্গন দিলা ॥২৪২॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍavat kari' rūpa bhūmite paḍilā\\nparama ānande prabhu āliṅgana dilā
verses.translation: At Prayāga, Rūpa Gosvāmī fell down on the ground to offer obeisances to the Lord, and the Lord embraced him with great delight.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপে শিক্ষা করাই’ পাঠাইলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nআপনে করিলা বারাণসী আগমন ॥২৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpe śikṣā karāi' pāṭhāilā vṛndāvana\\nāpane karilā vārāṇasī āgamana
verses.translation: After instructing Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī at Prayāga at the Daśāśvamedha-ghāṭa, Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered him to go to Vṛndāvana. The Lord then returned to Vārāṇasī.

verses.devanagari: কাশীতে প্রভুকে আসি’ মিলিলা সনাতন ।\\nদুই মাস রহি’ তাঁরে করাইলা শিক্ষণ ॥২৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: kāśīte prabhuke āsi' mililā sanātana\\ndui māsa rahi' tāṅre karāilā śikṣaṇa
verses.translation: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at Vārāṇasī, Sanātana Gosvāmī met Him there. The Lord remained there for two months and instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī perfectly.

verses.devanagari: মথুরা পাঠাইলা তাঁরে দিয়া ভক্তিবল ।\\nসন্ন্যাসীরে কৃপা করি’ গেলা নীলাচল ॥২৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: mathurā pāṭhāilā tāṅre diyā bhakti-bala\\nsannyāsīre kṛpā kari' gelā nīlācala
verses.translation: After fully instructing Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent him to Mathurā with empowered devotional service. In Benares He also bestowed His mercy upon the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs. He then returned to Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī].

verses.devanagari: ছয় বৎসর ঐছে প্রভু করিলা বিলাস ।\\nকভু ইতি-উতি, কভু ক্ষেত্রবাস ॥২৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: chaya vatsara aiche prabhu karilā vilāsa\\nkabhu iti-uti, kabhu kṣetra-vāsa
verses.translation: The Lord traveled all over India for six years. He was sometimes here and sometimes there performing His transcendental pastimes, and sometimes He remained at Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: আনন্দে ভক্ত-সঙ্গে সদা কীর্তন-বিলাস ।\\nজগন্নাথ-দরশন, প্রেমের বিলাস ॥২৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: ānande bhakta-saṅge sadā kīrtana-vilāsa\\njagannātha-daraśana, premera vilāsa
verses.translation: While at Jagannātha Purī, the Lord passed His time in great joy by performing saṅkīrtana and visiting the temple of Jagannātha in great ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যলীলার কৈলুঁ এই সূত্র-বিবরণ ।\\nঅন্ত্যলীলার সূত্র এবে শুন, ভক্তগণ ॥২৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: madhya-līlāra kailuṅ ei sūtra-vivaraṇa\\nantya-līlāra sūtra ebe śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: Thus I have given a synopsis of the madhya-līlā, the middle pastimes of the Lord. Now, O devotees, kindly hear the synopsis of the final pastimes of the Lord, known as antya-līlā.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবন হৈতে যদি নীলাচলে আইলা ।\\nআঠার বর্ষ তাহাঁ বাস, কাহাঁ নাহি গেলা ॥২৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvana haite yadi nīlācale āilā\\nāṭhāra varṣa tāhāṅ vāsa, kāhāṅ nāhi gelā
verses.translation: When the Lord returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana, He remained there and did not go anywhere else for eighteen years.

verses.devanagari: প্রতিবর্ষ আইসেন তাহাঁ গৌড়ের ভক্তগণ ।\\nচারি মাস রহে প্রভুর সঙ্গে সম্মিলন ॥২৫০॥
verses.transliteration: prativarṣa āisena tāhāṅ gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa\\ncāri māsa rahe prabhura saṅge sammilana
verses.translation: During those eighteen years, all the devotees of Bengal used to visit Him at Jagannātha Purī every year. They would remain there for four continuous months and enjoy the company of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: নিরন্তর নৃত্যগীত কীর্তন-বিলাস ।\\nআচণ্ডালে প্রেমভক্তি করিলা প্রকাশ ॥২৫১॥
verses.transliteration: nirantara nṛtya-gīta kīrtana-vilāsa\\nācaṇḍāle prema-bhakti karilā prakāśa
verses.translation: At Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed chanting and dancing unceasingly. Thus He enjoyed the pastime of saṅkīrtana. He manifested His causeless mercy, pure love of God, to everyone, including the lowest man.

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিত-গোসাঞি কৈল নীলাচলে বাস ।\\nবক্রেশ্বর, দামোদর, শঙ্কর, হরিদাস ॥২৫২॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍita-gosāñi kaila nīlācale vāsa\\nvakreśvara, dāmodara, śaṅkara, haridāsa
verses.translation: Residing with the Lord at Jagannātha Purī were Paṇḍita Gosāñi and other devotees, such as Vakreśvara, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: জগদানন্দ, ভগবান্, গোবিন্দ, কাশীশ্বর ।\\nপরমানন্দপুরী, আর স্বরূপ-দামোদর ॥২৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: jagadānanda, bhagavān, govinda, kāsīśvara\\nparamānanda-purī, āra svarūpa-dāmodara
verses.translation: Jagadānanda, Bhagavān, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Paramānanda Purī and Svarūpa Dāmodara were other devotees who also lived with the Lord.

verses.devanagari: ক্ষেত্রবাসী রামানন্দ রায় প্রভৃতি ।\\nপ্রভুসঙ্গে এই সব কৈল নিত্যস্থিতি ॥২৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: kṣetra-vāsī rāmānanda rāya prabhṛti\\nprabhu-saṅge ei saba kaila nitya-sthiti
verses.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya and other devotees who were residents of Jagannātha Purī also remained permanently with the Lord.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত, নিত্যানন্দ, মুকুন্দ, শ্রীবাস ।\\nবিদ্যানিধি, বাসুদেব, মুরারি, — যত দাস ॥২৫৫॥\\nপ্রতিবর্ষে আইসে সঙ্গে রহে চারিমাস ।\\nতাঁ-সবা লঞা প্রভুর বিবিধ বিলাস ॥২৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: prativarṣe āise saṅge rahe cāri-māsa\\ntāṅ-sabā lañā prabhura vividha vilāsa
verses.translation: Other devotees of the Lord-headed by Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda Prabhu, Mukunda, Śrīvāsa, Vidyānidhi, Vāsudeva and Murāri-used to visit Jagannātha Purī and remain with the Lord for four continuous months. The Lord enjoyed various pastimes in their company.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাসের সিদ্ধিপ্রাপ্তি, — অদ্ভুত সে সব ।\\nআপনি মহাপ্রভু যাঁর কৈল মহোৎসব ॥২৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsera siddhi-prāpti,—adbhuta se saba\\nāpani mahāprabhu yāṅra kaila mahotsava
verses.translation: At Jagannātha Purī, Haridāsa Ṭhākura passed away. The incident was very wonderful because the Lord Himself performed the festival of Ṭhākura Haridāsa's departure.

verses.devanagari: তবে রূপ-গোসাঞির পুনরাগমন ।\\nতাঁহার হৃদয়ে কৈল প্রভু শক্তি-সঞ্চারণ ॥২৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: tabe rūpa-gosāñira punar-āgamana\\ntāṅhāra hṛdaye kaila prabhu śakti-sañcāraṇa
verses.translation: At Jagannātha Purī Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord invested his heart with all transcendental power.

verses.devanagari: তবে ছোট হরিদাসে প্রভু কৈল দণ্ড ।\\nদামোদর-পণ্ডিত কৈল প্রভুকে বাক্য-দণ্ড ॥২৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: tabe choṭa haridāse prabhu kaila daṇḍa\\ndāmodara-paṇḍita kaila prabhuke vākya-daṇḍa
verses.translation: After this, the Lord punished Junior Haridāsa, and Dāmodara Paṇḍita gave some warning to the Lord.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nActually Dāmodara Paṇḍita was the eternal servant of the Lord. He could not punish the Lord at any time, nor had he any desire to, but He did give some warning to the Lord so that others would not blaspheme Him. Of course, He should have known that the Lord is the Supreme Personality of Godhead and is free to act in any way. There is no need to warn Him, and such an action is not very much appreciated by advanced devotees.

verses.devanagari: তবে সনাতন-গোসাঞির পুনরাগমন ।\\nজ্যৈষ্ঠমাসে প্রভু তাঁরে কৈল পরীক্ষণ ॥২৬০॥
verses.transliteration: tabe sanātana-gosāñira punar-āgamana\\njyaiṣṭha-māse prabhu tāṅre kaila parīkṣaṇa
verses.translation: Thereafter Sanātana Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord tested him in scorching heat during the month of Jyaiṣṭha.

verses.devanagari: তুষ্ট হঞা প্রভু তাঁরে পাঠাইলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nঅদ্বৈতের হস্তে প্রভুর অদ্ভুত ভোজন ॥২৬১॥
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭa hañā prabhu tāṅre pāṭhāilā vṛndāvana\\nadvaitera haste prabhura adbhuta bhojana
verses.translation: Being pleased, the Lord sent Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana. After that, He was fed wonderfully by the hands of Śrī Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ-সঙ্গে যুক্তি করিয়া নিভৃতে ।\\nতাঁরে পাঠাইলা গৌড়ে প্রেম প্রচারিতে ॥২৬২॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda-saṅge yukti kariyā nibhṛte\\ntāṅre pāṭhāilā gauḍe prema pracārite
verses.translation: After sending Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana, the Lord privately consulted with Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu. He then sent Him to Bengal to preach love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: তবে ত’ বল্লভ ভট্ট প্রভুরে মিলিলা ।\\nকৃষ্ণনামের অর্থ প্রভু তাঁহারে কহিলা ॥২৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe ta' vallabha bhaṭṭa prabhure mililā\\nkṛṣṇa-nāmera artha prabhu tāṅhāre kahilā
verses.translation: Soon afterward, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa met the Lord at Jagannātha Purī, and the Lord explained to him the import of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This Vallabha Bhaṭṭa is the head of the Vaiṣṇava
sampradāya
known as the Vallabhācārya-sampradāya in western India. There is a long story about Vallabha Ācārya narrated in the
Caitanya-caritāmṛta,
specifically in the Seventh Chapter of
Antya-līlā
and the Nineteenth Chapter of
Madhya-līlā.
Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the house of Vallabha Ācārya on the other side of Prayāga, in a place known as Ādāila-grāma. Later, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa saw Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī to explain his commentary on
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
He was very proud of his writings, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu corrected him, telling him that a Vaiṣṇava should be humble and follow in the footsteps of his predecessors. The Lord told him that his pride in being superior to Śrīdhara Svāmī was not at all befitting a Vaiṣṇava.

verses.devanagari: প্রদ্যুম্ন মিশ্রেরে প্রভু রামানন্দ-স্থানে ।\\nকৃষ্ণকথা শুনাইল কহি’ তাঁর গুণে ॥২৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: pradyumna miśrere prabhu rāmānanda-sthāne\\nkṛṣṇa-kathā śunāila kahi' tāṅra guṇe
verses.translation: After explaining the transcendental qualities of Rāmānanda Rāya, the Lord sent Pradyumna Miśra to the residence of Rāmānanda Rāya, and Pradyumna Miśra learned kṛṣṇa-kathā from him.

verses.devanagari: গোপীনাথ পট্টনায়ক — রামানন্দ-ভ্রাতা ।\\nরাজা মারিতেছিল, প্রভু হৈল ত্রাতা ॥২৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: gopīnātha paṭṭanāyaka—rāmānanda-bhrātā\\nrājā māritechila, prabhu haila trātā
verses.translation: After this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu saved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the younger brother of Rāmānanda Rāya, from being condemned to death by the King.

verses.devanagari: রামচন্দ্রপুরী-ভয়ে ভিক্ষা ঘাটাইলা ।\\nবৈষ্ণবের দুঃখ দেখি’ অর্ধেক রাখিলা ॥২৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: rāmacandra-purī-bhaye bhikṣā ghāṭāilā\\nvaiṣṇavera duḥkha dekhi' ardheka rākhilā
verses.translation: Rāmacandra Purī criticized Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's eating; therefore the Lord reduced His eating to a minimum. However, when all the Vaiṣṇavas became very sorry, the Lord increased His portion to half as much as usual.

verses.devanagari: ব্রহ্মাণ্ড-ভিতরে হয় চৌদ্দ ভুবন  ।\\nচৌদ্দভুবনে বৈসে যত জীবগণ ॥২৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍa-bhitare haya caudda bhuvana\\ncaudda-bhuvane vaise yata jīva-gaṇa
verses.translation: There are fourteen planetary systems within the universe, and all living entities reside in those planetary systems.

verses.devanagari: মনুষ্যের বেশ ধরি’ যাত্রিকের ছলে  ।\\nপ্রভুর দর্শন করে আসি’ নীলাচলে ॥২৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: manuṣyera veśa dhari' yātrikera chale\\nprabhura darśana kare āsi' nīlācale
verses.translation: Dressing like human beings on pilgrimage, they all used to come to Jagannātha Purī to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: একদিন শ্রীবাসাদি যত ভক্তগণ ।\\nমহাপ্রভুর গুণ গাঞা করেন কীর্তন ॥২৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina śrīvāsādi yata bhakta-gaṇa\\nmahāprabhura guṇa gāñā karena kīrtana
verses.translation: One day all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, were chanting the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ ভক্তগণে কহে সক্রোধ বচনে ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-নাম-গুণ ছাড়ি, কি কর কীর্তনে ॥২৭০॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' bhakta-gaṇe kahe sa-krodha vacane\\nkṛṣṇa-nāma-guṇa chāḍi, ki kara kīrtane
verses.translation: Not liking the chanting of His transcendental qualities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised them as if He were angry. "What kind of chanting is this?" He asked. "Are you leaving aside the chanting of the holy name of the Lord?"

verses.devanagari: ঔদ্ধত্য করিতে হৈল সবাকার মন ।\\nস্বতন্ত্র হইয়া সবে নাশা’বে ভুবন ॥২৭১॥
verses.transliteration: auddhatya karite haila sabākāra mana\\nsvatantra ha-iyā sabe nāśā 'be bhuvana
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised all the devotees, telling them not to show impudence and spoil the entire world by becoming independent.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu warned all His followers not to become independent or impudent. Unfortunately, after the disappearance of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, many
apa-sampradāyas
(so-called followers) invented many ways not approved by the
ācāryas.
Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura has described them as the
āula, bāula, kartābhajā, neḍā, daraveśa, sāni sahajiyā, sakhībhekī, smārta, jāta-gosāñi, ativāḍī, cūḍādhārī
and
gaurāṅga-nāgarī.
The
āula-sampradāya, bāula-sampradāya
and others invented their own ways of understanding Lord Caitanya's philosophy, without following in the footsteps of the
ācāryas.
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself indicates herein that all such attempts would simply spoil the spirit of His cult.

verses.devanagari: দশ দিকে কোটী কোটী লোক হেন কালে ।\\n‘জয় কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য’ বলি’ করে কোলাহলে ॥২৭২॥
verses.transliteration: daśa-dike koṭī koṭī loka hena kāle\\njaya kṛṣṇa-caitanya' bali' kare kolāhale
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was apparently in a angry mood and chastising His devotees, many thousands of people outside loudly cried in a tumultuous voice, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!"

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় মহাপ্রভু — ব্রজেন্দ্রকুমার ।\\nজগৎ তারিতে প্রভু, তোমার অবতার ॥২৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya mahāprabhu—vrajendra-kumāra\\njagat tārite prabhu, tomāra avatāra
verses.translation: All the people began to call very loudly, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the son of Mahārāja Nanda! Now You have appeared in order to deliver the whole world!

verses.devanagari: বহুদূর হৈতে আইনু হঞা বড় আর্ত ।\\nদরশন দিয়া প্রভু করহ কৃতার্থ ॥২৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: bahu-dūra haite āinu hañā baḍa ārta\\ndaraśana diyā prabhu karaha kṛtārtha
verses.translation: "O Lord, we are very unhappy. We have come a long distance to see You. Please be merciful and show us Your favor."

verses.devanagari: শুনিয়া লোকের দৈন্য দ্রবিলা হৃদয় ।\\nবাহিরে আসি’ দরশন দিলা দয়াময় ॥২৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: śuniyā lokera dainya dravilā hṛdaya\\nbāhire āsi' daraśana dilā dayā-maya
verses.translation: When the Lord heard the humble petition made by the people, his heart softened. Being very merciful, He immediately came out and gave audience to all of them.

verses.devanagari: বাহু তুলি’ বলে প্রভু বল’ ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ।\\nউঠিল — শ্রীহরিধ্বনি চতুর্দিক্ ভরি’ ॥২৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: bāhu tuli' bale prabhu bala' 'hari' 'hari'\\nuṭhila—śrī-hari-dhvani catur-dik bhari'
verses.translation: Raising His arms, the Lord asked everyone to chant loudly the vibration of the holy name of Lord Hari. There immediately arose a great stir, and the vibration of "Hari!" filled all directions.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু দেখি’ প্রেমে লোক আনন্দিত মন ।\\nপ্রভুকে ঈশ্বর বলি’ করয়ে স্তবন ॥২৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu dekhi' preme loka ānandita mana\\nprabhuke īśvara bali' karaye stavana
verses.translation: Seeing the Lord, everyone became joyful out of love. Everyone accepted the Lord as the Supreme, and thus they offered their prayers.

verses.devanagari: স্তব শুনি’ প্রভুকে কহেন শ্রীনিবাস ।\\nঘরে গুপ্ত হও, কেনে বাহিরে প্রকাশ ॥২৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: stava śuni' prabhuke kahena śrīnivāsa\\nghare gupta hao, kene bāhire prakāśa
verses.translation: While the people were offering their prayers unto the Lord, Śrīnivāsa Ācārya sarcastically said to the Lord, "At home, You wanted to be covered. Why have You exposed Yourself outside?"

verses.devanagari: কে শিখাল এই লোকে, কহে কোন্ বাত ।\\nইহা-সবার মুখ ঢাক দিয়া নিজ হাত ॥২৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: ke śikhāla ei loke, kahe kon bāta\\nihā-sabāra mukha ḍhāka diyā nija hāta
verses.translation: Śrīnivāsa Ācārya continued, "Who has taught these people? What are they saying? Now You can cover their mouths with Your own hand.

verses.devanagari: সূর্য যৈছে উদয় করি’ চাহে লুকাইতে ।\\nবুঝিতে না পারি তৈছে তোমার চরিতে ॥২৮০॥
verses.transliteration: sūrya yaiche udaya kari' cāhe lukāite\\nbujhite nā pāri taiche tomāra carite
verses.translation: "It is as if the sun, after rising, wanted to hide itself. We cannot understand such characteristics in Your behavior."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহেন, — শ্রীনিবাস, ছাড় বিড়ম্বনা ।\\nসবে মেলি’ কর মোর কতেক লাঞ্ছনা ॥২৮১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahena,—śrīnivāsa, chāḍa viḍambanā\\nsabe meli' kara mora kateka lāñcanā
verses.translation: The Lord replied, "My dear Śrīnivāsa, please stop joking. You have all combined together to humiliate Me in this way."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ লোকে করি’ শুভদৃষ্টি দান ।\\nঅভ্যন্তরে গেলা, লোকের পূর্ণ হৈল কাম ॥২৮২॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' loke kari' śubha-dṛṣṭi dāna\\nabhyantare gelā, lokera pūrṇa haila kāma
verses.translation: Thus speaking, the Lord entered His room after glancing auspiciously upon the people out of charity. In this way the desires of the people were completely fulfilled.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ-দাস নিত্যানন্দ-পাশে গেলা ।\\nচিড়া-দধি-মহোৎসব তাহাঁই করিলা ॥২৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha-dāsa nityānanda-pāśe gelā\\nciḍā-dadhi-mahotsava tāhāṅi karilā
verses.translation: At this time, Raghunātha dāsa approached Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu and, according to His order, prepared a feast and distributed prasāda composed of chipped rice and curd.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
There is a special preparation in Bengal wherein chipped rice is mixed with curd and sometimes with
sandeśa
and mango. It is a very palatable food offered to the Deity and then distributed to the public. Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, who was a householder at this time, met Nityānanda Prabhu. According to His advice, he executed this festival of
dadhi-ciḍā-prasāda.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর আজ্ঞা লঞা গেলা প্রভুর চরণে ।\\nপ্রভু তাঁরে সমর্পিলা স্বরূপের স্থানে ॥২৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra ājñā lañā gelā prabhura caraṇe\\ntāṅra prabhu tāṅre samarpilā svarūpera sthāne
verses.translation: Later, Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī left home and took shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī. At that time, the Lord received him and placed him under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara for spiritual enlightenment.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this regard, Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī writes in
Vilāpa-kusumāñjali
(5):
yo māṁ dustara-geha-nirjala-mahā-kūpād apāra-klamāt
sadyaḥ sāndra-dayāmbudhiḥ prakṛtitaḥ svairīkṛpā-rajjubhiḥ
uddhṛtyātma-saroja-nindi-caraṇa-prāntaṁ prapadya svayaṁ
śrī-dāmodara-sac cakāra tam ahaṁ caitanya-candraṁ bhaje
"Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who, by His unreserved mercy, kindly saved me from household life, which is exactly like a blind well without water, and placed me in the ocean of transcendental joy under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī."

verses.devanagari: ব্রহ্মানন্দ-ভারতীর ঘুচাইল চর্মাম্বর ।\\nএই মত লীলা কৈল ছয় বৎসর ॥২৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: brahmānanda-bhāratīra ghucāila carmāmbara\\nei mata līlā kaila chaya vatsara
verses.translation: Later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped Brahmānanda Bhāratī's habit of wearing deerskin. The Lord thus enjoyed His pastimes continuously for six years, experiencing varieties of transcendental bliss.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিল মধ্যলীলার সূত্রগণ ।\\nশেষ দ্বাদশ বৎসরের শুন বিবরণ ॥২৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahila madhya-līlāra sūtra-gaṇa\\nśeṣa dvādaśa vatsarera śuna vivaraṇa
verses.translation: I have thus given the codes of the madhya-līlā. Now please hear the pastimes the Lord performed during the last twelve years.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Thus Śrīla Kavirāja Gosvāmī, strictly following in the footsteps of Śrī Vyāsadeva, gives a synopsis of the
līlās
of
Caitanya-caritāmṛta.
He has given such a description at the end of each canto. In the
Ādi-līlā
he outlined the pastimes of the Lord in the five stages of boyhood, leaving the details of the description to Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. Now in this chapter the pastimes that took place at the end of the Lord's life are summarized. These are described in the
Madhya-līlā
and
Antya-līlā.
The rest of the pastimes have been described in codes in the Second Chapter of
Madhya-līlā.
In this way the author has gradually described both the
madhya-līlā
and
antya-līlā.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥২৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to the Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Chapter One, summarizing the later pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

sections.title: Chapter 2: The Ecstatic Manifestations of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu

verses.devanagari: বিচ্ছেদেঽস্মিন্ প্ৰভোরন্ত্যলীলা-সূত্রানুবর্ণনে ।\\nগৌরস্য কৃষ্ণবিচ্ছেদপ্ৰলাপাদ্যনুবর্ণ্যতে ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: vicchede 'smin prabhor antya-\\nlīlā-sūtrānuvarṇane\\ngaurasya kṛṣṇa-viccheda-\\npralāpādy anuvarṇyate
verses.translation: While relating in synopsis form the last division of the pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in this chapter I shall describe the Lord's transcendental ecstasy, which appears like madness due to His separation from Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this Second Chapter, the activities of Lord Caitanya that took place after the Lord accepted
sannyāsa
are generally described. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is specifically mentioned here as being
gaura,
or of fair complexion. Kṛṣṇa is generally known to be blackish, but when He is absorbed in the thought of the
gopīs,
who are all of fair complexion, Kṛṣṇa Himself also becomes fair. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in particular felt separation from Kṛṣṇa very deeply, exactly like a lover who is dejected in separation from the beloved. Such feelings, which were expressed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for nearly twelve years at the end of His pastimes, are described in brief in this Second Chapter of
Madhya-līlā.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaitacandra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of the Lord!

verses.devanagari: শেষ যে রহিল প্রভুর দ্বাদশ বৎসর ।\\nকৃষ্ণের বিয়োগ-স্ফূর্তি হয় নিরন্তর ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: śeṣa ye rahila prabhura dvādaśa vatsara\\nkṛṣṇera viyoga-sphūrti haya nirantara
verses.translation: During His last twelve years, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always manifested all the symptoms of ecstasy in separation from Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরাধিকার চেষ্টা যেন উদ্ধব-দর্শনে ।\\nএইমত দশা প্রভুর হয় রাত্রি-দিনে ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rādhikāra ceṣṭā yena uddhava-darśane\\nei-mata daśā prabhura haya rātri-dine
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's state of mind, day and night, was practically identical to Rādhārāṇī's state of mind when Uddhava came to Vṛndāvana to see the gopīs.

verses.devanagari: নিরন্তর হয় প্রভুর বিরহ-উন্মাদ ।\\nভ্রমময় চেষ্টা সদা, প্রলাপময় বাদ ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: nirantara haya prabhura viraha-unmāda\\nbhrama-maya ceṣṭā sadā, pralāpa-maya vāda
verses.translation: The Lord constantly exhibited a state of mind reflecting the madness of separation. All His activities were based on forgetfulness, and His talks were always based on madness.

verses.devanagari: রোমকূপে রক্তোদগম, দন্ত সব হালে ।\\nক্ষণে অঙ্গ ক্ষীণ হয়, ক্ষণে অঙ্গ ফুলে ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: roma-kūpe raktodgama, danta saba hāle\\nkṣaṇe aṅga kṣīṇa haya, kṣaṇe aṅga phule
verses.translation: Blood flowed from all the pores of His body, and all His teeth were loosened. At one moment His whole body became slender, and at another moment His whole body became fat.

verses.devanagari: গম্ভীরা-ভিতরে রাত্রে নাহি নিদ্রা-লব ।\\nভিত্তে মুখ-শির ঘষে, ক্ষত হয় সব ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: gambhīrā-bhitare rātre nāhi nidrā-lava\\nbhitte mukha-śira ghaṣe, kṣata haya saba
verses.translation: The small room beyond the corridor is called the Gambhīrā. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to stay in that room, but He did not sleep for a moment. All night He used to grind His mouth and head on the ground, and His face sustained injuries all over.

verses.devanagari: তিন দ্বারে কপাট, প্রভু যায়েন বাহিরে ।\\nকভু সিংহদ্বারে পড়ে, কভু সিন্ধুনীরে ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: tina dvāre kapāṭa, prabhu yāyena bāhire\\nkabhu siṁha-dvāre paḍe, kabhu sindhu-nīre
verses.translation: Although the three doors of the house were always closed, the Lord would nonetheless go out and sometimes would be found at Jagannātha Temple, before the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra. And sometimes the Lord would fall flat into the sea.

verses.devanagari: চটক পর্বত দেখি’ ‘গোবর্ধন’ ভ্রমে ।\\nধাঞা চলে আর্তনাদ করিয়া ক্রন্দনে ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: caṭaka parvata dekhi' 'govardhana' bhrame\\ndhāñā cale ārta-nāda kariyā krandane
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would also run very fast across the sand hills, mistaking them to be Govardhana. As He ran, He would wail and cry loudly.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Because of the winds of the sea, sometimes the sand would form dunes. Such sand dunes are called
caṭaka parvata.
Instead of seeing these sand dunes simply as hills of sand, the Lord would take them to be Govardhana Hill. Sometimes He would run toward these dunes at high speed, crying very loudly, expressing the state of mind exhibited by Rādhārāṇī. Thus Caitanya Mahāprabhu was absorbed in thoughts of Kṛṣṇa and His pastimes. His state of mind brought Him the atmosphere of Vṛndāvana and Govardhana Hill, and thus He enjoyed the transcendental bliss of separation and meeting.

verses.devanagari: উপবনোদ্যান দেখি’ বৃন্দাবন-জ্ঞান ।\\nতাহাঁ যাই’ নাচে, গায়, ক্ষণে মূর্চ্ছা যা’ন ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: upavanodyāna dekhi' vṛndāvana-jñāna\\ntāhāṅ yāi' nāce, gāya, kṣaṇe mūrcchā yā'na
verses.translation: Sometimes Caitanya Mahāprabhu mistook the small parks of the city for Vṛndāvana. Sometimes He would go there, dance and chant and sometimes fall unconscious in spiritual ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ নাহি শুনি যেই ভাবের বিকার ।\\nসেই ভাব হয় প্রভুর শরীরে প্রচার ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ nāhi śuni yei bhāvera vikāra\\nsei bhāva haya prabhura śarīre pracāra
verses.translation: The extraordinary transformations of the body due to transcendental feelings would never have been possible for anyone but the Lord, in whose body all transformations were manifest.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The ecstatic transformations of the body as described in such exalted literatures as
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
are practically not seen in this material world. However, these symptoms were perfectly present in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. These symptoms are indicative of
mahābhāva,
or the highest ecstasy. Sometimes
sahajiyās
artificially imitate these symptoms, but experienced devotees reject them immediately. The author admits herein that these symptoms are not to be found anywhere but in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: হস্তপদের সন্ধি সব বিতস্তি-প্রমাণে ।\\nসন্ধি ছাড়ি’ ভিন্ন হয়ে, চর্ম রহে স্থানে ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: hasta-padera sandhi saba vitasti-pramāṇe\\nsandhi chāḍi' bhinna haye, carma rahe sthāne
verses.translation: The joints of His hands and legs would sometimes become separated by eight inches, and they remained connected only by the skin.

verses.devanagari: হস্ত, পদ, শির, সব শরীর-ভিতরে ।\\nপ্রবিষ্ট হয় — কূর্মরূপ দেখিয়ে প্রভুরে ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: hasta, pada, śira saba śarīra-bhitare\\npraviṣṭa haya—kūrma-rūpa dekhiye prabhure
verses.translation: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's hands, legs and head would all enter within His body, just like the withdrawn limbs of a tortoise.

verses.devanagari: এই মত অদ্ভুত-ভাব শরীরে প্রকাশ ।\\nমনেতে শূন্যতা, বাক্যে হাহা-হুতাশ ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata adbhuta-bhāva śarīre prakāśa\\nmanete śūnyatā, vākye hā-hā-hutāśa
verses.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to manifest wonderful ecstatic symptoms. His mind appeared vacant, and there were only hopelessness and disappointment in His words.

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ মোর প্রাণনাথ মুরলীবদন ।\\nকাহাঁ করোঁ কাহাঁ পাঙ ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ mora prāṇa-nātha muralī-vadana\\nkāhāṅ karoṅ kāhāṅ pāṅ vrajendra-nandana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to express His mind in this way, "Where is the Lord of My life, who is playing His flute? What shall I do now? Where should I go to find the son of Mahārāja Nanda?

verses.devanagari: কাহারে কহিব, কেবা জানে মোর দুঃখ ।\\nব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন বিনু ফাটে মোর বুক ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāre kahiba, kebā jāne mora duḥkha\\nvrajendra-nandana vinu phāṭe mora buka
verses.translation: "To whom should I speak? Who can understand My disappointment? Without the son of Nanda Mahārāja, My heart is broken."

verses.devanagari: এইমত বিলাপ করে বিহ্বল অন্তর ।\\nরায়ের নাটক-শ্লোক পড়ে নিরন্তর ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata vilāpa kare vihvala antara\\nrāyera nāṭaka-śloka paḍe nirantara
verses.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always expressed bewilderment and lamented in separation from Kṛṣṇa. At such times He used to read the ślokas from Rāmānanda Rāya's drama known as Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমচ্ছেদরুজোঽবগচ্ছতি হরির্নায়ং ন চ প্রেম বা\\nস্থানাস্থানমবৈতি নাপি মদনো জানাতি নো দুর্বলাঃ ।\\nঅন্যো বেদ ন চান্যদুঃখমখিলং নো জীবনং বাশ্রবং\\nদ্বিত্রাণ্যেব দিনানি যৌবনমিদং হাহা বিধে কা গতিঃ ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: prema-ccheda-rujo 'vagacchati harir nāyaṁ na ca prema vā\\nsthānāsthānam avaiti nāpi madano jānāti no durbalāḥ\\nanyo veda na cānya-duḥkham akhilaṁ no jīvanaṁ vāśravaṁ\\ndvi-trāṇy eva dināni yauvanam idaṁ hā-hā vidhe kā gatiḥ
verses.translation: "[Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī used to lament:] 'Our Kṛṣṇa does not realize what we have suffered from injuries inflicted in the course of loving affairs. We are actually misused by love because love does not know where to strike and where not to strike. Even Cupid does not know of our very weakened condition. What should I tell anyone? No one can understand another's difficulties. Our life is actually not under our control, for youth will remain for two or three days and soon be finished. In this condition, O creator, what will be our destination?'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from the
Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka
(3.9), by Rāmānanda Rāya.

verses.devanagari: উপজিল প্রেমাঙ্কুর, ভাঙ্গিল যে দুঃখ-পূর,\\nকৃষ্ণ তাহা নাহি করে পান ।\\nবাহিরে নাগররাজ, ভিতরে শঠের কাজ,\\nপরনারী বধে সাবধান ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: upajila premāṅkura, bhāṅgila ye duḥkha-pūra,\\nkṛṣṇa tāhā nāhi kare pāna\\nbāhire nāgara-rāja, bhitare śaṭhera kāja,\\npara-nārī vadhe sāvadhāna
verses.translation: [Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī spoke thus, in distress due to separation from Kṛṣṇa:] "Oh, what shall I say of My distress? After I met Kṛṣṇa My loving propensities sprouted, but upon separating from Him I sustained a great shock, which is now continuing like the sufferings of a disease. The only physician for this disease is Kṛṣṇa Himself, but He is not taking care of this sprouting plant of devotional service. What can I say about the behavior of Kṛṣṇa? Outwardly He is a very attractive young lover, but at heart He is a great cheat, very expert in killing others' wives."

verses.devanagari: সখি হে, না বুঝিয়ে বিধির বিধান ।\\nসুখ লাগি’ কৈলুঁ প্রীত, হৈল দুঃখ বিপরীত,\\nএবে যায়, না রহে পরাণ ।। ২০ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: sakhī he, nā bujhiye vidhira vidhāna\\nsukha lāgi' kailuṅ prīta, haila duḥkha viparīta,\\nebe yāya, nā rahe parāṇa
verses.translation: [Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī continued lamenting about the consequences of loving Kṛṣṇa:] "My dear friend, I do not understand the regulative principles given by the Creator. I loved Kṛṣṇa for happiness, but the result was just the opposite. I am now in an ocean of distress. It must be that now I am going to die, for My vital force no longer remains. This is My state of mind.

verses.devanagari: কুটিল প্রেমা অগেয়ান, নাহি জানে স্থানাস্থান,\\nভাল-মন্দ নারে বিচারিতে ।\\nক্রূর শঠের গুণডোরে, হাতে-গলে বান্ধি’ মোরে,\\nরাখিয়াছে, নারি’ উকাশিতে ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: kuṭila premā ageyāna, nāhi jāne sthānāsthāna,\\nbhāla-manda nāre vicārite\\nkrūra śaṭhera guṇa-ḍore, hāte-gale bāndhi' more,\\nrākhiyāche, nāri' ukāśite
verses.translation: "By nature loving affairs are very crooked. They are not entered with sufficient knowledge, nor do they consider whether a place is suitable or not, nor do they look forward to the results. By the ropes of His good qualities, Kṛṣṇa, who is so unkind, has bound My neck and hands, and I am unable to get relief.

verses.devanagari: যে মদন তনুহীন, পরদ্রোহে পরবীণ,\\nবাণ সন্ধে অনুক্ষণ ।\\nঅবলার শরীরে, বিন্ধি’ কৈল জরজরে,\\nদুঃখ দেয়, না লয় জীবন ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: ye madana tanu-hīna, para-drohe paravīṇa,\\npāṅca bāṇa sandhe anukṣaṇa\\nabalāra śarīre, vindhi' kaila jarajare,\\nduḥkha deya, nā laya jīvana
verses.translation: "In My loving affairs there is a person named Madana. His qualities are thus: Personally He possesses no gross body, yet He is very expert in giving pains to others. He has five arrows, and fixing them on His bow, He shoots them into the bodies of innocent women. Thus these women become invalids. It would be better if He took My life without hesitation, but He does not do so. He simply gives Me pain.

verses.devanagari: অন্যের যে দুঃখ মনে, অন্যে তাহা নাহি জানে,\\nসত্য এই শাস্ত্রের বিচারে ।\\nঅন্য জন কাহাঁ লিখি, না জানয়ে প্রাণসখী,\\nযাতে কহে ধৈর্য ধরিবারে ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: anyera ye duḥkha mane, anye tāhā nāhi jāne,\\nsatya ei śāstrera vicāre\\nanya jana kāhāṅ likhi, nā jānaye prāṇa-sakhī,\\nyāte kahe dhairya dharibāre
verses.translation: "In the scriptures it is said that one person can never know the unhappiness in the mind of another. Therefore what can I say of My dear friends, Lalitā and the others? Nor can they understand the unhappiness within Me. They simply try to console Me repeatedly, saying, 'Dear friend, be patient.'

verses.devanagari: ‘কৃষ্ণ — কৃপা-পারাবার, কভু করিবেন অঙ্গীকার’,\\nসখি, তোর এ ব্যর্থ বচন ।\\nজীবের জীবন চঞ্চল, যেন পদ্মপত্রের জল,\\nতত দিন জীবে কোন্ জন ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'kṛṣṇa—kṛpā-pārāvāra, kabhu karibena aṅgīkāra'\\nsakhī, tora e vyartha vacana\\njīvera jīvana cañcala, yena padma-patrera jala,\\ntata dina jīve kon jana
verses.translation: "I say, 'My dear friends, you are asking Me to be patient, saying that Kṛṣṇa is an ocean of mercy and that some time in the future He will accept Me. However, I must say that this will not console Me. A living entity's life is very flickering. It is like water on the leaf of a lotus flower. Who will live long enough to expect Kṛṣṇa's mercy?

verses.devanagari: শত বৎসর পর্যন্ত, জীবের জীবন অন্ত,\\nএই বাক্য কহ না বিচারি’ ।\\nনারীর যৌবন-ধন, যারে কৃষ্ণ করে মন,\\nসে যৌবন — দিন দুই-চারি ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: śata vatsara paryanta, jīvera jīvana anta,\\nei vākya kaha nā vicāri'\\nnārīra yauvana-dhana, yāre kṛṣṇa kare mana,\\nse yauvana-dina dui-cāri
verses.translation: “ 'A human being does not live more than a hundred years. You should also consider that the youthfulness of a woman, which is the only attraction for Kṛṣṇa, remains for only a few days.

verses.devanagari: অগ্নি যৈছে নিজ-ধাম, দেখাইয়া অভিরাম,\\nপতঙ্গীরে আকর্ষিয়া মারে ।\\nকৃষ্ণ ঐছে নিজ-গুণ, দেখাইয়া হরে মন,\\nপাছে দুঃখ-সমুদ্রেতে ডারে ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: agni yaiche nija-dhāma, dekhāiyā abhirāma,\\npataṅgīre ākarṣiyā māre\\nkṛṣṇa aiche nija-guṇa, dekhāiyā hare mana,\\npāche duḥkha-samudrete ḍāre
verses.translation: “ 'If you say that Kṛṣṇa is an ocean of transcendental qualities and therefore must be merciful some day, I can only say that He is like fire, which attracts flies by its dazzling brightness and kills them. Such are the qualities of Kṛṣṇa. By showing us His transcendental qualities, He attracts our minds, and then later, by separating from us, He drowns us in an ocean of unhappiness.' "

verses.devanagari: এতেক বিলাপ করি’, বিষাদে শ্রীগৌরহরি,\\nউঘাড়িয়া দুঃখের কপাট ।\\nভাবের তরঙ্গ-বলে, নানারূপে মন চলে,\\nআর এক শ্লোক কৈল পাঠ ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: eteka vilāpa kari', viṣāde śrī-gaurahari,\\nughāḍiyā duḥkhera kapāṭa\\nbhāvera taraṅga-bale, nānā-rūpe mana cale,\\nāra eka śloka kaila pāṭha
verses.translation: In this way, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in a great ocean of sadness, and thus He opened the doors of His unhappiness. Forced by the waves of ecstasy, His mind wandered over transcendental mellows, and in this way He recited another verse [as follows].

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণরূপাদিনিষেবণং বিনা\\nব্যর্থানি মেঽহান্যখিলেন্দ্রিয়াণ্যলম্ ।\\nপাষাণশুষ্কেন্ধনভারকাণ্যহো\\nবিভর্মি বা তানি কথং হতত্রপঃ ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-rūpādi-niṣevaṇaṁ vinā\\nvyarthāni me 'hāny akhilendriyāṇy alam\\npāṣāṇa-śuṣkendhana-bhārakāṇy aho\\nbibharmi vā tāni kathaṁ hata-trapaḥ
verses.translation: “ 'My dear friends, unless I serve the transcendental form, qualities and pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, all My days and all My senses will become entirely useless. Now I am uselessly bearing the burden of My senses, which are like stone blocks and dried wood. I do not know how long I will be able to continue without shame.'

verses.devanagari: বংশীগানামৃত-ধাম, লাবণ্যামৃত-জন্মস্থান,\\nযে না দেখে সে চাঁদ বদন ।\\nসে নয়নে কিবা কাজ, পড়ুক তার মুণ্ডে বাজ,\\nসে নয়ন রহে কি কারণ ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: vaṁśī-gānāmṛta-dhāma, lāvaṇyāmṛta-janma-sthāna,\\nye nā dekhe se cāṅda vadana\\nse nayane kibā kāja, paḍuka tāra muṇḍe vāja,\\nse nayana rahe ki kāraṇa
verses.translation: "Of what use are eyes if one does not see the face of Kṛṣṇa, which resembles the moon and is the birthplace of all beauty and the reservoir of the nectarean songs of His flute? Oh, let a thunderbolt strike his head! Why does he keep such eyes?
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The moonlike face of Kṛṣṇa is the reservoir of nectarean songs and abode of His flute. It is also the root of all bodily beauty. If the eyes of the
gopīs
are not engaged in seeing the beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa, it is better that they be struck by a thunderbolt. For the
gopīs,
to see anything but Kṛṣṇa is uninteresting and, indeed, detestful. The
gopīs
are never pleased to see anything but Kṛṣṇa. The only solace for their eyes is the beautiful moonlike face of Kṛṣṇa, the worshipful object of all senses. When they cannot see the beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa, they actually see everything as vacant, and they desire to be struck by a thunderbolt. They do not find any reason to maintain their eyes when they are bereft of the beauty of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: সখি হে, শুন, মোর হত বিধিবল ।\\nমোর বপু-চিত্ত-মন, সকল ইন্দ্রিয়গণ,\\nকৃষ্ণ বিনু সকল বিফল ।। ৩০ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: sakhī he, śuna, mora hata vidhi-bala\\nmora vapu-citta-mana, sakala indriya-gaṇa,\\nkṛṣṇa vinu sakala viphala
verses.translation: "My dear friends, please hear Me. I have lost all providential strength. Without Kṛṣṇa, My body, consciousness and mind, as well as all My senses, are useless.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের মধুর বাণী, অমৃতের তরঙ্গিণী,\\nতার প্রবেশ নাহি যে শ্রবণে ।\\nকাণাকড়ি-ছিদ্র সম, জানিহ সে শ্রবণ,\\nতার জন্ম হৈল অকারণে ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera madhura vāṇī, amṛtera taraṅgiṇī,\\ntāra praveśa nāhi ye śravaṇe\\nkāṇākaḍi-chidra sama, jāniha se śravaṇa,\\ntāra janma haila akāraṇe
verses.translation: "Topics about Kṛṣṇa are like waves of nectar. If such nectar does not enter one's ear, the ear is no better than the hole of a damaged conchshell. Such an ear is created for no purpose.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this connection, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura quotes the following verses from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(2.3.17-24):
āyur harati vai puṁsām
udyann astaṁ ca yann asau
tasyarte yat-kṣaṇo nīta
uttama-śloka-vārtayā
taravaḥ kiṁ na jīvanti
bhastrāḥ kiṁ na śvasanty uta
na khādanti na mehanti
kiṁ grāme paśavo 'pare
śva-viḍ-varāhoṣṭra-kharaiḥ
saṁstutaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuḥ
na yat-karṇa-pathopeto
jātu nāma gadāgrajaḥ
bile batorukrama-vikramān ye
na śṛṇvataḥ karṇa-puṭe narasya
jihvāsatī dārdurikeva sūta
na copagāyaty urugāya-gāthāḥ
bhāraḥ paraṁ paṭṭa-kirīṭa-juṣṭam
apy uttamāṅgaṁ na namen mukundam
śāvau karau no kurute saparyāṁ
harer lasat-kāñcana-kaṅkaṇau vā
barhāyite te nayane narāṇāṁ
liṅgāni viṣṇor na nirīkṣato ye
pādau nṛṇāṁ tau druma-janma-bhājau
kṣetrāṇi nānuvrajato harer yau
jīvañ-chavo bhāgavatāṅghri-reṇuṁ
na jātu martyo 'bhilabheta yas tu
śrī-viṣṇu-padyā manujas tulasyāḥ
śvasañ chavo yas tu na veda gandham
tad aśma-sāraṁ hṛdayaṁ batedaṁ
yad gṛhyamāṇair hari-nāma-dheyaiḥ
na vikriyetātha yadā vikāro
netre jalaṁ gātra-ruheṣu harṣaḥ
"Both by rising and setting, the sun decreases the duration of life of everyone except one who utilizes the time by discussing topics of the all-good Personality of Godhead. Do the trees not live? Do the bellows of the blacksmith not breathe? All around us, do the beasts not eat and discharge semen? Men who are like dogs, hogs, camels and asses praise those men who never listen to the transcendental pastimes of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the deliverer from evils. One who has not listened to the messages about the prowess and marvelous acts of the Personality of Godhead and has not sung or chanted loudly the worthy songs about the Lord should be considered to possess ears like the holes of snakes and a tongue like that of a frog. The upper portion of the body, though crowned with a silk turban, is only a heavy burden if not bowed down before the Personality of Godhead, who can award
mukti
[freedom]. And the hands, though decorated with glittering bangles, are like those of a dead man if not engaged in the service of the Personality of Godhead Hari. The eyes which do not look at the symbolic representations of the Personality of Godhead Viṣṇu [His forms, name, quality, etc.] are like those printed on the plumes of a peacock, and the legs which do not move to the holy places [where the Lord is remembered] are considered to be like tree trunks. The person who has not at any time received upon his head the dust from the feet of a pure devotee of the Lord is certainly a dead body. And the person who has never experienced the flavor of the
tulasī
leaves from the lotus feet of the Lord is also a dead body, although breathing. Certainly that heart is steel-framed which, in spite of one's chanting the holy name of the Lord with concentration, does not change and feel ecstasy at which time tears fill the eyes and the hairs stand on end."

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের অধরামৃত, কৃষ্ণ-গুণ-চরিত,\\nসুধাসার-স্বাদ-বিনিন্দন ।\\nতার স্বাদ যে না জানে, জন্মিয়া না মৈল কেনে,\\nসে রসনা ভেক জিহ্বা সম ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera adharāmṛta, kṛṣṇa-guṇa-carita,\\nsudhā-sāra-svāda-vinindana\\ntāra svāda ye nā jāne, janmiyā nā maila kene,\\nse rasanā bheka jihvā sama
verses.translation: "The nectar from the lips of Lord Kṛṣṇa and His transcendental qualities and characteristics surpass the taste of the essence of all nectar, and there is no fault in tasting such nectar. If one does not taste it, he should die immediately after birth, and his tongue is to be considered no better than the tongue of a frog.

verses.devanagari: মৃগমদ নীলোৎপল, মিলনে যে পরিমল,\\nযেই হরে তার গর্ব-মান ।\\nহেন কৃষ্ণ-অঙ্গ-গন্ধ, যার নাহি সে সম্বন্ধ,\\nসেই নাসা ভস্ত্রার সমান ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: mṛga-mada nīlotpala, milane ye parimala,\\nyei hare tāra garva-māna\\nhena kṛṣṇa-aṅga-gandha, yāra nāhi se sambandha,\\nsei nāsā bhastrāra samāna
verses.translation: "One's nostrils are no better than the bellows of a blacksmith if he has not smelled the fragrance of Kṛṣṇa's body, which is like the aroma of musk combined with that of the bluish lotus flower. Indeed, such combinations are actually defeated by the aroma of Kṛṣṇa's body.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-কর-পদতল, কোটিচন্দ্র-সুশীতল,\\nতার স্পর্শ যেন স্পর্শমণি ।\\nতার স্পর্শ নাহি যার, সে যাউক্ ছারখার,\\nসেই বপু লৌহ-সম জানি ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-kara-pada-tala, koṭi-candra-suśītala,\\ntāra sparśa yena sparśa-maṇi\\ntāra sparśa nāhi yāra, se yāuk chārakhāra,\\nsei vapu lauha-sama jāni
verses.translation: "The palms of Kṛṣṇa's hands and the soles of His feet are so cool and pleasant that they can be compared only to the light of millions of moons. One who has touched such hands and feet has indeed tasted the effects of touchstone. If one has not touched them, his life is spoiled, and his body is like iron."

verses.devanagari: করি’ এত বিলপন, প্রভু শচীনন্দন,\\nউঘাড়িয়া হৃদয়ের শোক ।\\nদৈন্য-নির্বেদ-বিষাদে, হৃদয়ের অবসাদে,\\nপুনরপি পড়ে এক শ্লোক ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: kari' eta vilapana, prabhu śacī-nandana,\\nughāḍiyā hṛdayera śoka\\ndainya-nirveda-viṣāde, hṛdayera avasāde,\\npunarapi paḍe eka śloka
verses.translation: Lamenting in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu opened the doors of grief within His heart. Morose, humble and disappointed, He read a verse again and again with a despondent heart.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu,
the word
dainya
(humility) is explained as follows: "When unhappiness, fearfulness and the sense of having offended combine, one feels condemned. This sense of condemnation is described as
dīnatā,
humility. When one is subjected to such humility, he feels physically inactive, he apologizes, and his consciousness is disturbed. His mind is also restless, and many other symptoms are visible."1. \ Can you look this quote up and see if it ends where we indicate? \ (1) The word
nirveda
is also explained in the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu:
"One may feel unhappiness and separation, as well as jealousy and lamentation, due to not discharging one's duties. The despondency that results is called
nirveda.
When one is captured by this despondency, thoughts, tears, loss of bodily luster, humility and heavy breathing result."
Viṣāda
is also explained in the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu:
"When one fails to achieve his desired goal of life and repents for all his offenses, there is a state of regret called
viṣāda.
" The symptoms of
avasāda
are also explained: "One hankers to revive his original condition and inquires how to do so. There are also deep thought, heavy breathing, crying and lamentation, as well as a changing of the bodily color and drying up of the tongue."
In the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
thirty-three such destructive symptoms are mentioned. They are expressed in words, in the eyebrows and in the eyes. These symptoms are called
vyabhicārī bhāva,
destructive ecstasy. If they continue, they are sometimes called
sañcārī,
or continued ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: যদা যাতো দৈবান্মধুরিপুরসৌ লোচনপথং\\nতদাস্মাকং চেতো মদনহতকেনাহৃতমভূৎ ।\\nপুনর্যস্মিন্নেষ ক্ষণমপি দৃশোরেতি পদবীং\\nবিধাস্যামস্তস্মিন্নখিলঘটিকা রত্নখচিতাঃ ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: yadā yāto daivān madhu-ripur asau locana-pathaṁ\\ntadāsmākaṁ ceto madana-hatakenāhṛtam abhūt\\npunar yasminn eṣa kṣaṇam api dṛśor eti padavīṁ\\nvidhāsyāmas tasminn akhila-ghaṭikā ratna-khacitāḥ
verses.translation: “ 'If by chance the transcendental form of Kṛṣṇa comes before My path of vision, My heart, injured from being beaten, will be stolen away by Cupid, happiness personified. Because I could not see the beautiful form of Kṛṣṇa to My heart's content, when I again see His form I shall decorate the phases of time with many jewels.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī in the
Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka
(3.11), by Rāmānanda Rāya.

verses.devanagari: যে কালে বা স্বপনে, দেখিনু বংশীবদনে,\\nসেই কালে আইলা দুই বৈরি ।\\n‘আনন্দ’ আর ‘মদন’, হরি’ নিল মোর মন,\\nদেখিতে না পাইনু নেত্র ভরি’ ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: ye kāle vā svapane, dekhinu vaṁśī-vadane,\\nsei kāle āilā dui vairi\\n'ānanda' āra 'madana', hari' nila mora mana,\\ndekhite nā pāinu netra bhari'
verses.translation: "Whenever I had the chance to see Lord Kṛṣṇa's face and His flute, even in a dream, two enemies would appear before Me. They were pleasure and Cupid, and since they took away My mind, I was not able to see the face of Kṛṣṇa to the full satisfaction of My eyes.

verses.devanagari: পুনঃ যদি কোন ক্ষণ, করায় কৃষ্ণ দরশন,\\nতবে সেই ঘটী-ক্ষণ-পল ।\\nদিয়া মাল্যচন্দন, নানা রত্ন-আভরণ,\\nঅলঙ্কৃত করিমু সকল ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ yadi kona kṣaṇa, kayāya kṛṣṇa daraśana\\ntabe sei ghaṭī-kṣaṇa-pala\\ndiyā mālya-candana, nānā ratna-ābharaṇa,\\nalaṅkṛta karimu sakala
verses.translation: "If by chance such a moment comes when I can once again see Kṛṣṇa, then I shall worship those seconds, moments and hours with flower garlands and pulp of sandalwood and decorate them with all kinds of jewels and ornaments."

verses.devanagari: ক্ষণে বাহ্য হৈল মন, আগে দেখে দুই জন,\\nতাঁরে পুছে, — আমি না চৈতন্য?\\nস্বপ্নপ্রায় কি দেখিনু, কিবা আমি প্রলাপিনু,\\nতোমরা কিছু শুনিয়াছ দৈন্য? ॥ ৩৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇe bāhya haila mana, āge dekhe dui jana,\\ntāṅre puche,—āmi nā caitanya?\\nsvapna-prāya ki dekhinu, kibā āmi pralāpinu,\\ntomarā kichu śuniyācha dainya?
verses.translation: In an instant, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu regained external consciousness and saw two persons before Him. Questioning them, He asked, "Am I conscious? What dreams have I been seeing? What craziness have I spoken? Have you heard some expressions of humility?''
verses.purport: PURPORT\nWhen Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus spoke in ecstasy, He saw two persons before Him. One was His secretary, Svarūpa Dāmodara, and the other was Rāya Rāmānanda. Coming to His external consciousness, He saw them both present, and although He was still talking in the ecstasy of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, He immediately began to question whether He was the same Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শুন মোর প্রাণের বান্ধব ।\\nনাহি কৃষ্ণ-প্রেমধন, দরিদ্র মোর জীবন,\\nদেহেন্দ্রিয় বৃথা মোর সব ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: śuna mora prāṇera bāndhava\\nnāhi kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana, daridra mora jīvana,\\ndehendriya vṛthā mora saba
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "My dear friends, you are all My life and soul; therefore I tell you that I possess no wealth of love for Kṛṣṇa. Consequently My life is poverty-stricken. My limbs and senses are useless."

verses.devanagari: পুনঃ কহে, — হায় হায়, শুন, স্বরূপ-রামরায়,\\nএই মোর হৃদয়-নিশ্চয় ।\\nশুনি, করহ বিচার, হয়, নয় — কহ সার,\\nএত বলি’ শ্লোক উচ্চারয় ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ kahe,—hāya hāya, śuna, svarūpa-rāmarāya,\\nei mora hṛdaya-niścaya\\nśuni karaha vicāra, haya, naya—kaha sāra,\\neta bali' śloka uccāraya
verses.translation: Again He addressed both Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāya Rāmānanda, speaking despondently, "Alas! My friends, you can now know the certainty within My heart, and after knowing My heart you should judge whether I am correct or not. You can speak of this properly." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then began to chant another verse.

verses.devanagari: কই অবরহিঅং পেম্মং ণ হি হোই মাণুসে লোএ ।\\nজই হোই কস্স বিরহে হোন্তম্মি কো জীঅই ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: ka-i-avarahi-aṁ pemmaṁ ṇa hi hoi māṇuse loe\\nja-i hoi kassa virahe hontammi ko jīa-i
verses.translation: “ 'Love of Godhead, devoid of cheating propensities, is not possible within this material world. If there is such a love, there cannot be separation, for if there is separation, how can one live?'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse in a common language called
prākṛta,
and the exact Sanskrit transformation is
kaitava-rahitaṁ premā na hi bhavati mānuṣe loke yadi bhavati kasya viraho virahe saty api ko jīvati.

verses.devanagari: অকৈতব কৃষ্ণপ্রেম, যেন জাম্বুনদ-হেম,\\nসেই প্রেমা নৃলোকে না হয় ।\\nযদি হয় তার যোগ, না হয় তবে বিয়োগ,\\nবিয়োগ হৈলে কেহ না জীয়য় ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: akaitava kṛṣṇa-prema, yena jāmbūnada-hema,\\nsei premā nṛloke nā haya\\nyadi haya tāra yoga, nā haya tabe viyoga,\\nviyoga haile keha nā jīyaya
verses.translation: "Pure love for Kṛṣṇa, just like gold from the Jāmbū River, does not exist in human society. If it existed, there could not be separation. If separation were there, one could not live."

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ শচীসুত, শ্লোক পড়ে অদ্ভুত,\\nশুনে দুঁহে এক-মন হঞা ।\\nআপন-হৃদয়-কাজ, কহিতে বাসিয়ে লাজ,\\nতবু কহি লাজবীজ খাঞা ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' śacī-suta, śloka paḍe adbhuta,\\nśune duṅhe eka-mana hañā\\nāpana-hṛdaya-kāja, kahite vāsiye lāja,\\ntabu kahi lāja-bīja khāñā
verses.translation: Thus speaking, the son of Śrīmatī Śacīmātā recited another wonderful verse, and Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara heard this verse with rapt attention. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I feel shameful to disclose the activities of My heart. Nonetheless, I shall be done with all formalities and speak from the heart. Please hear."

verses.devanagari: ন প্রেমগন্ধোঽস্তি দরাপি মে হরৌ\\nক্রন্দামি সৌভাগ্যভরং প্রকাশিতুম্ ।\\nবংশীবিলাস্যাননলোকনং বিনা\\nবিভর্মি যৎ প্রাণপতঙ্গকান্ বৃথা ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: na prema-gandho 'sti darāpi me harau\\nkrandāmi saubhāgya-bharaṁ prakāśitum\\nvaṁśī-vilāsy-ānana-lokanaṁ vinā\\nbibharmi yat prāṇa-pataṅgakān vṛthā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, " 'My dear friends, I have not the slightest tinge of love of Godhead within My heart. When you see Me crying in separation, I am just falsely exhibiting a demonstration of My great fortune. Indeed, not seeing the beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa playing His flute, I continue to live My life like an insect, without purpose.'

verses.devanagari: দূরে শুদ্ধপ্রেমগন্ধ, কপট প্রেমের বন্ধ,\\nসেহ মোর নাহি কৃষ্ণ-পায় ।\\nতবে যে করি ক্রন্দন, স্বসৌভাগ্য প্ৰখ্যাপন,\\nকরি, ইহা জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: dūre śuddha-prema-gandha, kapaṭa premera bandha,\\nseha mora nāhi kṛṣṇa-pāya\\ntabe ye kari krandana, sva-saubhāgya prakhyāpana,\\nkari, ihā jāniha niścaya
verses.translation: "Actually, My love for Kṛṣṇa is far, far away. Whatever I do is actually false. When you see Me cry, I am simply exhibiting My great fortune. Please try to understand this beyond a doubt.

verses.devanagari: যাতে বংশীধ্বনি-সুখ, না দেখি’ সে চাঁদ মুখ,\\nযদ্যপি নাহিক ‘আলম্বন’ ।\\nনিজ-দেহে করি প্রীতি, কেবল কামের রীতি,\\nপ্রাণ-কীটের করিয়ে ধারণ ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: yāte vaṁśī-dhvani-sukha, nā dekhi' se cāṅda mukha,\\nyadyapi nāhika 'ālambana'\\nnija-dehe kari prīti, kevala kāmera rīti,\\nprāṇa-kīṭera kariye dhāraṇa
verses.translation: "Even though I do not see the moonlike face of Kṛṣṇa playing on His flute and although there is no possibility of My meeting Him, still I take care of My own body. That is the way of lust. In this way, I maintain My flylike life.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this connection, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that the lovable Supreme Lord is the supreme shelter. The Lord is the supreme subject, and the devotees are the object. The coming together of a subject and object is called
ālambana.
The object hears, and the subject plays the flute. That the object cannot see the moonlike face of Kṛṣṇa and has no eagerness to see Him is the sign of being without
ālambana.
Externally imagining such a thing simply satisfies one's lusty desires, and thus one lives without purpose.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণপ্রেমা সুনির্মল, যেন শুদ্ধগঙ্গাজল,\\nসেই প্রেমা — অমৃতের সিন্ধু ।\\nনির্মল সে অনুরাগে, না লুকায় অন্য দাগে,\\nশুক্লবস্ত্রে যৈছে মসীবিন্দু ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-premā sunirmala, yena śuddha-gaṅgā-jala,\\nsei premā—amṛtera sindhu\\nnirmala se anurāge, nā lukāya anya dāge,\\nśukla-vastre yaiche masī-bindu
verses.translation: "Love for Lord Kṛṣṇa is very pure, just like the waters of the Ganges. That love is an ocean of nectar. That pure attachment to Kṛṣṇa does not conceal any spot, which would appear just like a spot of ink on a white cloth.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nUnalloyed love of Kṛṣṇa is just like a big sheet of white cloth. Absence of attachment is compared to a black spot on that white cloth. Just as the black spot is prominent, so the absence of love of Godhead is prominent on the platform of pure love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: শুদ্ধপ্রেম-সুখসিন্ধু, পাই তার এক বিন্দু,\\nসেই বিন্দু জগৎ ডুবায় ।\\nকহিবার যোগ্য নয়, তথাপি বাউলে কয়,\\nকহিলে বা কেবা পাতিয়ায় ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: śuddha-prema-sukha-sindhu, pāi tāra eka bindu,\\nsei bindu jagat ḍubāya\\nkahibāra yogya naya, tathāpi bāule kaya,\\nkahile vā kebā pātiyāya
verses.translation: "Unalloyed love of Kṛṣṇa is like the ocean of happiness. If someone gets one drop of it, the whole world can drown in that drop. It is not befitting to express such love of Godhead, yet a madman must speak. However, even though he speaks, no one believes him."

verses.devanagari: এই মত দিনে দিনে, স্বরূপ-রামানন্দ-সনে,\\nনিজ-ভাব করেন বিদিত । ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata dine dine, svarūpa-rāmānanda-sane,\\nnija-bhāva karena vidita\\nbāhye viṣa-jvālā haya, bhitare ānanda-maya,\\nkṛṣṇa-premāra adbhuta carita
verses.translation: In this way, Lord Caitanya used to revel in ecstasy day after day and exhibit these ecstasies before Svarūpa and Rāmānanda Rāya. Externally there appeared severe tribulation, as if He were suffering from poisonous effects, but internally He was experiencing bliss. This is characteristic of transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: এই প্রেমা-আস্বাদন, তপ্ত-ইক্ষু-চর্বণ,\\nমুখ জ্বলে, না যায় ত্যজন ।\\nসেই প্রেমা যাঁর মনে, তার বিক্রম সেই জানে,\\nবিষামৃতে একত্র মিলন ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: ei premā-āsvādana, tapta-ikṣu-carvaṇa,\\nmukha jvale, nā yāya tyajana\\nsei premā yāṅra mane, tāra vikrama sei jāne,\\nviṣāmṛte ekatra milana
verses.translation: If one tastes such love of Godhead, he can compare it to hot sugarcane. When one chews hot sugarcane, his mouth burns, yet he cannot give it up. Similarly, if one has but a little love of Godhead, he can perceive its powerful effects. It can only be compared to poison and nectar mixed together.

verses.devanagari: পীড়াভির্নবকালকূট-কটুতাগর্বস্য নির্বাসনো\\nনিস্যন্দেন মুদাং সুধা-মধুরিমাহঙ্কারসঙ্কোচনঃ ।\\nপ্রেমা সুন্দরি নন্দনন্দনপরো জাগর্তি যস্যান্তরে\\nজ্ঞায়ন্তে স্ফুটমস্য বক্রমধুরাস্তেনৈব বিক্রান্তয়ঃ ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: pīḍābhir nava-kāla-kūṭa-kaṭutā-garvasya nirvāsano\\nnisyandena mudāṁ sudhā-madhurimāhaṅkāra-saṅkocanaḥ\\npremā sundari nanda-nandana-paro jāgarti yasyāntare\\njñāyante sphuṭam asya vakra-madhurās tenaiva vikrāntayaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke, " 'My dear beautiful friend, if one develops love of Godhead, love of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, all the bitter and sweet influences of this love will manifest in one's heart. Such love of Godhead acts in two ways. The poisonous effects of love of Godhead defeat the severe and fresh poison of the serpent. Yet there is simultaneously transcendental bliss, which pours down and defeats the pride of nectar and diminishes its value. In other words, love of Kṛṣṇa is so powerful that it simultaneously defeats the poisonous effects of a snake, as well as the happiness derived from pouring nectar on one's head. It is perceived as doubly effective, simultaneously poisonous and nectarean.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is spoken by Paurṇamāsī to Nāndīmukhī in the
Vidagdha-mādhava
(2.18), by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: যে কালে দেখে জগন্নাথ- শ্রীরাম-সুভদ্রা-সাথ,\\nতবে জানে — আইলাম কুরুক্ষেত্র ।\\nসফল হৈল জীবন, দেখিলুঁ পদ্মলোচন,\\nজুড়াইল তনু-মন-নেত্র ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: ye kāle dekhe jagannātha-śrīrāma-subhadrā-sātha,\\ntabe jāne—āilāma kurukṣetra\\nsaphala haila jīvana, dekhiluṅ padma-locana,\\njuḍāila tanu-mana-netra
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would see Jagannātha along with Balarāma and Subhadrā, He would immediately think that He had reached Kurukṣetra, where all of them had come. He would think that His life was successful because He had seen the lotus-eyed one, whom, if seen, pacifies the body, mind and eyes.

verses.devanagari: গরুড়ের সন্নিধানে, রহি’ করে দরশনে,\\nসে আনন্দের কি কহিব ব’লে ।\\nগরুড়-স্তম্ভের তলে, আছে এক নিম্ন খালে,\\nসে খাল ভরিল অশ্রুজলে ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: garuḍera sannidhāne, rahi' kare daraśane,\\nse ānandera ki kahiba ba'le\\ngaruḍa-stambhera tale, āche eka nimna khāle,\\nse khāla bharila aśru-jale
verses.translation: Staying near the Garuḍa-stambha, the Lord would look upon Lord Jagannātha. What can be said about the strength of that love? On the ground beneath the column of the Garuḍa-stambha was a deep ditch, and that ditch was filled with the water of His tears.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nIn front of the temple of Jagannātha is a column on which the statue of Garuḍa is situated. It is called the Garuḍa-stambha. Behind that column is a ditch, and that ditch was filled with the tears of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: তাহাঁ হৈতে ঘরে আসি’ মাটীর উপরে বসি’,\\nনখে করে পৃথিবী লিখন ।\\nহা-হা কাহাঁ বৃন্দাবন, কাহাঁ গোপেন্দ্রনন্দন,\\nকাহাঁ সেই বংশীবদন ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: tāhāṅ haite ghare āsi', māṭīra upare vasi',\\nnakhe kare pṛthivī likhana\\nhā-hā kāhāṅ vṛndāvana, kāhāṅ gopendra-nandana,\\nkāhāṅ sei vaṁśī-vadana
verses.translation: When coming from the Jagannātha temple to return to His house, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to sit on the ground and mark it with His nails. At such times He would be greatly morose and would cry, "Alas, where is Vṛndāvana? Where is Kṛṣṇa, the son of the King of the cowherd men? Where is that person who plays the flute?"

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ সে ত্রিভঙ্গঠাম, কাহাঁ সেই বেণুগান,\\nকাহাঁ সেই যমুনা-পুলিন ।\\nকাহাঁ সে রাসবিলাস, কাহাঁ নৃত্যগীত-হাস,\\nকাহাঁ প্রভু মদনমোহন ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ se tri-bhaṅga-ṭhāma, kāhāṅ sei veṇu-gāna,\\nkāhāṅ sei yamunā-pulina\\nkāhāṅ se rāsa-vilāsa, kāhāṅ nṛtya-gīta-hāsa,\\nkāhāṅ prabhu madana-mohana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to lament by saying, "Where is Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose form is curved in three places? Where is the sweet song of His flute, and where is the bank of the Yamunā? Where is the rāsa dance? Where is that dancing, singing, and laughing? Where is My Lord, Madana-mohana, the enchanter of Cupid?"

verses.devanagari: উঠিল নানা ভাবাবেগ, মনে হৈল উদ্বেগ,\\nক্ষণমাত্র নারে গোঙাইতে ।\\nপ্রবল বিরহানলে, ধৈর্য হৈল টলমলে,\\nনানা শ্লোক লাগিলা পড়িতে ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: uṭhila nānā bhāvāvega, mane haila udvega,\\nkṣaṇa-mātra nāre goṅāite\\nprabala virahānale, dhairya haila ṭalamale,\\nnānā śloka lāgilā paḍite
verses.translation: In this way various ecstatic emotions evolved, and the Lord's mind filled with anxiety. He could not escape even for a moment. In this way, because of fierce feelings of separation, His patience began to totter, and He began to recite various verses.

verses.devanagari: অমূন্যধন্যানি দিনান্তরাণি হরে ত্বদালোকনমন্তরেণ ।\\nঅনাথবন্ধো করুণৈকসিন্ধো হা হন্ত হা হন্ত কথং নয়ামি ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: amūny adhanyāni dināntarāṇi\\nhare tvad-ālokanam antareṇa\\nanātha-bandho karuṇaika-sindho\\nhā hanta hā hanta kathaṁ nayāmi
verses.translation: “ 'O My Lord, O Supreme Personality of Godhead, O friend of the helpless! You are the only ocean of mercy! Because I have not met You, My inauspicious days and nights have become unbearable. I do not know how I shall pass the time.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from
Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta
(41), by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: তোমার দর্শন-বিনে, অধন্য এ রাত্রি-দিনে,\\nএই কাল না যায় কাটন ।\\nতুমি অনাথের বন্ধু, অপার করুণা-সিন্ধু,\\nকৃপা করি’ দেহ দরশন ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra darśana-vine, adhanya e rātri-dine,\\nei kāla nā yāya kāṭana\\ntumi anāthera bandhu, apāra karuṇā-sindhu,\\nkṛpā kari' deha daraśana
verses.translation: "All these inauspicious days and nights are not passing, for I have not met You. It is difficult to know how to pass all this time. But You are the friend of the helpless and an ocean of mercy. Kindly give Me Your audience, for I am in a precarious position."

verses.devanagari: উঠিল ভাব-চাপল, মন হইল চঞ্চল,\\nভাবের গতি বুঝন না যায় ।\\nঅদর্শনে পোড়ে মন, কেমনে পাব দরশন,\\nকৃষ্ণ-ঠাঞি পুছেন উপায় ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: uṭhila bhāva-cāpala, mana ha-ila cañcala,\\nbhāvera gati bujhana nā yāya\\nadarśane poḍe mana, kemane pāba daraśana,\\nkṛṣṇa-ṭhāñi puchena upāya
verses.translation: In this way, the Lord's restlessness was awakened by ecstatic feelings, and His mind became agitated. No one could understand what course such ecstasy would take. Not being able to meet the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, Lord Caitanya's mind burned. He began to ask Kṛṣṇa of the means by which He could reach Him.

verses.devanagari: ত্বচ্ছৈশবং ত্রিভুবনাদ্ভুতমিত্যবেহি\\nমচ্চাপলঞ্চ তব বা মম বাধিগম্যম্ ।\\nতৎ কিং করোমি বিরলং মুরলীবিলাসি\\nমুগ্ধং মুখাম্বুজমুদীক্ষিতুমীক্ষণাভ্যাম্ ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: tvac-chaiśavaṁ tri-bhuvanādbhutam ity avehi\\nmac-cāpalaṁ ca tava vā mama vādhigamyam\\ntat kiṁ karomi viralaṁ muralī-vilāsi\\nmugdhaṁ mukhāmbujam udīkṣitum īkṣaṇābhyām
verses.translation: “ 'O Kṛṣṇa, O flute-player, the sweetness of Your early age is wonderful within these three worlds. You know My unsteadiness, and I know Yours. No one else knows about this. I want to see Your beautiful attractive face somewhere in a solitary place, but how can this be accomplished?'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is another quote from the
Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta
(32), of Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: তোমার মাধুরী-বল, তাতে মোর চাপল,\\nএই দুই, তুমি আমি জানি ।\\nকাহাঁ করোঁ কাহাঁ যাঙ, কাহাঁ গেলে তোমা পাঙ,\\nতাহা মোরে কহ ত’ আপনি ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra mādhurī-bala, tāte mora cāpala,\\nei dui, tumi āmi jāni\\nkāhāṅ karoṅ kāhāṅ yāṅ, kāhāṅ gele tomā pāṅ,\\ntāhā more kaha ta' āpani
verses.translation: "My dear Kṛṣṇa, only You and I know the strength of Your beautiful features and, because of them, My unsteadiness. Now, this is My position; I do not know what to do or where to go. Where can I find You? I am asking You to give directions."

verses.devanagari: নানা-ভাবের প্রাবল্য, হৈল্য সন্ধি-শাবল্য,\\nভাবে-ভাবে হৈল মহারণ ।\\nঔৎসুক্য, চাপল্য, দৈন্য, রোষামর্ষ আদি সৈন্য,\\nপ্রেমোন্মাদ — সবার কারণ ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: nānā-bhāvera prābalya, haila sandhi-śābalya,\\nbhāve-bhāve haila mahā-raṇa\\nautsukya, cāpalya, dainya, roṣāmarṣa ādi sainya,\\npremonmāda—sabāra kāraṇa
verses.translation: Because of the various kinds of ecstasy, contradictory states of mind occurred, and this resulted in a great fight between different types of ecstasy. Anxiety, impotence, humility, anger and impatience were all like soldiers fighting, and the madness of love of Godhead was the cause.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
it is stated that when similar ecstasies from separate causes meet, they are called
svarūpa-sandhi.
When opposing elements meet, whether they arise from a common cause or different causes, their conjunction is called
bhinna-rūpa-sandhi,
the meeting of contradictory ecstasies. The simultaneous joining of different ecstasies-fear and happiness, regret and happiness-is called meeting (
sandhi
). The word
śābalya
refers to different types of ecstatic symptoms combined together, like pride, despondency, humility, remembrance, doubt, impatience caused by insult, fear, disappointment, patience and eagerness. The friction that occurs when these combine is called
śābalya.
Similarly, when the desire to see the object is very prominent, or when one is unable to tolerate any delay in seeing the desired object, the incapability is called
autsukya,
or eagerness. If such eagerness is present, one's mouth dries up, and he becomes restless. He also becomes full of anxiety, and hard breathing and patience are observed. Similarly, the lightness of heart caused by strong attachment and strong agitation of the mind is called impotence (
cāpalya
). Failure of judgment, misuse of words, and obstinate activities devoid of anxiety are observed. Similarly, when one becomes too angry at the other party, offensive and abominable speech occurs, and this anger is called
roṣa.
When one becomes impatient due to being scolded or insulted, the resultant state of mind is called
amarṣa.
In this state of mind, one perspires, acquires a headache, fades in bodily color and experiences anxiety and an urge to search out the remedy. The bearing of a grudge, aversion and chastisement are all visible symptoms.

verses.devanagari: মত্তগজ ভাবগণ, প্রভুর দেহ — ইক্ষুবন,\\nগজ-যুদ্ধে বনের দলন ।\\nপ্ৰভুর হৈল দিব্যোন্মাদ, তনুমনের অবসাদ,\\nভাবাবেশে করে সম্বোধন ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: matta-gaja bhāva-gaṇa, prabhura deha—īkṣu-vana,\\ngaja-yuddhe vanera dalana\\nprabhura haila divyonmāda, tanu-manera avasāda,\\nbhāvāveśe kare sambodhana
verses.translation: The body of the Lord was just like a field of sugarcane into which the mad elephants of ecstasy entered. There was a fight amongst the elephants, and in the process the entire field of sugarcane was destroyed. Thus transcendental madness was awakened in the body of the Lord, and He experienced despondency in mind and body. In this ecstatic condition, He began to speak as follows.

verses.devanagari: হে দেব হে দয়িত হে ভুবনৈকবন্ধো\\nহে কৃষ্ণ হে চপল হে করুণৈকসিন্ধো ।\\nহে নাথ হে রমণ হে নয়নাভিরাম\\nহা হা কদা নু ভবিতাসি পদং দৃশোর্মে ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: he deva he dayita he bhuvanaika-bandho\\nhe kṛṣṇa he capala he karuṇaika-sindho\\nhe nātha he ramaṇa he nayanābhirāma\\nhā hā kadā nu bhavitāsi padaṁ dṛśor me
verses.translation: “ 'O My Lord! O dearest one! O only friend of the universe! O Kṛṣṇa, O restless one, O ocean of mercy! O My Lord, O My enjoyer, O beloved to My eyes! Alas, when will You again be visible to Me?' "
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis is text 40 of\nKṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta.

verses.devanagari: উন্মাদের লক্ষণ, করায় কৃষ্ণ-স্ফুরণ,\\nভাবাবেশে উঠে প্রণয় মান ।\\nসোল্লুণ্ঠ-বচন-রীতি, মান, গর্ব, ব্যাজ-স্তুতি,\\nকভু নিন্দা, কভু বা সম্মান ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: unmādera lakṣaṇa, karāya kṛṣṇa-sphuraṇa,\\nbhāvāveśe uṭhe praṇaya māna\\nsolluṇṭha-vacana-rīti, māna, garva, vyāja-stuti,\\nkabhu nindā, kabhu vā sammāna
verses.translation: The symptoms of madness served as an impetus for remembering Kṛṣṇa. The mood of ecstasy awoke love, disdain, defamation by words, pride, honor and indirect prayer. Thus Śrī Kṛṣṇa was sometimes blasphemed and sometimes honored.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The word
unmāda
is explained in
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
as extreme joy, misfortune and bewilderment in the heart due to separation. Symptoms of
unmāda
are laughing like a madman, dancing, singing, performing ineffectual activities, talking nonsense, running, shouting and sometimes working in contradictory ways. The word
praṇaya
is explained thus: When there is a possibility to receive direct honor but it is avoided, that love is called
praṇaya.
Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, in his
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi,
explains the word
māna
thus: When the lover feels novel sweetness by exchanging hearty loving words but wishes to hide his feelings by crooked means,
māna
is experienced.

verses.devanagari: তুমি দেব — ক্রীড়া-রত, ভুবনের নারী যত,\\nতাহে কর অভীষ্ট ক্রীড়ন ।\\nতুমি মোর দয়িত, মোতে বৈসে তোমার চিত,\\nমোর ভাগ্যে কৈলে আগমন ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: tumi deva—krīḍā-rata, bhuvanera nārī yata,\\ntāhe kara abhīṣṭa krīḍana\\ntumi mora dayita, mote vaise tomāra cita,\\nmora bhāgye kaile āgamana
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, You are engaged in Your pastimes, and You utilize all the women in the universe according to Your desire. You are so kind to Me. Please divert Your attention to Me, for by fortune You have appeared before Me.

verses.devanagari: ভুবনের নারীগণ, সবা’ কর আকর্ষণ,\\nতাহাঁ কর সব সমাধান ।\\nতুমি কৃষ্ণ — চিত্তহর, ঐছে কোন পামর,\\nতোমারে বা কেবা করে মান ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhuvanera nārī-gaṇa, sabā' kara ākarṣaṇa,\\ntāhāṅ kara saba samādhāna\\ntumi kṛṣṇa—citta-hara, aiche kona pāmara,\\ntomāre vā kebā kare māna
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, You attract all the women of the universe, and You make adjustments for all of them when they appear. You are Lord Kṛṣṇa, and You can enchant everyone, but on the whole, You are nothing but a debauchee. Who can honor You?

verses.devanagari: তোমার চপল-মতি, একত্র না হয় স্থিতি,\\nতা’তে তোমার নাহি কিছু দোষ ।\\nতুমি ত’ করুণাসিন্ধু, আমার পরাণ-বন্ধু,\\nতোমায় নাহি মোর কভু রোষ ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra capala-mati, ekatra nā haya sthiti,\\ntā'te tomāra nāhi kichu doṣa\\ntumi ta' karuṇā-sindhu, āmāra parāṇa-bandhu,\\ntomāya nāhi mora kabhu roṣa
