verses.devanagari: অবধূতের ঝুঠা লাগিল মোর অঙ্গে ।\\nপরম পবিত্র মোরে কৈল এই ঢঙ্গে ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: avadhūtera jhuṭhā lāgila mora aṅge\\nparama pavitra more kaila ei ḍhaṅge
verses.translation: When the rice thrown by Nityānanda Prabhu touched His body, Advaita Ācārya thought Himself purified by the touch of remnants thrown by Paramahaṁsa Nityānanda. Therefore He began dancing.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The word
avadhūta
refers to one above all rules and regulations. Sometimes, not observing all the rules and regulations of a
sannyāsī,
Nityānanda Prabhu exhibited the behavior of a mad
avadhūta.
He threw the remnants of food on the ground, and some of these remnants touched the body of Advaita Ācārya. Advaita Ācārya accepted this happily because He presented Himself as a member of the community of
smārta-brāhmaṇas.
By touching the remnants of food thrown by Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita Ācārya immediately felt Himself purified of all
smārta
contamination. The remnants of food left by a pure Vaiṣṇava are called
mahā-mahā-prasāda.
This is completely spiritual and is identified with Lord Viṣṇu. Such remnants are not ordinary. The spiritual master is to be considered on the stage of
paramahaṁsa
and beyond the jurisdiction of the
varṇāśrama
institution. The remnants of food left by the spiritual master and similar
paramahaṁsas
or pure Vaiṣṇavas are purifying. When an ordinary person touches such
prasāda,
his mind is purified, and his mind is raised to the status of a pure
brāhmaṇa.
The behavior and statements of Advaita Ācārya are meant for the understanding of ordinary people who are unaware of the strength of spiritual values, not knowing the potency of food left by the bona fide spiritual master and pure Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: তোরে নিমন্ত্রণ করি’ পাইনু তার ফল ।\\nতোর জাতি-কুল নাহি, সহজে পাগল ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: tore nimantraṇa kari' pāinu tāra phala\\ntora jāti-kula nāhi, sahaje pāgala
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya jokingly said, "My dear Nityānanda, I invited You, and indeed I have received the results. You have no fixed caste or dynasty. By nature You are a madman.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The words
sahaje pāgala
("by nature a madman") indicate that Nityānanda Prabhu was transcendentally situated on the
paramahaṁsa
stage. Because He always remembered Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa and Their service, this was transcendental madness. Śrī Advaita Ācārya was pointing out this fact.

verses.devanagari: আপনার সম মোরে করিবার তরে ।\\nঝুঠা দিলে, বিপ্র বলি’ ভয় না করিলে ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: āpanāra sama more karibāra tare\\njhuṭhā dile, vipra bali' bhaya nā karile
verses.translation: "To make Me a madman like Yourself, You have thrown the remnants of Your food at Me. You did not even fear the fact that I am a brāhmaṇa."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The words
āpanāra sama
indicate that Advaita Ācārya considered Himself to belong to the
smārta-brāhmaṇas,
and He considered Nityānanda Prabhu to be on the transcendental stage with pure Vaiṣṇavas. Lord Nityānanda gave Advaita Ācārya His remnants to situate Him on the same platform and make Him a pure unalloyed Vaiṣṇava or
paramahaṁsa.
Advaita Ācārya's statement indicates that a
paramahaṁsa
Vaiṣṇava is transcendentally situated. A pure Vaiṣṇava is not subject to the rules and regulations of the
smārta-brāhmaṇas.
That was the reason for Advaita Ācārya's stating,
āpanāra sama more karibāra tare:
"to raise Me to Your own standard." A pure Vaiṣṇava, or a person on the
paramahaṁsa
stage, accepts the remnants of food (
mahā-prasāda
) as spiritual. He does not consider it to be material or sense gratificatory. He accepts
mahā-prasāda
not as ordinary
dāl
and rice but as spiritual substance. To say nothing of the remnants of food left by a pure Vaiṣṇava,
prasāda
is never polluted even if it is touched by the mouth of a
caṇḍāla.
Indeed, it retains its spiritual value. Therefore by eating or touching such
mahā-prasāda,
a
brāhmaṇa
is not degraded. There is no question of being polluted by touching the remnants of such food. Actually, by eating such
mahā-prasāda,
one is freed from all the contaminations of the material condition. That is the verdict of the
śāstra.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ বলে, — এই কৃষ্ণের প্রসাদ ।\\nইহাকে ‘ঝুঠা’ কহিলে, তুমি কৈলে অপরাধ ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda bale,—ei kṛṣṇera prasāda\\nihāke 'jhuṭhā' kahile, tumi kaile aparādha
verses.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu replied, "These are the remnants of food left by Lord Kṛṣṇa. If You take them to be ordinary remnants, You have committed an offense."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In the
Bṛhad-viṣṇu Purāṇa
it is stated that one who considers
mahā-prasāda
to be equal to ordinary rice and
dāl
certainly commits a great offense. Ordinary edibles are touchable and untouchable, but there are no such dualistic considerations where
prasāda
is concerned.
prasāda
is transcendental, and there are no transformations or contaminations, just as there are no contaminations or transformations in the body of Lord Viṣṇu Himself. Thus even if one is a
brāhmaṇa
he is certain to be attacked by leprosy and bereft of all family members if he makes such dualistic considerations. Such an offender goes to hell, never to return. This is the injunction of the
Bṛhad-viṣṇu Purāṇa.

verses.devanagari: শতেক সন্ন্যাসী যদি করাহ ভোজন ।\\nতবে এই অপরাধ হইবে খণ্ডন ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: śateka sannyāsī yadi karāha bhojana\\ntabe ei aparādha ha-ibe khaṇḍana
verses.translation: Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu continued, "If you invite at least one hundred sannyāsīs to Your home and feed them sumptuously, Your offense will be nullified."

verses.devanagari: আচার্য কহে — না করিব সন্ন্যাসি-নিমন্ত্রণ ।\\nসন্ন্যাসী নাশিল মোর সব স্মৃতি-ধর্ম ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya kahe—nā kariba sannyāsi-nimantraṇa\\nsannyāsī nāśila mora saba smṛti-dharma
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya replied, "I shall never again invite another sannyāsī, for it is a sannyāsī who has spoiled all My brahminical smṛti regulations."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ দুই জনে করাইল আচমন ।\\nউত্তম শয্যাতে লইয়া করাইল শয়ন ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' dui jane karāila ācamana\\nuttama śayyāte la-iyā karāila śayana
verses.translation: After this, Advaita Ācārya made the Lords wash Their hands and mouths. He then took Them to a nice bed and made Them lie down to take rest.

verses.devanagari: লবঙ্গ এলাচী-বীজ — উত্তম রসবাস ।\\nতুলসী-মঞ্জরী সহ দিল মুখবাস ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: lavaṅga elācī-bīja—uttama rasa-vāsa\\ntulasī-mañjarī saha dila mukha-vāsa
verses.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya fed the two Lords cloves and cardamom mixed with tulasī flowers. Thus there was a good flavor within Their mouths.

verses.devanagari: সুগন্ধি চন্দনে লিপ্ত কৈল কলেবর ।\\nসুগন্ধি পুষ্পমালা আনি’ দিল হৃদয়-উপর ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: sugandhi candane lipta kaila kalevara\\nsugandhi puṣpa-mālā āni' dila hṛdaya-upara
verses.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya then smeared the bodies of the Lords with sandalwood pulp and then placed very fragrant flower garlands on Their chests.

verses.devanagari: আচার্য করিতে চাহে পাদ-সম্বাহন ।\\nসঙ্কুচিত হঞা প্রভু বলেন বচন ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya karite cāhe pāda-saṁvāhana\\nsaṅkucita hañā prabhu balena vacana
verses.translation: When the Lord lay down on the bed, Advaita Ācārya waited to massage His legs, but the Lord was very hesitant and spoke as follows to Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: বহুত নাচাইলে তুমি, ছাড় নাচান ।\\nমুকুন্দ-হরিদাস লইয়া করহ ভোজন ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: bahuta nācāile tumi, chāḍa nācāna\\nmukunda-haridāsa la-iyā karaha bhojana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Advaita Ācārya, You have made Me dance in various ways. Now give up this practice. Go with Mukunda and Haridāsa and accept Your lunch."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is here telling Advaita Ācārya that it is not befitting for a
sannyāsī
to accept nice beds to lie on or to chew cloves and cardamom and have his body smeared with sandalwood pulp. Nor is it befitting for him to accept fragrant garlands and have his legs massaged by a pure Vaiṣṇava. "You have already made Me dance according to Your vow," Caitanya Mahāprabhu said. "Now please stop it. You can go and take Your lunch with Mukunda and Haridāsa."

verses.devanagari: তবে ত’ আচার্য সঙ্গে লঞা দুই জনে ।\\nকরিল ইচ্ছায় ভোজন, যে আছিল মনে ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: tabe ta' ācārya saṅge lañā dui jane\\nkarila icchāya bhojana, ye āchila mane
verses.translation: Thereupon Advaita Ācārya took prasāda with Mukunda and Haridāsa, and they all wholeheartedly ate as much as they desired.

verses.devanagari: শান্তিপুরের লোক শুনি’ প্রভুর আগমন ।\\nদেখিতে আইলা লোক প্রভুর চরণ ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: śāntipurera loka śuni' prabhura āgamana\\ndekhite āilā loka prabhura caraṇa
verses.translation: When the people of Śāntipura heard that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was staying there, they all immediately came to see His lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: হরি’ ‘হরি’ বলে লোক আনন্দিত হঞা ।\\nচমত্কার পাইল প্রভুর সৌন্দর্য দেখিঞা ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'hari' 'hari' bale loka ānandita hañā\\ncamatkāra pāila prabhura saundarya dekhiñā
verses.translation: Being very pleased, all the people loudly began to shout the holy name of the Lord, "Hari! Hari!" Indeed, they became struck with wonder upon seeing the beauty of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: গৌর-দেহ-কান্তি সূর্য জিনিয়া উজ্জ্বল ।\\nঅরুণ-বস্ত্রকান্তি তাহে করে ঝলমল ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: gaura-deha-kānti sūrya jiniyā ujjvala\\naruṇa-vastra-kānti tāhe kare jhala-mala
verses.translation: They saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's very fair-complexioned body and its bright luster, which conquered the brilliance of the sun. Over and above this was the beauty of the saffron garments that glittered upon His body.

verses.devanagari: আইসে যায় লোক হর্ষে, নাহি সমাধান ।\\nলোকের সঙ্ঘট্টে দিন হৈল অবসান ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: āise yāya loka harṣe, nāhi samādhāna\\nlokera saṅghaṭṭe dina haila avasāna
verses.translation: People came and went with great pleasure. There was no calculating how many people assembled there before the day was over.

verses.devanagari: সন্ধ্যাতে আচার্য আরম্ভিল সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nআচার্য নাচেন, প্রভু করেন দর্শন ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: sandhyāte ācārya ārambhila saṅkīrtana\\nācārya nācena, prabhu karena darśana
verses.translation: As soon as it was evening, Advaita Ācārya began the congregational chanting. He even began to dance Himself, and the Lord saw the performance.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ গোসাঞি বুলে আচার্য ধরিঞা ।\\nহরিদাস পাছে নাচে হরষিত হঞা ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda gosāñi bule ācārya dhariñā\\nharidāsa pāche nāce haraṣita hañā
verses.translation: When Advaita Ācārya began to dance, Nityānanda Prabhu began dancing behind Him. Haridāsa Ṭhākura, being very pleased, also began dancing behind Him.

verses.devanagari: কি কহিব রে সখি আজুক আনন্দ ওর ।\\nচিরদিনে মাধব মন্দিরে মোর ।। ১১৪ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: ki kahiba re sakhī ājuka ānanda ora\\ncira-dine mādhava mandire mora
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya said, " 'My dear friends, what shall I say? Today I have received the highest transcendental pleasure. After many, many days, Lord Kṛṣṇa is in My house.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a song composed by Vidyāpati. Sometimes the word
mādhava
is misunderstood to refer to Mādhavendra Purī. Advaita Ācārya was a disciple of Mādhavendra Purī, and consequently some people think that He was referring to Mādhavendra Purī by using the word
mādhava.
But actually this is not the fact. This song was composed to commemorate the separation of Kṛṣṇa from Rādhārāṇī during Kṛṣṇa's absence in Mathurā. It is thought that this song was sung by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī when Kṛṣṇa returned. It is technically called
Mathurā-viraha.

verses.devanagari: এই পদ গাওয়াইয়া হর্ষে করেন নর্তন ।\\nস্বেদ-কম্প-পুলকাশ্রু-হুঙ্কার-গর্জন ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei pada gāoyāiyā harṣe karena nartana\\nsveda-kampa-pulakāśru-huṅkāra-garjana
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya led the saṅkīrtana party, and with great pleasure He sang this verse. There was a manifestation of ecstatic perspiration, shivering, raised hairs, tears in the eyes and sometimes thundering and bellowing.

verses.devanagari: ফিরি’ ফিরি’ কভু প্রভুর ধরেন চরণ ।\\nচরণে ধরিয়া প্ৰভুরে বলেন বচন ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: phiri' phiri' kabhu prabhura dharena caraṇa\\ncaraṇe dhariyā prabhure balena vacana
verses.translation: While dancing, Advaita Ācārya would sometimes turn around and around and catch the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He then speak to Him as follows.

verses.devanagari: অনেক দিন তুমি মোরে বেড়াইলে ভাণ্ডিয়া ।\\nঘরেতে পাঞাছি, এবে রাখিব বান্ধিয়া ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: aneka dina tumi more beḍāile bhāṇḍiyā\\ngharete pāñāchi, ebe rākhiba bāndhiyā
verses.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya would say, "Many days You escaped Me by bluffing. Now I have You in My home, and I will keep You bound up."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ আচার্য আনন্দে করেন নর্তন ।\\nপ্রহরেক-রাত্রি আচার্য কৈল সঙ্কীর্তন ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' ācārya ānande karena nartana\\nprahareka-rātri ācārya kaila saṅkīrtana
verses.translation: So speaking, Advaita Ācārya performed congregational chanting with great pleasure for three hours that night and danced all the time.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমের উৎকণ্ঠা — প্রভুর নাহি কৃষ্ণ-সঙ্গ ।\\nবিরহে বাড়িল প্রেমজ্বালার তরঙ্গ ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: premera utkaṇṭhā,—prabhura nāhi kṛṣṇa-saṅga\\nvirahe bāḍila prema-jvālāra taraṅga
verses.translation: When Advaita Ācārya danced in that way, Lord Caitanya felt ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, and because of His separation, the waves and flames of love increased.

verses.devanagari: ব্যাকুল হঞা প্রভু ভূমিতে পড়িলা ।\\nগোসাঞি দেখিয়া আচার্য নৃত্য সম্বরিলা ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: vyākula hañā prabhu bhūmite paḍilā\\ngosāñi dekhiyā ācārya nṛtya sambarilā
verses.translation: Being agitated by the ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly fell on the ground. Seeing this, Advaita Ācārya stopped dancing.

verses.devanagari: প্ৰভুর অন্তর মুকুন্দ জানে ভালমতে ।\\nভাবের সদৃশ পদ লাগিলা গাইতে ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura antara mukunda jāne bhāla-mate\\nbhāvera sadṛśa pada lāgilā gāite
verses.translation: When Mukunda saw the ecstasy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he understood the feelings of the Lord and began to sing many stanzas augmenting the force of the Lord's ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: আচার্য উঠাইল প্ৰভুকে করিতে নর্তন ।\\nপদ শুনি’ প্ৰভুর অঙ্গ না যায় ধারণ ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya uṭhāila prabhuke karite nartana\\npada śuni' prabhura aṅga nā yāya dhāraṇa
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya raised the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to help Him dance, but the Lord, after hearing the stanzas sung by Mukunda, could not be held due to His bodily symptoms.

verses.devanagari: অশ্রু, কম্প, পুলক, স্বেদ, গদ্গদ বচন ।\\nক্ষণে উঠে, ক্ষণে পড়ে, ক্ষণেক রোদন ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: aśru, kampa, pulaka, sveda, gadgada vacana\\nkṣaṇe uṭhe, kṣaṇe paḍe, kṣaṇeka rodana
verses.translation: Tears fell from His eyes, and His whole body trembled. His hair stood on end, He perspired heavily, and His words faltered. Sometimes He stood, and sometimes He fell. And sometimes He cried.

verses.devanagari: হা হা প্রাণপ্রিয়সখি, কি না হৈল মোরে ।\\nকানুপ্রেমবিষে মোর তনু-মন জরে ।। ১২৪ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: hā hā prāṇa-priya-sakhī, ki nā haila more\\nkānu-prema-viṣe mora tanu-mana jare
verses.translation: Mukunda sang, " 'My dear intimate friend! What has not happened to me! Due to the effects of the poison of love for Kṛṣṇa, my body and mind have been severely afflicted.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nWhen Mukunda saw that Caitanya Mahāprabhu was feeling ecstatic pain and manifesting ecstatic bodily symptoms, all due to feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa, he sang songs about meeting with Kṛṣṇa. Advaita Ācārya also stopped dancing.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রি-দিনে পোড়ে মন সোয়াস্তি না পাঙ ।\\nযাহাঁ গেলে কানু পাঙ, তাহাঁ উড়ি’ যাঙ ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: rātri-dine poḍe mana soyāsti nā pāṅ\\nyāhāṅ gele kānu pāṅ, tāhāṅ uḍi' yāṅ
verses.translation: “ 'My feeling is like this: My mind burns day and night, and I can get no rest. If there were someplace I could go to meet Kṛṣṇa, I would immediately fly there.' "

verses.devanagari: এই পদ গায় মুকুন্দ মধুর সুস্বরে ।\\nশুনিয়া প্রভুর চিত্ত অন্তরে বিদরে ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei pada gāya mukunda madhura susvare\\nśuniyā prabhura citta antare vidare
verses.translation: This stanza was sung by Mukunda in a very sweet voice, but as soon as Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this stanza, His mind went to pieces.

verses.devanagari: নির্বেদ, বিষাদ হর্ষ, চাপল্য, গর্ব, দৈন্য ।\\nপ্রভুর সহিত যুদ্ধ করে ভাব-সৈন্য ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: nirveda, viṣāda, harṣa, cāpalya, garva, dainya\\nprabhura sahita yuddha kare bhāva-sainya
verses.translation: The transcendental ecstatic symptoms of disappointment, moroseness, pleasure, restlessness, pride and humility all began to fight like soldiers within the Lord.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Harṣa is described in
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu. Harṣa
is experienced when one finally attains the desired goal of life and consequently becomes very glad. When
harṣa
is present, the body shivers, and one's bodily hairs stand on end. There are perspiration, tears and an outburst of passion and madness. The mouth becomes swollen, and one experiences inertia and illusion. When a person attains his desired object and feels very fortunate, the luster of his body increases. Because of his own qualities and feelings of greatness, he does not care for anyone else, and this is called
garva,
or pride. In this condition one utters prayers and does not reply to others' inquiries. Seeing one's own body, concealing one's desires and not heeding the words of others are symptoms visible in the ecstasy of
garva.

verses.devanagari: জর-জর হৈল প্রভু ভাবের প্রহারে ।\\nভূমিতে পড়িল, শ্বাস নাহিক শরীরে ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: jara-jara haila prabhu bhāvera prahāre\\nbhūmite paḍila, śvāsa nāhika śarīre
verses.translation: The entire body of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to totter due to the onslaught of various ecstatic symptoms. As a result, He immediately fell on the ground, and His breathing almost stopped.

verses.devanagari: দেখিয়া চিন্তিত হৈলা যত ভক্তগণ ।\\nআচম্বিতে উঠে প্রভু করিয়া গর্জন ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: dekhiyā cintita hailā yata bhakta-gaṇa\\nācambite uṭhe prabhu kariyā garjana
verses.translation: Upon seeing the condition of the Lord, all the devotees became very anxious. Then, suddenly, the Lord got up and began to make thundering sounds.

verses.devanagari: ‘বল্’ ‘বল্’ বলে, নাচে, আনন্দে বিহ্বল ।\\nবুঝন না যায় ভাব-তরঙ্গ প্রবল ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: 'bal' 'bal' bale, nāce, ānande vihvala\\nbujhana nā yāya bhāva-taraṅga prabala
verses.translation: Upon standing up, the Lord said, "Go on speaking! Go on speaking!" Thus He began to dance, overwhelmed with pleasure. No one could understand the strong waves of this ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ সঙ্গে বুলে প্ৰভুকে ধরিঞা ।\\nআচার্য, হরিদাস বুলে পাছে ত’ নাচিঞা ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda saṅge bule prabhuke dhariñā\\nācārya, haridāsa bule pāche ta', nāciñā
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda began to walk with Caitanya Mahāprabhu to see that He would not fall, and Advaita Ācārya and Haridāsa Ṭhākura followed Them, dancing.

verses.devanagari: এই মত প্ৰহরেক নাচে প্রভু রঙ্গে ।\\nকভু হর্ষ, কভু বিষাদ, ভাবের তরঙ্গে ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata prahareka nāce prabhu raṅge\\nkabhu harṣa, kabhu viṣāda, bhāvera taraṅge
verses.translation: In this way the Lord danced for at least three hours. Sometimes the symptoms of ecstasy were visible, including pleasure, moroseness and many other waves of ecstatic emotional love.

verses.devanagari: তিন দিন উপবাসে করিয়া ভোজন ।\\nউদ্দণ্ড-নৃত্যেতে প্রভুর হৈল পরিশ্রম ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: tina dina upavāse kariyā bhojana\\nuddaṇḍa-nṛtyete prabhura haila pariśrama
verses.translation: The Lord had been fasting for three days, and after that period He took eatables sumptuously. Thus when He danced and jumped high, He became a little fatigued.

verses.devanagari: তবু ত’ না জানে শ্রম প্রেমাবিষ্ট হঞা ।\\nনিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্ৰভুকে রাখিল ধরিঞা ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabu ta' nā jāne śrama premāviṣṭa hañā\\nnityānanda mahāprabhuke rākhila dhariñā
verses.translation: Being fully absorbed in love of Godhead, He would not understand His fatigue. But Nityānanda Prabhu, catching Him, stopped His dancing.

verses.devanagari: আচার্য-গোসাঞি তবে রাখিল কীর্তন ।\\nনানা সেবা করি’ প্রভুকে করাইল শয়ন ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya-gosāñi tabe rākhila kīrtana\\nnānā sevā kari' prabhuke karāila śayana
verses.translation: Although the Lord was fatigued, Nityānanda Prabhu kept Him steady by holding Him. At that time Advaita Ācārya suspended the chanting and, by rendering various services to the Lord, made Him lie down to take rest.

verses.devanagari: এইমত দশদিন ভোজন-কীর্তন ।\\nএকরূপে করি’ করে প্রভুর সেবন ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata daśa-dina bhojana-kīrtana\\neka-rūpe kari' kare prabhura sevana
verses.translation: For ten continuous days Advaita Ācārya held feasting and chanting in the evening. He served the Lord in this way without any change.

verses.devanagari: প্রভাতে আচার্যরত্ন দোলায় চড়াঞা ।\\nভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে আইলা শচীমাতা লঞা ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: prabhāte ācāryaratna dolāya caḍāñā\\nbhakta-gaṇa-saṅge āilā śacīmātā lañā
verses.translation: In the morning Candraśekhara brought Śacīmātā from her house with many devotees, and he seated her in a palanquin.

verses.devanagari: নদীয়া-নগরের লোক — স্ত্রী-বালক-বৃদ্ধ ।\\nসব লোক আইলা, হৈল সংঘট্ট সমৃদ্ধ ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: nadīyā-nagarera loka—strī-bālaka-vṛddha\\nsaba loka āilā, haila saṅghaṭṭa samṛddha
verses.translation: In this way, all the people of the town of Nadia-including all women, boys and old men-came there. Thus the crowd increased.

verses.devanagari: প্রাতঃকৃত্য করি’ করে নাম-সংকীর্তন ।\\nশচীমাতা লঞা আইলা অদ্বৈত-ভবন ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ-kṛtya kari' kare nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nśacīmātā lañā āilā advaita-bhavana
verses.translation: In the morning, after regular duties were completed and the Lord was chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, the people accompanied Śacīmātā to the house of Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: শচী-আগে পড়িলা প্রভু দণ্ডবৎ হঞা ।\\nকান্দিতে লাগিলা শচী কোলে উঠাইঞা ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: śacī-āge paḍilā prabhu daṇḍavat hañā\\nkāndite lāgilā śacī kole uṭhāiñā
verses.translation: As soon as mother Śacī appeared on the scene, Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell before her like a stick. Mother Śacī began to cry, taking the Lord on her lap.

verses.devanagari: দোঁহার দর্শনে দুঁহে হইলা বিহ্বল ।\\nকেশ না দেখিয়া শচী হইলা বিকল ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: doṅhāra darśane duṅhe ha-ilā vihvala\\nkeśa nā dekhiyā śacī ha-ilā vikala
verses.translation: Upon seeing one another, they both became overwhelmed. Seeing the Lord's head without hair, mother Śacī became greatly agitated.

verses.devanagari: অঙ্গ মুছে, মুখ চুম্বে, করে নিরীক্ষণ ।\\nদেখিতে না পায়, — অশ্রু ভরিল নয়ন ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: aṅga muche, mukha cumbe, kare nirīkṣaṇa\\ndekhite nā pāya,—aśru bharila nayana
verses.translation: Out of love she began to smear the body of the Lord Sometimes she kissed His face and tried to observe Him carefully, but because her eyes were filled with tears, she could not see.

verses.devanagari: কান্দিয়া কহেন শচী, বাছারে নিমাঞি ।\\nবিশ্বরূপ-সম না করিহ নিঠুরাই ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: kāndiyā kahena śacī, bāchāre nimāñi\\nviśvarūpa-sama nā kariha niṭhurāi
verses.translation: Understanding that Lord Caitanya had accepted the renounced order of life, Śacīmātā, crying, said to the Lord, "My darling Nimāi, do not be cruel like Viśvarūpa, Your elder brother."

verses.devanagari: সন্ন্যাসী হইয়া পুনঃ না দিল দরশন ।\\nতুমি তৈছে কৈলে মোর হইবে মরণ ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: sannyāsī ha-iyā punaḥ nā dila daraśana\\ntumi taiche kaile mora ha-ibe maraṇa
verses.translation: Mother Śacī continued, "After accepting the renounced order, Viśvarūpa never again gave me audience. If You do like Him, that will certainly be the death of me."

verses.devanagari: কান্দিয়া বলেন প্রভু — শুন, মোর আই ।\\nতোমার শরীর এই, মোর কিছু নাই ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: kāndiyā balena prabhu—śuna, mora āi\\ntomāra śarīra ei, mora kichu nāi
verses.translation: The Lord replied, "My dear mother, please hear. This body belongs to you. I do not possess anything.

verses.devanagari: তোমার পালিত দেহ, জন্ম তোমা হৈতে ।\\nকোটি জন্মে তোমার ঋণ না পারি শোধিতে ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra pālita deha, janma tomā haite\\nkoṭi janme tomāra ṛṇa nā pāri śodhite
verses.translation: "This body was raised by you, and it comes from you. I cannot repay this debt even in millions of births.

verses.devanagari: জানি’ বা না জানি’ কৈল যদ্যপি সন্ন্যাস ।\\nতথাপি তোমারে কভু নহিব উদাস ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: jāni' vā nā jāni' kaila yadyapi sannyāsa\\ntathāpi tomāre kabhu nahiba udāsa
verses.translation: "Knowingly or unknowingly I have accepted this renounced order. Still, I shall never be indifferent to you.

verses.devanagari: তুমি যাহাঁ কহ, আমি তাহাঁই রহিব ।\\nতুমি যেই আজ্ঞা কর, সেই ত’ করিব ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: tumi yāhāṅ kaha, āmi tāhāṅi rahiba\\ntumi yei ājñā kara, sei ta' kariba
verses.translation: "My dear mother, wherever you ask Me to stay I shall stay, and whatever you order I shall execute."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ পুনঃ পুনঃ করে নমস্কার ।\\nতুষ্ট হঞা আই কোলে করে বার বার ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' punaḥ punaḥ kare namaskāra\\ntuṣṭa hañā āi kole kare bāra bāra
verses.translation: Saying this, the Lord offered obeisances to His mother again and again, and mother Śacī, being pleased, took Him again and again on her lap.

verses.devanagari: তবে আই লঞা আচার্য গেলা অভ্যন্তর ।\\nভক্তগণ মিলিতে প্রভু হইলা সত্বর ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: tabe āi lañā ācārya gelā abhyantara\\nbhakta-gaṇa milite prabhu ha-ilā satvara
verses.translation: Then Advaita Ācārya took mother Śacī within the house. The Lord was immediately ready to meet all the devotees.

verses.devanagari: একে একে মিলিল প্রভু সব ভক্তগণ ।\\nসবার মুখ দেখি’ করে দৃঢ় আলিঙ্গন ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: eke eke milila prabhu saba bhakta-gaṇa\\nsabāra mukha dekhi' kare dṛḍha āliṅgana
verses.translation: The Lord met all the devotees one after the other, and looking at everyone's face individually, He embraced them tightly.

verses.devanagari: কেশ না দেখিয়া ভক্ত যদ্যপি পায় দুঃখ ।\\nসৌন্দর্য দেখিতে তবু পায় মহাসুখ ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: keśa nā dekhiyā bhakta yadyapi pāya duḥkha\\nsaundarya dekhite tabu pāya mahā-sukha
verses.translation: Although the devotees were unhappy at not seeing the Lord's hair, they nonetheless derived great happiness from seeing His beauty.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাস, রামাই, বিদ্যানিধি, গদাধর ।\\nগঙ্গাদাস, বক্রেশ্বর, মুরারি, শুক্লাম্বর ॥১৫৩॥\\nবুদ্ধিমন্ত খাঁন, নন্দন, শ্রীধর, বিজয় ।\\nবাসুদেব, দামোদর, মুকুন্দ, সঞ্জয় ॥১৫৪॥\\nকত নাম লইব যত নবদ্বীপবাসী ।\\nসবারে মিলিলা প্রভু কৃপাদৃষ্ট্যে হাসি’ ॥১৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: kata nāma la-iba yata navadvīpa-vāsī\\nsabāre mililā prabhu kṛpā-dṛṣṭye hāsi'
verses.translation: Śrīvāsa, Rāmāi, Vidyānidhi, Gadādhara, Gaṅgādāsa, Vakreśvara, Murāri, Śuklāmbara, Buddhimanta Khāṅ, Nandana, Śrīdhara, Vijaya, Vāsudeva, Dāmodara, Mukunda, Sañjaya and all the others, however many I can mention-indeed, all the inhabitants of Navadvīpa-arrived there, and the Lord met them with smiles and glances of mercy.

verses.devanagari: আনন্দে নাচয়ে সবে বলি’ ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ।\\nআচার্য-মন্দির হৈল শ্রীবৈকুণ্ঠপুরী ॥১৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: ānande nācaye sabe bali' 'hari' 'hari'\\nācārya-mandira haila śrī-vaikuṇṭha-purī
verses.translation: Everyone was chanting the holy names of Hari. and dancing. In this way the domicile of Advaita Ācārya was converted into Śrī Vaikuṇṭha Purī.

verses.devanagari: যত লোক আইল মহাপ্ৰভুকে দেখিতে  ।\\nনানা গ্রাম হৈতে, আর নবদ্বীপ হৈতে ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: yata loka āila mahāprabhuke dekhite\\nnānā-grāma haite, āra navadvīpa haite
verses.translation: People came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu from various other villages nearby, as well as Navadvīpa.

verses.devanagari: সবাকারে বাসা দিল — ভক্ষ্য, অন্নপান  ।\\nবহুদিন আচার্য-গোসাঞি কৈল সমাধান ॥১৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: sabākāre vāsā dila—bhakṣya, anna-pāna\\nbahu-dina ācārya-gosāñi kaila samādhāna
verses.translation: To everyone who came to see the Lord from villages nearby, especially from Navadvīpa, Advaita Ācārya gave residential quarters, as well as all kinds of eatables, for many days. Indeed, He properly adjusted everything.

verses.devanagari: আচার্য-গোসাঞির ভাণ্ডার — অক্ষয়, অব্যয় ।\\nযত দ্রব্য ব্যয় করে তত দ্রব্য হয় ॥১৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya-gosāñira bhāṇḍāra—akṣaya, avyaya\\nyata dravya vyaya kare tata dravya haya
verses.translation: The supplies of Advaita Ācārya were inexhaustible and indestructible. As many goods and commodities as He used, just as many again appeared.

verses.devanagari: সেই দিন হৈতে শচী করেন রন্ধন ।\\nভক্তগণ লঞা প্রভু করেন ভোজন ॥১৬০॥
verses.transliteration: sei dina haite śacī karena randhana\\nbhakta-gaṇa lañā prabhu karena bhojana
verses.translation: From the day Śacīmātā arrived at the house of Advaita Ācārya, she took charge of the cooking, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dined in the company of all the devotees.

verses.devanagari: দিনে আচার্যের প্রীতি — প্রভুর দর্শন ।\\nরাত্রে লোক দেখে প্রভুর নর্তন-কীর্তন ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: dine ācāryera prīti—prabhura darśana\\nrātre loka dekhe prabhura nartana-kīrtana
verses.translation: All the people who came there during the day saw Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the friendly behavior of Advaita Ācārya. At night they had the opportunity to see the Lord's dancing and hear His chanting.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তন করিতে প্রভুর সর্বভাবোদয় ।\\nস্তম্ভ, কম্প, পুলকাশ্রু, গদ্গদ, প্রলয় ॥১৬২॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtana karite prabhura sarva-bhāvodaya\\nstambha, kampa, pulakāśru, gadgada, pralaya
verses.translation: When the Lord performed kīrtana, He manifested all kinds of transcendental symptoms. He appeared stunned and trembling, His hair stood on end, and His voice faltered. There were tears and devastation.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Devastation is described in
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
as a combination of happiness and distress that becomes conspicuous by an absence of any sense of them. In this condition, a devotee falls to the ground, and the subsequent symptoms in the body ensue. These symptoms are mentioned above, and when they become prominent in the body, a state called
pralaya
(devastation) is manifest.

verses.devanagari: ক্ষণে ক্ষণে পড়ে প্রভু আছাড় খাঞা ।\\nদেখি’ শচীমাতা কহে রোদন করিয়া ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇe kṣaṇe paḍe prabhu āchāḍa khāñā\\ndekhi' śacīmātā kahe rodana kariyā
verses.translation: Frequently the Lord would tumble to the ground. Seeing this, mother Śacī would cry.

verses.devanagari: চূর্ণ হৈল, হেন বাসোঁ নিমাঞি-কলেবর  ।\\nহাহা করি’ বিষ্ণু-পাশে মাগে এই বর ॥১৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: cūrṇa haila, hena vāsoṅ nimāñi-kalevara\\nhā-hā kari' viṣṇu-pāśe māge ei vara
verses.translation: Śrīmatī Śacīmātā thought that the body of Nimāi was being smashed when He fell down so. She cried, "Alas!" and petitioned Lord Viṣṇu.

verses.devanagari: বাল্যকাল হৈতে তোমার যে কৈলুঁ সেবন  ।\\nতার এই ফল মোরে দেহ নারায়ণ ॥১৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: bālya-kāla haite tomāra ye kailuṅ sevana\\ntāra ei phala more deha nārāyaṇa
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, kindly bestow this benediction as a result of whatever service I have rendered unto You from my childhood.

verses.devanagari: যে কালে নিমাঞি পড়ে ধরণী-উপরে  ।\\nব্যথা যেন নাহি লাগে নিমাঞি-শরীরে ॥১৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: ye kāle nimāñi paḍe dharaṇī-upare\\nvyathā yena nāhi lāge nimāñi-śarīre
verses.translation: "Whenever Nimāi falls to the surface of the earth, please do not let Him feel any pain."

verses.devanagari: এইমত শচীদেবী বাৎসল্যে বিহ্বল ।\\nহর্ষ-ভয়-দৈন্যভাবে হইল বিকল ॥১৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata śacīdevī vātsalye vihvala\\nharṣa-bhaya-dainya-bhāve ha-ila vikala
verses.translation: When mother Śacī was thus overwhelmed in paternal love for Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, she became transformed with happiness, fear and humility, as well as bodily symptoms.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
These verses indicate that mother Śacī, born in the family of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, used to worship Lord Viṣṇu even before her marriage. As stated in
Bhagavad-gītā
(6:41):
prāpya puṇya-kṛtāṁ lokān
uṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
śucīnāṁ śrīmatāṁ gehe
yoga-bhraṣṭo 'bhijāyate
"The unsuccessful
yogī,
after many, many years of enjoyment on the planets of the pious living entities, is born into a family of righteous people, or into a family of rich aristocracy." Mother Śacī, a
nitya-siddha
living entity, is an incarnation of mother Yaśodā. She appeared in the house of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī and was everlastingly engaged in the service of Lord Viṣṇu. Later she directly had as her child Lord Viṣṇu, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and she served Him from the day of His appearance. This is the position of
nitya-siddha
associates. Śrī Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura therefore sings:
gaurāṅgera saṅgi-gaṇe nitya-siddha kari māne. Every devotee should know that all the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu-His family members, friends and other associates-were all
nitya-siddhas. A nitya-siddha
never forgets the service of the Lord. He is always engaged, even from childhood, in worshiping the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাসাদি যত প্রভুর বিপ্র ভক্তগণ ।\\nপ্রভুকে ভিক্ষা দিতে হৈল সবাকার মন ॥১৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsādi yata prabhura vipra bhakta-gaṇa\\nprabhuke bhikṣā dite haila sabākāra mana
verses.translation: Since Advaita Ācārya was giving alms and food to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the other devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, also desired to give Him alms and invite Him for lunch.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is the duty of all
gṛhasthas
to invite a
sannyāsī
to their homes if he happens to be in the neighborhood or village. This very system is still current in India. If a
sannyāsī
is in the neighborhood of a village, he is invited by all householders, one after another. As long as a
sannyāsī
remains in the village, he enlightens the inhabitants in spiritual understanding. In other words, a
sannyāsī
has no housing or food problems even when he travels extensively. Even though Advaita Ācārya was supplying Caitanya Mahāprabhu with
prasāda,
the other devotees from Navadvīpa and Śāntipura also desired to offer Him
prasāda.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ শচী সবাকারে করিল মিনতি ।\\nনিমাঞির দরশন আর মুঞি পাব কতি ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' śacī sabākāre karila minati\\nnimāñira daraśana āra muñi pāba kati
verses.translation: Hearing these proposals made by other devotees of the Lord, mother Śacī said to the devotees, "How many times shall I get the chance to see Nimāi again?"

verses.devanagari: তোমা-সবা-সনে হবে অন্যত্র মিলন ।\\nমুঞি অভাগিনীর মাত্র এই দরশন ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: tomā-sabā-sane habe anyatra milana\\nmuñi abhāginīra mātra ei daraśana
verses.translation: Śacīmātā submitted, "As far as you are concerned, you can meet Nimāi, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, many times somewhere else, but what is the possibility of my ever meeting Him again? I shall have to remain at home. A sannyāsī never returns to his home."

verses.devanagari: যাবৎ আচার্যগৃহে নিমাঞির অবস্থান ।\\nমুঞি ভিক্ষা দিমু, সবাকারে মাগোঁ দান ॥১৭১॥
verses.transliteration: yāvat ācārya-gṛhe nimāñira avasthāna\\nmuñi bhikṣā dimu, sabākāre māgoṅ dāna
verses.translation: Mother Śacī appealed to all the devotees to give her this charity: As long as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at the house of Advaita Ācārya, only she would supply Him food.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ ভক্তগণ কহে করি’ নমস্কার ।\\nমাতার যে ইচ্ছা সেই সম্মত সবার ॥১৭২॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' bhakta-gaṇa kahe kari' namaskāra\\nmātāra ye icchā sei sammata sabāra
verses.translation: Hearing this appeal from mother Śacī, all the devotees offered obeisances and said, "We all agree to whatever mother Śacī desires."

verses.devanagari: মাতার ব্যগ্রতা দেখি’ প্রভুর ব্যগ্র মন ।\\nভক্তগণ একত্র করি’ বলিলা বচন ॥১৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: mātāra vyagratā dekhi' prabhura vyagra mana\\nbhakta-gaṇa ekatra kari' balilā vacana
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw His mother's great eagerness, He became a little agitated. He therefore assembled all the devotees present and spoke to them.

verses.devanagari: তোমা-সবার আজ্ঞা বিনা চলিলাম বৃন্দাবন ।\\nযাইতে নারিল, বিঘ্ন কৈল নিবর্তন ॥১৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: tomā-sabāra ājñā vinā calilāma vṛndāvana\\nyāite nārila, vighna kaila nivartana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu informed them all, "Without your order, I tried to go to Vṛndāvana. There was some obstacle, however, and I had to return.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি সহসা আমি করিয়াছি সন্ন্যাস ।\\nতথাপি তোমা-সবা হৈতে নহিব উদাস ॥১৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi sahasā āmi kariyāchi sannyāsa\\ntathāpi tomā-sabā haite nahiba udāsa
verses.translation: "My dear friends, although I have suddenly accepted this renounced order, I still know that I shall never be indifferent to you.

verses.devanagari: তোমা-সব না ছাড়িব, যাবৎ আমি জীব’ ।\\nমাতারে তাবত্ আমি ছাড়িতে নারিব ॥১৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: tomā-saba nā chāḍiba, yāvat āmi jība'\\nmātāre tāvat āmi chāḍite nāriba
verses.translation: "My dear friends, as long as I remain manifest, I shall never give you up. Nor shall I be able to give up My mother.

verses.devanagari: সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম নহে — সন্ন্যাস করিয়া ।\\nনিজ জন্মস্থানে রহে কুটুম্ব লঞা ॥১৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: sannyāsīra dharma nahe—sannyāsa kariñā\\nnija janma-sthāne rahe kuṭumba lañā
verses.translation: "After accepting sannyāsa, it is not the duty of a sannyāsī to remain at his birthplace, encircled by relatives.

verses.devanagari: কেহ যেন এই বলি’ না করে নিন্দন ।\\nসেই যুক্তি কহ, যাতে রহে দুই ধর্ম ॥১৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: keha yena ei bali' nā kare nindana\\nsei yukti kaha, yāte rahe dui dharma
verses.translation: "Make some arrangement so that I may not leave you and at the same time people may not blame Me for remaining with relatives after taking sannyāsa."

verses.devanagari: শুনিয়া প্ৰভুর এই মধুর বচন ।\\nশচীপাশ আচার্যাদি করিল গমন ॥১৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: śuniyā prabhura ei madhura vacana\\nśacī-pāśa ācāryādi karila gamana
verses.translation: After hearing Lord Caitanya's statement, all the devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, approached mother Śacī.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর নিবেদন তাঁরে সকল কহিল ।\\nশুনি’ শচী জগন্মাতা কহিতে লাগিল ॥১৮০॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura nivedana tāṅre sakala kahila\\nśuni' śacī jagan-mātā kahite lāgila
verses.translation: When they submitted Lord Caitanya's statement, mother Śacī, who is the mother of the universe, began to speak.

verses.devanagari: তেঁহো যদি ইহাঁ রহে, তবে মোর সুখ ।\\nতাঁ’র নিন্দা হয় যদি, সেহ মোর দুঃখ ॥১৮১॥
verses.transliteration: teṅho yadi ihāṅ rahe, tabe mora sukha\\ntāṅ'ra nindā haya yadi, seha mora duḥkha
verses.translation: Śacīmātā said, "It will be a great happiness for me if Nimāi, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, stays here. But at the same time, if someone blames Him, it will be my great unhappiness."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is a great happiness for a mother if her son does not leave home to search out Kṛṣṇa but remains with her. At the same time, if a son does not search after Kṛṣṇa but simply remains at home, he is certainly blamed by experienced saintly persons. Such blame certainly causes great unhappiness for a mother. If a real mother wants her son to progress spiritually, she had better allow him to go out searching for Kṛṣṇa. The mother naturally desires the welfare of the son. If a mother does not allow her son to search for Kṛṣṇa, she is called
mā,
which indicates
māyā.
By allowing her son to go as a
sannyāsī
and search for Kṛṣṇa, Śacīmātā instructs all mothers of the world. She indicates that all sons should become real devotees of Kṛṣṇa and should not stay at home under the care of an affectionate mother. This is supported by
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(5.5.18):
gurur na sa syāt sva-jano na sa syāt
pitā na sa syāj jananī na sā syāt
daivaṁ na tat syān na patiś ca sa syān
na mocayed yaḥ samupeta-mṛtyum
"No one should become a spiritual master-nor a relative, father, mother, worshipable Deity or husband-if he cannot help a person escape the imminent path of death." Every living entity is wandering within the universe, subjected to the law of
karma
and transmigrating from one body to another and from one planet to another. Therefore the whole Vedic process is meant to save the wandering living entities from the clutches of
māyā
-birth, death, disease and old age. This means stopping the cycle of birth and death. This cycle can be stopped only if one worships Kṛṣṇa. As the Lord says in the
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 4.9):
janma karma ca me divyam
evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma
naiti mām eti so 'rjuna
"One who knows the transcendental nature of My appearance and activities does not, upon leaving the body, take his birth again in this material world, but attains My eternal abode, O Arjuna."
To stop the cycle of birth and death, one has to understand Kṛṣṇa as He is. Simply by knowing Kṛṣṇa, one can stop the process of rebirth into this material world. By acting in Kṛṣṇa consciousness, one can return to Godhead. The highest perfection of life is for a father, mother, spiritual master, husband or any other family member to help others return home, back to Godhead. That is the most preferred welfare activity for the benefit of relatives. Therefore, Śacīmātā, although the mother of Nimāi Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, considered all the facts and decided to allow her son to go out and search for Kṛṣṇa. At the same time, she made some arrangements in order that she might get news of all the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: তাতে এই যুক্তি ভাল, মোর মনে লয় ।\\nনীলাচলে রহে যদি, দুই কার্য হয় ॥১৮২॥
verses.transliteration: tāte ei yukti bhāla, mora mane laya\\nnīlācale rahe yadi, dui kārya haya
verses.translation: Mother Śacī said, "This consideration is good. In my opinion, if Nimāi remains at Jagannātha Purī, He may not leave any one of us and at the same time can remain aloof as a sannyāsī. Thus both purposes are fulfilled.

verses.devanagari: নীলাচলে নবদ্বীপে যেন দুই ঘর ।\\nলোক-গতাগতি-বার্তা পাব নিরন্তর ॥১৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: nīlācale navadvīpe yena dui ghara\\nloka-gatāgati-vārtā pāba nirantara
verses.translation: "Since Jagannātha Purī and Navadvīpa are intimately related-as if they were two rooms in the same house-people from Navadvīpa generally go to Jagannātha Purī, and those in Jagannātha Purī go to Navadvīpa. This going and coming will help carry news of Lord Caitanya. In this way I will be able to get news of Him.

verses.devanagari: তুমি সব করিতে পার গমনাগমন ।\\nগঙ্গাস্নানে কভু হবে তাঁর আগমন ॥১৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: tumi saba karite pāra gamanāgamana\\ngaṅgā-snāne kabhu habe tāṅra āgamana
verses.translation: "All you devotees will be able to come and go, and sometimes He may also come to take His bath in the Ganges.

verses.devanagari: আপনার দুঃখ-সুখ তাহাঁ নাহি গণি ।\\nতাঁর যেই সুখ, তাহা নিজ-সুখ মানি ॥১৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: āpanāra duḥkha-sukha tāhāṅ nāhi gaṇi\\ntāṅra yei sukha, tāhā nija-sukha māni
verses.translation: "I do not care for my personal happiness or unhappiness, but only for His happiness. Indeed, I accept His happiness as my happiness."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ ভক্তগণ তাঁরে করিল স্তবন ।\\nবেদ-আজ্ঞা যৈছে, মাতা, তোমার বচন ॥১৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' bhakta-gaṇa tāṅre karila stavana\\nveda-ājñā yaiche, mātā, tomāra vacana
verses.translation: After hearing Śacīmātā, all the devotees offered her prayers and assured her that her order, like a Vedic injunction, could not be violated.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তগণ প্রভু-আগে আসিয়া কহিল ।\\nশুনিয়া প্ৰভুর মনে আনন্দ হইল ॥১৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-gaṇa prabhu-āge āsiyā kahila\\nśuniyā prabhura mane ānanda ha-ila
verses.translation: All the devotees informed Lord Caitanya of Śacīmātā's decision. Hearing it, the Lord became very pleased.

verses.devanagari: নবদ্বীপ-বাসী আদি যত ভক্তগণ ।\\nসবারে সম্মান করি’ বলিলা বচন ॥১৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: navadvīpa-vāsī ādi yata bhakta-gaṇa\\nsabāre sammāna kari' balilā vacana
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered respects to all the devotees present from Navadvīpa and other towns, speaking to them as follows.

verses.devanagari: তুমি-সব লোক — মোর পরম বান্ধব ।\\nএই ভিক্ষা মাগোঁ, — মোরে দেহ তুমি সব ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: tumi-saba loka—mora parama bāndhava\\nei bhikṣā māgoṅ,—more deha tumi saba
verses.translation: "My dear friends, you are all My intimate friends. Now I am begging a favor of you. Please give it to Me."

verses.devanagari: ঘরে যাঞা কর সদা কৃষ্ণসংকীর্তন ।\\nকৃষ্ণনাম, কৃষ্ণকথা, কৃষ্ণ আরাধন ॥১৯০॥
verses.transliteration: ghare yāñā kara sadā kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana\\nkṛṣṇa-nāma, kṛṣṇa-kathā, kṛṣṇa ārādhana
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested them all to return home and begin chanting the holy name congregationally. He also requested them to worship Kṛṣṇa, chant His holy name and discuss His holy pastimes.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Hare Kṛṣṇa movement, is very nicely explained by Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu authoritatively. It is not that everyone has to take
sannyāsa
like Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Everyone can execute the cult of Kṛṣṇa consciousness at home, as ordered by the Lord. Everyone can congregationally chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra.
One can also discuss the subject matter of
Bhagavad-gītā
and
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
and install Deities of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa or Gaura-Nitāi or both and worship them very carefully in one's own home. It is not that we have to open different centers all over the world. Whoever cares for the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement can install Deities at home and, under superior guidance, worship the Deity regularly, chanting the
mahā-mantra
and discussing
Bhagavad-gītā
and
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
We are actually teaching in our classes how to go about this. One who feels that he is not yet ready to live in a temple or undergo strict regulative principles in the temple-especially householders who live with a wife and children-can start a center at home by installing the Deity, worshiping the Lord morning and evening, chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa and discussing
Bhagavad-gītā
and
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
Anyone can do this at home without difficulty, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested all the devotees present there to do so.

verses.devanagari: আজ্ঞা দেহ নীলাচলে করিয়ে গমন ।\\nমধ্যে মধ্যে আসি’ তোমায় দিব দরশন ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: ājñā deha nīlācale kariye gamana\\nmadhye madhye āsi' tomāya diba daraśana
verses.translation: After thus instructing the devotees, the Lord asked their permission to go to Jagannātha Purī. He assured them that at intervals He would come there and meet them again and again.

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ সবাকারে ঈষৎ হাসিঞা ।\\nবিদায় করিল প্রভু সম্মান করিঞা ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' sabākāre īṣat hāsiñā\\nvidāya karila prabhu sammāna kariñā
verses.translation: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, offering due respects to all the devotees and smiling very mildly, bid them farewell.

verses.devanagari: সবা বিদায় দিয়া প্রভু চলিতে কৈল মন ।\\nহরিদাস কান্দি’ কহে করুণ বচন ॥১৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: sabā vidāya diyā prabhu calite kaila mana\\nharidāsa kāndi' kahe karuṇa vacana
verses.translation: After requesting all the devotees to return home, the Lord decided to go to Jagannātha Purī. At that time Haridāsa Ṭhākura began to cry and speak some pathetic words.

verses.devanagari: নীলাচলে যাবে তুমি, মোর কোন্ গতি ।\\nনীলাচলে যাইতে মোর নাহিক শকতি ॥১৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: nīlācale yābe tumi, mora kon gati\\nnīlācale yāite mora nāhika śakati
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "You are going to Jagannātha Purī, and that is all right, but what will be my destination? I am not able to go to Jagannātha Purī."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Although Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura was born in a Muslim family, he was accepted as a properly initiated
brāhmaṇa.
As such, he had every right to enter the temple of Jagannātha Purī, but because there were some rules and regulations stipulating that only
brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas
and
śūdras
(members of the
varṇāśrama-dharma
system) could enter, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, out of his great humility, did not want to violate these existing rules. He therefore said that he did not have the strength to enter into the temple, and he pointed out that if Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lived within the temple, there would be no way for Haridāsa Ṭhākura to see Him. Later, when Haridāsa Ṭhākura went to Jagannātha Purī, he lived outside the temple on the beach by the sea. A monastery has now been erected there, known as Siddhabakula Maṭha. people go there to see the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: মুঞি অধম তোমার না পাব দরশন ।\\nকেমতে ধরিব এই পাপিষ্ঠ জীবন ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: muñi adhama tomāra nā pāba daraśana\\nkemate dhariba ei pāpiṣṭha jīvana
verses.translation: "Because I am the lowest among men, I shall not be able to see You. How shall I maintain my sinful life?"

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — কর তুমি দৈন্য সম্বরণ ।\\nতোমার দৈন্যেতে মোর ব্যাকুল হয় মন ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—kara tumi dainya saṁvaraṇa\\ntomāra dainyete mora vyākula haya mana
verses.translation: The Lord replied to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, "Please check your humility. Just seeing your humility, very much agitates My mind."

verses.devanagari: তোমার লাগি’ জগন্নাথে করিব নিবেদন ।\\nতোমা-লঞা যাব আমি শ্রীপুরুষোত্তম ॥১৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: tomā lāgi' jagannāthe kariba nivedana\\ntomā-lañā yāba āmi śrī-puruṣottama
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu assured Haridāsa Ṭhākura that He would place a petition before Lord Jagannātha and that He would certainly take him there to Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: তবে ত’ আচার্য কহে বিনয় করিঞা ।\\nদিন দুই-চারি রহ কৃপা ত’ করিয়া ॥১৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: tabe ta' ācārya kahe vinaya kariñā\\ndina dui-cāri raha kṛpā ta' kariñā
verses.translation: After that, Advaita Ācārya respectfully requested Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu to show Him mercy by remaining another two or four days.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যের বাক্য প্রভু না করে লঙ্ঘন ।\\nরহিলা অদ্বৈত-গৃহে, না কৈল গমন ॥১৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryera vākya prabhu nā kare laṅghana\\nrahilā advaita-gṛhe, nā kaila gamana
verses.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu never violated the request of Advaita Ācārya; therefore He remained at His home and did not leave immediately for Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: আনন্দিত হৈল আচার্য, শচী, ভক্ত, সব ।\\nপ্রতিদিন করে আচার্য মহা-মহোৎসব ॥২০০॥
verses.transliteration: ānandita haila ācārya, śacī, bhakta, saba\\nprati-dina kare ācārya mahā-mahotsava
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya's decision was received very happily by Advaita Ācārya, mother Śacī and all the devotees. Advaita Ācārya celebrated every day with a great festival.

verses.devanagari: দিনে কৃষ্ণ-কথা-রস ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nরাত্রে মহা-মহোৎসব সংকীর্তন-রঙ্গে ॥২০১॥
verses.transliteration: dine kṛṣṇa-kathā-rasa bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge\\nrātre mahā-mahotsava saṅkīrtana-raṅge
verses.translation: During the day the devotees discussed subject matters concerning Kṛṣṇa, and at night there was a great festival of congregational chanting at the house of Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: আনন্দিত হঞা শচী করেন রন্ধন ।\\nসুখে ভোজন করে প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণ ॥২০২॥
verses.transliteration: ānandita hañā śacī karena randhana\\nsukhe bhojana kare prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: Mother Śacī cooked with great pleasure, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, along with the devotees, accepted the prasāda with great pleasure.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যের শ্রদ্ধা-ভক্তি-গৃহ-সম্পদ-ধনে ।\\nসকল সফল হৈল প্ৰভুর আরাধনে ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryera śraddhā-bhakti-gṛha-sampada-dhane\\nsakala saphala haila prabhura ārādhane
verses.translation: In this way all the opulences of Advaita Ācārya-His faith, devotion, home, riches and everything else-were successfully utilized in the worship of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Advaita Ācārya set an ideal example for all householder devotees in His receiving of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees and in His execution of a daily festival at His home. If one has the proper means and wealth, he should occasionally invite the devotees of Lord Caitanya, who are engaged in preaching all over the world, and hold a festival at home simply by distributing
prasāda
and talking about Kṛṣṇa during the day and holding congregational chanting for at least three hours in the evening. This procedure must be adopted in all centers of the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement. Thus they will daily perform
saṅkīrtana-yajña.
In
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(11.5.32) the daily performance of
saṅkīrtana-yajña
is recommended for this age (
yajñaiḥ saṅkīrtana-prāyair yajanti hi su-medhasaḥ
). One should worship Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His four associates, the Pañca-tattva, by distributing
prasāda
and holding congregational chanting. Indeed, that
yajña
or sacrifice is most recommended in this Age of Kali. In this age, other
yajñas
are not possible to perform, but this
yajña
can be performed everywhere and anywhere without difficulty.

verses.devanagari: শচীর আনন্দ বাড়ে দেখি’ পুত্রমুখ ।\\nভোজন করাঞা পূর্ণ কৈল নিজসুখ ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: śacīra ānanda bāḍe dekhi' putra-mukha\\nbhojana karāñā pūrṇa kaila nija-sukha
verses.translation: As mother Śacī constantly saw the face of her son and fed Him, her own happiness increased and was indeed complete.

verses.devanagari: এইমত অদ্বৈত-গৃহে ভক্তগণ মিলে ।\\nবঞ্চিলা কতকদিন মহা-কুতূহলে ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata advaita-gṛhe bhakta-gaṇa mile\\nvañcilā kataka-dina mahā-kutūhale
verses.translation: In this way, at Advaita Ācārya's house all the devotees met and passed some days together in a greatly festive mood.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন প্রভু কহে সব ভক্তগণে ।\\nনিজ-নিজ-গৃহে সবে করহ গমনে ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina prabhu kahe saba bhakta-gaṇe\\nnija-nija-gṛhe sabe karaha gamane
verses.translation: The next day, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested all the devotees to return to their respective homes.

verses.devanagari: ঘরে গিয়া কর সবে কৃষ্ণসংকীর্তন ।\\nপুনরপি আমা-সঙ্গে হইবে মিলন ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: ghare giyā kara sabe kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana\\npunarapi āmā-saṅge ha-ibe milana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also asked them to execute the congregational chanting of the holy name of the Lord at their homes, and He assured them that they would be able to meet Him again.

verses.devanagari: কভু বা তোমরা করিবে নীলাদ্রি গমন ।\\nকভু বা আসিব আমি করিতে গঙ্গাস্নান ॥২০৮॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu vā tomarā karibe nīlādri gamana\\nkabhu vā āsiba āmi karite gaṅgā-snāna
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told them, "Sometimes you will come to Jagannātha Purī, and sometimes I shall come bathe in the Ganges."

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ-গোসাঞি, পণ্ডিত জগদানন্দ ।\\nদামোদর পণ্ডিত, আর দত্ত মুকুন্দ ॥২০৯॥\\nএই চারিজন আচার্য দিল প্রভু সনে ।\\nজননী প্ৰবোধ করি’ বন্দিল চরণে ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: ei cāri-jana ācārya dila prabhu sane\\njananī prabodha kari' vandila caraṇe
verses.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya sent four persons-Nityānanda Gosāñi, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Dāmodara Paṇḍita and Mukunda Datta-to accompany the Lord. After pacifying His mother, Śacīmātā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu submitted prayers to her lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: তাঁরে প্রদক্ষিণ করি’ করিল গমন ।\\nএথা আচার্যের ঘরে উঠিল ক্রন্দন ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅre pradakṣiṇa kari' karila gamana\\nethā ācāryera ghare uṭhila krandana
verses.translation: When everything was arranged, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu circumambulated His mother and then started for Jagannātha Purī. In the house of Advaita Ācārya there arose tumultuous crying.

verses.devanagari: নিরপেক্ষ হঞা প্রভু শীঘ্র চলিলা ।\\nকান্দিতে কান্দিতে আচার্য পশ্চাৎ চলিলা ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: nirapekṣa hañā prabhu śīghra calilā\\nkāndite kāndite ācārya paścāt calilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was unaffected. He left swiftly, and Advaita Ācārya followed Him weeping.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura explains, the word
nirapekṣa
means not being affected by anything material and remaining fixed in the service of the Lord. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not very much care for the roaring tumult and cry at the house of Advaita Ācārya, which He heard when starting for Jagannātha Purī. Worldly moralists may criticize Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for being very cruel, but the Lord did not care for such criticism. As the world teacher of this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, He actually showed that a person seriously engaged in Kṛṣṇa consciousness should not be affected by worldly affection. The best course is to engage in rendering service to the Lord and to become callous to material objectives. Externally everyone is attached to material things, but if one becomes entangled in such things, he cannot make progress in Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Therefore those who are engaged in Kṛṣṇa consciousness should not care for the so-called morality of the material world if that morality opposes the service of the Lord. As Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu has personally shown, one cannot properly execute Kṛṣṇa consciousness without being neutral.

verses.devanagari: কত দূর গিয়া প্রভু করি’ যোড় হাত ।\\nআচার্যে প্রবোধি’ কহে কিছু মিষ্ট বাত ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: kata dūra giyā prabhu kari' yoḍa hāta\\nācārye prabodhi' kahe kichu miṣṭa bāta
verses.translation: After He had followed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for some distance, Advaita Ācārya was petitioned by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with folded hands. The Lord spoke the following sweet words.

verses.devanagari: জননী প্ৰবোধি’ কর ভক্ত সমাধান ।\\nতুমি ব্যগ্র হৈলে কারো না রহিবে প্রাণ ॥২১৪॥
verses.transliteration: jananī prabodhi' kara bhakta samādhāna\\ntumi vyagra haile kāro nā rahibe prāṇa
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Please pacify all the devotees and My mother. If You become agitated, no one will be able to continue to exist."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ প্রভু তাঁরে করি’ আলিঙ্গন ।\\nনিবৃত্তি করিয়া কৈল স্বচ্ছন্দ গমন ॥২১৫॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre kari' āliṅgana\\nnivṛtti kariyā kaila svacchanda gamana
verses.translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Advaita Ācārya and stopped Him from following any further. Then, without anxiety, He proceeded to Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: গঙ্গাতীরে-তীরে প্রভু চারিজন-সাথে ।\\nনীলাদ্রি চলিলা প্রভু ছত্রভোগ-পথে ॥২১৬॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā-tīre-tīre prabhu cāri-jana-sāthe\\nnīlādri calilā prabhu chatrabhoga-pathe
verses.translation: The Lord, with the other four persons, went along the banks of the Ganges through the path of Chatrabhoga toward Nīlādri, Jagannātha Purī.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In the southern section of the eastern railway, in the district of twenty-four
pargaṇās,
is a station named Magrāhāṭa. If one goes to the southeastern side of that station for some fourteen miles, there is a place called Jayanagara. About six miles south of this Jayanagara station is a village named Chatrabhoga. Sometimes this village is called Khāḍi. In this village is a Deity of Lord Śiva known as Vaijurkānātha. A festival takes place there every year during the months of March and April. The festival is known as Nandā-melā. At the present moment the Ganges does not flow there. On the same railway line is another station, known as Bāruipura, and near this station is another place, called Āṭisārā. Formerly this village was also situated on the banks of the Ganges. One can go from this village to Pāṇihāṭī and from there to Varāha-nagara, north of Calcutta. In those days the Ganges flowed to the south of Calcutta through Kālī-ghāṭa, which is still known as Ādi-gaṅgā. From Bāruipura, the Ganges branched out and flowed through Diamond Harbor near the Mathurāpura police station. It is to be noted that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed through all these places on His way to Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: ‘চৈতন্যমঙ্গলে’ প্ৰভুর নীলাদ্রি-গমন ।\\nবিস্তারি বর্ণিয়াছেন দাস-বৃন্দাবন ॥২১৭॥
verses.transliteration: 'caitanya-maṅgale' prabhura nīlādri-gamana\\nvistāri varṇiyāchena dāsa-vṛndāvana
verses.translation: In his book known as Caitanya-maṅgala [Caitanya-bhāgavata], Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has elaborately described the Lord's passage to Jagannātha Purī.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nŚrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura states that while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed through Bengal, He passed through Āṭisārā-grāma, Varāha-grāma and Chatrabhoga. He then reached the Orissa province, where He passed through Prayāga-ghāṭa, Suvarṇarekhā, Remuṇā, Yājapura, Vaitaraṇī, Daśāśvamedha-ghāṭa, Kaṭaka, Mahānadī, Bhuvaneśvara (where there is a big lake known as Bindu-sarovara), Kamalapura and Āthāranālā. In this way, passing through all these and other places, He reached Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত-গৃহে প্রভুর বিলাস শুনে যেই জন ।\\nঅচিরে মিলয়ে তাঁরে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-ধন ॥২১৮॥
verses.transliteration: advaita-gṛhe prabhura vilāsa śune yei jana\\nacire milaye tāṅre kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana
verses.translation: If one hears the activities of the Lord at the house of Advaita Ācārya, he will certainly very soon attain the riches of love of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥২১৯॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Third Chapter, describing Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's stay at the house of Advaita Ācārya, His acceptance of the sannyāsa order and observation of daily festivals at Advaita Ācārya's house, His congregationally chanting the holy name of the Lord and His feasting with all the devotees.

sections.title: Chapter 4: Śrī Mādhavendra Purī's Devotional Service

verses.devanagari: যস্মৈ দাতুং চোরয়ন্ ক্ষীরভাণ্ডং\\nগোপীনাথঃ ক্ষীরচোরাভিধোঽভূৎ ।\\nশ্রীগোপালঃ প্রাদুরাসীদ্বশঃ সন্\\nযৎপ্রেম্ণা তং মাধবেন্দ্রং নতোঽস্মি ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: yasmai dātuṁ corayan kṣīra-bhāṇḍaṁ\\ngopīnāthaḥ kṣīra-corābhidho 'bhūt\\nśrī-gopālaḥ prādurāsīd vaśaḥ san\\nyat-premṇā taṁ mādhavendraṁ nato 'smi
verses.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto Mādhavendra Purī, who was given a pot of sweet rice stolen by Śrī Gopīnātha, celebrated thereafter as Kṣīra-corā. Being pleased by Mādhavendra Purī's love, Śrī Gopāla, the Deity at Govardhana, appeared to the public vision.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura annotates that this Gopāla Deity was originally installed by Vajra, the grandson of Kṛṣṇa. Mādhavendra Purī rediscovered Gopāla and established Him on top of Govardhana Hill. This Gopāla Deity is still situated at Nāthadvāra and is under the management of descendants of Vallabhācārya. The worship of the Deity is very luxurious, and one who goes there can purchase varieties of
prasāda
by paying a small price.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় গৌরচন্দ্র জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌড়ভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya gauracandra jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaitacandra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Prabhu! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

verses.devanagari: নীলাদ্রিগমন, জগন্নাথ-দরশন ।\\nসার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য-প্ৰভুর মিলন ॥৩॥\\nএসব লীলা প্ৰভুর দাস বৃন্দাবন ।\\nবিস্তারি’ করিয়াছেন উত্তম বর্ণন ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: e saba līlā prabhura dāsa vṛndāvana\\nvistāri' kariyāchena uttama varṇana
verses.translation: The Lord went to Jagannātha Purī and visited Lord Jagannātha's temple. He also met with Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya. All these pastimes have been very elaborately explained by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura in his book Caitanya-bhāgavata.

verses.devanagari: সহজে বিচিত্র মধুর চৈতন্য-বিহার ।\\nবৃন্দাবনদাস-মুখে অমৃতের ধার ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: sahaje vicitra madhura caitanya-vihāra\\nvṛndāvana-dāsa-mukhe amṛtera dhāra
verses.translation: By nature all the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are very wonderful and sweet, and when they are described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, they become like a shower of nectar.

verses.devanagari: অতএব তাহা বর্ণিলে হয় পুনরুক্তি ।\\nদম্ভ করি’ বর্ণি যদি তৈছে নাহি শক্তি ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva tāhā varṇile haya punarukti\\ndambha kari' varṇi yadi taiche nāhi śakti
verses.translation: Therefore I very humbly submit that since these incidents have already been nicely described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, I would be very proud to repeat the same thing, and this would not be very good. I do not have such powers.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যমঙ্গলে যাহা করিল বর্ণন ।\\nসূত্ররূপে সেই লীলা করিয়ে সূচন ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-maṅgale yāhā karila varṇana\\nsūtra-rūpe sei līlā kariye sūcana
verses.translation: I am therefore presenting in short codes all those events already described in the Caitanya-maṅgala [now known as Caitanya-bhāgavata] by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর সূত্রে আছে, তেঁহ না কৈল বর্ণন ।\\nযথাকথঞ্চিত্ করি’ যে লীলা কথন ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra sūtre āche, teṅha nā kaila varṇana\\nyathā-kathañcit kari' se līlā kathana
verses.translation: Some of the incidents in his codes he did not describe elaborately, and so I shall try to describe them in this book.

verses.devanagari: অতএব তাঁর পায়ে করি নমস্কার ।\\nতাঁর পায় অপরাধ না হউক্ আমার ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva tāṅra pāye kari namaskāra\\ntāṅra pāya aparādha nā ha-uk āmāra
verses.translation: I thus offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. I hope that I will not offend his lotus feet by this action.

verses.devanagari: এইমত মহাপ্রভু চলিলা নীলাচলে ।\\nচারি ভক্ত সঙ্গে কৃষ্ণকীর্তন-কুতূহলে ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata mahāprabhu calilā nīlācale\\ncāri bhakta saṅge kṛṣṇa-kīrtana-kutūhale
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu proceeded toward Jagannātha Purī with four of His devotees, and He chanted the holy name of the Lord, the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, with great eagerness.

verses.devanagari: ভিক্ষা লাগি’ একদিন এক গ্রাম গিয়া ।\\nআপনে বহুত অন্ন আনিল মাগিয়া ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: bhikṣā lāgi' eka-dina eka grāma giyā\\nāpane bahuta anna ānila māgiyā
verses.translation: Each day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally went to a village and collected a great quantity of rice and other grains for the preparation of prasāda.

verses.devanagari: পথে বড় বড় দানী বিঘ্ন নাহি করে ।\\nতা’ সবারে কৃপা করি’ আইলা রেমুণারে ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: pathe baḍa baḍa dānī vighna nāhi kare\\ntā' sabāre kṛpā kari' āilā remuṇāre
verses.translation: There were many rivers on the way, and at each river there was a tax collector. They did not hinder the Lord, however, and He showed them mercy. Finally He reached the village of Remuṇā.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
There is a railway station named Baleśvara, and five miles to the west is a village named Remuṇā. The temple of Kṣīra-corā-gopīnātha still exists in this village, and within the temple the
samādhi
tomb of Rasikānanda Prabhu, the chief disciple of Śyāmānanda Gosvāmī, can still be found.

verses.devanagari: রেমুণাতে গোপীনাথ পরম-মোহন ।\\nভক্তি করি’ কৈল প্রভু তাঁর দরশন ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: remuṇāte gopīnātha parama-mohana\\nbhakti kari' kaila prabhu tāṅra daraśana
verses.translation: The Deity of Gopīnātha in the temple at Remuṇā was very attractive. Lord Caitanya visited the temple and offered His obeisances with great devotion.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর পাদপদ্ম নিকট প্রণাম করিতে ।\\nতাঁর পুষ্প-চূড়া পড়িল প্ৰভুর মাথাতে ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra pāda-padma nikaṭa praṇāma karite\\ntāṅra puṣpa-cūḍā paḍila prabhura māthāte
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered His obeisances at the lotus feet of the Gopīnātha Deity, the helmet of flowers on the head of Gopīnātha fell down and landed on the head of Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: চূড়া পাঞা মহাপ্ৰভুর আনন্দিত মন ।\\nবহু নৃত্যগীত কৈল লঞা ভক্তগণ ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: cūḍā pāñā mahāprabhura ānandita mana\\nbahu nṛtya-gīta kaila lañā bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: When the Deity's helmet fell upon His head, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very pleased, and thus He chanted and danced in various ways with His devotees.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর প্রভাব দেখি’ প্রেম-রূপ-গুণ ।\\nবিস্মিত হইলা গোপীনাথের দাসগণ ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura prabhāva dekhi' prema-rūpa-guṇa\\nvismita ha-ilā gopīnāthera dāsa-gaṇa
verses.translation: All the servants of the Deity were struck with wonder due to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's intense love, His exquisite beauty and His transcendental qualities.

verses.devanagari: নানারূপে প্রীত্যে কৈল প্রভুর সেবন ।\\nসেই রাত্রি তাহাঁ প্রভু করিলা বঞ্চন ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: nānā-rūpe prītye kaila prabhura sevana\\nsei rātri tāhāṅ prabhu karilā vañcana
verses.translation: Because of their love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they served Him in many ways, and that night the Lord stayed at the temple of Gopīnātha.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রসাদ-ক্ষীর-লোভে রহিলা প্রভু তথা ।\\nপূর্বে ঈশ্বরপুরী তাঁরে কহিয়াছেন কথা ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprasāda-kṣīra-lobhe rahilā prabhu tathā\\npūrve īśvara-purī tāṅre kahiyāchena kathā
verses.translation: The Lord remained there because He was very eager to receive the remnants of sweet rice offered to the Gopīnātha Deity, having heard a narration from His spiritual master, Īśvara Purī, of what had once happened there.

verses.devanagari: ‘ক্ষীরচোরা গোপীনাথ’ প্রসিদ্ধ তাঁর নাম ।\\nভক্তগণে কহে প্রভু সেই ত’ আখ্যান ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'kṣīra-corā gopīnātha' prasiddha tāṅra nāma\\nbhakta-gaṇe kahe prabhu sei ta' ākhyāna
verses.translation: That Deity was known widely as Kṣīra-corā-gopīnātha, and Caitanya Mahāprabhu told His devotees the story of how the Deity became so famous.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে মাধবপুরীর লাগি’ ক্ষীর কৈল চুরি ।\\nঅতএব নাম হৈল ‘ক্ষীরচোরা হরি’ ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve mādhava-purīra lāgi' kṣīra kaila curi\\nataeva nāma haila 'kṣīra-corā hari'
verses.translation: Formerly the Deity had stolen a pot of sweet rice for Mādhavendra Purī; therefore He became very famous as the Lord who stole the sweet rice.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে শ্ৰীমাধব-পুরী আইলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে গেলা গিরি গোবর্ধন ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve śrī-mādhava-purī āilā vṛndāvana\\nbhramite, bhramite gelā giri govardhana
verses.translation: Once, Śrī Mādhavendra Purī traveled to Vṛndāvana, where he came upon the hill known as Govardhana.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমে মত্ত, — নাহি তাঁর রাত্রিদিন-জ্ঞান ।\\nক্ষণে উঠে, ক্ষণে পড়ে, নাহি স্থানাস্থান ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: preme matta,—nāhi tāṅra rātri-dina-jñāna\\nkṣaṇe uṭhe, kṣaṇe paḍe, nāhi sthānāsthāna
verses.translation: Mādhavendra Purī was almost mad in his ecstasy of love of Godhead, and he did not know whether it was day or night. Sometimes he stood up, and sometimes he fell to the ground. He could not discriminate whether he was in a proper place or not.

verses.devanagari: শৈল পরিক্রমা করি’ গোবিন্দকুণ্ডে আসি’ ।\\nস্নান করি, বৃক্ষতলে আছে সন্ধ্যায় বসি’ ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: śaila parikramā kari' govinda-kuṇḍe āsi'\\nsnāna kari, vṛkṣa-tale āche sandhyāya vasi'
verses.translation: After circumambulating the hill, Mādhavendra Purī went to Govinda-kuṇḍa and took his bath. He then sat beneath a tree to take his evening rest.

verses.devanagari: গোপাল-বালক এক দুগ্ধ-ভাণ্ড লঞা ।\\nআসি’ আগে ধরি’ কিছু বলিল হাসিয়া ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: gopāla-bālaka eka dugdha-bhāṇḍa lañā\\nāsi' āge dhari' kichu balila hāsiyā
verses.translation: While he was sitting beneath a tree, an unknown cowherd boy came with a pot of milk, placed it before Mādhavendra Purī and, smiling, addressed him as follows.

verses.devanagari: পুরী, এই দুগ্ধ লঞা কর তুমি পান ।\\nমাগি’ কেনে নাহি খাও, কিবা কর ধ্যান ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: purī, ei dugdha lañā kara tumi pāna\\nmāgi' kene nāhi khāo, kibā kara dhyāna
verses.translation: "O Mādhavendra Purī, please drink the milk I have brought. Why don't you beg some food to eat? What kind of meditation are you undergoing?"

verses.devanagari: বালকের সৌন্দর্যে পুরীর হইল সন্তোষ ।\\nতাহার মধুর-বাক্যে গেল ভোক-শোষ ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: bālakera saundarye purīra ha-ila santoṣa\\ntāhāra madhura-vākye gela bhoka-śoṣa
verses.translation: When he saw the beauty of that boy, Mādhavendra Purī became very satisfied. Hearing His sweet words, he forgot all hunger and thirst.

verses.devanagari: পুরী কহে, — কে তুমি, কাহাঁ তোমার বাস ।\\nকেমতে জানিলে, আমি করি উপবাস ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: purī kahe,—ke tumi, kāhāṅ tomāra vāsa\\nke-mate jānile, āmi kari upavāsa
verses.translation: Mādhavendra Purī said, "Who are You ? Where do You reside? And how did You know that I was fasting?"

verses.devanagari: বালক কহে, — গোপ আমি, এই গ্রামে বসি ।\\nআমার গ্রামেতে কেহ না রহে উপবাসী ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: bālaka kahe,—gopa āmi, ei grāme vasi\\nāmāra grāmete keha nā rahe upavāsī
verses.translation: The boy replied, "Sir, I am a cowherd boy, and I reside in this village. In My village, no one fasts.

verses.devanagari: কেহ অন্ন মাগি’ খায়, কেহ দুগ্ধাহার ।\\nঅযাচক-জনে আমি দিয়ে ত’ আহার ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: keha anna māgi' khāya, keha dugdhāhāra\\nayācaka-jane āmi diye ta' āhāra
verses.translation: "In this village a person can beg food from others and thus eat. Some people drink only milk, but if a person does not ask anyone for food, I supply him all his eatables.

verses.devanagari: জল নিতে স্ত্রীগণ তোমারে দেখি’ গেল ।\\nস্ত্রীসব দুগ্ধ দিয়া আমারে পাঠাইল ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: jala nite strī-gaṇa tomāre dekhi' gela\\nstrī-saba dugdha diyā āmāre pāṭhāila
verses.translation: "The women who come here to take water saw you, and they supplied Me with this milk and sent Me to you."

verses.devanagari: গোদোহন করিতে চাহি, শীঘ্র আমি যাব ।\\nআরবার আসি আমি এই ভাণ্ড লইব ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: go-dohana karite cāhi, śīghra āmi yāba\\nāra-bāra āsi āmi ei bhāṇḍa la-iba
verses.translation: The boy continued, "I must go very soon to milk the cows, but I shall return and take back this milk pot from you."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ গেলা বালক না দেখিয়ে আর ।\\nমাধব-পুরীর চিত্তে হইল চমৎকার ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' gelā bālaka nā dekhiye āra\\nmādhava-purīra citte ha-ila camatkāra
verses.translation: Saying this, the boy left the place. Indeed, He suddenly could be seen no more, and Mādhavendra Purī's heart was filled with wonder.

verses.devanagari: দুগ্ধ পান করি’ ভাণ্ড ধুঞা রাখিল ।\\nবাট দেখে, সে বালক পুনঃ না আইল ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: dugdha pāna kari' bhāṇḍa dhuñā rākhila\\nbāṭa dekhe, se bālaka punaḥ nā āila
verses.translation: After drinking the milk, Mādhavendra Purī washed the pot and put it aside. He looked toward the path, but the boy never returned.

verses.devanagari: বসি’ নাম লয় পুরী, নিদ্রা নাহি হয় ।\\nশেষরাত্রে তন্দ্রা হৈল, — বাহ্যবৃত্তি-লয় ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: vasi' nāma laya purī, nidrā nāhi haya\\nśeṣa-rātre tandrā haila,—bāhya-vṛtti-laya
verses.translation: Mādhavendra Purī could not sleep. He sat and chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, and at the end of the night he dozed a little, and his external activities stopped.

verses.devanagari: স্বপ্নে দেখে, সেই বালক সম্মুখে আসিঞা ।\\nএক কুঞ্জে লঞা গেল হাতেতে ধরিঞা ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: svapne dekhe, sei bālaka sammukhe āsiñā\\neka kuñje lañā gela hātete dhariñā
verses.translation: In a dream Mādhavendra Purī saw the very same boy. The boy came before him and, holding his hand, took him to a bush in the jungle.

verses.devanagari: কুঞ্জ দেখাঞা কহে, — আমি এই কুঞ্জে রই ।\\nশীত-বৃষ্টি-বাতাগ্নিতে মহা-দুঃখ পাই ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: kuñja dekhāñā kahe,—āmi ei kuñje ra-i\\nśīta-vṛṣṭi-vātāgnite mahā-duḥkha pāi
verses.translation: The boy showed Mādhavendra Purī the bush and said, "I reside in this bush, and because of this I suffer very much from severe cold, rain showers, winds and scorching heat.

verses.devanagari: গ্রামের লোক আনি’ আমা কাঢ়’ কুঞ্জ হৈতে ।\\nপর্বত-উপরি লঞা রাখ ভালমতে ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: grāmera loka āni' āmā kāḍha' kuñja haite\\nparvata-upari lañā rākha bhāla-mate
verses.translation: "Please bring the people of the village and get them to take Me out of this bush. Then have them situate Me nicely on top of the hill.

verses.devanagari: এক মঠ করি’ তাহাঁ করহ স্থাপন ।\\nবহু শীতল জলে কর শ্রীঅঙ্গ মার্জন ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: eka maṭha kari' tāhāṅ karaha sthāpana\\nbahu śītala jale kara śrī-aṅga mārjana
verses.translation: "Please construct a temple on top of that hill," the boy continued, "and install Me in that temple. After this, wash Me with large quantities of cold water so that My body may be cleansed.

verses.devanagari: বহুদিন তোমার পথ করি নিরীক্ষণ ।\\nকবে আসি’ মাধব আমা করিবে সেবন ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: bahu-dina tomāra patha kari nirīkṣaṇa\\nkabe āsi' mādhava āmā karibe sevana
verses.translation: "For many days I have been observing you, and I have been wondering, 'When will Mādhavendra Purī come here to serve Me?'

verses.devanagari: তোমার প্রেমবশে করি’ সেবা অঙ্গীকার ।\\nদর্শন দিয়া নিস্তারিব সকল সংসার ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra prema-vaśe kari' sevā aṅgīkāra\\ndarśana diyā nistāriba sakala saṁsāra
verses.translation: "I have accepted your service due to your ecstatic love for Me. Thus I shall appear, and by My audience all fallen souls will be delivered.

verses.devanagari: ‘শ্রীগোপাল’ নাম মোর, — গোবর্ধনধারী ।\\nবজ্রের স্থাপিত, আমি ইহাঁ অধিকারী ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: 'śrī-gopāla' nāma mora,—govardhana-dhārī\\nvajrera sthāpita, āmi ihāṅ adhikārī
verses.translation: "My name is Gopāla. I am the lifter of Govardhana Hill. I was installed by Vajra, and here I am the authority.

verses.devanagari: শৈল-উপরি হৈতে আমা কুঞ্জে লুকাঞা ।\\nম্লেচ্ছ-ভয়ে সেবক মোর গেল পলাঞা ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: śaila-upari haite āmā kuñje lukāñā\\nmleccha-bhaye sevaka mora gela palāñā
verses.translation: "When the Mohammedans attacked, the priest who was serving Me hid Me in this bush in the jungle. Then he ran away out of fear of the attack.

verses.devanagari: সেই হৈতে রহি আমি এই কুঞ্জ-স্থানে ।\\nভাল হৈল আইলা আমা কাঢ় সাবধানে ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: sei haite rahi āmi ei kuñja-sthāne\\nbhāla haila āilā āmā kāḍha sāvadhāne
verses.translation: "Since the priest went away, I have been staying in this bush. It is very good that you have come here. Now just remove Me with care."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ সে-বালক অন্তর্ধান কৈল ।\\nজাগিয়া মাধবপুরী বিচার করিল ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' se-bālaka antardhāna kaila\\njāgiyā mādhava-purī vicāra karila
verses.translation: After saying this, the boy disappeared. Then Mādhavendra Purī woke up and began to consider his dream.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণকে দেখিনু মুঞি নারিনু চিনিতে ।\\nএত বলি’ প্রেমাবেশে পড়িলা ভূমিতে ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇake dekhinu muñi nārinu cinite\\neta bali' premāveśe paḍilā bhūmite
verses.translation: Mādhavendra Purī began to lament, "I saw Lord Kṛṣṇa directly, but I could not recognize Him!" Thus he fell down on the ground in ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: ক্ষণেক রোদন করি, মন কৈল ধীর ।\\nআজ্ঞা-পালন লাগি’ হইলা সুস্থির ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇeka rodana kari, mana kaila dhīra\\nājñā-pālana lāgi' ha-ilā susthira
