verses.devanagari: এই মত চন্দন দেয় প্রত্যহ ঘষিয়া ।\\nপরায় সেবক সব আনন্দ করিয়া ॥১৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata candana deya pratyaha ghaṣiyā\\nparāya sevaka saba ānanda kariyā
verses.translation: In this way Gopīnāthajī was supplied ground sandalwood pulp daily. The servants of Gopīnātha were very pleased with this.

verses.devanagari: প্রত্যহ চন্দন পরায়, যাবৎ হৈল অন্ত ।\\nতথায় রহিল পুরী তাবৎ পর্যন্ত ॥১৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: pratyaha candana parāya, yāvat haila anta\\ntathāya rahila purī tāvat paryanta
verses.translation: In this way the sandalwood pulp was smeared over the body of Gopīnātha until the whole stock was finished. Mādhavendra Purī stayed there until that time.

verses.devanagari: গ্রীষ্মকাল-অন্তে পুনঃ নীলাচলে গেলা ।\\nনীলাচলে চাতুর্মাস্য আনন্দে রহিলা ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: grīṣma-kāla-ante punaḥ nīlācale gelā\\nnīlācale cāturmāsya ānande rahilā
verses.translation: At the end of summer Mādhavendra Purī returned to Jagannātha Purī, where he remained with great pleasure during the whole period of Cāturmāsya.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The Cāturmāsya period begins in the month of Āṣāḍha (June-July) from the day of Ekādaśī called Śayanā-ekādaśī, in the fortnight of the waxing moon. The period ends in the month of Kārtika (October-November) on the Ekādaśī day known as Utthānā-ekādaśī, in the fortnight of the waxing moon. This four-month period is known as Cāturmāsya. Some Vaiṣṇavas also observe it from the full-moon day of Āṣāḍha until the full-moon day of Kārtika. That is also a period of four months. This period, calculated by the lunar months, is called Cāturmāsya, but others also observe Cāturmāsya according to the solar month from Śrāvaṇa to Kārtika. The whole period, either lunar or solar, takes place during the rainy season. Cāturmāsya should be observed by all sections of the population. It does not matter whether one is a
gṛhastha
or a
sannyāsī.
The observance is obligatory for all
āśramas.
The real purpose behind the vow taken during these four months is to minimize the quantity of sense gratification. This is not very difficult. In the month of Śrāvaṇa one should not eat spinach, in the month of Bhādra one should not eat yogurt, and in the month of Āśvina one should not drink milk. One should not eat fish or other nonvegetarian food during the month of Kārtika. A nonvegetarian diet means fish and meat. Similarly,
masura dāl
and
urad dāl
are also considered nonvegetarian. These two
dāl
s contain a great amount of protein, and food rich in protein is considered nonvegetarian. On the whole, during the four-month period of Cāturmāsya one should practice giving up all food intended for sense enjoyment.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীমুখে মাধব-পুরীর অমৃত-চরিত ।\\nভক্তগণে শুনাঞা প্রভু করে আস্বাদিত ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-mukhe mādhava-purīra amṛta-carita\\nbhakta-gaṇe śunāñā prabhu kare āsvādita
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally praised the nectarean characteristics of Mādhavendra Purī, and while He related all this to the devotees, He personally relished it.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — নিত্যানন্দ, করহ বিচার ।\\nপুরী-সম ভাগ্যবান্ জগতে নাহি আর ॥১৭১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—nityānanda, karaha vicāra\\npurī-sama bhāgyavān jagate nāhi āra
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked Nityānanda Prabhu to judge whether there was anyone within the world as fortunate as Mādhavendra Purī.

verses.devanagari: দুগ্ধদান-ছলে কৃষ্ণ যাঁরে দেখা দিল ।\\nতিনবারে স্বপ্নে আসি’ যাঁরে আজ্ঞা কৈল ॥১৭২॥
verses.transliteration: dugdha-dāna-chale kṛṣṇa yāṅre dekhā dila\\ntina-bāre svapne āsi' yāṅre ājñā kaila
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Mādhavendra Purī was so fortunate that Kṛṣṇa personally appeared before him on the plea of delivering milk. Three times the Lord gave orders to Mādhavendra Purī in dreams.

verses.devanagari: যাঁর প্রেমে বশ হঞা প্রকট হইলা ।\\nসেবা অঙ্গীকার করি’ জগত তারিলা ॥১৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: yāṅra preme vaśa hañā prakaṭa ha-ilā\\nsevā aṅgīkāra kari' jagata tārilā
verses.translation: "Being obliged because of the loving affairs of Mādhavendra Purī, Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself appeared as the Gopāla Deity, and, accepting his service, He liberated the whole world.

verses.devanagari: যাঁর লাগি’ গোপীনাথ ক্ষীর কৈল চুরি ।\\nঅতএব নাম হৈল ‘ক্ষীরচোরা’ করি’ ॥১৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: yāṅra lāgi' gopīnātha kṣīra kaila curi\\nataeva nāma haila 'kṣīra-corā' kari'
verses.translation: "On account of Mādhavendra Purī, Lord Gopīnātha stole the pot of sweet rice. Thus He became famous as Kṣīra-corā [the thief who stole the sweet rice].

verses.devanagari: কর্পূর-চন্দন যাঁর অঙ্গে চড়াইল ।\\nআনন্দে পুরী-গোসাঞির প্রেম উথলিল ॥১৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: karpūra-candana yāṅra aṅge caḍāila\\nānande purī-gosāñira prema uthalila
verses.translation: "Mādhavendra Purī smeared the sandalwood pulp over the body of Gopīnātha, and in this way he was overpowered with love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: ম্লেচ্ছদেশে কর্পূর-চন্দন আনিতে জঞ্জাল । পুরী দুঃখ পাবে ইহা জানিয়া গোপাল ॥১৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: mleccha-deśe karpūra-candana ānite jañjāla\\npurī duḥkha pābe ihā jāniyā gopāla
verses.translation: "In the provinces of India governed by the Mohammedans, there was much inconvenience in traveling with sandalwood and camphor. Because of this, Mādhavendra Purī might have gotten into trouble. This became known to the Gopāla Deity.

verses.devanagari: মহা-দয়াময় প্ৰভু — ভকতবত্সল  ।\\nচন্দন পরি’ ভক্তশ্রম করিল সফল ॥১৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-dayā-maya prabhu—bhakata-vatsala\\ncandana pari' bhakta-śrama karila saphala
verses.translation: "The Lord is very merciful and attached to His devotees, so when Gopīnātha was covered with sandalwood pulp, Mādhavendra Purī's labor became successful."

verses.devanagari: পুরীর প্রেম-পরাকাষ্ঠা করহ বিচার ।\\nঅলৌকিক প্রেম চিত্তে লাগে চমৎকার ॥১৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: purīra prema-parākāṣṭhā karaha vicāra\\nalaukika prema citte lāge camatkāra
verses.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu placed the standard of Mādhavendra Purī's intense love before Nityānanda Prabhu for judgment. "All his loving activities are uncommon," Caitanya Mahāprabhu said. "Indeed, one is struck with wonder to hear of his activities."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
When the living entity feels spiritual separation from Kṛṣṇa (
kṛṣṇa-viraha
), he has achieved the prime success of life. When one becomes disinterested in material things, he is simply experiencing the other side of attraction for material things. However, feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa and engaging in the service of the Lord to fulfill His mission constitute the best example of love of Kṛṣṇa. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to point out this intense love of Kṛṣṇa exhibited by Mādhavendra Purī. All Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees later followed in the footsteps of Mādhavendra Purī, serving the Lord without personal considerations.

verses.devanagari: পরম বিরক্ত, মৌনী, সর্বত্র উদাসীন ।\\nগ্রাম্যবার্তা-ভয়ে দ্বিতীয়-সঙ্গ-হীন ॥১৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: parama virakta, maunī, sarvatra udāsīna\\ngrāmya-vārtā-bhaye dvitīya-saṅga-hīna
verses.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "Śrī Mādhavendra Purī used to remain alone. He was completely renounced and always very silent. He was uninterested in everything material, and for fear of talking about mundane things, he always lived without a companion.

verses.devanagari: হেন-জন গোপালের আজ্ঞামৃত পাঞা ।\\nসহস্র ক্রোশ আসি’ বুলে চন্দন মাগিঞা ॥১৮০॥
verses.transliteration: hena-jana gopālera ājñāmṛta pāñā\\nsahasra krośa āsi' bule candana māgiñā
verses.translation: "After receiving the transcendental orders of Gopāla, this great personality traveled thousands of miles just to collect sandalwood by begging.

verses.devanagari: ভোকে রহে, তবু অন্ন মাগিঞা না খায় ।\\nহেন-জন-চন্দন-ভার বহি’ লঞা যায় ॥১৮১॥
verses.transliteration: bhoke rahe, tabu anna māgiñā nā khāya\\nhena-jana candana-bhāra vahi' lañā yāya
verses.translation: "Although Mādhavendra Purī was hungry, he would not beg food to eat. This renounced person carried a load of sandalwood for the sake of Śrī Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: ‘মণেক চন্দন, তোলা-বিশেক কর্পূর ।\\nগোপালে পরাইব’ — এই আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥১৮২॥
verses.transliteration: 'maṇeka candana, tolā-viśeka karpūra\\ngopāle parāiba'—ei ānanda pracura
verses.translation: "Without considering his personal comforts, Mādhavendra Purī carried one mound [about eighty-two pounds] of sandalwood and twenty tolās [about eight ounces] of camphor to smear over the body of Gopāla. This transcendental pleasure was sufficient for him.

verses.devanagari: উৎকলের দানী রাখে চন্দন দেখিঞা ।\\nতাহাঁ এড়াইল রাজপত্র দেখাঞা ॥১৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: utkalera dānī rākhe candana dekhiñā\\ntāhāṅ eḍāila rāja-patra dekhāñā
verses.translation: "Since there were restrictions against taking the sandalwood out of the Orissa province, the toll official confiscated the stock, but Mādhavendra Purī showed him the release papers given by the government and consequently escaped difficulties.

verses.devanagari: ম্লেচ্ছদেশ দূর পথ, জগাতি অপার ।\\nকেমতে চন্দন নিব — নাহি এ বিচার ॥১৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: mleccha-deśa dūra patha, jagāti apāra\\nke-mate candana niba—nāhi e vicāra
verses.translation: "Mādhavendra Purī was not at all anxious during the long journey to Vṛndāvana through the provinces governed by the Mohammedans and filled with unlimited numbers of watchmen.

verses.devanagari: সঙ্গে এক বট নাহি ঘাটীদান দিতে ।\\nতথাপি উৎসাহ বড় চন্দন লঞা যাইতে ॥১৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: saṅge eka vaṭa nāhi ghāṭī-dāna dite\\ntathāpi utsāha baḍa candana lañā yāite
verses.translation: "Although Mādhavendra Purī did not have a farthing with him, he was not afraid to pass by the toll officers. His only enjoyment was in carrying the load of sandalwood to Vṛndāvana for Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: প্রগাঢ় প্রেমের এই স্বভাব-আচার ।\\nনিজ-দুঃখ-বিঘ্নাদির না করে বিচার ॥১৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: pragāḍha-premera ei svabhāva-ācāra\\nnija-duḥkha-vighnādira nā kare vicāra
verses.translation: "This is the natural result of intense love of Godhead. The devotee does not consider personal inconveniences or impediments. In all circumstances he wants to serve the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is natural for those who have developed intense love for Kṛṣṇa not to care for personal inconvenience and impediments. Such devotees are simply determined to execute the order of the Supreme Personality of Godhead or His representative, the spiritual master. In all circumstances, even amidst the greatest dangers, they undeviatingly carry on with the greatest determination. This definitely proves the intense love of the servitor. As stated in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.14.8),
tat te 'nukampāṁ su-samīkṣamāṇaḥ:
those who seriously desire to get free from the clutches of material existence, who have developed intense love for Kṛṣṇa, are worthy candidates for going back home, back to Godhead. An intense lover of Kṛṣṇa does not care for any number of material discomforts, scarcity, impediments or unhappiness. It is said that when one sees apparent unhappiness or distress in a perfect Vaiṣṇava, it is not at all unhappiness for him; rather, it is transcendental bliss. In the
Śikṣāṣṭaka
(8), Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has also instructed:
āśliṣya vā pāda-ratāṁ pinaṣṭu mām.
The intense lover of Kṛṣṇa is never deviated from his service, despite all difficulties and impediments brought before him.

verses.devanagari: এই তার গাঢ় প্রেমা লোকে দেখাইতে ।\\nগোপাল তাঁরে আজ্ঞা দিল চন্দন আনিতে ॥১৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei tāra gāḍha premā loke dekhāite\\ngopāla tāṅre ājñā dila candana ānite
verses.translation: "Śrī Gopāla wanted to show how intensely Mādhavendra Purī loved Kṛṣṇa; therefore He asked him to go to Nīlācala to fetch sandalwood and camphor.

verses.devanagari: বহু পরিশ্রমে চন্দন রেমুণা আনিল ।\\nআনন্দ বাড়িল মনে, দুঃখ না গণিল ॥১৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: bahu pariśrame candana remuṇā ānila\\nānanda bāḍila mane, duḥkha nā gaṇila
verses.translation: "With great trouble and after much labor, Mādhavendra Purī brought the load of sandalwood to Remuṇā. However, he was still very pleased; he discounted all the difficulties.

verses.devanagari: পরীক্ষা করিতে গোপাল কৈল আজ্ঞা দান ।\\nপরীক্ষা করিয়া শেষে হৈল দয়াবান্ ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: parīkṣā karite gopāla kaila ājñā dāna\\nparīkṣā kariyā śeṣe haila dayāvān
verses.translation: "To test the intense love of Mādhavendra Purī, Gopāla, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, ordered him to bring sandalwood from Nīlācala, and when Mādhavendra Purī passed this examination, the Lord became very merciful to him.

verses.devanagari: এই ভক্তি, ভক্তপ্রিয়-কৃষ্ণ-ব্যবহার ।\\nবুঝিতেও আমা-সবার নাহি অধিকার ॥১৯০॥
verses.transliteration: ei bhakti, bhakta-priya-kṛṣṇa-vyavahāra\\nbujhiteo āmā-sabāra nāhi adhikāra
verses.translation: "Such behavior exhibited in loving service between the devotee and the devotee's lovable object, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, is transcendental. It is not possible for a common man to understand. Common men do not even have the capacity."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ পড়ে প্রভু তাঁর কৃত শ্লোক ।\\nযেই শ্লোক-চন্দ্রে জগৎ কর্যাছে আলোক ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' paḍe prabhu tāṅra kṛta śloka\\nyei śloka-candre jagat karyāche āloka
verses.translation: After saying this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu read the famous verse of Mādhavendra Purī. That verse is just like the moon. It has spread illumination all over the world.

verses.devanagari: ঘষিতে ঘষিতে যৈছে মলয়জ-সার ।\\nগন্ধ বাড়ে, তৈছে এই শ্লোকের বিচার ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: ghaṣite ghaṣite yaiche malayaja-sāra\\ngandha bāḍe, taiche ei ślokera vicāra
verses.translation: By continuous rubbing, the aroma of Malaya sandalwood increases. Similarly, by considering this verse, its importance increases.

verses.devanagari: রত্নগণ-মধ্যে যৈছে কৌস্তুভমণি ।\\nরসকাব্য-মধ্যে তৈছে এই শ্লোক গণি ॥১৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: ratna-gaṇa-madhye yaiche kaustubha-maṇi\\nrasa-kāvya-madhye taiche ei śloka gaṇi
verses.translation: As the Kaustubha-maṇi is considered the most precious of valuable stones, this verse is similarly considered the best of mellow poems.

verses.devanagari: এই শ্লোক কহিয়াছেন রাধা-ঠাকুরাণী ।\\nতাঁর কৃপায় স্ফুরিয়াছে মাধবেন্দ্র-বাণী ॥১৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei śloka kahiyāchena rādhā-ṭhākurāṇī\\ntāṅra kṛpāya sphuriyāche mādhavendra-vāṇī
verses.translation: Actually this verse was spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī Herself, and by Her mercy only was it manifest in the words of Mādhavendra Purī.

verses.devanagari: কিবা গৌরচন্দ্র ইহা করে আস্বাদন ।\\nইহা আস্বাদিতে আর নাহি চৌঠজন ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: kibā gauracandra ihā kare āsvādana\\nihā āsvādite āra nāḥi cauṭha-jana
verses.translation: Only Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has tasted the poetry of this verse. No fourth man is capable of understanding it.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis indicates that only Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Mādhavendra Purī and Caitanya Mahāprabhu are capable of understanding the purport of this verse.

verses.devanagari: শেষকালে এই শ্লোক পঠিতে পঠিতে ।\\nসিদ্ধিপ্রাপ্তি হৈল পুরীর শ্লোকের সহিতে ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: śeṣa-kāle ei śloka paṭhite paṭhite\\nsiddhi-prāpti haila purīra ślokera sahite
verses.translation: Mādhavendra Purī recited this verse again and again at the end of his material existence. Thus uttering this verse, he attained the ultimate goal of life.

verses.devanagari: অয়ি দীনদয়ার্দ্রনাথ হে মথুরানাথ কদাবলোক্যসে ।\\nহৃদয়ং ত্বদলোককাতরং দয়িত ভ্রাম্যতি কিং করোম্যহম্ ॥১৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: ayi dīna-dayārdra nātha he\\nmathurā-nātha kadāvalokyase\\nhṛdayaṁ tvad-aloka-kātaraṁ\\ndayita bhrāmyati kiṁ karomy aham
verses.translation: "O My Lord! O most merciful master! O master of Mathurā! When shall I see You again? Because of My not seeing You, My agitated heart has become unsteady. O most beloved one, what shall I do now?"
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The uncontaminated devotees who strictly depend on the Vedānta philosophy are divided into four
sampradāyas,
or transcendental parties. Out of the four
sampradāyas,
the Śrī Madhvācārya-sampradāya was accepted by Mādhavendra Purī. Thus he took
sannyāsa
according to
paramparā,
the disciplic succession. Beginning from Madhvācārya down to the spiritual master of Mādhavendra Purī, the
ācārya
named Lakṣmīpati, there was no realization of devotional service in conjugal love. Śrī Mādhavendra Purī introduced the conception of conjugal love for the first time in the Madhvācārya-sampradāya, and this conclusion of the Madhvācārya-sampradāya was revealed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu when He toured southern India and met the Tattvavādīs, who supposedly belonged to the Madhvācārya-sampradāya.
When Śrī Kṛṣṇa left Vṛndāvana and accepted the kingdom of Mathurā, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, out of ecstatic feelings of separation, expressed how Kṛṣṇa can be loved in separation. Thus devotional service in separation is central to this verse. Worship in separation is considered by the
Gauḍīya-Mādhva sampradāya
to be the topmost level of devotional service. According to this conception, the devotee thinks of himself as very poor and neglected by the Lord. Thus he addresses the Lord as
dīna-dayārdra nātha,
as did Mādhavendra Purī. Such an ecstatic feeling is the highest form of devotional service. Because Kṛṣṇa had gone to Mathurā, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was very much affected, and She expressed Herself thus: "My dear Lord, because of Your separation My mind has become overly agitated. Now tell Me, what can I do? I am very poor and You are very merciful, so kindly have compassion upon Me and let Me know when I shall see You." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always expressing the ecstatic emotions of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī that She exhibited when She saw Uddhava at Vṛndāvana. Similar feelings, experienced by Mādhavendra Purī, are expressed in this verse. Therefore, Vaiṣṇavas in the
Gauḍīya-Mādhva sampradāya
say that the ecstatic feelings experienced by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu during His appearance came from Śrī Mādhavendra Purī through Īśvara Purī. All the devotees in the line of the
Gauḍīya-Mādhva sampradāya
accept these principles of devotional service.

verses.devanagari: এই শ্লোক পড়িতে প্রভু হইলা মূর্চ্ছিতে ।\\nপ্রেমেতে বিবশ হঞা পড়িল ভূমিতে ॥১৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei śloka paḍite prabhu ha-ilā mūrcchite\\npremete vivaśa hañā paḍila bhūmite
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited this verse, He immediately fell to the ground unconscious. He was overwhelmed and had no control over Himself.

verses.devanagari: আস্তে-ব্যস্তে কোলে করি’ নিল নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nক্রন্দন করিয়া তবে উঠে গৌরচন্দ্র ॥১৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: āste-vyaste kole kari' nila nityānanda\\nkrandana kariyā tabe uṭhe gauracandra
verses.translation: When Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell to the ground in ecstatic love, Lord Nityānanda quickly took Him on His lap. Crying, Caitanya Mahāprabhu then got up again.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমোন্মাদ হৈল, উঠি’ ইতি-উতি ধায় ।\\nহুঙ্কার করয়ে, হাসে, কান্দে, নাচে, গায় ॥২০০॥
verses.transliteration: premonmāda haila, uṭhi' iti-uti dhāya\\nhuṅkāra karaye, hāse, kānde, nāce, gāya
verses.translation: Exhibiting ecstatic emotions, the Lord began to run here and there, making resounding noises. Sometimes He laughed, and sometimes He cried, and sometimes He danced and sang.

verses.devanagari: ‘অয়ি দীন’, ‘অয়ি দীন’ বলে বারবার ।\\nকণ্ঠে না নিঃসরে বাণী, নেত্রে অশ্রুধার ॥২০১॥
verses.transliteration: 'ayi dīna, 'ayi dīna' bale bāra-bāra\\nkaṇṭhe nā niḥsare vāṇī, netre aśru-dhāra
verses.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu could not recite the whole verse. He simply said, "Ayi dīna, ayi dīna," repeatedly. Thus He could not speak, and profuse tears were in His eyes.

verses.devanagari: কম্প, স্বেদ, পুলকাশ্রু, স্তম্ভ, বৈবর্ণ্য ।\\nনির্বেদ, বিষাদ, জাড্য, গর্ব, হর্ষ, দৈন্য ॥২০২॥
verses.transliteration: kampa, sveda, pulakāśru, stambha, vaivarṇya\\nnirveda, viṣāda, jāḍya, garva, harṣa, dainya
verses.translation: Trembling, perspiration, jubilant tears, shock, fading of the bodily luster, disappointment, moroseness, loss of memory, pride, joy and humility were all visible in Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's body.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu, jāḍya
is explained as loss of memory brought about by severe shock due to separation from the beloved. In that state of mind, one loses all concern for loss and gain, hearing and seeing, as well as all other considerations. This marks the preliminary appearance of illusion.

verses.devanagari: এই শ্লোকে উঘাড়িলা প্রেমের কপাট ।\\nগোপীনাথ-সেবক দেখে প্ৰভুর প্রেমনাট ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei śloke ughāḍilā premera kapāṭa\\ngopīnātha-sevaka dekhe prabhura prema-nāṭa
verses.translation: This verse uncovered the door of ecstatic love, and when it was exhibited, all the servants of Gopīnātha saw Caitanya Mahāprabhu dance in ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: লোকের সংঘট্ট দেখি’ প্ৰভুর বাহ্য হৈল ।\\nঠাকুরের ভোগ সরি’ আরতি বাজিল ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: lokera saṅghaṭṭa dekhi' prabhura bāhya haila\\nṭhākurera bhoga sari' ārati bājila
verses.translation: When many people crowded around Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He regained His external senses. In the meantime, the offering to the Deity had been finished, and there was a resounding ārati performance.

verses.devanagari: ঠাকুরে শয়ন করাঞা পূজারী হৈল বাহির ।\\nপ্রভুর আগে আনি’ দিল প্রসাদ বার ক্ষীর ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: ṭhākure śayana karāñā pūjārī haila bāhira\\nprabhura āge āni' dila prasāda bāra kṣīra
verses.translation: When the Deities were laid down to rest, the priest came out of the temple and offered all twelve pots of sweet rice to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: ক্ষীর দেখি’ মহাপ্রভুর আনন্দ বাড়িল ।\\nভক্তগণে খাওয়াইতে পঞ্চ ক্ষীর লৈল ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: kṣīra dekhi' mahāprabhura ānanda bāḍila\\nbhakta-gaṇe khāoyāite pañca kṣīra laila
verses.translation: When all the pots of sweet rice, remnants left by Gopīnātha, were placed before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He became very pleased. In order to feed the devotees, He accepted five of them.

verses.devanagari: সাত ক্ষীর পূজারীকে বাহুড়িয়া দিল ।\\nপঞ্চক্ষীর পঞ্চজনে বাঁটিয়া খাইল ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: sāta kṣīra pūjārīke bāhuḍiyā dila\\npañca-kṣīra pañca-jane vāṅṭiyā khāila
verses.translation: The seven remaining pots were pushed forward and delivered to the priest. Then the five pots of sweet rice the Lord had accepted were distributed among the five devotees, and they ate the prasāda.

verses.devanagari: গোপীনাথ-রূপে যদি করিয়াছেন ভোজন ।\\nভক্তি দেখাইতে কৈল প্রসাদ ভক্ষণ ॥২০৮॥
verses.transliteration: gopīnātha-rūpe yadi kariyāchena bhojana\\nbhakti dekhāite kaila prasāda bhakṣaṇa
verses.translation: Being identical with the Gopīnātha Deity, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had already tasted and eaten the pots of sweet rice. Yet just to manifest devotional service, He again ate the pots of sweet rice as a devotee.

verses.devanagari: নাম-সংকীর্তনে সেই রাত্রি গোঙাইলা ।\\nমঙ্গল-আরতি দেখি’ প্রভাতে চলিলা ॥২০৯॥
verses.transliteration: nāma-saṅkīrtane sei rātri goṅāilā\\nmaṅgala-ārati dekhi' prabhāte calilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed that night at the temple engaged in congregational chanting. In the morning, after seeing the maṅgala-ārati performance, He departed.

verses.devanagari: গোপাল-গোপীনাথ-পুরীগোসাঞির গুণ ।\\nভক্ত-সঙ্গে শ্রীমুখে প্রভু কৈলা আস্বাদন ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: gopāla-gopīnātha-purī-gosāñira guṇa\\nbhakta-saṅge śrī-mukhe prabhu kailā āsvādana
verses.translation: In this way, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally tasted with His own mouth the transcendental qualities of Gopālajī, Gopīnātha and Śrī Mādhavendra Purī.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ আখ্যানে কহিলা দোঁহার মহিমা ।\\nপ্রভুর ভক্তবাৎসল্য, আর ভক্তপ্রেম-সীমা ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' ākhyāne kahilā doṅhāra mahimā\\nprabhura bhakta-vātsalya, āra bhakta-prema-sīmā
verses.translation: Thus I have described both the transcendental glories of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's affection for His devotees and the highest limit of ecstatic love of God.

verses.devanagari: শ্রদ্ধাযুক্ত হঞা ইহা শুনে যেই জন ।\\nশ্রীকৃষ্ণ-চরণে সেই পায় প্রেমধন ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: śraddhā-yukta hañā ihā śune yei jana\\nśrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇe sei pāya prema-dhana
verses.translation: One who hears this narration with faith and devotion attains the treasure of love of Godhead at the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Fourth Chapter, describing Śrī Mādhavendra Purī's devotional service.

sections.title: Chapter 5: The Activities of Sākṣi-gopāla

verses.devanagari: পদ্ভ্যাং চলন্ যঃ প্রতিমা-স্বরূপো\\nব্রহ্মণ্যদেবো হি শতাহগম্যম্ ।\\nদেশং যযৌ বিপ্রকৃতেঽদ্ভুতেহং\\nতং সাক্ষিগোপালমহং নতোঽস্মি ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: padbhyāṁ calan yaḥ pratimā-svarūpo\\nbrahmaṇya-devo hi śatāha-gamyam\\ndeśaṁ yayau vipra-kṛte 'dbhutehaṁ\\ntaṁ sākṣi-gopālam ahaṁ nato 'smi
verses.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto the Supreme Personality of God [brahmaṇya-deva], who appeared as Sākṣi-gopāla to benefit a brāhmaṇa. For one hundred days He traveled through the country, walking on His own legs. Thus His activities are wonderful.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaitacandra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Śrī Advaita Prabhu! And all glories to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

verses.devanagari: চলিতে চলিতে আইলা যাজপুর-গ্রাম ।\\nবরাহ-ঠাকুর দেখি’ করিলা প্রণাম ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: calite calite āilā yājapura-grāma\\nvarāha-ṭhākura dekhi' karilā praṇāma
verses.translation: Walking and walking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His party finally arrived at Yājapura on the river Vaitaraṇī. There He saw the temple of Varāhadeva and offered His obeisances unto Him.

verses.devanagari: নৃত্যগীত কৈল প্রেমে বহুত স্তবন ।\\nযাজপুরে সে রাত্রি করিলা যাপন ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: nṛtya-gīta kaila preme bahuta stavana\\nyājapure se rātri karilā yāpana
verses.translation: In the temple of Varāhadeva, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in chanting and dancing and offered prayers. He passed that night in the temple.

verses.devanagari: কটকে আইলা সাক্ষিগোপাল দেখিতে ।\\nগোপাল-সৌন্দর্য দেখি’ হৈলা আনন্দিতে ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: kaṭake āilā sākṣi-gopāla dekhite\\ngopāla-saundarya dekhi' hailā ānandite
verses.translation: Afterwards, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the town of Kaṭaka to see the temple of the witness Gopāla. When He saw the Deity of Gopāla, He was very much pleased with His beauty.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমাবেশে নৃত্যগীত কৈল কতক্ষণ ।\\nআবিষ্ট হঞা কৈল গোপাল স্তবন ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: premāveśe nṛtya-gīta kaila kata-kṣaṇa\\nāviṣṭa hañā kaila gopāla stavana
verses.translation: While there, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in chanting and dancing for some time, and being overwhelmed, He offered many prayers to Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: সেই রাত্রি তাহাঁ রহি’ ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nগোপালের পূর্বকথা শুনে বহু রঙ্গে ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: sei rātri tāhāṅ rahi' bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge\\ngopālera pūrva-kathā śune bahu raṅge
verses.translation: That night Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed in the temple of Gopāla, and along with all the devotees, He heard the narration of the witness Gopāla with great pleasure.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ-গোসাঞি যবে তীর্থ ভ্রমিলা ।\\nসাক্ষিগোপাল দেখিবারে কটক আইলা ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda-gosāñi yabe tīrtha bhramilā\\nsākṣi-gopāla dekhibāre kaṭaka āilā
verses.translation: Previously, when Nityānanda Prabhu had toured all over India to see different places of pilgrimage, He also had come to see Sākṣi-gopāla at Kaṭaka.

verses.devanagari: সাক্ষিগোপালের কথা শুনি, লোকমুখে ।\\nসেই কথা কহেন, প্রভু শুনে মহাসুখে ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: sākṣi-gopālera kathā śuni, loka-mukhe\\nsei kathā kahena, prabhu śune mahā-sukhe
verses.translation: At that time, Nityānanda Prabhu had heard the story of Sākṣi-gopāla from the townspeople. He now recited this again, and Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard the narration with great pleasure.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The Sākṣi-gopāla temple is situated between the Khurdā Road junction railway station and the Jagannātha Purī station. The Deity is not presently situated in Kaṭaka, but when Nityānanda Prabhu traveled there, the Deity was present. Kaṭaka is a town in Orissa situated on the Mahānadī River. When Sākṣi-gopāla was brought from Vidyānagara in southern India, He stayed for some time at Kaṭaka. Thereafter, He was situated for some time in the Jagannātha temple. It seems that in the temple of Jagannātha there was some disagreement between Jagannātha and Sākṣi-gopāla, a disagreement called
prema-kalaha,
a quarrel of love. In order to settle this love quarrel, the King of Orissa constructed a village about six miles from Jagannātha Purī. The village was called Satyavādī, and Gopāla was stationed there. Thereafter, a new temple was constructed. Now there is a Sākṣi-gopāla station, and people go there to see the witness Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে বিদ্যানগরের দুই ত’ ব্রাহ্মণ ।\\nতীর্থ করিবারে দুঁহে করিলা গমন ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve vidyānagarera dui ta' brāhmaṇa\\ntīrtha karibāre duṅhe karilā gamana
verses.translation: Formerly at Vidyānagara in South India there were two brāhmaṇas who made a long tour to see different places of pilgrimage.

verses.devanagari: গয়া, বারাণসী, প্ৰয়াগ — সকল করিয়া ।\\nমথুরাতে আইলা দুঁহে আনন্দিত হঞা ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: gayā, vārāṇasī, prayāga—sakala kariyā\\nmathurāte āilā duṅhe ānandita hañā
verses.translation: First of all they visited Gayā, then Kāśī, then Prayāga. Finally, with great pleasure, they came to Mathurā.

verses.devanagari: বনযাত্রায় বন দেখি’ দেখে গোবর্ধন ।\\nদ্বাদশ-বন দেখি’ শেষে গেলা বৃন্দাবন ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: vana-yātrāya vana dekhi' dekhe govardhana\\ndvādaśa-vana dekhi' śeṣe gelā vṛndāvana
verses.translation: After reaching Mathurā, they started visiting the different forests of Vṛndāvana and came to Govardhana Hill. They visited all twelve forests [vanas] and at last came to the town of Vṛndāvana.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThe five forests situated on the eastern side of the river Yamunā are Bhadra, Bilva, Loha, Bhāṇḍīra and Mahāvana. The seven forests situated on the western side of the Yamunā are Madhu, Tāla, Kumuda, Bahulā, Kāmya, Khadira and Vṛndāvana. After visiting all these forests, these pilgrims went to a place known as Pañcakrośī Vṛndāvana. Out of the twelve forests, the Vṛndāvana forest extends from the town of Vṛndāvana up to Nanda-grāma and Varṣāṇa, a distance of thirty-two miles, within which the Pañcakrośī Vṛndāvana town is situated.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনে গোবিন্দ-স্থানে মহাদেবালয় ।\\nসে মন্দিরে গোপালের মহাসেবা হয় ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvane govinda-sthāne mahā-devālaya\\nse mandire gopālera mahā-sevā haya
verses.translation: In the village of Pañcakrośī Vṛndāvana, at the site where the Govinda temple is now situated, there was a great temple where gorgeous worship of Gopāla was performed.

verses.devanagari: কেশীতীর্থ, কালীয়-হ্রদাদিকে কৈল স্নান ।\\nশ্রীগোপাল দেখি’ তাহাঁ করিলা বিশ্রাম ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: keśī-tīrtha, kālīya-hradādike kaila snāna\\nśrī-gopāla dekhi' tāhāṅ karilā viśrāma
verses.translation: After taking baths at different bathing places along the river Yamunā, such as Keśī-ghāṭa and Kāliya-ghāṭa, the pilgrims visited the temple of Gopāla. Afterwards, they took rest in that temple.

verses.devanagari: গোপাল-সৌন্দর্য দুঁহার মন নিল হরি’ ।\\nসুখ পাঞা রহে তাহাঁ দিন দুই-চারি ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: gopāla-saundarya duṅhāra mana nila hari'\\nsukha pāñā rahe tāhāṅ dina dui-cāri
verses.translation: The beauty of the Gopāla Deity stole away their minds, and feeling great happiness, they remained there for two or four days.

verses.devanagari: দুইবিপ্ৰ-মধ্যে এক বিপ্ৰ — বৃদ্ধপ্রায় ।\\nআর বিপ্র — যুবা, তাঁর করেন সহায় ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: dui-vipra-madhye eka vipra—vṛddha-prāya\\nāra vipra—yuvā, tāṅra karena sahāya
verses.synonyms:
dui-vipra-madhye
—between the two
brāhmaṇas
;
eka vipra
—one
brāhmaṇa
;
vrddha-prāya
—elderly man;
āra vipra
—the second
brāhmaṇa
;
yuvā
—young man;
tāṅra
—of the older
brāhmaṇa
;
karena
—does;
sahāya
—assistance.
verses.translation: One of the two brāhmaṇas was an old man, and the other was young. The young man was assisting the old one.

verses.devanagari: ছোটবিপ্ৰ করে সদা তাঁহার সেবন ।\\nতাঁহার সেবায় বিপ্রের তুষ্ট হৈল মন ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: choṭa-vipra kare sadā tāṅhāra sevana\\ntāṅhāra sevāya viprera tuṣṭa haila mana
verses.translation: Indeed, the young brāhmaṇa always rendered service to the older one, and the old man, being very satisfied with his service, was pleased with him.

verses.devanagari: বিপ্র বলে, — তুমি মোর বহু সেবা কৈলা ।\\nসহায় হঞা মোরে তীর্থ করাইলা ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: vipra bale—tumi mora bahu sevā kailā\\nsahāya hañā more tīrtha karāilā
verses.translation: The older man told the younger, "You have rendered various types of service to me. You have assisted me in traveling to all these places of pilgrimage.

verses.devanagari: পুত্রেও পিতার ঐছে না করে সেবন ।\\nতোমার প্ৰসাদে আমি না পাইলাম শ্রম ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: putreo pitāra aiche nā kare sevana\\ntomāra prasāde āmi nā pāilāma śrama
verses.translation: "Even my own son does not render such service. By your mercy, I did not become fatigued while on this tour.

verses.devanagari: কৃতঘ্নতা হয় তোমায় না কৈলে সম্মান ।\\nঅতএব তোমায় আমি দিব কন্যাদান ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: kṛta-ghnatā haya tomāya nā kaile sammāna\\nataeva tomāya āmi diba kanyā-dāna
verses.translation: "If I do not show you any respect, I will be ungrateful. Therefore, I promise to give you my daughter in charity."

verses.devanagari: ছোটবিপ্র কহে, — “শুন, বিপ্ৰ-মহাশয় ।\\nঅসম্ভব কহ কেনে, যেই নাহি হয় ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: choṭa-vipra kahe, "śuna, vipra-mahāśaya\\nasambhava kaha kene, yei nāhi haya
verses.translation: The younger brāhmaṇa replied, "My dear sir, please hear me. You are saying something very unusual. Such a thing never happens.

verses.devanagari: মহাকুলীন তুমি — বিদ্যা-ধনাদি-প্রবীণ ।\\nআমি অকুলীন, আর ধন-বিদ্যা-হীন ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-kulīna tumi—vidyā-dhanādi-pravīṇa\\nāmi akulīna, āra dhana-vidyā-hīna
verses.translation: "You are a most aristocratic family man, well educated and very rich. I am not at all aristocratic, and I am without a decent education and have no wealth.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Due to pious activities, one can be enriched by four opulences: one may obtain birth in an aristocratic family, become highly educated, become very beautiful or get a sufficient quantity of riches. These are symptoms of pious activities performed in one's past life. In India it is still current for an aristocratic family never to consider a marriage with a common family. Though the caste may be the same, to maintain the aristocracy such marriages are rejected. No poor man will dare marry the daughter of a rich man. Because of this, when the elderly
brāhmaṇa
offered the young
brāhmaṇa
his daughter, the young
brāhmaṇa
did not believe that it would be possible to marry her. Therefore he asked the elderly
brāhmaṇa
why he was proposing something unprecedented (
asambhava
). It was unheard of for an aristocratic person to offer his daughter to a person who was both uneducated and poor.

verses.devanagari: কন্যাদান-পাত্র আমি না হই তোমার ।\\nকৃষ্ণপ্রীত্যে করি তোমার সেবা-ব্যবহার ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: kanyā-dāna-pātra āmi nā ha-i tomāra\\nkṛṣṇa-prītye kari tomāra sevā-vyavahāra
verses.translation: "Sir, I am not a suitable bridegroom for your daughter. I render service to you only for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Both
brāhmaṇas
were pure Vaiṣṇavas. The younger man took special care of the older one simply to please Kṛṣṇa. In
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(11.19.21) Kṛṣṇa says,
mad-bhakta-pūjābhyadhikā:
"It is better to render service to My devotee." Thus, according to the Gauḍīya-Vaiṣṇava philosophy of Caitanya Mahāprabhu, it is better to be a servant of the servant of God. One should not try to serve Kṛṣṇa directly. A pure Vaiṣṇava serves a servant of Kṛṣṇa and identifies himself as a servant of a servant of Kṛṣṇa. This is pleasing to Lord Kṛṣṇa. Śrīla Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura confirms this philosophy:
chāḍiyā vaiṣṇava-sevā nistāra pāyeche kebā.
Unless one serves a liberated Vaiṣṇava, he cannot attain liberation by directly serving Kṛṣṇa. He must serve the servant of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ব্রাহ্মণ-সেবায় কৃষ্ণের প্রীতি বড় হয় ।\\nতাঁহার সন্তোষ ভক্তি-সম্পদ্ বাড়য় ।।” ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa-sevāya kṛṣṇera prīti baḍa haya\\ntāṅhāra santoṣe bhakti-sampad bāḍaya"
verses.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa is very pleased by service rendered to brāhmaṇas, and when the Lord is pleased, the opulence of one's devotional service increases."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this regard, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that the younger
brāhmaṇa
rendered service to the older one with the purpose of pleasing Kṛṣṇa. It was not a matter of ordinary worldly dealings. Kṛṣṇa is pleased when a Vaiṣṇava is rendered service. Because the younger
brāhmaṇa
served the older one, Lord Gopāla agreed to become a witness of the marriage negotiation in order to maintain the prestige of both devotees. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would certainly not have liked to hear about marital dealings unless such dealings were exchanged between two Vaiṣṇavas. Marriage arrangements and ceremonies belong to ordinary material
karma-kāṇḍa
sections of the scriptures. The Vaiṣṇavas, however, are not interested in any kind of
karma-kāṇḍa
dealings. Śrīla Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura says:
karma-kāṇḍa jñāna-kāṇḍa kevala viṣera bhāṇḍa.
For a Vaiṣṇava, the
karma-kāṇḍa
and
jñāna-kāṇḍa
sections of the
Vedas
are unnecessary. Indeed, a real Vaiṣṇava takes these sections as a poison pot (
viṣera bhāṇḍa
). Sometimes we take part in a marriage ceremony for our disciples, but this does not mean that we are interested in
karma-kāṇḍa
activities. Sometimes, not knowing the Vaiṣṇava philosophy, an outsider criticizes such activity, maintaining that a
sannyāsī
should not take part in a marriage ceremony between a young boy and a young girl. However, this is not a
karma-kāṇḍa
activity, because our purpose is to spread the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement. We are giving all facility to the general populace to take to Kṛṣṇa consciousness, and in order to fix the devotees in concentration on the service of the Lord, marriage is sometimes allowed. We have experienced that such married couples actually render very important service to the mission. Therefore, one should not misunderstand when a
sannyāsī
takes part in a marriage ceremony. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Nityānanda Prabhu took great pleasure in hearing about the marriage ceremony between the young
brāhmaṇa
and the daughter of the elderly
brāhmaṇa.

verses.devanagari: বড়বিপ্ৰ কহে, — “তুমি না কর সংশয় ।\\nতোমাকে কন্যা দিব আমি, করিল নিশ্চয় ।।” ॥ ২৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: baḍa-vipra kahe,—"tumi nā kara saṁśaya\\ntomāke kanyā diba āmi, karila niścaya"
verses.translation: The older brāhmaṇa replied, "My dear boy, do not doubt me. I will give you my daughter in charity. I have already decided this."

verses.devanagari: ছোটবিপ্ৰ বলে, — “তোমার স্ত্রীপুত্র সব  ।\\nবহু জ্ঞাতি-গোষ্ঠি তোমার বহুত বান্ধব ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: choṭa-vipra bale,—"tomāra strī-putra saba\\nbahu jñāti-goṣṭhī tomāra bahuta bāndhava
verses.translation: The young brāhmaṇa said, "You have a wife and sons, and you have a large circle of relatives and friends.

verses.devanagari: তা’-সবার সম্মতি বিনা নহে কন্যাদান  ।\\nরুক্মিণীর পিতা ভীষ্মক তাহাতে প্রমাণ ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: tā'-sabāra sammati vinā nahe kanyā-dāna\\nrukmiṇīra pitā bhīṣmaka tāhāte pramāṇa
verses.translation: "Without the consent of all your friends and relatives, it is not possible to give me your daughter in charity. Just consider the story of Queen Rukmiṇī and her father, Bhīṣmaka.

verses.devanagari: ভীষ্মকের ইচ্ছা, — কৃষ্ণে কন্যা সমর্পিতে ।\\nপুত্রের বিরোধে কন্যা নারিল অর্পিতে ।।” ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhīṣmakera icchā,—kṛṣṇe kanyā samarpite\\nputrera virodhe kanyā nārila arpite"
verses.translation: "King Bhīṣmaka wanted to give his daughter, Rukmiṇī, in charity to Kṛṣṇa, but Rukmī, his eldest son, objected. Therefore he could not carry out his decision."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As stated in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.52.25):
bandhūnām icchatāṁ dātuṁ
kṛṣṇāya bhaginīṁ nṛpa
tato nivārya kṛṣṇa-dviḍ
rukmī caidyam amanyata
King Bhīṣmaka of Vidarbha wanted to offer Kṛṣṇa his daughter, Rukmiṇī, but Rukmī, the eldest of his five sons, objected. Therefore he withdrew his decision and decided to offer Rukmiṇī to the King of Cedi, Śiśupāla, who was a cousin of Kṛṣṇa's. However, Rukmiṇī conceived of a trick: she sent a letter to Kṛṣṇa asking Him to kidnap her. Thus in order to please Rukmiṇī, who was His great devotee, Kṛṣṇa kidnapped her. There ensued a great fight between Kṛṣṇa and the opposing party, headed by Rukmiṇī's brother Rukmī. Rukmī was defeated and, because of his harsh words against Kṛṣṇa, was about to be killed, but he was saved at the request of Rukmiṇī. However, Kṛṣṇa shaved off all of Rukmī's hair with His sword. Śrī Balarāma did not like this, and so to please Rukmiṇī, Balarāma rebuked Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: বড়বিপ্র কহে, — “কন্যা মোর নিজ-ধন ।\\nনিজ-ধন দিতে নিষেধিবে কোন্ জন ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: baḍa-vipra kahe,—"kanyā mora nija-dhana\\nnija-dhana dite niṣedhibe kon jana
verses.translation: The elderly brāhmaṇa said, "My daughter is my own property. If I choose to give my property to someone, who has the power to stop me?

verses.devanagari: তোমাকে কন্যা দিব, সবাকে করি’ তিরস্কার ।\\nসংশয় না কর তুমি, করহ স্বীকার ।।” ॥ ৩০ ॥
verses.transliteration: tomāke kanyā diba, sabāke kari' tiraskāra\\nsaṁśaya nā kara tumi, karaha svīkāra"
verses.translation: "My dear boy, I will give my daughter to you in charity, and I will neglect the position of all others. Don't doubt me in this regard; just accept my proposal."

verses.devanagari: ছোটবিপ্র কহে — “যদি কন্যা দিতে মন ।\\nগোপালের আগে কহ এ সত্যবচন ।।” ॥ ৩১ ॥
verses.transliteration: choṭa-vipra kahe,—"yadi kanyā dite mana\\ngopālera āge kaha e satya-vacana"
verses.translation: The younger brāhmaṇa replied, "If you have decided to give your young daughter to me, then say so before the Gopāla Deity."

verses.devanagari: গোপালের আগে বিপ্র কহিতে লাগিল ।\\n“তুমি জান, নিজ-কন্যা ইহারে আমি দিল ।।” ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: gopālera āge vipra kahite lāgila\\n'tumi jāna, nija-kanyā ihāre āmi dila'
verses.translation: Coming before Gopāla, the elderly brāhmaṇa said, "My dear Lord, please witness that I have given my daughter to this boy."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In India it is still the custom for a daughter to be offered to someone simply by word. This is called
vāg-datta.
This means that the father, brother or guardian of a girl has given his word that she will be married to a certain man. Consequently, that daughter cannot be married to anyone else. She is reserved by virtue of the honest words of the father or guardian. There are many instances in which the parents of a female child have given someone a verbal promise that their daughter will be married to his son. Both parties agree to wait until the boy and girl are grown up, and then the marriage takes place. Following this custom, which is very old in India, the elderly
brāhmaṇa
promised to give his daughter to the younger
brāhmaṇa
in charity, and he promised this before the Gopāla Deity. In India the custom is to honor any promise made before the Deity. Such a promise cannot be canceled. In Indian villages, whenever there is a quarrel between two parties, they go to a temple to settle the quarrel. Whatever is spoken in front of the Deity is taken to be true, for no one would dare lie before the Deity. This same principle was followed in the Battle of Kurukṣetra. Therefore in the very beginning of
Bhagavad-gītā
it is stated:
dharma-kṣetre kuru-kṣetre.
By not becoming God conscious, human society is deteriorating to the lowest standard of animal life. This Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement is very essential to reviving God consciousness among the general populace. If people actually become God conscious, all quarrels can be settled outside of court, as happened in the case of the two
brāhmaṇas
whose disagreement was settled by the witness Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: ছোটবিপ্র বলে, — “ঠাকুর, তুমি মোর সাক্ষী ।\\nতোমা সাক্ষী বোলাইমু, যদি অন্যথা দেখি ।।” ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: choṭa-vipra bale,—"ṭhākura, tumi mora sākṣī\\ntomā sākṣī bolāimu, yadi anyathā dekhi"
verses.translation: Then the younger brāhmaṇa addressed the Deity, saying, "My dear Lord, You are my witness. I shall call for You to testify if it is necessary later on."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ দুইজনে চলিলা দেশেরে ।\\nগুরুবুদ্ধ্যে ছোট-বিপ্ৰ বহু সেবা করে ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' dui-jane calilā deśere\\nguru-buddhye choṭa-vipra bahu sevā kare
verses.translation: After these talks, the two brāhmaṇas started for home. As usual, the young brāhmaṇa accompanied the elderly brāhmaṇa as if the older brāhmaṇa were a guru [spiritual master] and rendered him service in various ways.

verses.devanagari: দেশে আসি’ দুইজনে গেলা নিজ-ঘরে ।\\nকত দিনে বড়-বিপ্র চিন্তিত অন্তরে ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: deśe āsi' dui-jane gelā nija-ghare\\nkata dine baḍa-vipra cintita antare
verses.translation: After returning to Vidyānagara, each brāhmaṇa went to his respective home. After some time, the elderly brāhmaṇa became very anxious.

verses.devanagari: তীর্থে বিপ্রে বাক্য দিলুঁ, — কেমতে সত্য হয় ।\\nস্ত্রী, পুত্র, জ্ঞাতি, বন্ধু জানিবে নিশ্চয় ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: tīrthe vipre vākya diluṅ,—kemate satya haya\\nstrī, putra, jñāti, bandhu jānibe niścaya
verses.translation: He began to think, "I have given my word to a brāhmaṇa in a holy place, and what I promised will certainly come to pass. I must now disclose this to my wife, sons, other relatives and friends."

verses.devanagari: একদিন নিজ-লোক একত্র করিল ।\\nতা-সবার আগে সব বৃত্তান্ত কহিল ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina nija-loka ekatra karila\\ntā-sabāra āge saba vṛttānta kahila
verses.translation: Thus one day the elderly brāhmaṇa called for a meeting of all his relatives and friends, and before them all he narrated what had taken place in front of Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ সব গোষ্ঠী তার করে হাহাকার ।\\n‘ঐছে বাত়্ মুখে তুমি না আনিবে আর ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' saba goṣṭhī tāra kare hāhā-kāra\\n'aiche bāt mukhe tumi nā ānibe āra
verses.translation: When those who belonged to the family circle heard the narration of the old brāhmaṇa, they made exclamations showing their disappointment. They all requested that he not make such a proposal again.

verses.devanagari: নীচে কন্যা দিলে কুল যাইবেক নাশ ।\\nশুনিঞা সকল লোক করিবে উপহাস ।।’ ॥ ৩৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: nīce kanyā dile kula yāibeka nāśa\\nśuniñā sakala loka karibe upahāsa'
verses.translation: They unanimously agreed, "If you offer your daughter to a degraded family, your aristocracy will be lost. When people hear of this, they will make jokes and laugh at you."

verses.devanagari: বিপ্র বলে, — “তীর্থ-বাক্য কেমনে করি আন ।\\nযে হউক্, সে হউক, আমি দিব কন্যাদান ।।” ॥ ৪০ ॥
verses.transliteration: vipra bale,—"tīrtha-vākya kemane kari āna\\nye ha-uk, se ha-uka, āmi diba kanyā-dāna"
verses.translation: The elderly brāhmaṇa said, "How can I undo the promise I made in a holy place while on pilgrimage? Whatever may happen, I must give him my daughter in charity."

verses.devanagari: জ্ঞাতি লোক কহে, — ‘মোরা তোমাকে ছাড়িব ।’\\nস্ত্রী-পুত্র কহে, — ‘বিষ খাইয়া মরিব ।।’ ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: jñāti loka kahe,—'morā tomāke chāḍiba'\\nstrī-putra kahe,—'viṣa khāiyā mariba'
verses.translation: The relatives unanimously said, "If you give your daughter to that boy, we shall give up all connection with you." Indeed, his wife and sons declared, "If such a thing happens, we shall take poison and die."

verses.devanagari: বিপ্র বলে, — “সাক্ষী বোলাঞা করিবেক ন্যায় ।\\nজিতি’ কন্যা লবে, মোর ব্যর্থ ধর্ম হয় ।।” ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: vipra bale,—"sākṣī bolāñā karibeka nyāya\\njiti' kanyā labe, mora vyartha dharma haya"
verses.translation: The elderly brāhmaṇa said, "If I do not give my daughter to the young brāhmaṇa, he will call Śrī Gopālajī as a witness. Thus he will take my daughter by force, and in that case my religious principles will become meaningless."

verses.devanagari: পুত্র বলে, — “প্রতিমা সাক্ষী, সেহ দূর দেশে ।\\nকে তোমার সাক্ষী দিবে, চিন্তা কর কিসে ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: putra bale,—"pratimā sākṣī, seha dūra deśe\\nke tomāra sākṣī dibe, cintā kara kise
verses.translation: His son replied, "The Deity may be a witness, but He is in a distant country. How can He come to bear witness against you? Why are you so anxious over this?

verses.devanagari: নাহি কহি — না কহিও এ মিথ্যা-বচন ।\\nসবে কহিবে — ‘মোর কিছু নাহিক স্মরণ ।।’ ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: nāhi kahi—nā kahio e mithyā-vacana\\nsabe kahibe—'mora kichu nāhika smaraṇa'
verses.translation: "You do not have to flatly deny that you spoke such a thing. There is no need to make a false statement. Simply say that you do not remember what you said.

verses.devanagari: তুমি যদি কহ, — ‘আমি কিছুই না জানি ।\\nতবে আমি ন্যায় করি’ ব্রাহ্মণেরে জিনি ।।” ॥ ৪৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: tumi yadi kaha,—'āmi kichui nā jāni'\\ntabe āmi nyāya kari' brāhmaṇere jini"
verses.translation: "If you simply say, 'I do not remember,' I shall take care of the rest. By argument, I shall defeat the young brāhmaṇa."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The son of the elderly
brāhmaṇa
was an atheist and a follower of the Raghunātha-smṛti. He was very expert in dealing with pounds-shillings-pence, but he was fool number one. Consequently, he did not believe in the spiritual position of the Deity, nor did he have any faith in the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Therefore, as a typical idol worshiper, he considered the form of the Lord to be made of stone or wood. Thus he assured his father that the witness was only a stone Deity and was not capable of speaking. Besides that, he assured his father that the Deity was situated far away and consequently could not come to bear witness. In essence, he was saying: "Have no anxiety. You do not have to lie directly, but you should speak like a diplomat, like King Yudhiṣṭhira when he spoke to Droṇācārya—
aśvatthāmā hata iti gajaḥ.
Following this principle, simply say that you do not remember anything and are completely unaware of the statements given by the young
brāhmaṇa.
If you make the background like that, I shall know how to fill in the argument and defeat him by word jugglery. Thus I shall save you from having to give your daughter to him. In this way, our aristocracy will be saved. You have nothing to worry about."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ বিপ্রের চিন্তিত হৈল মন ।\\nএকান্ত-ভাবে চিন্তে বিপ্র গোপাল-চরণ ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' viprera cintita haila mana\\nekānta-bhāve cinte vipra gopāla-caraṇa
verses.translation: When the elderly brāhmaṇa heard this, the mind became very agitated. Feeling helpless, he simply turned his attention to the lotus feet of Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: ‘মোর ধর্ম রক্ষা পায়, না মরে নিজ-জন ।\\nদুই রক্ষা কর, গোপাল, লইনু শরণ ।।’ ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: 'mora dharma rakṣā pāya, nā mare nija-jana\\ndui rakṣā kara, gopāla, lainu śaraṇa'
verses.translation: The elderly brāhmaṇa prayed, "My dear Lord Gopāla, I have taken shelter of Your lotus feet, and therefore I request You to please protect my religious principles from disturbance and at the same time save my kinsmen from dying."

verses.devanagari: এইমত বিপ্র চিত্তে চিন্তিতে লাগিল ।\\nআর দিন লঘুবিপ্র তাঁর ঘরে আইল ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata vipra citte cintite lāgila\\nāra dina laghu-vipra tāṅra ghare āila
verses.translation: The next day, the elderly brāhmaṇa was thinking deeply about this matter when the young brāhmaṇa came to his house.

verses.devanagari: আসিঞা পরম-ভক্ত্যে নমস্কার করি’ ।\\nবিনয় করিঞা কহে কর দুই যুড়ি’ ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: āsiñā parama-bhaktye namaskāra kari'\\nvinaya kariñā kahe kara dui yuḍi'
verses.translation: The young brāhmaṇa came to him and offered respectful obeisances. Then, very humbly folding his hands, he spoke as follows.

verses.devanagari: ‘তুমি মোরে কন্যা দিতে কর্যাছ অঙ্গীকার ।\\nএবে কিছু নাহি কহ, কি তোমার বিচার ।।’ ॥ ৫০ ॥
verses.transliteration: 'tumi more kanyā dite karyācha aṅgīkāra\\nebe kichu nāhi kaha, ki tomāra vicāra'
verses.translation: "You have promised to give your daughter in charity to me. Now you do not say anything. What is your conclusion?"

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ সেই বিপ্র রহে মৌন ধরি’ ।\\nতাঁর পুত্র মারিতে আইল হাতে ঠেঙ্গা করি’ ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' sei vipra rahe mauna dhari'\\ntāṅra putra mārite āila hāte ṭheṅgā kari'
verses.translation: After the young brāhmaṇa submitted this statement, the elderly brāhmaṇa remained silent. Taking this opportunity, his son immediately came out with a stick to strike the younger man.

verses.devanagari: ‘আরে অধম! মোর ভগ্নী চাহ বিবাহিতে ।\\nবামন হঞা চাঁদ যেন চাহ ত’ ধরিতে ।।’ ॥ ৫২ ॥
verses.transliteration: 'āre adhama! mora bhagnī cāha vivāhite\\nvāmana hañā cāṅda yena cāha ta' dharite'
verses.translation: The son said, "Oh, you are most degraded! You want to marry my sister, just like a dwarf who wants to catch the moon!"

verses.devanagari: ঠেঞা দেখি’ সেই বিপ্র পলাঞা গেল ।\\nআর দিন গ্রামের লোক একত্র করিল ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: ṭheñā dekhi' sei vipra palāñā gela\\nāra dina grāmera loka ekatra karila
verses.translation: Seeing a stick in the hand of the son, the younger brāhmaṇa fled. The next day, however, he gathered together all the people of the village.

verses.devanagari: সব লোক বড়বিপ্রে ডাকিয়া আনিল ।\\nতবে সেই লঘুবিপ্র কহিতে লাগিল ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: saba loka baḍa-vipre ḍākiyā ānila\\ntabe sei laghu-vipra kahite lāgila
verses.translation: All the people of the village then called for the elderly brāhmaṇa and brought him to their meeting place. The young brāhmaṇa then began to speak before them as follows.

verses.devanagari: ‘ইহঁ মোরে কন্যা দিতে কর্যাছে অঙ্গীকার ।\\nএবে যে না দেন, পুছ ইঁহার ব্যবহার ।।’ ॥ ৫৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: 'iṅha more kanyā dite karyāche aṅgīkāra\\nebe ye nā dena, pucha iṅhāra vyavahāra'
verses.translation: "This gentleman has promised to hand over his daughter to me, yet now he does not follow his promise. Please ask him about his behavior."

verses.devanagari: তবে সেই বিপ্রেরে পুছিল সর্বজন ।\\n‘কন্যা কেনে না দেহ, যদি দিয়াছ বচন ।।’ ॥ ৫৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: tabe sei viprere puchila sarva-jana\\n'kanyā kene nā deha, yadi diyācha vacana'
verses.translation: All the people gathered there asked the elderly brāhmaṇa, "If you have already promised to give him your daughter in charity, why are you not fulfilling your promise? You have given your word of honor."

verses.devanagari: বিপ্র কহে, — ‘শুন, লোক, মোর নিবেদন ।\\nকবে কি বলিয়াছি, মোর নাহিক স্মরণ ।।’ ॥ ৫৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: vipra kahe,—'śuna, loka, mora nivedana\\nkabe ki baliyāchi, mora nāhika smaraṇa'
verses.translation: The elderly brāhmaṇa said, "My dear friends, please hear what I have to submit. I do not exactly remember making a promise like that."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ তাঁর পুত্র বাক্য-চ্ছল পাঞা ।\\nপ্রগল্ভ হইয়া কহে সম্মুখে আসিঞা ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' tāṅra putra vākya-cchala pāñā\\npragalbha ha-iyā kahe sammukhe āsiñā
verses.translation: When the elderly brāhmaṇa's son heard this, he took the opportunity to juggle some words. Becoming very impudent, he stood before the assembly and spoke as follows.

verses.devanagari: ‘তীর্থযাত্রায় পিতার সঙ্গে ছিল বহু ধন ।\\nধন দেখি এই দুষ্টের লৈতে হৈল মন ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'tīrtha-yātrāya pitāra saṅge chila bahu dhana\\ndhana dekhi ei duṣṭera laite haila mana
verses.translation: "While touring the holy places of pilgrimage, my father carried much money. Seeing the money, this rogue decided to take it away.

verses.devanagari: আর কেহ সঙ্গে নাহি, এই সঙ্গে একল ।\\nধুতুরা খাওয়াঞা বাপে করিল পাগল ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: āra keha saṅge nāhi, ei saṅge ekala\\ndhuturā khāoyāñā bāpe karila pāgala
verses.translation: "There was no one besides this man with my father. Giving him an intoxicant known as dhuturā to eat, this rogue made my father mad.

verses.devanagari: সব ধন লঞা কহে — ‘চোরে লইল ধন ।’\\n‘কন্যা দিতে চাহিয়াছে’ — উঠাইল বচন ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: saba dhana lañā kahe—'core la-ila dhana'\\n'kanyā dite cāhiyāche'—uṭhāila vacana
verses.translation: "Having taken all my father's money, this rogue claimed that it was taken by some thief. Now he is claiming that my father has promised to give him his daughter in charity.

verses.devanagari: তোমরা সকল লোক করহ বিচারে ।\\n‘মোর পিতার কন্যা দিতে যোগ্য কি ইহারে ।।’ ॥ ৬২ ॥
verses.transliteration: tomarā sakala loka karaha vicāre\\n'mora pitāra kanyā dite yogya ki ihāre'
verses.translation: "All of you assembled here are gentlemen. Please judge whether it is befitting to offer this poor brāhmaṇa my father's daughter."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ লোকের মনে হইল সংশয় ।\\n‘সম্ভবে, — ধনলোভে লোক ছাড়ে ধর্মভয় ।।’ ॥ ৬৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' lokera mane ha-ila saṁśaya\\n'sambhave,—dhana-lobhe loka chāḍe dharma-bhaya'
verses.translation: Hearing all these statements, all the people gathered there became a little doubtful. They thought it quite possible that because of attraction for riches one might give up his religious principles.

verses.devanagari: তবে ছোটবিপ্র কহে, — “শুন, মহাজন ।\\nন্যায় জিনিবারে কহে অসত্য-বচন ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabe choṭa-vipra kahe, "śuna, mahājana\\nnyāya jinibāre kahe asatya-vacana
verses.translation: At that time the young brāhmaṇa said, "My dear gentlemen, please hear. Just to gain victory in an argument, this man is lying.

verses.devanagari: এই বিপ্র মোর সেবায় তুষ্ট যবে হৈলা ।\\n‘তোরে আমি কন্যা দিব’ আপনে কহিলা ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei vipra mora sevāya tuṣṭa yabe hailā\\n'tore āmi kanyā diba' āpane kahilā
verses.translation: "Being very satisfied with my service, this brāhmaṇa said to me of his own accord, 'I promise to hand over my daughter to you.'

verses.devanagari: তবে মুঞি-নিষেধিনু, — শুন, দ্বিজবর ।\\nতোমার কন্যার যোগ্য নহি মুঞি বর ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: tabe muñi niṣedhinu,—śuna, dvija-vara\\ntomāra kanyāra yogya nahi muñi vara
verses.translation: "At that time I forbade him to do this, telling him, 'O best of the brāhmaṇas, I am not a fit husband for your daughter.

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ তুমি পণ্ডিত, ধনী, পরম কুলীন ।\\nকাহাঁ মুঞি দরিদ্র, মূর্খ, নীচ, কুলহীন ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ tumi paṇḍita, dhanī, parama kulīna\\nkāhāṅ muñi daridra, mūrkha, nīca, kula-hīna
verses.translation: “ 'Whereas you are a learned scholar, a rich man belonging to an aristocratic family, I am a poor man, uneducated and with no claim to aristocracy.'

verses.devanagari: তবু এই বিপ্র মোরে কহে বার বার ।\\nতোরে কন্যা দিলুঁ, তুমি করহ স্বীকার ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: tabu ei vipra more kahe bāra bāra\\ntore kanyā diluṅ, tumi karaha svīkāra
verses.translation: "Still this brāhmaṇa insisted. Again and again he asked me to accept his proposal, saying, 'I have given you my daughter. Please accept her.'

verses.devanagari: তবে আমি কহিলাঙ — শুন, মহামতি ।\\nতোমার স্ত্রী-পুত্র-জ্ঞাতির না হবে সম্মতি ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: tabe āmi kahilāṅ—śuna, mahā-mati\\ntomāra strī-putra-jñātira nā habe sammati
verses.translation: "I then said, 'Please hear. You are a learned brāhmaṇa. Your wife, friends and relatives will never agree to this proposal.

verses.devanagari: কন্যা দিতে নারিবে, হবে অসত্য-বচন ।\\nপুনরপি কহে বিপ্র করিয়া যতন ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: kanyā dite nāribe, habe asatya-vacana\\npunarapi kahe vipra kariyā yatana
verses.translation: “ 'My dear sir, you will not be able to fulfill your promise. Your promise will be broken.' Yet, again and again the brāhmaṇa emphasized his promise.

verses.devanagari: কন্যা তোরে দিলুঁ, দ্বিধা না করিহ চিতে ।\\nআত্মকন্যা দিব, কেবা পারে নিষেধিতে ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: kanyā tore diluṅ, dvidhā nā kariha cite\\nātma-kanyā diba, kebā pāre niṣedhite
verses.translation: “ 'I have offered you my daughter. Do not hesitate. She is my daughter, and I shall give her to you. Who can forbid me?'

verses.devanagari: তবে আমি কহিলাঙ দৃঢ় করি’ মন ।\\nগোপালের আগে কহ এ-সত্য বচন ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: tabe āmi kahilāṅ dṛḍha kari' mana\\ngopālera āge kaha e-satya vacana
verses.translation: "At that time I concentrated my mind and requested the brāhmaṇa to make the promise before the Gopāla Deity.

verses.devanagari: তবে ইঁহো গোপালের আগেতে কহিল ।\\nতুমি জান, এই বিপ্রে কন্যা আমি দিল ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe iṅho gopālera āgete kahila\\ntumi jāna, ei vipre kanyā āmi dila
verses.translation: "Then this gentleman said in front of the Gopāla Deity, 'My dear Lord, please bear witness. I have offered my daughter to this brāhmaṇa in charity.'

verses.devanagari: তবে আমি গোপালেরে সাক্ষী করিঞা ।\\nকহিলাঙ তাঁর পদে মিনতি করিঞা ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabe āmi gopālere sākṣī kariñā\\nkahilāṅ tāṅra pade minati kariñā
verses.translation: "Accepting the Gopāla Deity as my witness, I then submitted the following at His lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: যদি এই বিপ্র মোরে না দিবে কন্যাদান ।\\nসাক্ষী বোলাইমু তোমায়, হইও সাবধান ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: yadi ei vipra more nā dibe kanyā-dāna\\nsākṣī bolāimu tomāya, ha-io sāvadhāna
verses.translation: “ 'If this brāhmaṇa later hesitates to give me his daughter, my dear Lord, I shall call on You as a witness. Please note this with care and attention.'

verses.devanagari: এই বাক্যে সাক্ষী মোর আছে মহাজন ।\\nযাঁর বাক্য সত্য করি মানে ত্রিভুবন ।।” ॥ ৭৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: ei vākye sākṣī mora āche mahājana\\nyāṅra vākya satya kari māne tribhuvana"
verses.translation: "Thus I have called upon a great personality in this transaction. I have asked the Supreme Godhead to be my witness. The entire world accepts the words of the Supreme Personality of Godhead."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Although the young
brāhmaṇa
described himself as having no claims to aristocracy and being an uneducated common man, still he had one good qualification: he believed that the Supreme Personality of Godhead was the topmost authority, he accepted the words of Lord Kṛṣṇa without hesitation, and he had firm faith in the Lord's consistency. According to Prahlāda Mahārāja, another authority on the Supreme Personality of Godhead, such a staunch and faithful devotee of the Lord must be understood to be a most learned scholar:
tan manye 'dhītam uttamam
(Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 7.5.24). A pure devotee who has firm faith in the words of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is to be considered a most learned scholar, the topmost aristocrat and the richest man in the whole world. All godly qualities automatically exist in such a devotee. In the preaching work of the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, we, as the servant of the servant of the servant of the servant of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, fully believe in the words of Kṛṣṇa and His servants, the disciplic succession. In this way we are presenting the words of Kṛṣṇa throughout the world. Even though we are neither a rich man nor a very learned scholar, and even though we do not belong to any aristocracy, this movement is still being welcomed and is very easily spreading all over the world. Although we are very poor and have no professional source of income, Kṛṣṇa supplies money whenever we need it. Whenever we need some men, Kṛṣṇa supplies them. Thus it is stated in
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 6.22):
yaṁ labdhvā cāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ.
Actually, if we can attain the favor of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, we do not need anything else. We certainly do not need those things which a mundane person considers to be material assets.

verses.devanagari: তবে বড়বিপ্র কহে, — “এই সত্য কথা ।\\nগোপাল যদি সাক্ষী দেন, আপনে আসি’ এথা ॥৭৭॥\\nতবে কন্যা দিব আমি, জানিহ নিশ্চয় ।” তাঁর পুত্র কহে, — ‘এই ভাল বাত হয় ।।’ ৭৮ ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: tabe kanyā diba āmi, jāniha niścaya"\\ntāṅra putra kahe,—'ei bhāla bāta haya'
verses.translation: Taking this opportunity, the elderly brāhmaṇa immediately confirmed that this was really true. He said, "If Gopāla personally comes here to serve as a witness, I shall surely give my daughter to the young brāhmaṇa." The elderly brāhmaṇa's son immediately confirmed this, saying, "Yes, this is a very nice settlement."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As the Supersoul within the heart of all living entities, Kṛṣṇa knows everyone's desire, everyone's request and everyone's prayer. Although all these may be contradictory, the Lord has to create a situation in which everyone will be pleased. This is an instance of a marriage negotiation between an elderly
brāhmaṇa
and a youthful one. The elderly
brāhmaṇa
was certainly willing to give his daughter in charity to the young
brāhmaṇa,
but his son and relatives became impediments to this transaction. The elderly
brāhmaṇa
considered how to get out of this situation and still offer his daughter to the young
brāhmaṇa.
His son, an atheist and a very cunning fellow, was thinking of how to stop the marriage. The father and son were thinking in a contradictory way, yet Kṛṣṇa created a situation wherein they both agreed. They both agreed that if the Gopāla Deity would come and serve as a witness, the daughter would be given to the young
brāhmaṇa.

verses.devanagari: বড়বিপ্রের মনে, — ‘কৃষ্ণ বড় দয়াবান্ ।\\nঅবশ্য মোর বাক্য তেঁহো করিবে প্রমাণ ।।’ ॥ ৭৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: baḍa-viprera mane,—'kṛṣṇa baḍa dayāvān\\navaśya mora vākya teṅho karibe pramāṇa'
verses.translation: The elderly brāhmaṇa thought, "Since Lord Kṛṣṇa is very merciful, He will certainly come to prove my statement."

verses.devanagari: পুত্রের মনে, — ‘প্রতিমা না আসিবে সাক্ষী দিতে ।’\\nএই বুদ্ধ্যে দুইজন হইলা সম্মতে ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: putrera mane,—'pratimā nā āsibe sākṣī dite'\\nei buddhye dui-jana ha-ilā sammate
verses.translation: The atheistic son thought, "It is not possible for Gopāla to come and bear witness." Thinking thus, both father and son agreed.

verses.devanagari: ছোটবিপ্র বলে, — ‘পত্র করহ লিখন ।\\nপুনঃ যেন নাহি চলে এসব বচন ।।’ ॥ ৮১ ॥
verses.transliteration: choṭa-vipra bale,—'patra karaha likhana\\npunaḥ yena nāhi cale e-saba vacana'
verses.translation: The young brāhmaṇa took this opportunity to speak: "Please write this down on paper in black and white so that you may not again change your word of honor."

verses.devanagari: তবে সব লোক মেলি’ পত্র ত’ লিখিল ।\\nদুঁহার সম্মতি লঞা মধ্যস্থ রাখিল ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: tabe saba loka meli' patra ta' likhila\\nduṅhāra sammati lañā madhyastha rākhila
verses.translation: All the assembled people got this statement down in black and white and, taking the signatures of agreement from both of them, served as the mediators.

verses.devanagari: তবে ছোটবিপ্র কহে, — শুন, সর্বজন ।\\nএই বিপ্র — সত্য-বাক্য, ধর্মপরায়ণ ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe choṭa-vipra kahe,—śuna, sarva-jana\\nei vipra—satya-vākya, dharma-parāyaṇa
verses.translation: The young brāhmaṇa then said, "Will all you gentlemen present please hear me? This elderly brāhmaṇa is certainly truthful and is following religious principles.

verses.devanagari: স্ববাক্য ছাড়িতে ইঁহার নাহি কভু মন ।\\nস্বজন-মৃত্যু-ভয়ে কহে অসত্য-বচন ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: sva-vākya chāḍite iṅhāra nāhi kabhu mana\\nsvajana-mṛtyu-bhaye kahe asatya-vacana
verses.translation: "He had no desire to break his promise, but fearing that his kinsmen would commit suicide, he deviated from the truth.

verses.devanagari: ইঁহার পুণ্যে কৃষ্ণে আনি’ সাক্ষী বোলাইব ।\\nতবে এই বিপ্রের সত্য-প্রতিজ্ঞা রাখিব ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: iṅhāra puṇye kṛṣṇe āni' sākṣī bolāiba\\ntabe ei viprera satya-pratijñā rākhiba
verses.translation: "By the piety of the elderly brāhmaṇa, I shall call the Supreme Personality of Godhead as a witness. Thus I shall keep his truthful promise intact."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ নাস্তিক লোক উপহাস করে ।\\nকেহ বলে, ঈশ্বর — দয়ালু, আসিতেই পারে ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' nāstika loka upahāsa kare\\nkeha bale, īśvara—dayālu, āsiteha pāre
verses.translation: Hearing the emphatic statement of the younger brāhmaṇa, some atheists in the meeting began to cut jokes. However, someone else said, "After all, the Lord is merciful, and if He likes, He can come."

verses.devanagari: তবে সেই ছোটবিপ্র গেলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nদণ্ডবৎ করি’ কহে সব বিবরণ ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: tabe sei choṭa-vipra gelā vṛndāvana\\ndaṇḍavat kari' kahe saba vivaraṇa
verses.translation: After the meeting, the young brāhmaṇa started for Vṛndāvana. Upon arriving there, he first offered his respectful obeisances to the Deity and then narrated everything in full detail.

verses.devanagari: “ব্রহ্মণ্যদেব তুমি বড় দয়াময় ।\\nদুই বিপ্রের ধর্ম রাখ হঞা সদয় ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: "brahmaṇya-deva tumi baḍa dayā-maya\\ndui viprera dharma rākha hañā sadaya
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, You are the protector of brahminical culture, and You are also very merciful. Therefore, kindly show Your great mercy by protecting the religious principles of us two brāhmaṇas.

verses.devanagari: কন্যা পাব, — মোর মনে ইহা নাহি সুখ ।\\nব্রাহ্মণের প্রতিজ্ঞা যায় — এই বড় দুঃখ ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: kanyā pāba,—mora mane ihā nāhi sukha\\nbrāhmaṇera pratijñā yāya—ei baḍa duḥkha
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, I am not thinking to become happy by getting the daughter as a bride. I am simply thinking that the brāhmaṇa has broken his promise, and that is giving me great pain."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It was not at all the intention of the young
brāhmaṇa
to get the daughter of the elderly
brāhmaṇa
in marriage and thus enjoy material happiness and sense gratification. It was not for that reason that the young
brāhmaṇa
went to Vṛndāvana to ask the Supreme Personality of Godhead to act as a witness. His only concern was that the elderly
brāhmaṇa
had promised something, and if Gopāla did not bear witness to that transaction, then the older
brāhmaṇa
would incur a spiritual blemish. Therefore, the young
brāhmaṇa
wanted protection and help from the Deity. The young
brāhmaṇa
was thus a pure Vaiṣṇava, and he had no desire for sense gratification. He wanted only to serve the Supreme Personality of Godhead and the older
brāhmaṇa,
who was also a Vaiṣṇava and very devoted to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: এত জানি’ তুমি সাক্ষী দেহ, দয়াময় ।\\nজানি’ সাক্ষী নাহি দেয়, তার পাপ হয় ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: eta jāni' tumi sākṣī deha, dayā-maya\\njāni' sākṣī nāhi deya, tāra pāpa haya
verses.translation: The young brāhmaṇa continued, "My dear sir, You are very merciful and You know everything. Therefore, kindly be a witness in this case. A person who knows things as they are and still does not bear witness becomes involved in sinful activities."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The dealings between a devotee and the Lord are very simple. The young
brāhmaṇa
said to the Lord, "You know everything, but if You do not bear witness, You will be involved in sinful activities." There is no possibility, however, of the Lord's being involved in sinful activities. A pure devotee, even though he knows everything of the Supreme Lord, can speak with the Lord exactly as if He were a common man. Although the dealings between the Lord and His devotee are always very simple and open, there is formality. All these things happen because of the connection between the Lord and the devotee.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ কহে, — বিপ্র, তুমি যাহ স্ব-ভবনে ।\\nসভা করি’ মোরে তুমি করিহ স্মরণে ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa kahe,—vipra, tumi yāha sva-bhavane\\nsabhā kari' more tumi kariha smaraṇe
verses.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa replied, "My dear brāhmaṇa, go back to your home and call a meeting of all the men. In that meeting, just try to remember Me.

verses.devanagari: আবির্ভাব হঞা আমি তাঁহা সাক্ষী দিব ।\\nতবে দুই বিপ্রের সত্য প্রতিজ্ঞা রাখিব ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: āvirbhāva hañā āmi tāhāṅ sākṣī diba\\ntabe dui viprera satya pratijñā rākhiba
verses.translation: "I shall certainly appear there, and at that time I shall protect the honor of both you brāhmaṇas by bearing witness to the promise."

verses.devanagari: বিপ্র বলে, — “যদি হও চতুর্ভুজ-মূর্তি ।\\nতবু তোমার বাক্যে কারু না হবে প্রতীতি ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: vipra bale,—"yadi hao caturbhuja-mūrti\\ntabu tomāra vākye kāru nā habe pratīti
verses.translation: The young brāhmaṇa replied, "My dear sir, even if You appear there as a four-handed Viṣṇu Deity, still, none of those people will believe in Your words.

verses.devanagari: এই মূর্তি গিয়া যদি এই শ্রীবদনে ।\\nসাক্ষী দেহ যদি — তবে সর্বলোক শুনে ।।” ॥ ৯৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: ei mūrti giyā yadi ei śrī-vadane\\nsākṣī deha yadi—tabe sarva-loka śune"
verses.translation: "Only if You go there in this form of Gopāla and speak the words from Your beautiful face will Your testimony be heard by all the people."

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ কহে, — “প্রতিমা চলে, কোথাহ না শুনি ।”\\nবিপ্র বলে, — “প্রতিমা হঞা কহ কেনে বাণী ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa kahe,—"pratimā cale, kothāha nā śuni"\\nvipra bale,—"pratimā hañā kaha kene vāṇī
verses.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa said, "I've never heard of a Deity's walking from one place to another." The brāhmaṇa replied, "That is true, but how is it that You are speaking to me, although You are a Deity?

verses.devanagari: প্রতিমা নহ তুমি, — সাক্ষাৎ ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ।\\nবিপ্র লাগি’ কর তুমি অকার্য-করণ ।।” ॥ ৯৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: pratimā naha tumi—sākṣāt vrajendra-nandana\\nvipra lāgi' kara tumi akārya-karaṇa"
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, You are not a statue; You are directly the son of Mahārāja Nanda. Now, for the sake of the old brāhmaṇa, You can do something You have never done before."

verses.devanagari: হাসিঞা গোপাল কহে, — “শুনহ, ব্রাহ্মণ ।\\nতোমার পাছে পাছে আমি করিব গমন ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: hāsiñā gopāla kahe,—"śunaha, brāhmaṇa\\ntomāra pāche pāche āmi kariba gamana
verses.translation: Śrī Gopālajī then smiled and said, "My dear brāhmaṇa, just listen to Me. I shall walk behind you, and in this way I shall go with you."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The conversation between Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa and the
brāhmaṇa
is proof that the Lord in His
arcā-mūrti,
or form made of material elements, is not material, for those elements, although separated from the Lord, are also a part of the Lord's energy, as stated in
Bhagavad-gītā.
Because the elements are the Lord's own energy and because there is no difference between the energy and the energetic, the Lord can appear through any element. Just as the sun can act through the sunshine and thus distribute its heat and light, so Kṛṣṇa, by His inconceivable power, can appear in His original spiritual form in any material element, including stone, wood, paint, gold, silver and jewels, because the material elements are all His energy. The
śāstras
warn,
arcye viṣṇau śilā-dhīḥ .
.
. nārakī saḥ:
one should never think of the
arcā-mūrti,
the Deity within the temple, as stone, wood or any other material element. Because of his advanced devotional position, the younger
brāhmaṇa
knew that although the Deity of Gopāla appeared to be stone, He was not stone. He was the son of Nanda Mahārāja, Vrajendra-nandana Himself.
As such, the Deity can act exactly as the Lord did in His original form as Kṛṣṇa. Lord Kṛṣṇa was talking to the young
brāhmaṇa
just to test his knowledge about the
arcā-vigraha.
In other words, those who have understood the science of Kṛṣṇa-Kṛṣṇa's name, form, quality and so forth-can also talk with the Deity. To an ordinary person, however, the Deity will appear to be made of stone, wood or some other material. In the higher sense, since all material elements ultimately emanate from the supreme spiritual entity, nothing is really material. Being omnipotent, omnipresent and omniscient, Kṛṣṇa can deal with His devotees in any form without difficulty. By the mercy of the Lord, the devotee knows perfectly well about the Lord's dealings. Indeed, he can talk face to face with the Lord.

verses.devanagari: উলটিয়া আমা তুমি না করিহ দরশনে ।\\nআমাকে দেখিলে, আমি রহিব সেই স্থানে ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: ulaṭiyā āmā tumi nā kariha daraśane\\nāmāke dekhile, āmi rahiba sei sthāne
verses.translation: The Lord continued, "Do not try to see Me by turning around. As soon as you see Me, I shall remain stationary in that very place.

verses.devanagari: নূপুরের ধ্বনিমাত্র আমার শুনিবা ।\\nসেই শব্দে আমার গমন প্রতীতি করিবা ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: nūpurera dhvani-mātra āmāra śunibā\\nsei śabde āmāra gamana pratīti karibā
verses.translation: "You will know that I am walking behind you by the sound of My ankle bells.

verses.devanagari: একসের অন্ন রান্ধি’ করিহ সমর্পণ ।\\nতাহা খাঞা তোমার সঙ্গে করিব গমন ।।” ॥ ১০০ ॥
verses.transliteration: eka-sera anna rāndhi' kariha samarpaṇa\\ntāhā khāñā tomāra saṅge kariba gamana
verses.translation: "Cook one kilo of rice daily and offer it. I shall eat that rice and follow behind you."

verses.devanagari: আর দিন আজ্ঞা মাগি’ চলিলা ব্রাহ্মণ ।\\nতার পাছে পাছে গোপাল করিলা গমন ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina ājñā māgi' calilā brāhmaṇa\\ntāra pāche pāche gopāla karilā gamana
verses.translation: The next day, the brāhmaṇa begged permission from Gopāla and started for his country. Gopāla followed him, step by step.

verses.devanagari: নূপুরের ধ্বনি শুনি’ আনন্দিত মন ।\\nউত্তমান্ন পাক করি’ করায় ভোজন ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: nūpurera dhvani śuni' ānandita mana\\nuttamānna pāka kari' karāya bhojana
verses.translation: While Gopāla followed the young brāhmaṇa, the tinkling sound of His ankle bells could be heard. The brāhmaṇa became very pleased, and he cooked first-class rice for Gopāla to eat.

verses.devanagari: এইমতে চলি’ বিপ্র নিজে-দেশে আইলা ।\\nগ্রামের নিকট আসি’ মনেতে চিন্তিলা ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mate cali' vipra nija-deśe āilā\\ngrāmera nikaṭa āsi' manete cintilā
verses.translation: The young brāhmaṇa walked and walked in this way until he eventually arrived in his own country. When he neared his own village, he began to think as follows.

verses.devanagari: ‘এবে মুঞি গ্রামে আইনু, যাইমু ভবন ।\\nলোকেরে কহিব গিয়া সাক্ষীর আগমন ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'ebe muñi grāme āinu, yāimu bhavana\\nlokere kahiba giyā sākṣīra āgamana
verses.translation: "I have now come to my village, and I shall go to my home and tell all the people that the witness has arrived."

verses.devanagari: সাক্ষাতে না দেখিলে মনে প্রতীতি না হয় ।\\nইহাঁ যদি রহেন, তবু নাহি কিছু ভয় ।।’ ॥ ১০৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: sākṣāte nā dekhile mane pratīti nā haya\\nihāṅ yadi rahena, tabu nāhi kichu bhaya'
verses.translation: The brāhmaṇa then began to think that if the people didn't directly see the Gopāla Deity, they would not believe that He had arrived. "But even if Gopāla stays here," he thought, "there is still nothing to fear."

verses.devanagari: এত ভাবি’ সেই বিপ্র ফিরিয়া চাহিল ।\\nহাসিঞা গোপাল-দেব তথায় রহিল ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta bhāvi' sei vipra phiriyā cāhila\\nhāsiñā gopāla-deva tathāya rahila
verses.translation: Thinking this, the brāhmaṇa turned to look back, and He saw that Gopāla, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, was standing there smiling.

verses.devanagari: ব্রাহ্মণেরে কহে, — “তুমি যাহ নিজ-ঘর ।\\nএথায় রহিব আমি, না যাব অতঃপর ।।” ॥ ১০৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇere kahe,—"tumi yāha nija-ghara\\nethāya rahiba āmi, nā yāba ataḥpara"
