verses.translation: "If the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is not bestowed upon a person-regardless of how learned a scholar that person may be and regardless of his seeing or listening-he cannot accept the Lord as the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The same principles can be applied to demoniac persons, even though they be in the
sampradāya
of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Without receiving the Lord's special power, one cannot preach His glories all over the world. Even though one may celebrate himself as a learned follower of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and even though one may attempt to preach the holy name of the Lord all over the world, if he is not favored by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu he will find fault with the pure devotee and will not be able to understand how a preacher is empowered by Lord Caitanya. One must be considered bereft of the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu when he criticizes the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement now spreading all over the world or finds fault with this movement or the leader of the movement.

verses.devanagari: অথাপি তে দেব পদাম্বুজদ্বয়-\\nপ্ৰসাদলেশানুগৃহীত এব হি ।\\nজানাতি তত্ত্বং ভগবন্মহিম্নো\\nন চান্য একোঽপি চিরং বিচিন্বন্ ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: athāpi te deva padāmbuja-dvaya-\\nprasāda-leśānugṛhīta eva hi\\njānāti tattvaṁ bhagavan-mahimno\\nna cānya eko 'pi ciraṁ vicinvan
verses.translation: “ 'My Lord, if one is favored by even a slight trace of the mercy of Your lotus feet, he can understand the greatness of Your personality. But those who speculate to understand the Supreme Personality of Godhead are unable to know You, even though they continue to study the Vedas for many years.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is a quotation from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.14.29). It is explained in the
Madhya-līlā,
in the Sixth Chapter, text 84.

verses.devanagari: রাজা কহে, — সবে জগন্নাথ না দেখিয়া ।\\nচৈতন্যের বাসা-গৃহে চলিলা ধাঞা ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: rājā kahe,-sabe jagannātha nā dekhiyā\\ncaitanyera vāsā-gṛhe calilā dhāñā
verses.translation: The King said, "Instead of visiting the temple of Lord Jagannātha, all the devotees are running toward the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

verses.devanagari: ভট্ট কহে, — এই ত’ স্বাভাবিক প্রেম-রীত । মহাপ্রভু মিলিবারে উৎকণ্ঠিত চিত । আগে তাঁরে মিলি’ সবে তাঁরে সঙ্গে লঞা । তাঁর সঙ্গে জগন্নাথ দেখিবেন গিয়া ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭa kahe,-ei ta' svābhāvika prema-rīta\\nmahāprabhu milibāre utkaṇṭhita cita
verses.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya replied, "This is spontaneous love. All the devotees are very anxious to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: আগে তাঁরে মিলি’ সবে তাঁরে সঙ্গে লঞা ।\\nতাঁর সঙ্গে জগন্নাথ দেখিবেন গিয়া ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: āge tāṅre mili' sabe tāṅre saṅge lañā\\ntāṅra saṅge jagannātha dekhibena giyā
verses.translation: "First the devotees will meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then take Him with them to the temple to see Lord Jagannātha."

verses.devanagari: রাজা কহে, — ভবানন্দের পুত্র বাণীনাথ । প্রসাদ লঞা সঙ্গে চলে পাঁচ-সাত । মহাপ্রভুর আলয়ে করিল গমন । এত মহাপ্রসাদ চাহি’ — কহ কি কারণ ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: rājā kahe,-bhavānandera putra vāṇīnātha\\nprasāda lañā saṅge cale pāṅca-sāta
verses.translation: The King said, "The son of Bhavānanda Rāya named Vāṇīnātha, along with five or seven other men, went there to take the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভুর আলয়ে করিল গমন ।\\nএত মহাপ্রসাদ চাহি’ — কহ কি কারণ ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhura ālaye karila gamana\\neta mahā-prasāda cāhi'-kaha ki kāraṇa
verses.translation: "Indeed, Vāṇīnātha has already gone to the residence of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and has taken a huge quantity of mahā-prasāda. Please let me know the reason for this."

verses.devanagari: ভট্ট কহে, — ভক্তগণ আইল জানিঞা ।\\nপ্রভুর ইঙ্গিতে প্রসাদ যায় তাঁরা লঞা ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭa kahe,-bhakta-gaṇa āila jāniñā\\nprabhura iṅgite prasāda yāya tāṅrā lañā
verses.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "Understanding that all the devotees have come, Lord Caitanya gave the sign, and therefore they have brought such great quantities of mahā-prasāda."

verses.devanagari: রাজা কহে, — উপবাস, ক্ষৌর — তীর্থের বিধান ।\\nতাহা না করিয়া কেনে খাইব অন্ন-পান ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: rājā kahe,-upavāsa, kṣaura-tīrthera vidhāna\\ntāhā nā kariyā kene khāiba anna-pāna
verses.translation: The King then asked Bhaṭṭācārya, "Why have they not observed the regulations for visiting the pilgrimage place, such as fasting, shaving and so on? Why have they first eaten prasāda?"

verses.devanagari: ভট্ট কহে, — তুমি যেই কহ, সেই বিধি-ধর্ম ।\\nএই রাগমার্গে আছে সূক্ষ্মধর্ম-মর্ম ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭa kahe,-tumi yei kaha, sei vidhi-dharma\\nei rāga-mārge āche sūkṣma-dharma-marma
verses.translation: The Bhaṭṭācārya told the King, "What you have said is right according to the regulative principles governing the visiting of holy places, but there is another path, which is the path of spontaneous love. According to those principles, there are subtle intricacies involved in the execution of religious principles.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
According to the Vedic regulative principles, one has to be celibate before entering a holy place of pilgrimage. Generally people are very much addicted to sense gratification, and unless they have sex at night, they cannot sleep. The regulative principles therefore enjoin that before a common man goes to a holy place of pilgrimage, he should observe complete celibacy. As soon as one enters a holy place, he must observe fasting for the day, and after shaving his head clean, he must take a bath in a river or ocean near the holy place. These methods are adopted to neutralize the effects of sinful activities. Visiting a holy place of pilgrimage means neutralizing the reactions of a sinful life. Those who go to holy places of pilgrimage actually unload the reactions of their sinful lives, and consequently holy places are overloaded with sinful activities left there by visitors.
When a saintly person or pure devotee visits such a holy place, he absorbs the sinful effects left by the common man and again purifies the holy place.
Tīrthī-kurvanti tīrthāni
(Bhāg. 1.13.10). Therefore a common man's visit to a holy place and an exalted saintly person's visit there are different. The common man leaves his sins in the holy place, and a saintly person or devotee cleanses these sins simply by his presence. The devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu were not common men, and they could not be subjected to the rules and regulations governing the visiting of holy places. Rather, they exhibited their spontaneous love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Immediately upon arrival at the holy place, they went to see Lord Caitanya, and by His order they took
mahā-prasāda
without following the regulations governing holy places.

verses.devanagari: ঈশ্বরের পরোক্ষ আজ্ঞা — ক্ষৌর, উপোষণ ।\\nপ্রভুর সাক্ষাৎ আজ্ঞা — প্রসাদ-ভোজন ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: īśvarera parokṣa ājñā-kṣaura, upoṣaṇa\\nprabhura sākṣāt ājñā-prasāda-bhojana
verses.translation: "The scriptural injunctions for shaving and fasting are indirect orders of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. However, when there is a direct order from the Lord to take prasāda, naturally the devotees take prasāda as their first duty.

verses.devanagari: তাহাঁ উপবাস, যাহাঁ নাহি মহাপ্রসাদ ।\\nপ্রভু-আজ্ঞা-প্রসাদ-ত্যাগে হয় অপরাধ ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāhāṅ upavāsa, yāhāṅ nāhi mahā-prasāda\\nprabhu-ājñā-prasāda-tyāge haya aparādha
verses.translation: "When mahā-prasāda is not available, there must be fasting, but when the Supreme Personality of Godhead orders one directly to take prasāda, neglecting such an opportunity is offensive.

verses.devanagari: বিশেষে শ্রীহস্তে প্রভু করে পরিবেশন ।\\nএত লাভ ছাড়ি’ কোন্ করে উপোষণ ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: viśeṣe śrī-haste prabhu kare pariveśana\\neta lābha chāḍi' kon kare upoṣaṇa
verses.translation: "When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is distributing prasāda with His transcendental hand, who will neglect such an opportunity and accept the regulative principle of fasting?

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে প্রভু মোরে প্রসাদ-অন্ন আনি’ দিল ।\\nপ্রাতে শয্যায় বসি’ আমি সে অন্ন খাইল ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve prabhu more prasāda-anna āni' dila\\nprāte śayyāya vasi' āmi se anna khāila
verses.translation: "Previously the Lord gave me mahā-prasāda rice one morning, and I ate that just sitting on my bed, without having even washed my mouth.

verses.devanagari: যাঁরে কৃপা করি’ করেন হৃদয়ে প্রেরণ ।\\nকৃষ্ণাশ্রয় হয়, ছাড়ে বেদ-লোক-ধর্ম ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: yāṅre kṛpā kari' karena hṛdaye preraṇa\\nkṛṣṇāśraya haya, chāḍe veda-loka-dharma
verses.translation: "The man to whom the Lord shows His mercy by inspiring him within the heart takes shelter only of Lord Kṛṣṇa and abandons all Vedic and social customs.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is also the teaching of
Bhagavad-gītā
:
sarva-dharmān parityajya
mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja
ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo
mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
"Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions. Do not fear." Such firm faith in the Supreme Personality of Godhead is possible only by the mercy of the Lord. The Lord is sitting within everyone's heart, and when He personally inspires His devotee, the devotee does not stick to the Vedic principles or social customs but rather devotes himself to the transcendental loving service of the Lord. This is confirmed in the following verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(4.29.46).

verses.devanagari: যদা যমনুগৃহ্ণাতি ভগবানাত্মভাবিতঃ ।\\nস জহাতি মতিং লোকে বেদে চ পরিনিষ্ঠিতাম্ ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: yadā yam anugṛhṇāti\\nbhagavān ātma-bhāvitaḥ\\nsa jahāti matiṁ loke\\nvede ca pariniṣṭhitām
verses.translation: “ 'When one is inspired by the Lord, who is sitting in everyone's heart, he does not care for social custom or Vedic regulative principles.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This instruction (Bhāg. 4.29.46) was given by Nārada Gosvāmī to King Prācīnabarhi in connection with the story of Purañjana. Here Nārada implies that without the mercy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead one cannot extricate himself from the fruitive activities that are under the jurisdiction of the
Vedas.
In previous verses (
Bhāg.
4.29.42-44) Nārada admits that even personalities like Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva, Manu, the Prajāpatis (headed by Dakṣa), the four Kumāras, Marīci, Atri, Aṅgira, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Bhṛgu, Vasiṣṭha and even Nārada himself could not properly receive the causeless mercy of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: তবে রাজা অট্টালিকা হৈতে তলেতে আইলা ।\\nকাশীমিশ্র, পড়িছা-পাত্র, দুঁহে আনাইলা ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: tabe rājā aṭṭālikā haite talete āilā\\nkāśī-miśra, paḍichā-pātra, duṅhe ānāilā
verses.translation: After this, King Pratāparudra came down from the top of his palace to the ground and called for Kāśī Miśra and the inspector in the temple.

verses.devanagari: প্রতাপরুদ্র আজ্ঞা দিল সেই দুই জনে ।\\nপ্রভু-স্থানে আসিয়াছেন যত প্রভুর গণে ॥১২০॥\\nসবারে স্বচ্ছন্দ বাসা, স্বচ্ছন্দ প্রসাদ ।\\nস্বচ্ছন্দ দর্শন করাইহ, নহে যেন বাধ ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: sabāre svacchanda vāsā, svacchanda prasāda\\nsvacchanda darśana karāiha, nahe yena bādha
verses.translation: Mahārāja Pratāparudra then told both Kāśī Miśra and the temple inspector, "Provide all the devotees and associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with comfortable residences, convenient eating facilities for prasāda and convenient visiting arrangements at the temple so that there will not be any difficulty.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর আজ্ঞা পালিহ দুঁহে সাবধান হঞা ।\\nআজ্ঞা নহে, তবু করিহ, ইঙ্গিত বুঝিয়া ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura ājñā pāliha duṅhe sāvadhāna hañā\\nājñā nahe, tabu kariha, iṅgita bujhiyā
verses.translation: "The orders of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu must be carefully carried out. Although the Lord may not give direct orders, you are still to carry out His desires simply by understanding His indications."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ বিদায় দিল সেই দুই-জনে ।\\nসার্বভৌম দেখিতে আইল বৈষ্ণব-মিলনে ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' vidāya dila sei dui-jane\\nsārvabhauma dekhite āila vaiṣṇava-milane
verses.translation: Saying this, the King gave permission to them to leave. Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya also went to see the assembly of all the Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: গোপীনাথাচার্য ভট্টাচার্য সার্বভৌম ।\\nদূরে রহি’ দেখে প্রভুর বৈষ্ণব-মিলন ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: gopīnāthācārya bhaṭṭācārya sārvabhauma\\ndūre rahi' dekhe prabhura vaiṣṇava-milana
verses.translation: From a distant place both Gopīnātha Ācārya and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya watched the meeting of all the Vaiṣṇavas with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সিংহদ্বার ডাহিনে ছাড়ি’ সব বৈষ্ণবগণ । কাশীমিশ্র-গৃহ-পথে করিলা গমন । হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু নিজগণ-সঙ্গে । বৈষ্ণবে মিলিলা আসি’ পথে বহুরঙ্গে ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha-dvāra ḍāhine chāḍi' saba vaiṣṇava-gaṇa\\nkāśī-miśra-gṛha-pathe karilā gamana
verses.translation: Beginning from the right side of the lion gate, or the main gate of the temple, all the Vaiṣṇavas began to proceed toward the house of Kāśī Miśra.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু নিজগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nবৈষ্ণবে মিলিলা আসি’ পথে বহুরঙ্গে ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle mahāprabhu nija-gaṇa-saṅge\\nvaiṣṇave mililā āsi' pathe bahu-raṅge
verses.translation: In the meantime, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, accompanied by His personal associates, met all the Vaiṣṇavas on the road with great jubilation.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত করিল প্রভুর চরণ বন্দন । আচার্যেরে কৈল প্রভু প্রেম-আলিঙ্গন । প্রেমানন্দে হৈলা দুঁহে পরম অস্থির । সময় দেখিয়া প্রভু হৈলা কিছু ধীর ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: advaita karila prabhura caraṇa vandana\\nācāryere kaila prabhu prema-āliṅgana
verses.translation: First Advaita Ācārya offered prayers to the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord immediately embraced Him in ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমানন্দে হৈলা দুঁহে পরম অস্থির ।\\nসময় দেখিয়া প্রভু হৈলা কিছু ধীর ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: premānande hailā duṅhe parama asthira\\nsamaya dekhiyā prabhu hailā kichu dhīra
verses.translation: Indeed, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Advaita Ācārya displayed agitation due to ecstatic love. Seeing the time and circumstance, however, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained patient.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাসাদি করিল প্রভুর চরণ বন্দন । প্রত্যেকে করিল প্রভু প্রেম-আলিঙ্গন । একে একে সর্বভক্তে কৈল সম্ভাষণ । সবা লঞা অভ্যন্তরে করিলা গমন ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsādi karila prabhura caraṇa vandana\\npratyeke karila prabhu prema-āliṅgana
verses.translation: After this, all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, offered prayers to the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord embraced each and every one of them in great love and ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: একে একে সর্বভক্তে কৈল সম্ভাষণ ।\\nসবা লঞা অভ্যন্তরে করিলা গমন ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: eke eke sarva-bhakte kaila sambhāṣaṇa\\nsabā lañā abhyantare karilā gamana
verses.translation: The Lord addressed all the devotees one after another and took all of them with Him into the house.

verses.devanagari: মিশ্রের আবাস সেই হয় অল্প স্থান ।\\nঅসংখ্য বৈষ্ণব তাহাঁ হৈল পরিমাণ ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: miśrera āvāsa sei haya alpa sthāna\\nasaṅkhya vaiṣṇava tāhāṅ haila parimāṇa
verses.translation: Since the residence of Kāśī Miśra was insufficient, all the assembled devotees were very much overcrowded.

verses.devanagari: আপন-নিকটে প্রভু সবা বসাইলা ।\\nআপনি শ্রীহস্তে সবারে মাল্য-গন্ধ দিলা ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: āpana-nikaṭe prabhu sabā vasāilā\\nāpani śrī-haste sabāre mālya-gandha dilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu made all the devotees sit at His side, and with His own hand He offered them garlands and sandalwood pulp.

verses.devanagari: ভট্টাচার্য, আচার্য তবে মহাপ্রভুর স্থানে ।\\nযথাযোগ্য মিলিলা সবাকার সনে ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭācārya, ācārya tabe mahāprabhura sthāne\\nyathā-yogya mililā sabākāra sane
verses.translation: After this, Gopīnātha Ācārya and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya met all the Vaiṣṇavas at the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in a befitting manner.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈতেরে কহেন প্রভু মধুর বচনে ।\\nআজি আমি পূর্ণ হইলাঙ তোমার আগমনে ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: advaitere kahena prabhu madhura vacane\\nāji āmi pūrṇa ha-ilāṅa tomāra āgamane
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu addressed Advaita Ācārya Prabhu, saying sweetly, "My dear Sir, today I have become perfect because of Your arrival."

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত কহে, — ঈশ্বরের এই স্বভাব হয় ।\\nযদ্যপি আপনে পূর্ণ, সর্বৈশ্বর্যময় ॥১৩৫॥\\nতথাপি ভক্তসঙ্গে হয় সুখোল্লাস ।\\nভক্ত-সঙ্গে করে নিত্য বিবিধ বিলাস ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpi bhakta-saṅge haya sukhollāsa\\nbhakta-saṅge kare nitya vividha vilāsa
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya Prabhu replied, "This is a natural characteristic of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Although He is personally complete and full of all opulences, He takes transcendental pleasure in the association of His devotees, with whom He has a variety of eternal pastimes."

verses.devanagari: বাসুদেব দেখি’ প্রভু আনন্দিত হঞা । তাঁরে কিছু কহে তাঁর অঙ্গে হস্ত দিয়া । যদ্যপি মুকুন্দ — আমা-সঙ্গে শিশু হৈতে । তাঁহা হৈতে অধিক সুখ তোমারে দেখিতে ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: vāsudeva dekhi' prabhu ānandita hañā\\ntāṅre kichu kahe tāṅra aṅge hasta diyā
verses.translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Vāsudeva Datta, the father of Mukunda Datta, He immediately became very happy and, placing His hand on his body, began to speak.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি মুকুন্দ — আমা-সঙ্গে শিশু হৈতে ।\\nতাঁহা হৈতে অধিক সুখ তোমারে দেখিতে ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi mukunda-āmā-saṅge śiśu haite\\ntāṅhā haite adhika sukha tomāre dekhite
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Although Mukunda is My friend from childhood, I nonetheless take greater pleasure in seeing you than in seeing him."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nVāsudeva Datta was the father of Mukunda Datta, who was the childhood friend of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. It is naturally a great pleasure to see a friend, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu informed the father that although it was His pleasure to see His friend, His pleasure was increased by seeing the father.

verses.devanagari: বাসু কহে, — মুকুন্দ আদৌ পাইল তোমার সঙ্গ ।\\nতোমার চরণ পাইল সেই পুনর্জন্ম ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: vāsu kahe,-mukunda ādau pāila tomāra saṅga\\ntomāra caraṇa pāila sei punar-janma
verses.translation: Vāsudeva replied, "Mukunda got Your association in the beginning. As such, he has taken shelter at Your lotus feet. That is his transcendental rebirth."

verses.devanagari: ছোট হঞা মুকুন্দ এবে হৈল আমার জ্যেষ্ঠ ।\\nতোমার কৃপাপাত্র তাতে সর্বগুণে শ্রেষ্ঠ ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: choṭa hañā mukunda ebe haila āmāra jyeṣṭha\\ntomāra kṛpā-pātra tāte sarva-guṇe śreṣṭha
verses.translation: Thus Vāsudeva Datta admitted his inferiority to Mukunda, his son. "Although Mukunda is my junior," he said, "he first received Your favor. Consequently he became transcendentally senior to me. Besides that, You very much favored Mukunda. Thus he is superior in all good qualities."

verses.devanagari: পুনঃ প্রভু কহে — আমি তোমার নিমিত্তে । দুই পুস্তক আনিয়াছি ‘দক্ষিণ’ হইতে । স্বরূপের ঠাঁই আছে, লহ তা লিখিয়া । বাসুদেব আনন্দিত পুস্তক পাঞা ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ prabhu kahe-āmi tomāra nimitte\\ndui pustaka āniyāchi 'dakṣiṇa' ha-ite
verses.translation: The Lord said, "For your sake only, I have brought two books from South India.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপের ঠাঁই আছে, লহ তা লিখিয়া ।\\nবাসুদেব আনন্দিত পুস্তক পাঞা ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpera ṭhāṅi āche, laha tā likhiyā\\nvāsudeva ānandita pustaka pāñā
verses.translation: "The books are kept with Svarūpa Dāmodara, and you can get them copied." Hearing this, Vāsudeva became very glad.

verses.devanagari: প্রত্যেক বৈষ্ণব সবে লিখিয়া লইল ।\\nক্রমে ক্রমে দুই গ্রন্থ সর্বত্র ব্যাপিল ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: pratyeka vaiṣṇava sabe likhiyā la-ila\\nkrame krame dui grantha sarvatra vyāpila
verses.translation: Indeed, each and every Vaiṣṇava copied the two books. By and by, the two books [the Brahma-saṁhitā and Śrī Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta] were broadcast all over India.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাসাদ্যে কহে প্রভু করি’ মহাপ্রীত ।\\nতোমার চারি-ভাইর আমি হইনু বিক্রীত ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsādye kahe prabhu kari' mahā-prīta\\ntomāra cāri-bhāira āmi ha-inu vikrīta
verses.translation: The Lord addressed Śrīvāsa and his brothers with great love and affection, saying, "I am so obliged that I am purchased by you four brothers."

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাস কহেন, — কেনে কহ বিপরীত ।\\nকৃপা-মূল্যে চারি ভাই হই তোমার ক্রীত ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsa kahena,-kene kaha viparīta\\nkṛpā-mūlye cāri bhāi ha-i tomāra krīta
verses.translation: Śrīvāsa then replied to the Lord, "Why are You speaking in a contradictory way? Rather, we four brothers have been purchased by Your mercy."

verses.devanagari: শঙ্করে দেখিয়া প্রভু কহে দামোদরে । সগৌরব-প্রীতি আমার তোমার উপরে । শুদ্ধ কেবল-প্রেম শঙ্কর-উপরে । অতএব তোমার সঙ্গে রাখহ শঙ্করে ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: śaṅkare dekhiyā prabhu kahe dāmodare\\nsagaurava-prīti āmāra tomāra upare
verses.translation: After seeing Śaṅkara, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Dāmodara, "My affection for you is on the platform of awe and reverence.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nHere the Lord is addressing Dāmodara Paṇḍita, who is different from Svarūpa Dāmodara. Dāmodara Paṇḍita is the elder brother of Śaṅkara. Thus the Lord informed Dāmodara that His affection toward him was on the platform of awe and reverence. However, the Lord's affection toward his younger brother, Śaṅkara, was on the platform of pure love.

verses.devanagari: শুদ্ধ কেবল-প্রেম শঙ্কর-উপরে ।\\nঅতএব তোমার সঙ্গে রাখহ শঙ্করে ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: śuddha kevala-prema śaṅkara-upare\\nataeva tomāra saṅge rākhaha śaṅkare
verses.translation: "Therefore keep your younger brother Śaṅkara with you because he is connected to Me by pure unalloyed love."

verses.devanagari: দামোদর কহে, — শঙ্কর ছোট আমা হৈতে ।\\nএবে আমার বড় ভাই তোমার কৃপাতে ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: dāmodara kahe,-śaṅkara choṭa āmā haite\\nebe āmāra baḍa bhāi tomāra kṛpāte
verses.translation: Dāmodara Paṇḍita replied, "Śaṅkara is my younger brother, but from today he becomes my elder brother because of Your special mercy upon him."

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দে কহে প্রভু, — তোমার আমাতে ।\\nগাঢ় অনুরাগ হয়, জানি আগে হৈতে ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: śivānande kahe prabhu,-tomāra āmāte\\ngāḍha anurāga haya, jāni āge haite
verses.translation: Then turning toward Śivānanda Sena, the Lord said, "I know that from the very beginning your affection for Me has been very great."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ শিবানন্দ-সেন প্রেমাবিষ্ট হঞা ।\\nদণ্ডবৎ হঞা পড়ে শ্লোক পড়িয়া ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' śivānanda-sena premāviṣṭa hañā\\ndaṇḍavat hañā paḍe śloka paḍiyā
verses.translation: Immediately upon hearing this, Śivānanda Sena became absorbed in ecstatic love and fell down on the ground, offering obeisances to the Lord. He then began to recite the following verse.

verses.devanagari: নিমজ্জতোঽনন্ত ভবার্ণবান্তশ্চিরায় মে কূলমিবাসি লব্ধঃ ।\\nত্বয়াপি লব্ধং ভগবন্নিদানীমনুত্তমং পাত্রমিদং দয়ায়াঃ ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: nimajjato 'nanta bhavārṇavāntaś\\ncirāya me kūlam ivāsi labdhaḥ\\ntvayāpi labdhaṁ bhagavann idānīm\\nanuttamaṁ pātram idaṁ dayāyāḥ
verses.translation: “ 'O my Lord! O unlimited one! Although I was merged in the ocean of nescience, I have now, after a long time, attained You, just as one may attain the seashore. My dear Lord, by getting me, You have obtained the right person upon whom to bestow Your causeless mercy.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from the
Stotra-ratna
(21), composed by Ālabandāru Yāmunācārya. One's relationship with the Supreme Personality of Godhead may be reestablished even after one has fallen into the ocean of nescience, which is the ocean of material existence involving the repetition of birth, death, old age and disease, all arising out of the acceptance of the material body. There are 8,400,000 species of material life, but in the human body one attains a chance to get release from the repetition of birth and death. When one becomes the Lord's devotee, he is rescued from this dangerous ocean of birth and death. The Lord is always prepared to show His mercy to the fallen souls struggling against miserable material conditions. As Lord Kṛṣṇa states in the
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 15.7):
mamaivāṁśo jīva-loke
jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
manaḥ-ṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi
prakṛti-sthāni karṣati
"The living entities in this conditioned world are My eternal fragmental parts. Due to conditioned life, they are struggling very hard with the six senses, which include the mind."
Thus every living being is struggling hard in this material nature. Actually the living entity is part and parcel of the Supreme Lord, and when he surrenders unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he attains release from the ocean of birth and death. The Lord, being very kind to fallen souls, is always anxious to get the living entity out of the ocean of nescience. If the living entity understands his position and surrenders to the Lord, his life becomes successful.

verses.devanagari: প্রথমে মুরারি-গুপ্ত প্রভুরে না মিলিয়া ।\\nবাহিরেতে পড়ি’ আছে দণ্ডবৎ হঞা ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: prathame murāri-gupta prabhure nā miliyā\\nbāhirete paḍi' āche daṇḍavat hañā
verses.translation: Murāri Gupta at first did not meet the Lord but rather remained outside the door, falling down like a stick to offer obeisances.

verses.devanagari: মুরারি না দেখিয়া প্রভু করে অন্বেষণ ।\\nমুরারি লইতে ধাঞা আইলা বহুজন ॥১৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: murāri nā dekhiyā prabhu kare anveṣaṇa\\nmurāri la-ite dhāñā āilā bahu-jana
verses.translation: When Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could not see Murāri amongst the devotees, He inquired about him. Thereupon many people immediately went to Murāri, running to take him to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: তৃণ দুইগুচ্ছ মুরারি দশনে ধরিয়া ।\\nমহাপ্রভু আগে গেলা দৈন্যাধীন হঞা ॥১৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: tṛṇa dui-guccha murāri daśane dhariyā\\nmahāprabhu āge gelā dainyādhīna hañā
verses.translation: Thus Murāri Gupta, catching two bunches of straw in his teeth, went before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with humility and meekness.

verses.devanagari: মুরারি দেখিয়া প্রভু আইলা মিলিতে । পাছে ভাগে মুরারি, লাগিলা কহিতে । মোরে না ছুঁইহ, প্রভু, মুঞি ত’ পামর । তোমার স্পর্শযোগ্য নহে পাপ কলেবর ॥১৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: murāri dekhiyā prabhu āilā milite\\npāche bhāge murāri, lāgilā kahite
verses.translation: Upon seeing Murāri come to meet Him, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went up to him, but Murāri began to run away and speak as follows.

verses.devanagari: মোরে না ছুঁইহ, প্রভু, মুঞি ত’ পামর ।\\nতোমার স্পর্শযোগ্য নহে পাপ কলেবর ॥১৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: more nā chuṅiha, prabhu, muñi ta' pāmara\\ntomāra sparśa-yogya nahe pāpa kalevara
verses.translation: "My Lord, please do not touch me. I am most abominable and am not fit for You to touch because my body is sinful."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — মুরারি, কর দৈন্য সম্বরণ ।\\nতোমার দৈন্য দেখি’ মোর বিদীর্ণ হয় মন ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,-murāri, kara dainya saṁvaraṇa\\ntomāra dainya dekhi' mora vidīrṇa haya mana
verses.translation: The Lord said, "My dear Murāri, please restrain your unnecessary humility. My mind is disturbed to see your meekness."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ প্রভু তাঁরে কৈল আলিঙ্গন ।\\nনিকটে বসাঞা করে অঙ্গ সম্মার্জন ॥১৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre kaila āliṅgana\\nnikaṭe vasāñā kare aṅga sammārjana
verses.translation: Saying this, the Lord embraced Murāri and had him sit down by His side. The Lord then began to cleanse his body with His own hands.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যরত্ন, বিদ্যানিধি, পণ্ডিত গদাধর ।\\nগঙ্গাদাস, হরিভট্ট, আচার্য পুরন্দর ॥১৫৯॥\\nপ্রত্যেকে সবার প্রভু করি’ গুণ গান ।\\nপুনঃ পুনঃ আলিঙ্গিয়া করিল সম্মান ॥১৬০॥
verses.transliteration: pratyeke sabāra prabhu kari' guṇa gāna\\npunaḥ punaḥ āliṅgiyā karila sammāna
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then again and again embraced all the devotees, including Ācāryaratna, Vidyānidhi, Paṇḍita Gadādhara, Gaṅgādāsa, Hari Bhaṭṭa and Ācārya Purandara. The Lord described their good qualities and glorified them again and again.

verses.devanagari: সবারে সম্মানি’ প্রভুর হইল উল্লাস ।\\nহরিদাসে না দেখিয়া কহে, — কাহাঁ হরিদাস ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: sabāre sammāni' prabhura ha-ila ullāsa\\nharidāse nā dekhiyā kahe,-kāhāṅ haridāsa
verses.translation: After thus offering respect to each and every devotee, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very jubilant. However, not seeing Haridāsa Ṭhākura, He inquired, "Where is Haridāsa?"

verses.devanagari: দূর হৈতে হরিদাস গোসাঞে দেখিয়া ।\\nরাজপথ-প্রান্তে পড়ি’ আছে দণ্ডবৎ হঞা ॥১৬২॥
verses.transliteration: dūra haite haridāsa gosāñe dekhiyā\\nrājapatha-prānte paḍi' āche daṇḍavat hañā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then saw in the distance that Haridāsa Ṭhākura was lying down flat on the road offering obeisances.

verses.devanagari: মিলন-স্থানে আসি’ প্রভুরে না মিলিলা ।\\nরাজপথ-প্রান্তে দূরে পড়িয়া রহিলা ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: milana-sthāne āsi' prabhure nā mililā\\nrājapatha-prānte dūre paḍiyā rahilā
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura did not come to the Lord's meeting place but remained fallen flat on the common road at a distance.

verses.devanagari: ভক্ত সব ধাঞা আইল হরিদাসে নিতে ।\\nপ্রভু তোমায় মিলিতে চাহে, চলহ ত্বরিতে ॥১৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta saba dhāñā āila haridāse nite\\nprabhu tomāya milite cāhe, calaha tvarite
verses.translation: All the devotees then went to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, saying, "The Lord wants to meet you. Please come immediately."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহে, — মুঞি নীচ-জাতি ছার ।\\nমন্দির-নিকটে যাইতে মোর নাহি অধিকার ॥১৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahe,-muñi nīca-jāti chāra\\nmandira-nikaṭe yāite mora nāhi ādhikāra
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "I cannot go near the temple because I am a low-caste, abominable person. I have no authority to go there."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Although Haridāsa Ṭhākura was such a highly exalted Vaiṣṇava that he was addressed as Haridāsa Gosvāmī, he still did not like to disturb the common sense of the general populace. Haridāsa Ṭhākura was so exalted that he was addressed as
ṭhākura
and
gosāñi,
and these titles are offered to the most advanced Vaiṣṇavas. The spiritual master is generally called
gosāñi,
and
ṭhākura
is used to address the
paramahaṁsas,
those in the topmost rank of spirituality. Nonetheless, Haridāsa Ṭhākura did not want to go near the temple, although he was called there by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself. The Jagannātha temple still accepts only those Hindus who are in the
varṇāśrama
order. Other castes, especially those who are not Hindu, are not allowed to enter the temple. This is a long-standing regulation, and thus Haridāsa Ṭhākura, although certainly competent and qualified to enter the temple, did not want even to go near it. This is called Vaiṣṇava humility.

verses.devanagari: নিভৃতে টোটা-মধ্যে স্থান যদি পাঙ । তাহাঁ পড়ি’ রহো, একলে কাল গোঙাঙ । জগন্নাথ-সেবকের মোর স্পর্শ নাহি হয় । তাহাঁ পড়ি’ রহোঁ, — মোর এই বাঞ্ছা হয় ॥১৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: nibhṛte ṭoṭā-madhye sthāna yadi pāṅa\\ntāhāṅ paḍi' raho, ekale kāla goṅāṅa
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura then expressed his desire: "If I could just get a solitary place near the temple, I could stay there alone and pass my time.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথ-সেবকের মোর স্পর্শ নাহি হয় ।\\nতাহাঁ পড়ি’ রহোঁ, — মোর এই বাঞ্ছা হয় ॥১৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: jagannātha-sevakera mora sparśa nāhi haya\\ntāhāṅ paḍi' rahoṅ,-mora ei vāñchā haya
verses.translation: "I do not wish the servants of Lord Jagannātha to touch me. I would remain there in the garden alone. That is my desire."

verses.devanagari: এই কথা লোক গিয়া প্রভুরে কহিল ।\\nশুনিয়া প্রভুর মনে বড় সুখ হইল ॥১৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei kathā loka giyā prabhure kahila\\nśuniyā prabhura mane baḍa sukha ha-ila
verses.translation: When this message was relayed to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by the people, the Lord became very happy to hear it.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে কাশীমিশ্র, পড়িছা, — দুই জন ।\\nআসিয়া করিল প্রভুর চরণ বন্দন ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle kāśī-miśra, paḍichā,-dui jana\\nāsiyā karila prabhura caraṇa vandana
verses.translation: At this time, Kāśī Miśra, along with the superintendent of the temple, came and offered his respects unto the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সর্ব বৈষ্ণব দেখি’ সুখ বড় পাইলা ।\\nযথাযোগ্য সবা-সনে আনন্দে মিলিলা ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: sarva vaiṣṇava dekhi' sukha baḍa pāilā\\nyathā-yogya sabā-sane ānande mililā
verses.translation: Upon seeing all the Vaiṣṇavas together, Kāśī Miśra and the superintendent became very happy. With great happiness they met with them in a befitting manner.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুপদে দুই জনে কৈল নিবেদনে ।\\nআজ্ঞা দেহ’, — বৈষ্ণবের করি সমাধানে ॥১৭১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu-pade dui jane kaila nivedane\\nājñā deha',-vaiṣṇavera kari samādhāne
verses.translation: Both submitted to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Please give us orders so that we may make proper arrangements to accommodate all the Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: সবার করিয়াছি বাসা-গৃহ-স্থান ।\\nমহাপ্রসাদ সবাকারে করি সমাধান ॥১৭২॥
verses.transliteration: sabāra kariyāchi vāsā-gṛha-sthāna\\nmahā-prasāda sabākāre kari samādhāna
verses.translation: "Accommodations have been arranged for all the Vaiṣṇavas. Now let us distribute mahā-prasāda to all of them."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — গোপীনাথ, যাহ’ বৈষ্ণব লঞা ।\\nযাহাঁ যাহাঁ কহে বাসা, তাহাঁ দেহ’ লঞা ॥১৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,-gopīnātha, yāha' vaiṣṇava lañā\\nyāhāṅ yāhāṅ kahe vāsā, tāhāṅ deha' lañā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately told Gopīnātha Ācārya, "Please go with the Vaiṣṇavas and accommodate them in whatever residences Kāśī Miśra and the temple superintendent offer."

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রসাদান্ন দেহ বাণীনাথ-স্থানে ।\\nসর্ব বৈষ্ণবের ইঁহো করিবে সমাধানে ॥১৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-prasādānna deha vāṇīnātha-sthāne\\nsarva-vaiṣṇavera iṅho karibe samādhāne
verses.translation: Then the Lord told Kāśī Miśra and the temple superintendent, "As for the remnants of food left by Jagannātha, let them be delivered to Vāṇīnātha Rāya's charge, for he can take care of all the Vaiṣṇavas and distribute mahā-prasāda to them."

verses.devanagari: আমার নিকটে এই পুষ্পের উদ্যানে । একখানি ঘর আছে পরম-নির্জনে । সেই ঘর আমাকে দেহ’ — আছে প্রয়োজন । নিভৃতে বসিয়া তাহাঁ করিব স্মরণ ॥১৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra nikaṭe ei puṣpera udyāne\\neka-khāni ghara āche parama-nirjane
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "Nearby My place, in this garden of flowers, is a single room that is very solitary.

verses.devanagari: সেই ঘর আমাকে দেহ’ — আছে প্রয়োজন ।\\nনিভৃতে বসিয়া তাহাঁ করিব স্মরণ ॥১৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: sei ghara āmāke deha'-āche prayojana\\nnibhṛte vasiyā tāhāṅ kariba smaraṇa
verses.translation: "Please give that room to Me, for I have a need for it. Indeed, I shall remember the lotus feet of the Lord sitting in that solitary place."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This statement of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is significant.
Nibhṛte vasiyā tāhāṅ kariba smaraṇa:
"I shall sit down there in that solitary place and remember the lotus feet of the Lord." Neophyte students are not to imitate sitting in a solitary place and remembering the lotus feet of the Lord by chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra.
We should always remember that it was Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself who wanted such a place, either for Himself or Haridāsa Ṭhākura. No one can suddenly attain the level of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and sit down in a solitary place to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
and remember the lotus feet of the Lord. Only an exalted person like Haridāsa Ṭhākura or Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is personally exhibiting the proper behavior for an
ācārya,
can engage in such a practice.
At the present moment we see that some of the members of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness are tending to leave their preaching activities in order to sit in a solitary place. This is not a very good sign. It is a fact that Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura has condemned this process for neophytes. He has even stated in a song,
pratiṣṭhāra tare, nirjanera ghare, tava hari-nāma kevala kaitava:
"Sitting in a solitary place intending to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
is considered a cheating process." This practice is not possible for neophytes at all. The neophyte devotee must act and work very laboriously under the direction of the spiritual master, and he must thus preach the cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Only after maturing in devotion can he sit down in a solitary place to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself did. Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He nonetheless traveled all over India continuously for six years and then retired at Jagannātha Purī to teach us a lesson. Even at Jagannātha Purī the Lord chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
in a great meeting at the Jagannātha temple. The point is that one should not try to imitate Haridāsa Ṭhākura at the beginning of one's transcendental life. One must first become very mature in devotion and thus receive the approval of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Only at such a time may one actually sit down peacefully in a solitary place to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
and remember the lotus feet of the Lord. The senses are very strong, and if a neophyte devotee imitates Haridāsa Ṭhākura, his enemies (
kāma, krodha, lobha, moha, mada
and
mātsarya
) will disturb and fatigue him. Instead of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra,
the neophyte will simply sleep soundly. Preaching work is meant for advanced devotees, and when an advanced devotee is further elevated on the devotional scale, he may retire to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mantra
in a solitary place. However, if one simply imitates advanced spiritual life, he will fall down, just like the
sahajiyās
in Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: মিশ্র কহে, — সব তোমার, চাহ কি কারণে ? আপন-ইচ্ছায় লহ, যেই তোমার মনে । আমি-দুই হই তোমার দাস আজ্ঞাকারী । যে চাহ, সেই আজ্ঞা দেহ’ কৃপা করি’ ॥১৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: miśra kahe,-saba tomāra, cāha ki kāraṇe?\\nāpana-icchāya laha, yei tomāra mane
verses.translation: Kāśī Miśra then told Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu: "Everything belongs to You. What is the use of Your begging? By Your own will You can take whatever You like.

verses.devanagari: আমি-দুই হই তোমার দাস আজ্ঞাকারী ।\\nযে চাহ, সেই আজ্ঞা দেহ’ কৃপা করি’ ॥১৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: āmi-dui ha-i tomāra dāsa ājñākārī\\nye cāha, sei ājñā deha' kṛpā kari'
verses.translation: "My Lord, we are Your two servants and are here just to carry out Your orders. By Your mercy, please tell us to do whatever You want."

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ দুই জনে বিদায় লইল ।\\nগোপীনাথ, বাণীনাথ — দুঁহে সঙ্গে নিল ॥১৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' dui jane vidāya la-ila\\ngopīnātha, vāṇīnātha-duṅhe saṅge nila
verses.translation: Saying this, Kāśī Miśra and the temple inspector took their departure, and Gopīnātha and Vāṇīnātha went with them.

verses.devanagari: গোপীনাথে দেখাইল সব বাসা-ঘর ।\\nবাণীনাথ-ঠাঞি দিল প্রসাদ বিস্তর ॥১৮০॥
verses.transliteration: gopīnāthe dekhāila saba vāsā-ghara\\nvāṇīnātha-ṭhāñi dila prasāda vistara
verses.translation: Gopīnātha was then shown all the residential places, and Vāṇīnātha was given large quantities of food [mahā-prasāda] left by Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: বাণীনাথ আইলা বহু প্রসাদ পিঠা লঞা ।\\nগোপীনাথ আইলা বাসা সংস্কার করিয়া ॥১৮১॥
verses.transliteration: vāṇīnātha āilā bahu prasāda piṭhā lañā\\ngopīnātha āilā vāsā saṁskāra kariyā
verses.translation: Thus Vāṇīnātha Rāya returned with large quantities of Lord Jagannātha's food remnants, including cakes and other good eatables. Gopīnātha Ācārya also returned after cleansing all the residential quarters.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভু কহে, — শুন, সর্ব বৈষ্ণবগণ । নিজ-নিজ-বাসা সবে করহ গমন । সমুদ্রস্নান করি’ কর চূড়া দরশন । তবে আজি ইহঁ আসি’ করিবে ভোজন ॥১৮২॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu kahe,-śuna, sarva vaiṣṇava-gaṇa\\nnija-nija-vāsā sabe karaha gamana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then addressed all the Vaiṣṇavas and requested that they listen to Him. He said, "Now you can go to your respective residential quarters.

verses.devanagari: সমুদ্রস্নান করি’ কর চূড়া দরশন ।\\nতবে আজি ইহঁ আসি’ করিবে ভোজন ॥১৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: samudra-snāna kari' kara cūḍā daraśana\\ntabe āji ihaṅ āsi' karibe bhojana
verses.translation: "Go to the sea and bathe and look at the top of the temple. After so doing, please come back here and take your lunch."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু নমস্করি’ সবে বাসাতে চলিলা ।\\nগোপীনাথাচার্য সবে বাসা-স্থান দিলা ॥১৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu namaskari' sabe vāsāte calilā\\ngopīnāthācārya sabe vāsā-sthāna dilā
verses.translation: After offering obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the devotees departed for their residences, and Gopīnātha Ācārya showed them their respective quarters.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভু আইলা তবে হরিদাস-মিলনে ।\\nহরিদাস করে প্রেমে নাম-সংকীর্তনে ॥১৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu āilā tabe haridāsa-milane\\nharidāsa kare preme nāma-saṅkīrtane
verses.translation: After this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to meet Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and He saw him engaged in chanting the mahā-mantra with ecstatic love. Haridāsa chanted, "Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু দেখি’ পড়ে আগে দণ্ডবৎ হঞা ।\\nপ্রভু আলিঙ্গন কৈল তাঁরে উঠাঞা ॥১৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu dekhi' paḍe āge daṇḍavat hañā\\nprabhu āliṅgana kaila tāṅre uṭhāñā
verses.translation: As soon as Haridāsa Ṭhākura saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he immediately fell down like a stick to offer Him obeisances, and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu raised him up and embraced him.

verses.devanagari: দুইজনে প্রেমাবেশে করেন ক্রন্দনে ।\\nপ্রভু-গুণে ভৃত্য বিকল, প্রভু ভৃত্য-গুণে ॥১৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: dui-jane premāveśe karena krandane\\nprabhu-guṇe bhṛtya vikala, prabhu bhṛtya-guṇe
verses.translation: Then both the Lord and His servant began to cry in ecstatic love. Indeed, the Lord was transformed by the quality of His servant, and the servant was transformed by the quality of his master.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The Māyāvādī philosophers say that the living entity and the Supreme Lord are nondifferent, and therefore they equate the transformation of the living entity with the transformation of the Lord. In other words, Māyāvādīs say that if the living entity is pleased, the Lord is also pleased, and if the living entity is displeased, the Lord is also displeased. By juggling words in this way, Māyāvādīs try to prove that there is no difference between the living entity and the Lord. This, however, is not a fact. In this verse Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī explains:
prabhu-guṇe bhṛtya vikala, prabhu bhṛtya-guṇe.
The Lord and the living entity are not equal, for the Lord is always the master, and the living entity is always the servant. Transformation takes place due to transcendental qualities, and it is thus said that the servant of the Lord is the heart of the Lord, and the Lord is the heart of the servant. This is also explained by Lord Kṛṣṇa in the
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 4.11):
ye yathā māṁ prapadyante
tāṁs tathaiva bhajāmy aham
mama vartmānuvartante
manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
"As all surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā."
The Lord is always eager to congratulate the servant because of the servant's transcendental quality. The servant pleasingly renders service unto the Lord, and the Lord also very pleasingly reciprocates, rendering even more than the servant.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহে, — প্রভু, না ছুঁইও মোরে ।\\nমুঞি — নীচ, অস্পৃশ্য, পরম পামরে ॥১৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahe,-prabhu, nā chuṅio more\\nmuñi-nīca, aspṛśya, parama pāmare
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My dear Lord, please do not touch me, for I am most fallen and untouchable and am lowest among men."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — তোমা স্পর্শি পবিত্র হইতে ।\\nতোমার পবিত্র ধর্ম নাহিক আমাতে ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,-tomā sparśi pavitra ha-ite\\ntomāra pavitra dharma nāhika āmāte
verses.translation: The Lord said, "I wish to touch you just to be purified, for your purified activities do not exist in Me."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is an example of the reciprocation of feelings between master and servant. The servant thinks that he is most impure and that the master should not touch him, and the master thinks that because He has become impure by associating with so many impure living entities, He should touch a pure devotee like Haridāsa Ṭhākura just to purify Himself. Actually both the servant and the master are already purified because neither of them is in touch with the impurities of material existence. They are already equal in quality because both of them are the purest. There is a difference in quantity, however, because the master is unlimited and the servant is limited. Consequently the servant always remains subordinate to the master, and this relationship is eternal and undisturbed. As soon as the servant feels like becoming the master, he falls into
māyā.
Thus it is by misuse of free will that one falls under the influence of
māyā.
The Māyāvādī philosophers try to explain the equality of master and servant in terms of quantity, but they fail to explain why, if the master and servant are equal, the servant falls victim of
māyā.
They try to explain that when the servant, the living entity, is out of the clutches of
māyā,
he immediately becomes the so-called master again. Such an explanation is never satisfactory. Being unlimited, the master cannot become a victim of
māyā,
for in such a case His unlimitedness is crippled or limited. Thus the Māyāvāda explanation is not correct. The fact is that the master is always master and unlimited, and the servant, being limited, is sometimes curtailed by the influence of
māyā. Māyā
is also the master's energy and is also unlimited; therefore the limited servant or limited living entity is forced to remain under the master or the master's potency,
māyā.
Being freed from
māyā's
influence, one can again become a pure servant and equal qualitatively to the Lord. The relationship between master and servant continues due to their being unlimited and limited respectively.

verses.devanagari: ক্ষণে ক্ষণে কর তুমি সর্বতীর্থে স্নান । ক্ষণে ক্ষণে কর তুমি যজ্ঞ-তপো-দান । নিরন্তর কর চারি বেদ অধ্যয়ন । দ্বিজ-ন্যাসী হৈতে তুমি পরম-পাবন ॥১৯০॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇe kṣaṇe kara tumi sarva-tīrthe snāna\\nkṣaṇe kṣaṇe kara tumi yajña-tapo-dāna
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exalted Haridāsa Ṭhākura, stating, "At every moment you take your bath in all the holy places of pilgrimage, and at every moment you perform great sacrifices, austerity and charity.

verses.devanagari: নিরন্তর কর চারি বেদ অধ্যয়ন ।\\nদ্বিজ-ন্যাসী হৈতে তুমি পরম-পাবন ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: nirantara kara cāri veda adhyayana\\ndvija-nyāsī haite tumi parama-pāvana
verses.translation: "You are constantly studying the four Vedas, and you are far better than any brāhmaṇa or sannyāsī."

verses.devanagari: অহো বত শ্বপচোঽতো গরীয়ান্\\nযজ্জিহ্বাগ্রে বর্ততে নাম তুভ্যম্ ।\\nতেপুস্তপস্তে জুহুবুঃ সস্নুরার্যা\\nব্রহ্মানূচুর্নাম গৃণন্তি যে তে ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: aho bata śva-paco 'to garīyān\\nyaj-jihvāgre vartate nāma tubhyam\\ntepus tapas te juhuvuḥ sasnur āryā\\nbrahmānūcur nāma gṛṇanti ye te
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then recited the following verse: " 'My dear Lord, one who always keeps Your holy name on his tongue becomes greater than an initiated brāhmaṇa. Although he may be born in a family of dog-eaters and therefore by material calculation may be the lowest among men, he is still glorious. This is the wonderful effect of chanting the holy name of the Lord. It is therefore concluded that one who chants the holy name of the Lord should be understood to have performed all kinds of austerities and great sacrifices mentioned in the Vedas. He has already taken his bath in all the holy places of pilgrimage. He has studied all the Vedas, and he is actually an Āryan.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The word Āryan means advanced. Unless one is spiritually advanced, he cannot be called an Āryan, and this is the difference between Āryan and non-Āryan. Non-Āryans are those who are not spiritually advanced. By following the Vedic culture, by performing great sacrifices and by becoming a strict follower of the Vedic instructions, one may become a
brāhmaṇa,
a
sannyāsī
or an Āryan. It is not possible to become a
brāhmaṇa, sannyāsī
or Āryan without being properly qualified.
Bhāgavata-dharma
never allows one to become a cheap
brāhmaṇa, sannyāsī
or Āryan. The qualities or qualifications described herein are quoted from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(3.33.7) and were spoken by Devahūti, the mother of Kapiladeva, when she understood the influence of devotional service (
bhakti-yoga
). In this way Devahūti praised the devotee, pointing out his greatness in all respects.

verses.devanagari: এত বলি তাঁরে লঞা গেলা পুষ্পোদ্যানে ।\\nঅতি নিভৃতে তাঁরে দিলা বাসা-স্থানে ॥১৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali tāṅre lañā gelā puṣpodyāne\\nati nibhṛte tāṅre dilā vāsā-sthāne
verses.translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took Haridāsa Ṭhākura within the flower garden, and there, in a very much secluded place, He showed him his residence.

verses.devanagari: এইস্থানে রহি’ কর নাম-সংকীর্তন ।\\nপ্রতিদিন আসি’ আমি করিব মিলন ॥১৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei-sthāne rahi' kara nāma saṅkīrtana\\nprati-dina āsi' āmi kariba milana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Haridāsa Ṭhākura, "Remain here and chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra. I shall personally come here to meet you daily.

verses.devanagari: মন্দিরের চক্র দেখি’ করিহ প্রণাম ।\\nএই ঠাঞি তোমার আসিবে প্রসাদান্ন ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: mandirera cakra dekhi' kariha praṇāma\\nei ṭhāñi tomāra āsibe prasādānna
verses.translation: "Remain here peacefully and look at the cakra on the top of the temple and offer obeisances. As far as your prasāda is concerned, I shall arrange to have that sent here."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Since he was born in a Mohammedan family, Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura could not enter the temple of Jagannātha due to temple restrictions. Nonetheless, he was recognized by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as Nāmācārya Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Haridāsa Ṭhākura, however, considered himself unfit to enter the Jagannātha temple. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could have personally taken Haridāsa Ṭhākura in the Jagannātha temple if He wished, but the Lord did not like to disturb a popular custom. Consequently the Lord asked His servant simply to look at the Viṣṇu wheel on top of the temple and offer obeisances (
namaskāra
). This means that if one is not allowed to enter the temple, or if he thinks himself unfit to enter the temple, he can look at the wheel from outside the temple, and that is as good as seeing the Deity within.
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu promised to come daily to see Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and this indicates that Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura was so advanced in spiritual life that, although considered unfit to enter the temple, he was being personally visited by the Lord every day. Nor was there any need for his going outside his residence to collect food. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu assured Haridāsa Ṭhākura that the remnants of His foodstuffs would be sent there.
Yoga-kṣemaṁ vahāmy aham
(Bg. 9.22). As stated in
Bhagavad-gītā,
the Lord arranges all life's necessities for His devotees.
One reference is made here for those who are very anxious to imitate the behavior of Ṭhākura Haridāsa in an unnatural way. One must receive the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu or His representative before adopting such a way of life. The duty of a pure devotee or a servant of the Lord is to carry out the order of the Lord. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked Nityānanda Prabhu to go to Bengal and preach, and He asked the Gosvāmīs, Rūpa and Sanātana, to go to Vṛndāvana and excavate the lost places of pilgrimage. In this case the Lord asked Haridāsa Ṭhākura to remain there at Jagannātha Purī and constantly chant the holy names of the Lord. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave different persons different orders, and consequently one should not try to imitate the behavior of Haridāsa Ṭhākura without being ordered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu or His representative. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura condemns such imitations in this way:
"My dear mind, you are trying to imitate Haridāsa Ṭhākura and chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mantra
in a secluded place, but you are not worth being called a Vaiṣṇava because what you want is cheap popularity and not the actual qualifications of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. If you try to imitate him you will fall down, for your neophyte position will cause you to think of women and money. Thus you will fall into the clutches of
māyā,
and your so-called chanting in a secluded place will bring about your downfall."

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ, জগদানন্দ, দামোদর, মুকুন্দ ।\\nহরিদাসে মিলি’ সবে পাইল আনন্দ ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda, jagadānanda, dāmodara, mukunda\\nharidāse mili' sabe pāila ānanda
verses.translation: When Nityānanda Prabhu, Jagadānanda Prabhu, Dāmodara Prabhu and Mukunda Prabhu met Haridāsa Ṭhākura, they all became very much pleased.

verses.devanagari: সমুদ্রস্নান করি’ প্রভু আইলা নিজ স্থানে ।\\nঅদ্বৈতাদি গেলা সিন্ধু করিবারে স্নানে ॥১৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: samudra-snāna kari' prabhu āilā nija sthāne\\nadvaitādi gelā sindhu karibāre snāne
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence after taking a bath in the sea, all the devotees, headed by Advaita Prabhu, went to bathe in the sea.

verses.devanagari: আসি’ জগন্নাথের কৈল চূড়া দরশন ।\\nপ্রভুর আবাসে আইলা করিতে ভোজন ॥১৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: āsi' jagannāthera kaila cūḍā daraśana\\nprabhura āvāse āilā karite bhojana
verses.translation: After bathing in the sea, all the devotees, headed by Advaita Prabhu, returned, and on their return they saw the top of the Jagannātha temple. They then went to the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to take their luncheon.

verses.devanagari: সবারে বসাইলা প্রভু যোগ্য ক্রম করি’ ।\\nশ্রীহস্তে পরিবেশন কৈল গৌরহরি ॥১৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: sabāre vasāilā prabhu yogya krama kari'\\nśrī-haste pariveśana kaila gaurahari
verses.translation: One after the other, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu made all the devotees sit in their proper places. He then began to distribute prasāda with His own transcendental hand.

verses.devanagari: অল্প অন্ন নাহি আইসে দিতে প্রভুর হাতে ।\\nদুই-তিনের অন্ন দেন এক এক পাতে ॥২০০॥
verses.transliteration: alpa anna nāhi āise dite prabhura hāte\\ndui-tinera anna dena eka eka pāte
verses.translation: All the devotees were served prasāda on plantain leaves, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu distributed on each leaf a quantity suitable for two or three men to eat, for His hand could not distribute less than that.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু না খাইলে কেহ না করে ভোজন ।\\nঊর্ধ্ব-হস্তে বসি’ রহে সর্ব ভক্তগণ ॥২০১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu nā khāile keha nā kare bhojana\\nūrdhva-haste vasi' rahe sarva bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: All the devotees kept their hands raised over the prasāda distributed to them, for they did not want to eat without seeing the Lord eat first.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি প্রভুকে কৈল নিবেদন ।\\nতুমি না বসিলে কেহ না করে ভোজন ॥২০২॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi prabhuke kaila nivedana\\ntumi nā vasile keha nā kare bhojana
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī then informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Unless You sit and take prasāda, no one will accept it.

verses.devanagari: তোমা-সঙ্গে রহে যত সন্ন্যাসীর গণ । গোপীনাথাচার্য তাঁরে করিয়াছে নিমন্ত্রণ । আচার্য আসিয়াছেন ভিক্ষার প্রসাদান্ন লঞা । পুরী, ভারতী আছেন তোমার অপেক্ষা করিয়া ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: tomā-saṅge rahe yata sannyāsīra gaṇa\\ngopīnāthācārya tāṅre kariyāche nimantraṇa
verses.translation: "Gopīnātha Ācārya has invited all the sannyāsīs who remained with You to come and take prasāda.

verses.devanagari: আচার্য আসিয়াছেন ভিক্ষার প্রসাদান্ন লঞা ।\\nপুরী, ভারতী আছেন তোমার অপেক্ষা করিয়া ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya āsiyāchena bhikṣāra prasādānna lañā\\npurī, bhāratī āchena tomāra apekṣā kariyā
verses.translation: "Gopīnātha Ācārya has already come bringing sufficient remnants of food to distribute to all the sannyāsīs, and sannyāsīs like Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī are waiting for You.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ লঞা ভিক্ষা করিতে বৈস তুমি ।\\nবৈষ্ণবের পরিবেশন করিতেছি আমি ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda lañā bhikṣā karite vaisa tumi\\nvaiṣṇavera pariveśana karitechi āmi
verses.translation: "You may sit down and accept the luncheon with Nityānanda Prabhu, and I shall distribute the prasāda to all the Vaiṣṇavas."

verses.devanagari: তবে প্রভু প্রসাদান্ন গোবিন্দ-হাতে দিলা ।\\nযত্ন করি’ হরিদাস-ঠাকুরে পাঠাইলা ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: tabe prabhu prasādānna govinda-hāte dilā\\nyatna kari' haridāsa-ṭhākure pāṭhāilā
verses.translation: After this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu carefully delivered some prasāda into the hands of Govinda to be given to Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: আপনে বসিলা সব সন্ন্যাসীরে লঞা ।\\nপরিবেশন করে আচার্য হরষিত হঞা ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: āpane vasilā saba sannyāsīre lañā\\npariveśana kare ācārya haraṣita hañā
verses.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally sat down to accept lunch with the other sannyāsīs, and Gopīnātha Ācārya began to distribute the prasāda with great pleasure.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ গোসাঞি, দামোদর, জগদানন্দ ।\\nবৈষ্ণবেরে পরিবেশে তিন জনে — আনন্দ ॥২০৮॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa gosāñi, dāmodara, jagadānanda\\nvaiṣṇavere pariveśe tina jane-ānanda
verses.translation: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, Dāmodara Paṇḍita and Jagadānanda all began to distribute prasāda to the devotees with great pleasure.

verses.devanagari: নানা পিঠাপানা খায় আকণ্ঠ পূরিয়া ।\\nমধ্যে মধ্যে ‘হরি’ কহে আনন্দিত হঞা ॥২০৯॥
verses.transliteration: nānā piṭhā-pānā khāya ākaṇṭha pūriyā\\nmadhye madhye 'hari' kahe ānandita hañā
verses.translation: They ate all kinds of cakes and sweet rice, filling themselves up to their throats, and at intervals they vibrated the holy name of the Lord in great jubilation.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is the practice of Vaiṣṇavas while taking
prasāda
to chant the holy name of Lord Hari at intervals and also sing various songs, such as
śarīra avidyā-jāla.
Those who are honoring
prasāda,
accepting the remnants of food offered to the Deity, must always remember that
prasāda
is not ordinary food.
Prasāda
is transcendental. We are therefore reminded:
mahā-prasāde govinde
nāma-brahmaṇi vaiṣṇave
sv-alpa-puṇya-vatāṁ rājan
viśvāso naiva jāyate
Those who are not pious cannot understand the value of
mahā-prasāda
or the holy name of the Lord. Both
prasāda
and the Lord's name are on the Brahman platform, or spiritual platform. One should never consider
prasāda
to be like ordinary hotel cooking. Nor should one touch any kind of food not offered to the Deity. Every Vaiṣṇava strictly follows this principle and does not accept any food that is not
prasāda.
One should take
prasāda
with great faith and should chant the holy name of the Lord and worship the Deity in the temple, always remembering that the Deity,
mahā-prasāda
and the holy name do not belong to the mundane platform. By worshiping the Deity, eating
prasāda
and chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra,
one can always remain on the spiritual platform (
brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
).

verses.devanagari: ভোজন সমাপ্ত হৈল, কৈল আচমন ।\\nসবারে পরাইল প্রভু মাল্য-চন্দন ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: bhojana samāpta haila, kaila ācamana\\nsabāre parāila prabhu mālya-candana
verses.translation: After everyone had finished his lunch and washed his mouth and hands, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally decorated everyone with flower garlands and sandalwood pulp.

verses.devanagari: বিশ্রাম করিতে সবে নিজ বাসা গেলা ।\\nসন্ধ্যাকালে আসি’ পুনঃ প্রভুকে মিলিলা ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: viśrāma karite sabe nija vāsā gelā\\nsandhyā-kāle āsi' punaḥ prabhuke mililā
verses.translation: After thus accepting prasāda, they all went to take rest at their respective residences, and in the evening they again came to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে রামানন্দ আইলা প্রভু-স্থানে ।\\nপ্রভু মিলাইল তাঁরে সব বৈষ্ণবগণে ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle rāmānanda āilā prabhu-sthāne\\nprabhu milāila tāṅre saba vaiṣṇava-gaṇe
verses.translation: At this time Rāmānanda Rāya also came to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord took the opportunity to introduce all the Vaiṣṇavas to him.

verses.devanagari: সবা লঞা গেলা প্রভু জগন্নাথালয় ।\\nকীর্তন আরম্ভ তথা কৈল মহাশয় ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: sabā lañā gelā prabhu jagannāthālaya\\nkīrtana ārambha tathā kaila mahāśaya
verses.translation: The great Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, then took all of them to the temple of Jagannātha and began the congregational chanting of the holy name there.

verses.devanagari: সন্ধ্যা-ধূপ দেখি’ আরম্ভিলা সংকীর্তন ।\\nপড়িছা আসি’ সবারে দিল মাল্য-চন্দন ॥২১৪॥
verses.transliteration: sandhyā-dhūpa dekhi' ārambhilā saṅkīrtana\\npaḍichā āsi' sabāre dila mālya-candana
verses.translation: After seeing the dhūpa-ārati of the Lord, they all began congregational chanting. Then the paḍichā, the superintendent of the temple, came and offered flower garlands and sandalwood pulp to everyone.

verses.devanagari: চারিদিকে চারি সম্প্রদায় করেন কীর্তন ।\\nমধ্যে নৃত্য করে প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ॥২১৫॥
verses.transliteration: cāri-dike cāri sampradāya karena kīrtana\\nmadhye nṛtya kare prabhu śacīra nandana
verses.translation: Four parties were then distributed in four directions to perform saṅkīrtana, and in the middle of them the Lord Himself, known as the son of mother Śacī, began to dance.

verses.devanagari: অষ্ট মৃদঙ্গ বাজে, বত্রিশ করতাল ।\\nহরিধ্বনি করে সবে, বলে — ভাল, ভাল ॥২১৬॥
verses.transliteration: aṣṭa mṛdaṅga bāje, batriśa karatāla\\nhari-dhvani kare sabe, bale-bhāla, bhāla
verses.translation: In the four groups there were eight mṛdaṅgas and thirty-two cymbals. All together they began to vibrate the transcendental sound, and everyone said, "Very good! Very good!"

verses.devanagari: কীর্তনের ধ্বনি মহামঙ্গল উঠিল ।\\nচতুর্দশ লোক ভরি’ ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভেদিল ॥২১৭॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtanera dhvani mahā-maṅgala uṭhila\\ncaturdaśa loka bhari' brahmāṇḍa bhedila
verses.translation: When the tumultuous vibration of saṅkīrtana resounded, all good fortune immediately awakened, and the sound penetrated the whole universe through the fourteen planetary systems.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তন-আরম্ভে প্রেম উথলি’ চলিল ।\\nনীলাচলবাসী লোক ধাঞা আইল ॥২১৮॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtana-ārambhe prema uthali' calila\\nnīlācala-vāsī loka dhāñā āila
verses.translation: When the congregational chanting began, ecstatic love immediately overflooded everything, and all the residents of Jagannātha Purī came running.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তন দেখি’ সবার মনে হৈল চমৎকার ।\\nকভু নাহি দেখি ঐছে প্রেমের বিকার ॥২১৯॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtana dekhi' sabāra mane haila camatkāra\\nkabhu nāhi dekhi aiche premera vikāra
verses.translation: Everyone was astonished to see such a performance of saṅkīrtana, and they all agreed that never before had kīrtana been so performed and ecstatic love of God so exhibited.

verses.devanagari: তবে প্রভু জগন্নাথের মন্দির বেড়িয়া ।\\nপ্রদক্ষিণ করি’ বুলেন নর্তন করিয়া ॥২২০॥
verses.transliteration: tabe prabhu jagannāthera mandira beḍiyā\\npradakṣiṇa kari' bulena nartana kariyā
verses.translation: At this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu circumambulated the temple of Jagannātha and continuously danced about the whole area.

verses.devanagari: আগে-পাছে গান করে চারি সম্প্রদায় ।\\nআছাড়ের কালে ধরে নিত্যানন্দ রায় ॥২২১॥
verses.transliteration: āge-pāche gāna kare cāri sampradāya\\nāchāḍera kāle dhare nityānanda rāya
verses.translation: As the circumambulation was performed, the four kīrtana parties sang in front and in the rear. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down to the ground, Śrī Nityānanda Rāya Prabhu lifted Him up.

verses.devanagari: অশ্রু, পুলক, কম্প, স্বেদ, গম্ভীর হুঙ্কার ।\\nপ্রেমের বিকার দেখি’ লোকে চমত্কার ॥২২২॥
verses.transliteration: aśru, pulaka, kampa, sveda, gambhīra huṅkāra\\npremera vikāra dekhi' loke camatkāra
verses.translation: While kīrtana was going on, there was a transformation of ecstatic love and much tears, jubilation, trembling, perspiration and deep resounding in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Upon seeing this transformation, all the people present became very much astonished.

verses.devanagari: পিচ্কারি-ধারা জিনি’ অশ্রু নয়নে ।\\nচারিদিকের লোক সব করয়ে সিনানে ॥২২৩॥
verses.transliteration: pickāri-dhārā jini' aśru nayane\\ncāri-dikera loka saba karaye sināne
verses.translation: The tears from the eyes of the Lord came out with great force, like water from a syringe. Indeed, all the people who surrounded Him were moistened by His tears.

verses.devanagari: ‘বেড়ানৃত্য’ মহাপ্রভু করি’ কতক্ষণ ।\\nমন্দিরের পাছে রহি’ করয়ে কীর্তন ॥২২৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'beḍā-nṛtya' mahāprabhu kari' kata-kṣaṇa\\nmandirera pāche rahi' karaye kīrtana
verses.translation: After circumambulating the temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for some time remained at the rear of the temple and continued His saṅkīrtana.

verses.devanagari: চারিদিকে চারি সম্প্রদায় উচ্চৈঃস্বরে গায় ।\\nমধ্যে তাণ্ডব-নৃত্য করে গৌররায় ॥২২৫॥
verses.transliteration: cāri-dike cāri sampradāya uccaiḥsvare gāya\\nmadhye tāṇḍava-nṛtya kare gaurarāya
verses.translation: On all four sides the four saṅkīrtana groups chanted very loudly, and in the middle Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced, jumping high.

verses.devanagari: বহুক্ষণ নৃত্য করি’ প্রভু স্থির হৈলা ।\\nচারি মহান্তেরে তবে নাচিতে আজ্ঞা দিলা ॥২২৬॥
verses.transliteration: bahu-kṣaṇa nṛtya kari' prabhu sthira hailā\\ncāri mahāntere tabe nācite ājñā dilā
verses.translation: After dancing for a long time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became still and ordered four great personalities to begin to dance.

verses.devanagari: এক সম্প্রদায়ে নাচে নিত্যানন্দ-রায়ে ।\\nঅদ্বৈত-আচার্য নাচে আর সম্প্রদায়ে ॥২২৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka sampradāye nāce nityānanda-rāye\\nadvaita-ācārya nāce āra sampradāye
verses.translation: In one group Nityānanda Prabhu began to dance, and in another group Advaita Ācārya began to dance.

verses.devanagari: আর সম্প্রদায়ে নাচে পণ্ডিত-বক্রেশ্বর ।\\nশ্রীবাস নাচে আর সম্প্রদায়-ভিতর ॥২২৮॥
verses.transliteration: āra sampradāye nāce paṇḍita-vakreśvara\\nśrīvāsa nāce āra sampradāya-bhitara
verses.translation: In another group Vakreśvara Paṇḍita and in another group Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura began to dance.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যে রহি’ মহাপ্রভু করেন দরশন ।\\nতাহাঁ এক ঐশ্বর্য তাঁর হইল প্রকটন ॥২২৯॥
verses.transliteration: madhye rahi' mahāprabhu karena daraśana\\ntāhāṅ eka aiśvarya tāṅra ha-ila prakaṭana
verses.translation: While this dancing was going on, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu watched them and performed a miracle.

verses.devanagari: চারিদিকে নৃত্যগীত করে যত জন ।\\nসবে দেখে, — প্ৰভু করে আমারে দরশন ॥২৩০॥
verses.transliteration: cāri-dike nṛtya-gīta kare yata jana\\nsabe dekhe,-prabhu kare āmāre daraśana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood in the middle of the dancers, and all the dancers in all directions perceived that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was looking at them.

verses.devanagari: চারি জনের নৃত্য দেখিতে প্রভুর অভিলাষ ।\\nসেই অভিলাষে করে ঐশ্বর্য প্রকাশ ॥২৩১॥
verses.transliteration: cāri janera nṛtya dekhite prabhura abhilāṣa\\nsei abhilāṣe kare aiśvarya prakāśa
verses.translation: Wanting to see the dancing of the four great personalities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited Himself in such a way to appear as if He were seeing everyone.

verses.devanagari: দর্শনে আবেশ তাঁর দেখি’ মাত্র জানে ।\\nকেমনে চৌদিকে দেখে, — ইহা নাহি জানে ॥২৩২॥
verses.transliteration: darśane āveśa tāṅra dekhi' mātra jāne\\nkemane caudike dekhe,-ihā nāhi jāne
verses.translation: Everyone who saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could understand that He was performing a miracle, but they did not know how it was that He could see from all four sides.

verses.devanagari: পুলিন-ভোজনে যেন কৃষ্ণ মধ্য-স্থানে ।\\nচৌদিকের সখা কহে, — আমারে নেহানে ॥২৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: pulina-bhojane yena kṛṣṇa madhya-sthāne\\ncaudikera sakhā kahe,-āmāre nehāne
verses.translation: In His own pastimes in Vṛndāvana, when Kṛṣṇa used to eat on the bank of the Yamunā and sit in the center of His friends, every one of the cowherd boys would perceive that Kṛṣṇa was looking at him. In the same way, when Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, everyone saw that Caitanya Mahāprabhu was facing him.

verses.devanagari: নৃত্য করিতে যেই আইসে সন্নিধানে ।\\nমহাপ্রভু করে তাঁরে দৃঢ় আলিঙ্গনে ॥২৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: nṛtya karite yei āise sannidhāne\\nmahāprabhu kare tāṅre dṛḍha āliṅgane
verses.translation: When someone came nearby while dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would tightly embrace him.

verses.devanagari: মহানৃত্য, মহাপ্রেম, মহাসংকীর্তন ।\\nদেখি’ প্রেমাবেশে ভাসে নীলাচল-জন ॥২৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-nṛtya, mahā-prema, mahā-saṅkīrtana\\ndekhi' premāveśe bhāse nīlācala-jana
verses.translation: Upon seeing the great dancing, great love and great saṅkīrtana, all the people of Jagannātha Purī floated in an ecstatic ocean of love.

verses.devanagari: গজপতি রাজা শুনি’ কীর্তন-মহত্ত্ব ।\\nঅট্টালিকা চড়ি’ দেখে স্বগণ-সহিত ॥২৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: gajapati rājā śuni' kīrtana-mahattva\\naṭṭālikā caḍi' dekhe svagaṇa-sahita
verses.translation: Hearing the greatness of the saṅkīrtana, King Pratāparudra went up to the top of his palace and watched the performance with his personal associates.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তন দেখিয়া রাজার হৈল চমৎকার ।\\nপ্রভুকে মিলিতে উত্কণ্ঠা বাড়িল অপার ॥২৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtana dekhiyā rājāra haila camatkāra\\nprabhuke milite utkaṇṭhā bāḍila apāra
verses.translation: The King was very astonished to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's kīrtana, and the King's anxiety to meet Him increased unlimitedly.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তন-সমাপ্ত্যে প্রভু দেখি’ পুষ্পাঞ্জলি ।\\nসর্ব বৈষ্ণব লঞা প্রভু আইলা বাসা চলি’ ॥২৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtana-samāptye prabhu dekhi' puṣpāñjali\\nsarva vaiṣṇava lañā prabhu āilā vāsā cali'
verses.translation: After the saṅkīrtana ended, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu watched the offering of flowers to the Lord Jagannātha Deity. Then He and all the Vaiṣṇavas returned to His residence.

verses.devanagari: পড়িছা আনিয়া দিল প্রসাদ বিস্তর ।\\nসবারে বাঁটিয়া তাহা দিলেন ঈশ্বর ॥২৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: paḍichā āniyā dila prasāda vistara\\nsabāre bāṅṭiyā tāhā dilena īśvara
verses.translation: The superintendent of the temple then brought large quantities of prasāda, which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally distributed to all the devotees.

verses.devanagari: সবারে বিদায় দিল করিতে শয়ন ।\\nএইমত লীলা করে শচীর নন্দন ॥২৪০॥
verses.transliteration: sabāre vidāya dila karite śayana\\nei-mata līlā kare śacīra nandana
verses.translation: Finally they all departed to rest in bed. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of Śacīmātā, performed His pastimes.

verses.devanagari: যাবৎ আছিলা সবে মহাপ্রভু-সঙ্গে ।\\nপ্রতিদিন এইমত করে কীর্তন-রঙ্গে ॥২৪১॥
verses.transliteration: yāvat āchilā sabe mahāprabhu-saṅge\\nprati-dina ei-mata kare kīrtana-raṅge
verses.translation: As long as the devotees remained at Jagannātha Purī with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the pastime of saṅkīrtana was performed with great jubilation every day.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিলুঁ প্রভুর কীর্তন-বিলাস ।\\nযেবা ইহা শুনে, হয় চৈতন্যের দাস ॥২৪২॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura kīrtana-vilāsa\\nyebā ihā śune, haya caitanyera dāsa
verses.translation: In this way I have explained the Lord's pastime of saṅkīrtana, and I bless everyone with this benediction: By listening to this description, one will surely become a servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥২৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Eleventh Chapter, describing the beḍā-kīrtana pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

sections.title: Chapter 12: The Cleansing of the Guṇḍicā Temple

verses.devanagari: শ্রীগুণ্ডিচা-মন্দিরমাত্মবৃন্দৈঃ\\nসংমার্জয়ন্ ক্ষালনতঃ স গৌরঃ ।\\nস্বচিত্তবচ্ছীতলমুজ্জ্বলঞ্চ\\nকৃষ্ণোপবেশৌপয়িকং চকার ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-guṇḍicā-mandiram ātma-vṛndaiḥ\\nsammārjayan kṣālanataḥ sa gauraḥ\\nsva-citta-vac chītalam ujjvalaṁ ca\\nkṛṣṇopaveśaupayikaṁ cakāra
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and cleansed the Guṇḍicā temple with His devotees and associates. In this way He made the temple as cool and bright as His own heart, and thus He made the place befitting for Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa to sit.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় গৌরচন্দ্র জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya gauracandra jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Gauracandra! All glories to Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীবাসাদি গৌরভক্তগণ ।\\nশক্তি দেহ, — করি যেন চৈতন্য বর্ণন ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrīvāsādi gaura-bhakta-gaṇa\\nśakti deha,-kari yena caitanya varṇana
verses.translation: All glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura! I beg their power so that I can properly describe Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে দক্ষিণ হৈতে প্রভু যবে আইলা ।\\nতাঁরে মিলিতে গজপতি উত্কণ্ঠিত হৈলা ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve dakṣiṇa haite prabhu yabe āilā\\ntāṅre milite gajapati utkaṇṭhita hailā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned from His South Indian tour, Mahārāja Pratāparudra, the King of Orissa, became very anxious to meet Him.

verses.devanagari: কটক হৈতে পত্রী দিল সার্বভৌম-ঠাঞি ।\\nপ্রভুর আজ্ঞা হয় যদি, দেখিবারে যাই ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: kaṭaka haite patrī dila sārvabhauma-ṭhāñi\\nprabhura ājñā haya yadi, dekhibāre yāi
verses.translation: The King sent a letter from his capital, Kaṭaka, to Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, entreating him to obtain the Lord's permission so that he could go and see Him.

verses.devanagari: ভট্টাচার্য লিখিল, — প্ৰভুর আজ্ঞা না হৈল  ।\\nপুনরপি রাজা তাঁরে পত্রী পাঠাইল ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭācārya likhila,-prabhura ājñā nā haila\\npunarapi rājā tāṅre patrī pāṭhāila
verses.translation: Replying to the King's letter, Bhaṭṭācārya wrote that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had not given His permission. After this, the King wrote him another letter.

verses.devanagari: প্ৰভুর নিকটে আছে যত ভক্তগণ  ।\\nমোর লাগি’ তাঁ-সবারে করিহ নিবেদন ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura nikaṭe āche yata bhakta-gaṇa\\nmora lāgi' tāṅ-sabāre kariha nivedana
verses.translation: In this letter the King requested Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, "Please appeal to all the devotees associated with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submit this petition to them on my behalf.

verses.devanagari: সেই সব দয়ালু মোরে হঞা সদয়  ।\\nমোর লাগি’ প্রভুপদে করিবে বিনয় ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: sei saba dayālu more hañā sadaya\\nmora lāgi' prabhu-pade karibe vinaya
verses.translation: "If all the devotees associated with the Lord are favorably disposed toward me, they can submit my petition at the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: তাঁ-সবার প্ৰসাদে মিলে শ্রীপ্ৰভুর পায়  ।\\nপ্রভুকৃপা বিনা মোর রাজ্য নাহি ভায় ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅ-sabāra prasāde mile śrī-prabhura pāya\\nprabhu-kṛpā vinā mora rājya nāhi bhāya
verses.translation: "By the mercy of all the devotees, one can attain the shelter of the lotus feet of the Lord. Without His mercy, my kingdom does not appeal to me.

verses.devanagari: যদি মোরে কৃপা না করিবে গৌরহরি  ।\\nরাজ্য ছাড়ি’ যোগী হই’ হইব ভিখারী ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: yadi more kṛpā nā karibe gaurahari\\nrājya chāḍi' yogī ha-i' ha-iba bhikhārī
verses.translation: "If Gaurahari, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, will not show mercy to me, I shall give up my kingdom, become a mendicant and beg from door to door."

verses.devanagari: ভট্টাচার্য পত্রী দেখি’ চিন্তিত হঞা ।\\nভক্তগণ-পাশ গেলা সেই পত্রী লঞা ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭācārya patrī dekhi' cintita hañā\\nbhakta-gaṇa-pāśa gelā sei patrī lañā
verses.translation: When the Bhaṭṭācārya received this letter, he became very anxious. He then took the letter and went to the devotees of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: সবারে মিলিয়া কহিল রাজ-বিবরণ ।\\nপিছে সেই পত্রী সবারে করাইল দরশন ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: sabāre miliyā kahila rāja-vivaraṇa\\npiche sei patrī sabāre karāila daraśana
verses.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya met with all the devotees and described the King's wishes. Then he presented the letter to all of them for inspection.

verses.devanagari: পত্রী দেখি’ সবার মনে হইল বিস্ময় ।\\nপ্রভুপদে গজপতির এত ভক্তি হয়! ॥ ১৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: patrī dekhi' sabāra mane ha-ila vismaya\\nprabhu-pade gajapatira eta bhakti haya!!
verses.translation: Upon reading the letter, everyone was astonished to see that King Pratāparudra had so much devotion for the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সবে কহে, — প্রভু তাঁরে কভু না মিলিবে ।\\nআমি-সব কহি যদি, দুঃখ সে মানিবে ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: sabe kahe,-prabhu tāṅre kabhu nā milibe\\nāmi-saba kahi yadi, duḥkha se mānibe
verses.translation: The devotees gave their opinion and said, "The Lord would never meet the King, and if we requested Him to do so, the Lord would surely feel very unhappy."

verses.devanagari: সার্বভৌম কহে, — সবে চল’ একবার ।\\nমিলিতে না কহিব, কহিব রাজ-ব্যবহার ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: sārvabhauma kahe,-sabe cala' eka-bāra\\nmilite nā kahiba, kahiba rāja-vyavahāra
verses.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya then said, "We shall go once again to the Lord, but we shall not request Him to meet the King. Rather, we shall simply describe the good behavior of the King."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ সবে গেলা মহাপ্ৰভুর স্থানে ।\\nকহিতে উন্মুখ সবে, না কহে বচনে ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' sabe gelā mahāprabhura sthāne\\nkahite unmukha sabe, nā kahe vacane
verses.translation: Having thus reached a decision, they all went to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There, although ready to speak, they could not even utter a word.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — কি কহিতে সবার আগমন ।\\nদেখিয়ে কহিতে চাহ, — না কহ, কি কারণ ? ॥ ১৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,-ki kahite sabāra āgamana\\ndekhiye kahite cāha,-nā kaha, ki kāraṇa?
verses.translation: After they arrived at Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's place, the Lord, seeing them, said, "What have you all come here to say? I see that you want to say something, but you do not speak. What is the reason?"

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ কহে, — তোমায় চাহি নিবেদিতে ।\\nনা কহিলে রহিতে নারি, কহিতে ভয় চিত্তে ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda kahe,-tomāya cāhi nivedite\\nnā kahile rahite nāri, kahite bhaya citte
verses.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu then said, "We want to tell You something. Although we cannot stay without speaking, we are still very much afraid to speak.

verses.devanagari: যোগ্যাযোগ্য তোমায় সব চাহি নিবেদিতে ।\\nতোমা না মিলিলে রাজা চাহে যোগী হৈতে ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: yogyāyogya tomāya saba cāhi nivedite\\ntomā nā milile rājā cāhe yogī haite
