even Kṛṣṇa Himself, because He is bestowing freely what no one else has ever given-pure love of Kṛṣṇa." Śrīla Locana dāsa Ṭhākura has also sung,
parama karuṇa, pahuṅ dui jana, nitāi-gaura-candra:
"The two brothers Nitāi and Gaura are so kind that no one can compare to them." Similarly, Śrīla Narottama dāsa ṭhākura has sung:
vrajendra-nandana yei,     śacī-suta haila sei,
balarāma haila nitāi,
dīna-hīna yata chila,     hari-nāme uddhārila,
tā'ra sākṣī jagāi-mādhāi
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's special mission is the deliverance of all fallen souls in Kali-yuga. Devotees of Kṛṣṇa must persistently seek the favor and mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to become fit to return home, back to Godhead.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু বলে, — কে তুমি, করিলা মোর হিত ?\\nআচম্বিতে আসি’ পিয়াও কৃষ্ণলীলামৃত ? ॥ ১৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu bale,-ke tumi, karilā mora hita?\\nācambite āsi' piyāo kṛṣṇa-līlāmṛta?
verses.translation: Finally Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Who are you? You have done so much for Me. All of a sudden you have come here and made Me drink the nectar of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: রাজা কহে, — আমি তোমার দাসের অনুদাস ।\\nভৃত্যের ভৃত্য কর, — এই মোর আশ ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: rājā kahe,-āmi tomāra dāsera anudāsa\\nbhṛtyera bhṛtya kara,-ei mora āśa
verses.translation: The King replied, "My Lord, I am the most obedient servant of Your servants. It is my ambition that You will accept me as the servant of Your servants."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThe greatest achievement for a devotee is to become a servant of the servants. Actually no one should desire to become the direct servant of the Lord. That is not a very good idea. When Prahlāda Mahārāja was offered a benediction by Nṛsiṁhadeva, Prahlāda rejected all kinds of material benediction, but he prayed to become the servant of the servant of the Lord. When Dhruva Mahārāja was offered a benediction by Kuvera, the treasurer of the demigods, Dhruva could have asked for unlimited material opulence, but he simply asked for the benediction of becoming the servant of the servants of the Lord. Kholāvecā Śrīdhara was a very poor man, but when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to give him a benediction, he also prayed to the Lord to be allowed to remain a servant of the servants of the Lord. The conclusion is that being the servant of the servants of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the highest benediction one can desire.

verses.devanagari: তবে মহাপ্রভু তাঁরে ঐশ্বর্য দেখাইল ।\\n‘কারেহ না কহিবে’ এই নিষেধ করিল ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: tabe mahāprabhu tāṅre aiśvarya dekhāila\\n'kāreha nā kahibe' ei niṣedha karila
verses.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu displayed some of His divine opulences to the King, and He forbade him to disclose this to anyone.

verses.devanagari: ‘রাজা’ — হেন জ্ঞান কভু না কৈল প্রকাশ ।\\nঅন্তরে সকল জানেন, বাহিরে উদাস ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: 'rājā'-hena jñāna kabhu nā kaila prakāśa\\nantare sakala jānena, bāhire udāsa
verses.translation: Although within His heart Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew everything that was happening, externally He did not disclose it. Nor did He disclose that He knew He was talking with King Pratāparudra.

verses.devanagari: প্রতাপরুদ্রের ভাগ্য দেখি’ ভক্তগণে ।\\nরাজারে প্রশংসে সবে আনন্দিত-মনে ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: pratāparudrera bhāgya dekhi' bhakta-gaṇe\\nrājāre praśaṁse sabe ānandita-mane
verses.translation: Seeing the Lord's special mercy upon King Pratāparudra, the devotees praised the King's fortune, and their minds became open and blissful.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis is a characteristic of a Vaiṣṇava. He is never envious if one receives the mercy and strength of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. A pure Vaiṣṇava is very happy to see a person elevated in devotional service. Unfortunately, there are many so-called Vaiṣṇavas who become envious to see someone actually recognized by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. It is a fact that no one can preach Caitanya Mahāprabhu's message without receiving the special mercy of the Lord. This is known to every Vaiṣṇava, yet there are some envious people who cannot tolerate the expansion of this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement all over the world. They find fault with a pure devotee preacher and do not praise him for the excellent service he renders in fulfilling Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mission.

verses.devanagari: দণ্ডবৎ করি’ রাজা বাহিরে চলিলা ।\\nযোড় হস্ত করি’ সব ভক্তেরে বন্দিলা ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍavat kari' rājā bāhire calilā\\nyoḍa hasta kari' saba bhaktere vandilā
verses.translation: Submissively offering prayers to the devotees with folded hands and offering obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the King went outside.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যাহ্ন করিলা প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণ ।\\nবাণীনাথ প্রসাদ লঞা কৈল আগমন ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: madhyāhna karilā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa\\nvāṇīnātha prasāda lañā kaila āgamana
verses.translation: After this, Vāṇīnātha Rāya brought all kinds of prasāda, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted lunch with the devotees.

verses.devanagari: সার্বভৌম-রামানন্দ-বাণীনাথে দিয়া ।\\nপ্রসাদ পাঠা’ল রাজা বহুত করিয়া ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: sārvabhauma-rāmānanda-vāṇīnāthe diyā\\nprasāda pāṭhā'la rājā bahuta kariyā
verses.translation: The King also sent a large quantity of prasāda through Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya.

verses.devanagari: ‘বলগণ্ডি ভোগে’র প্রসাদ — উত্তম, অনন্ত ।\\n‘নি-সকড়ি’ প্রসাদ আইল, যার নাহি অন্ত ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: 'balagaṇḍi bhoge'ra prasāda-uttama, ananta\\n'ni-sakaḍi' prasāda āila, yāra nāhi anta
verses.translation: The prasāda sent by the King had been offered at the Balagaṇḍi festival and included uncooked milk products and fruits. It was all of the finest quality, and there was no end to the variety.

verses.devanagari: ছানা, পানা, পৈড়, আম্র, নারিকেল, কাঁঠাল ।\\nনানাবিধ কদলক, আর বীজ-তাল ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: chānā, pānā, paiḍa, āmra, nārikela, kāṅṭhāla\\nnānā-vidha kadalaka, āra bīja-tāla
verses.translation: There was curd, fruit juice, coconut, mango, dried coconut, jackfruit, various kinds of bananas and palm fruit seeds.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is the first list of
prasāda
offered to Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: নারঙ্গ, ছোলঙ্গ, টাবা, কমলা, বীজপূর ।\\nবাদাম, ছোহারা, দ্রাক্ষা, পিণ্ডখর্জুর ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: nāraṅga, cholaṅga, ṭābā, kamalā, bīja-pūra\\nbādāma, chohārā, drākṣā, piṇḍa-kharjura
verses.translation: There were also oranges, grapefruit, tangerines, almonds, dried fruit, raisins and dates.

verses.devanagari: মনোহরা-লাড়ু আদি শতেক প্রকার ।\\nঅমৃতগুটিকা-আদি, ক্ষীরসা অপার ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: manoharā-lāḍu ādi śateka prakāra\\namṛta-guṭikā-ādi, kṣīrasā apāra
verses.translation: There were hundreds of different types of sweetmeats like manoharā-lāḍu, sweets like amṛta-guṭikā and various types of condensed milk.

verses.devanagari: অমৃতমণ্ডা, সরবতী, আর কুম্ড়া-কুরী ।\\nসরামৃত, সরভাজা, আর সরপুরী ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: amṛta-maṇḍā, saravatī, āra kumḍā-kurī\\nsarāmṛta, sarabhājā, āra sarapurī
verses.translation: There were also papayas and saravatī, a type of orange, and also crushed squash. There was also regular cream, fried cream and a type of purī made with cream.

verses.devanagari: হরিবল্লভ, সেঁওতি, কর্পূর, মালতী ।\\nডালিমা মরিচ-লাড়ু, নবাত, অমৃতি ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: hari-vallabha, seṅoti, karpūra, mālatī\\nḍālimā marica-lāḍu, navāta, amṛti
verses.translation: There were also sweets like hari-vallabha and sweets made of seṅoti flowers, karpūra flowers and mālatī flowers. There were pomegranates, sweets made with black pepper, sweets made with fused sugar, and amṛti-jilipi.

verses.devanagari: পদ্মচিনি, চন্দ্রকান্তি, খাজা, খণ্ডসার ।\\nবিয়রি, কদ্মা, তিলাখাজার প্রকার ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: padmacini, candrakānti, khājā, khaṇḍasāra\\nviyari, kadmā, tilākhājāra prakāra
verses.translation: There was lotus flower sugar, a kind of bread made from urad dhal, crispy sweetmeats, sugar candy, fried rice sweets, sesame seed sweets and cookies made from sesame seeds.

verses.devanagari: নারঙ্গ-ছোলঙ্গ-আম্র-বৃক্ষের আকার ।\\nফুল-ফল-পত্রযুক্ত খণ্ডের বিকার ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: nāraṅga-cholaṅga-āmra-vṛkṣera ākāra\\nphula-phala-patra-yukta khaṇḍera vikāra
verses.translation: There were sweetmeats made from sugarcane candy in the form of oranges, lemons and mangoes along with fruits, flowers and leaves.

verses.devanagari: দধি, দুগ্ধ, ননী, তক্র, রসালা, শিখরিণী ।\\nস-লবণ মুদগাঙ্কুর, আদা খানি খানি ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: dadhi, dugdha, nanī, takra, rasālā, śikhariṇī\\nsa-lavaṇa mudgāṅkura, ādā khāni khāni
verses.translation: There was yogurt, milk, butter, buttermilk, fruit juice, a preparation made of fried yogurt and sugar candy, and salty mung dhal sprouts with shredded ginger.

verses.devanagari: লেম্বু-কুল-আদি নানা-প্রকার আচার ।\\nলিখিতে না পারি প্রসাদ কতেক প্রকার ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: lembu-kula-ādi nānā-prakāra ācāra\\nlikhite nā pāri prasāda kateka prakāra
verses.translation: There were also various types of pickles-lemon pickle, berry pickle and so on. Indeed, I am not able to describe the variety of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nIn verses 26-34, the author describes the various foods offered to Lord Jagannātha. He has described them as far as possible, but he finally admits his inability to describe them completely.

verses.devanagari: প্রসাদে পূরিত হইল অর্ধ উপবন ।\\nদেখিয়া সন্তোষ হৈল মহাপ্রভুর মন ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: prasāde pūrita ha-ila ardha upavana\\ndekhiyā santoṣa haila mahāprabhura mana
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw half the garden filled with a variety of prasāda, He was very satisfied.

verses.devanagari: এইমত জগন্নাথ করেন ভোজন ।\\nএই সুখে মহাপ্রভুর জুড়ায় নয়ন ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata jagannātha karena bhojana\\nei sukhe mahāprabhura juḍāya nayana
verses.translation: Indeed, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was fully satisfied just to see how Lord Jagannātha accepted all the food.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Following in the footsteps of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, a Vaiṣṇava should be fully satisfied simply to see a variety of food offered to the Deity of Jagannātha or Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. A Vaiṣṇava should not hunger for a variety of food for his own sake; rather, his satisfaction is in seeing various foods being offered to the Deity. In his
Gurv-aṣṭaka,
Śrīla Viśvanātha Cakravartī Ṭhākura writes:
catur-vidha-śrī-bhagavat-prasāda-
svādv-anna-tṛptān hari-bhakta-saṅghān
kṛtvaiva tṛptiṁ bhajataḥ sadaiva
vande guroḥ śrī-caraṇāravindam
"The spiritual master is always offering Kṛṣṇa four kinds of delicious food [analyzed as that which is licked, chewed, drunk and sucked]. When the spiritual master sees that the devotees are satisfied by eating
bhagavat-prasāda,
he is satisfied. I offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of such a spiritual master."
The spiritual master's duty is to engage his disciples in preparing varieties of nice food to offer the Deity. After being offered, this food is distributed as
prasāda
to the devotees. These activities satisfy the spiritual master, although he himself does not eat or require such a variety of
prasāda.
By seeing to the offering and distribution of
prasāda,
he himself is encouraged in devotional service.

verses.devanagari: কেয়াপত্র-দ্রোণী আইল বোঝা পাঁচ-সাত ।\\nএক এক জনে দশ দোনা দিল, — এত পাত ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: keyā-patra-droṇī āila bojhā pāṅca-sāta\\neka eka jane daśa donā dila,-eta pāta
verses.translation: There then arrived five or seven loads of plates made of the leaves of the ketakī tree. Each man was supplied ten of these plates, and in this way the dishes were served.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তনীয়ার পরিশ্রম জানি’ গৌররায় ।\\nতাঁ-সবারে খাওয়াইতে প্রভুর মন ধায় ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtanīyāra pariśrama jāni' gaurarāya\\ntāṅ-sabāre khāoyāite prabhura mana dhāya
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu understood the labor of all the kīrtana chanters; therefore He was very eager to feed them sumptuously.

verses.devanagari: পাঁতি পাঁতি করি’ ভক্তগণে বসাইলা ।\\nপরিবেশন করিবারে আপনে লাগিলা ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: pāṅti pāṅti kari' bhakta-gaṇe vasāilā\\npariveśana karibāre āpane lāgilā
verses.translation: All the devotees sat down in lines, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally began to distribute the prasāda.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু না খাইলে, কেহ না করে ভোজন ।\\nস্বরূপ-গোসাঞি তবে কৈল নিবেদন ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu nā khāile, keha nā kare bhojana\\nsvarupa-gosāñi tabe kaila nivedana
verses.translation: However, the devotees could not accept the prasāda until Caitanya Mahāprabhu took it. It was Svarūpa Gosvāmī who informed the Lord of this.

verses.devanagari: আপনে বৈস, প্রভু, ভোজন করিতে ।\\nতুমি না খাইলে, কেহ না পারে খাইতে ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: āpane vaisa, prabhu, bhojana karite\\ntumi nā khāile, keha nā pāre khāite
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "My Lord, would You please sit down. No one will eat until You do."

verses.devanagari: তবে মহাপ্রভু বৈসে নিজগণ লঞা ।\\nভোজন করাইল সবাকে আকণ্ঠ পূরিয়া ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: tabe mahāprabhu vaise nija-gaṇa lañā\\nbhojana karāila sabāke ākaṇṭha pūriyā
verses.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down with His personal associates and fed everyone of them very sumptuously until they were filled to the necks.

verses.devanagari: ভোজন করি’ বসিলা প্রভু করি’ আচমন ।\\nপ্রসাদ উবরিল, খায় সহস্রেক জন ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: bhojana kari' vasilā prabhu kari' ācamana\\nprasāda ubarila, khāya sahasreka jana
verses.translation: After finishing, the Lord washed His mouth and sat down. There was so much extra prasāda that it was distributed to thousands.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় গোবিন্দ দীন-হীন জনে ।\\nদুঃখী কাঙ্গাল আনি’ করায় ভোজনে ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura ājñāya govinda dīna-hīna jane\\nduḥkhī kāṅgāla āni' karāya bhojane
verses.translation: Following the orders of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Govinda, His personal servant, called for all the poor beggars, who were unhappy due to their poverty, and fed them sumptuously.

verses.devanagari: কাঙ্গালের ভোজন-রঙ্গ দেখে গৌরহরি ।\\n‘হরিবোল’ বলি’ তারে উপদেশ করি ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: kāṅgālera bhojana-raṅga dekhe gaurahari\\n'hari-bola' bali' tāre upadeśa kari
verses.translation: Observing the beggars eating prasāda, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted, "Hari bol!" and instructed them to chant the holy name.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In a song, Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura chants:
miche māyāra vaśe, yāccha bhese',
khāccha hābuḍubu, bhāi
jīva kṛṣṇa-dāsa, e viśvāsa,
ka'rle ta' āra duḥkha nāi
"Everyone is captivated by the waves of the ocean of nescience, but if everyone would immediately accept Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa as their eternal master, there would be no chance of being carried away by the waves of illusion. Then all sufferings would stop." Kṛṣṇa conducts the material world under the three modes of material nature, and consequently there are three platforms of life-higher, middle and lower. On whatever platform one may be situated, one is tossed by the waves of material nature. Someone may be rich, someone may be middle class, and someone may be a poor beggar—it doesn't matter. As long as one is under the spell of the three modes of material nature, he must continue to experience these divisions.
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu therefore advised the beggars to chant "Hari bol!" while taking
prasāda.
Chanting means accepting one's self as the eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa. This is the only solution, regardless of social position. Everyone is suffering under the spell of
māyā;
therefore the best course is to learn how to get out of the clutches of
māyā.
That is the verdict of the
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 14.26):
māṁ ca yo 'vyabhicāreṇa
bhakti-yogena sevate
sa guṇān samatītyaitān
brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
"One who engages in full devotional service, who does not fall down in any circumstance, at once transcends the modes of material nature and thus comes to the level of Brahman."
One can overcome the spell of
māyā
and attain the transcendental platform by agreeing to engage in the devotional service of the Lord. Devotional service begins with
śravaṇaṁ kīrtanam;
therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised the beggars to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
for elevation to the transcendental position. On the transcendental platform, there is no distinction between the rich, the middle class and the poor.

verses.devanagari: ‘হরিবোল’ বলি’ কাঙ্গাল প্রেমে ভাসি’ যায় ।\\nঐছন অদ্ভুত লীলা করে গৌররায় ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'hari-bola' bali' kāṅgāla preme bhāsi' yāya\\naichana adbhuta līlā kare gaurarāya
verses.translation: As soon as the beggars chanted the holy name, "Hari bol," they were immediately absorbed in ecstatic love of Godhead. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed wonderful pastimes.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
To feel the emotion of ecstatic love of God is to be on the transcendental platform. If one can keep himself in that transcendental position, he will surely return home, back to Godhead. In the spiritual world there are no higher, middle or lower classes. This is confirmed by
Īśopaniṣad, Mantra
Seven:
yasmin sarvāṇi bhūtāny
ātmaivābhūd vijānataḥ
tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śoka
ekatvam anupaśyataḥ
"One who always sees all living entities as spiritual sparks, in quality one with the Lord, becomes a true knower of things. What, then, can be illusion or anxiety for him?"

verses.devanagari: ইহাঁ জগন্নাথের রথ-চলন-সময় ।\\nগৌড় সব রথ টানে, আগে নাহি যায় ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: ihāṅ jagannāthera ratha-calana-samaya\\ngauḍa saba ratha ṭāne, āge nāhi yāya
verses.translation: Outside the garden, when it was time to pull Jagannātha's car, all the workers called gauḍas tried to pull it, but it would not move forward.

verses.devanagari: টানিতে না পারে গৌড়, রথ ছাড়ি’ দিল ।\\nপাত্র-মিত্র লঞা রাজা ব্যগ্র হঞা আইল ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: ṭānite nā pāre gauḍa, ratha chāḍi' dila\\npātra-mitra lañā rājā vyagra hañā āila
verses.translation: When the gauḍas saw that they could not budge the car, they abandoned the attempt. Then the King arrived in great anxiety, and he was accompanied by his officers and friends.

verses.devanagari: মহামল্লগণে দিল রথ চালাইতে ।\\nআপনে লাগিলা রথ, না পারে টানিতে ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-malla-gaṇe dila ratha cālāite\\nāpane lāgilā ratha, nā pāre ṭānite
verses.translation: The King then arranged for big wrestlers to try to pull the car, and even the King himself joined in, but the car could not be moved.

verses.devanagari: ব্যগ্র হঞা আনে রাজা মত্ত-হাতীগণ ।\\nরথ চালাইতে রথে করিল যোজন ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: vyagra hañā āne rājā matta-hātī-gaṇa\\nratha cālāite rathe karila yojana
verses.translation: Becoming even more eager to move the car, the King had very strong elephants brought forth and harnessed to it.

verses.devanagari: মত্ত-হস্তিগণ টানে যার যত বল ।\\nএক পদ না চলে রথ, হইল অচল ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: matta-hasti-gaṇa ṭāne yāra yata bala\\neka pada nā cale ratha, ha-ila acala
verses.translation: The strong elephants pulled with all their strength, but still the car remained at a standstill, not budging an inch.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ মহাপ্ৰভু আইলা নিজগণ লঞা ।\\nমত্তহস্তী রথ টানে, — দেখে দাণ্ডাঞা ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' mahāprabhu āilā nija-gaṇa lañā\\nmatta-hastī ratha ṭāne,-dekhe dāṇḍāñā
verses.translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this news, He went there with all His personal associates. They then stood there and watched the elephants try to pull the car.

verses.devanagari: অঙ্কুশের ঘায় হস্তী করয়ে চিৎকার ।\\nরথ নাহি চলে, লোকে করে হাহাকার ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: aṅkuśera ghāya hastī karaye citkāra\\nratha nāhi cale, loke kare hāhākāra
verses.translation: The elephants, being beaten by the elephant-goad, were crying, but still the car would not move. The assembled people cried out, "Alas!"

verses.devanagari: তবে মহাপ্রভু সব হস্তী ঘুচাইল  ।\\nনিজগণে রথ-কাছি টানিবারে দিল ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabe mahāprabhu saba hastī ghucāila\\nnija-gaṇe ratha-kāchi ṭānibāre dila
verses.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu let all the elephants go free and placed the car's ropes in the hands of His own men.

verses.devanagari: আপনে রথের পাছে ঠেলে মাথা দিয়া  ।\\nহড়্ হড়্ করি, রথ চলিল ধাইয়া ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: āpane rathera pāche ṭhele māthā diyā\\nhaḍ haḍ kari, ratha calila dhāiyā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to the back of the car and began to push with His head. It was then that the car began to move and ramble along, making a rattling sound.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তগণ কাছি হাতে করি’ মাত্র ধায় ।\\nআপনে চলিল রথ, টানিতে না পায় ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-gaṇa kāchi hāte kari' mātra dhāya\\nāpane calila ratha, ṭānite nā pāya
verses.translation: Indeed, the car began to move automatically, and the devotees simply carried the rope in their hands. Since it was moving effortlessly, they did not need to pull it.

verses.devanagari: আনন্দে করয়ে লোক ‘জয়’ ‘জয়’-ধ্বনি ।\\n‘জয় জগন্নাথ’ বই আর নাহি শুনি ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: ānande karaye loka 'jaya' 'jaya'-dhvani\\n'jaya jagannātha' ba-i āra nāhi śuni
verses.translation: When the car moved forward, everyone began to chant with great pleasure, "All glories! All glories!" and "All glories to Lord Jagannātha!" No one could hear anything else.

verses.devanagari: নিমেষে ত’ গেল রথ গুণ্ডিচার দ্বার ।\\nচৈতন্য-প্রতাপ দেখি’ লোকে চমৎকার ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: nimeṣe ta' gela ratha guṇḍicāra dvāra\\ncaitanya-pratāpa dekhi' loke camatkāra
verses.translation: In a moment the car reached the door of the Guṇḍicā temple. Upon seeing the uncommon strength of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the people were struck with wonder.

verses.devanagari: ‘জয় গৌরচন্দ্র’, ‘জয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য’ ।\\nএইমত কোলাহল লোকে ধন্য ধন্য ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'jaya gauracandra', jaya śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya'\\nei-mata kolāhala loke dhanya dhanya
verses.translation: The crowd made a tumultuous vibration, chanting, "Jaya Gauracandra! Jaya Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya!" Then the people began to chant, "Wonderful! Wonderful!"

verses.devanagari: দেখিয়া প্রতাপরুদ্র পাত্র-মিত্র-সঙ্গে ।\\nপ্রভুর মহিমা দেখি’ প্রেমে ফুলে অঙ্গে ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: dekhiyā pratāparudra pātra-mitra-saṅge\\nprabhura mahimā dekhi' preme phule aṅge
verses.translation: Seeing the greatness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Pratāparudra Mahārāja and his ministers and friends were so moved by ecstatic love that their hair stood on end.

verses.devanagari: পাণ্ডুবিজয় তবে করে সেবকগণে ।\\nজগন্নাথ বসিলা গিয়া নিজ সিংহাসনে ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍu-vijaya tabe kare sevaka-gaṇe\\njagannātha vasilā giyā nija-siṁhāsane
verses.translation: All the servants of Lord Jagannātha then took Him down from the car, and the Lord went to sit on His throne.

verses.devanagari: সুভদ্রা-বলরাম নিজ-সিংহাসনে আইলা ।\\nজগন্নাথের স্নানভোগ হইতে লাগিলা ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: subhadrā-balarāma nija-siṁhāsane āilā\\njagannāthera snāna-bhoga ha-ite lāgilā
verses.translation: Subhadrā and Balarāma also sat on their respective thrones. There followed the bathing of Lord Jagannātha and finally the offering of food.

verses.devanagari: আঙ্গিনাতে মহাপ্ৰভু লঞা ভক্তগণ ।\\nআনন্দে আরম্ভ কৈল নর্তন-কীর্তন ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: āṅgināte mahāprabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa\\nānande ārambha kaila nartana-kīrtana
verses.translation: While Lord Jagannātha, Lord Balarāma and Subhadrā sat on their respective thrones, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees began to perform saṅkīrtana with great pleasure, chanting and dancing in the yard of the temple.

verses.devanagari: আনন্দে মহাপ্রভুর প্রেম উথলিল ।\\nদেখি’ সব লোক প্রেম-সাগরে ভাসিল ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: ānande mahāprabhura prema uthalila\\ndekhi' saba loka prema-sāgare bhāsila
verses.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was chanting and dancing, He was overwhelmed with ecstatic love, and all the people who saw Him were also flooded in the ocean of love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: নৃত্য করি’ সন্ধ্যাকালে আরতি দেখিল ।\\nআইটোটা আসি’ প্রভু বিশ্রাম করিল ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: nṛtya kari' sandhyā-kāle ārati dekhila\\nāiṭoṭā āsi' prabhu viśrāma karila
verses.translation: In the evening, after finishing His dancing in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple, the Lord observed the ārati ceremony. Thereafter He went to a place called Āiṭoṭā and took rest for the night.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈতাদি ভক্তগণ নিমন্ত্রণ কৈল ।\\nমুখ্য মুখ্য নব জন নব দিন পাইল ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: advaitādi bhakta-gaṇa nimantraṇa kaila\\nmukhya mukhya nava jana nava dina pāila
verses.translation: For nine days, nine chief devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, got an opportunity to invite the Lord to their homes.

verses.devanagari: আর ভক্তগণ চাতুর্মাস্যে যত দিন ।\\nএক এক দিন করি’ করিল বণ্টন ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: āra bhakta-gaṇa cāturmāsye yata dina\\neka eka dina kari' karila baṇṭana
verses.translation: During the four months of the rainy season, the remaining devotees extended invitations to the Lord for one day each. In this way they shared invitations.

verses.devanagari: চারি মাসের দিন মুখ্যভক্ত বাঁটি’ নিল ।\\nআর ভক্তগণ অবসর না পাইল ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: cāri māsera dina mukhya-bhakta bāṅṭi' nila\\nāra bhakta-gaṇa avasara nā pāila
verses.translation: For the four-month period, all the daily invitations were shared among the important devotees. The rest of the devotees did not get an opportunity to extend an invitation to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: এক দিন নিমন্ত্রণ করে দুই-তিনে মিলি’ ।\\nএইমত মহাপ্রভুর নিমন্ত্রণ-কেলি ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka dina nimantraṇa kare dui-tine mili'\\nei-mata mahāprabhura nimantraṇa-keli
verses.translation: Since they could not get one day each, two or three devotees combined to extend an invitation. These are the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's acceptance of invitations.

verses.devanagari: প্রাতঃকালে স্নান করি’ দেখি’ জগন্নাথ ।\\nসংকীর্তনে নৃত্য করে ভক্তগণ সাথ ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ-kāle snāna kari' dekhi' jagannātha\\nsaṅkīrtane nṛtya kare bhakta-gaṇa sātha
verses.translation: After taking His bath early in the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go see Lord Jagannātha in the temple. Then He would perform saṅkīrtana with His devotees.

verses.devanagari: কভু অদ্বৈতে নাচায়, কভু নিত্যানন্দে ।\\nকভু হরিদাসে নাচায়, কভু অচ্যুতানন্দে ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu advaite nācāya, kabhu nityānande\\nkabhu haridāse nācāya, kabhu acyutānande
verses.translation: By chanting and dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu induced Advaita Ācārya to dance. Sometimes He induced Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Acyutānanda to dance.

verses.devanagari: কভু বক্রেশ্বরে, কভু আর ভক্তগণে ।\\nত্রিসন্ধ্যা কীর্তন করে গুণ্ডিচা-প্রাঙ্গণে ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu vakreśvare, kabhu āra bhakta-gaṇe\\ntrisandhyā kīrtana kare guṇḍicā-prāṅgaṇe
verses.translation: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged Vakreśvara and other devotees in chanting and dancing. Three times daily-morning, noon and evening-He would perform saṅkīrtana in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনে আইলা কৃষ্ণ — এই প্রভুর জ্ঞান ।\\nকৃষ্ণের বিরহ-স্ফূর্তি হৈল অবসান ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvane āilā kṛṣṇa-ei prabhura jñāna\\nkṛṣṇera viraha-sphūrti haila avasāna
verses.translation: At this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt that Lord Kṛṣṇa had returned to Vṛndāvana. Thinking this, His feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa subsided.

verses.devanagari: রাধা-সঙ্গে কৃষ্ণ-লীলা — এই হৈল জ্ঞানে ।\\nএই রসে মগ্ন প্রভু হইলা আপনে ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā-saṅge kṛṣṇa-līlā-ei haila jñāne\\nei rase magna prabhu ha-ilā āpane
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always thinking of the pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and He remained personally merged in this consciousness.

verses.devanagari: নানোদ্যানে ভক্তসঙ্গে বৃন্দাবন-লীলা ।\\n‘ইন্দ্রদ্যুম্ন’-সরোবরে করে জলখেলা ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: nānodyāne bhakta-saṅge vṛndāvana-līlā\\n'indradyumna'-sarovare kare jala-khelā
verses.translation: There were many gardens near the Guṇḍicā temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees used to perform the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in each of them. In the lake named Indradyumna, He sported in the water.

verses.devanagari: আপনে সকল ভক্তে সিঞ্চে জল দিয়া ।\\nসব ভক্তগণ সিঞ্চে চৌদিকে বেড়িয়া ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: āpane sakala bhakte siñce jala diyā\\nsaba bhakta-gaṇa siñce caudike beḍiyā
verses.translation: The Lord personally splashed all the devotees with water, and the devotees, surrounding Him on all sides, also splashed the Lord.

verses.devanagari: কভু এক মণ্ডল, কভু অনেক মণ্ডল ।\\nজলমণ্ডূক-বাদ্যে সবে বাজায় করতাল ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu eka maṇḍala, kabhu aneka maṇḍala\\njala-maṇḍūka-vādye sabe bājāya karatāla
verses.translation: While in the water they sometimes formed a circle and sometimes many circles, and while in the water they used to play cymbals and imitate the croaking of frogs.

verses.devanagari: দুই-দুই জনে মেলি’ করে জল-রণ ।\\nকেহ হারে, কেহ জিনে — প্ৰভু করে দরশন ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: dui-dui jane meli' kare jala-raṇa\\nkeha hāre, keha jine-prabhu kare daraśana
verses.translation: Sometimes two would pair off to fight in the water. One would emerge victorious and the other defeated, and the Lord would watch all this fun.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত-নিত্যানন্দে জল-ফেলাফেলি ।\\nআচার্য হারিয়া পাছে করে গালাগালি ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: advaita-nityānande jala-phelāpheli\\nācārya hāriyā pāche kare gālāgāli
verses.translation: The first sporting took place between Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, who threw water upon one another. Advaita Ācārya was defeated, and He later began to rebuke Nityānanda Prabhu, calling Him bad names.

verses.devanagari: বিদ্যানিধির জলকেলি স্বরূপের সনে ।\\nগুপ্ত-দত্তে জলকেলি করে দুইজনে ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: vidyānidhira jala-keli svarūpera sane\\ngupta-datte jala-keli kare dui jane
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara and Vidyānidhi also threw water upon one another, and Murāri Gupta and Vāsudeva Datta also sported in that way.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাস সহিত জল খেলে গদাধর ।\\nরাঘব-পণ্ডিত সনে খেলে বক্রেশ্বর ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsa-sahita jala khele gadādhara\\nrāghava-paṇḍita sane khele vakreśvara
verses.translation: Another duel took place between Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and Gadādhara Paṇḍita, and yet another between Rāghava Paṇḍita and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita. Thus they all engaged in throwing water.

verses.devanagari: সার্বভৌম-সঙ্গে খেলে রামানন্দ-রায় ।\\nগাম্ভীর্য গেল দোঁহার, হৈল শিশুপ্রায় ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: sārvabhauma-saṅge khele rāmānanda-rāya\\ngāmbhīrya gela doṅhāra, haila śiśu-prāya
verses.translation: Indeed, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya engaged in water sports with Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, and they both lost their gravity and became like children.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্ৰভু তাঁ দোঁহার চাঞ্চল্য দেখিয়া  ।\\nগোপীনাথাচার্যে কিছু কহেন হাসিয়া ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu tāṅ doṅhāra cāñcalya dekhiyā\\ngopīnāthācārye kichu kahena hāsiyā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the exuberance of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya, He smiled and spoke to Gopīnātha Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিত, গম্ভীর, দুঁহে — প্রামাণিক জন  ।\\nবাল-চাঞ্চল্য করে, করাহ বর্জন ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍita, gambhīra, duṅhe-prāmāṇika jana\\nbāla-cāñcalya kare, karāha varjana
verses.translation: "Tell Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya to stop their childish play because they are both learned scholars and very grave and great personalities."

verses.devanagari: গোপীনাথ কহে, — তোমার কৃপা-মহাসিন্ধু ।\\nউছলিত করে যবে তার এক বিন্দু ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: gopīnātha kahe,-tomāra kṛpā-mahāsindhu\\nuchalita kare yabe tāra eka bindu
verses.translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya replied, "I believe that one drop of the ocean of Your great mercy has swelled up upon them.

verses.devanagari: মেরু-মন্দর-পর্বত ডুবায় যথা তথা ।\\nএই দুই — গণ্ড-শৈল, ইহার কা কথা ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: meru-mandara-parvata ḍubāya yathā tathā\\nei dui-gaṇḍa-śaila, ihāra kā kathā
verses.translation: "A drop from the ocean of Your mercy can drown great mountains like Sumeru and Mandara. Since these two gentlemen are little hills by comparison, there is no wonder that they are being drowned in the ocean of Your mercy.

verses.devanagari: শুষ্কতর্ক-খলি খাইতে জন্ম গেল যাঁর ।\\nতাঁরে লীলামৃত পিয়াও, — এ কৃপা তোমার ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: śuṣka-tarka-khali khāite janma gela yāṅra\\ntāṅre līlāmṛta piyāo,-e kṛpā tomāra
verses.translation: "Logic is like a dry oil cake from which all the oil has been extracted. Bhaṭṭācārya passed his life in eating such dry cakes, but now You have made him drink the nectar of transcendental pastimes. It is certainly Your great mercy upon him."

verses.devanagari: হাসি’ মহাপ্রভু তবে অদ্বৈতে আনিল ।\\nজলের উপরে তাঁরে শেষ-শয্যা কৈল ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: hāsi' mahāprabhu tabe advaite ānila\\njalera upare tāṅre śeṣa-śayyā kaila
verses.translation: After Gopīnātha Ācārya finished talking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and, calling for Advaita Ācārya, made Him act like the Śeṣa Nāga bed.

verses.devanagari: আপনে তাঁহার উপর করিল শয়ন ।\\n‘শেষশায়ী-লীলা’ প্রভু কৈল প্রকটন ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: āpane tāṅhāra upara karila śayana\\n'śeṣa-śāyī-līlā' prabhu kaila prakaṭana
verses.translation: Lying down on Advaita Prabhu, who was floating on the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu demonstrated the pastime of Śeṣaśāyī Viṣṇu.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত নিজ-শক্তি প্রকট করিয়া ।\\nমহাপ্রভু লঞা বুলে জলেতে ভাসিয়া ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: advaita nija-śakti prakaṭa kariyā\\nmahāprabhu lañā bule jalete bhāsiyā
verses.translation: Manifesting His personal potency, Advaita Ācārya floated about on the water, carrying Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: এইমত জলক্রীড়া করি’ কতক্ষণ ।\\nআইটোটা আইলা প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণ ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata jala-krīḍā kari' kata-kṣaṇa\\nāiṭoṭā āilā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: After sporting in the water for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His place at Āiṭoṭā, accompanied by His devotees.

verses.devanagari: পুরী, ভারতী আদি যত মুখ্য ভক্তগণ ।\\nআচার্যের নিমন্ত্রণে করিলা ভোজন ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: purī, bhāratī ādi yata mukhya bhakta-gaṇa\\nācāryera nimantraṇe karilā bhojana
verses.translation: Paramānanda Purī, Brahmānanda Bhāratī and all the other chief devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took lunch at the invitation of Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: বাণীনাথ আর যত প্রসাদ আনিল ।\\nমহাপ্ৰভুর গণে সেই প্রসাদ খাইল ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: vāṇīnātha āra yata prasāda ānila\\nmahāprabhura gaṇe sei prasāda khāila
verses.translation: Whatever extra prasāda was brought by Vāṇīnātha Rāya was taken by the other associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: অপরাহ্ণে আসি’ কৈল দর্শন, নর্তন ।\\nনিশাতে উদ্যানে আসি’ করিলা শয়ন ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: aparāhne āsi' kaila darśana, nartana\\nniśāte udyāne āsi' karilā śayana
verses.translation: In the afternoon, the Lord went to the Guṇḍicā temple to visit the Lord and dance. At night He went to the garden to take rest.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন আসি’ কৈল ঈশ্বর দরশন ।\\nপ্রাঙ্গণে নৃত্য-গীত কৈল কতক্ষণ ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina āsi' kaila īśvara daraśana\\nprāṅgaṇe nṛtya-gīta kaila kata-kṣaṇa
verses.translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also went to the temple of Guṇḍicā and saw the Lord. He then chanted and danced in the yard for some time.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে প্রভু উদ্যানে আসিয়া ।\\nবৃন্দাবন-বিহার করে ভক্তগণ লঞা ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge prabhu udyāne āsiyā\\nvṛndāvana-vihāra kare bhakta-gaṇa lañā
verses.translation: Accompanied by His devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went into the garden and enjoyed the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura has pointed out that this
vṛndāvana-vihāra
—the pastimes of Vṛndāvana-does not refer to Kṛṣṇa's mixing with the
gopīs
or the transcendental mellow of
parakīya-rasa.
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's
vṛndāvana-līlā
in the garden of Jagannātha Purī did not involve association with women or with other people's wives in the fashion transcendentally demonstrated by Śrī Kṛṣṇa. In His
vṛndāvana-līlā,
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu conceived of Himself as the assistant of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī enjoyed the company of Kṛṣṇa, Her maidservants were very pleased. One should not compare Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's
vṛndāvana-vihāra
in the garden of Jagannātha with the activities of the
gaurāṅga-nāgarīs.

verses.devanagari: বৃক্ষবল্লী প্রফুল্লিত প্ৰভুর দরশনে ।\\nভৃঙ্গ-পিক গায়, বহে শীতল পবনে ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣa-vallī praphullita prabhura daraśane\\nbhṛṅga-pika gāya, vahe śītala pavane
verses.translation: There were multifarious trees and creepers in the garden, and they were all jubilant to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Indeed, the birds were chirping, the bees were buzzing, and a cool breeze was blowing.

verses.devanagari: প্রতি-বৃক্ষতলে প্রভু করেন নর্তন ।\\nবাসুদেব-দত্ত মাত্র করেন গায়ন ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: prati-vṛkṣa-tale prabhu karena nartana\\nvāsudeva-datta mātra karena gāyana
verses.translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced beneath each and every tree, Vāsudeva Datta sang alone.

verses.devanagari: এক এক বৃক্ষতলে এক এক গান গায় ।\\nপরম-আবেশে একা নাচে গৌররায় ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka eka vṛkṣa-tale eka eka gāna gāya\\nparama-āveśe ekā nāce gaurarāya
verses.translation: As Vāsudeva Datta sang a different song beneath each and every tree, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced there alone in great ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: তবে বক্রেশ্বরে প্রভু কহিলা নাচিতে ।\\nবক্রেশ্বর নাচে, প্রভু লাগিলা গাইতে ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: tabe vakreśvare prabhu kahilā nācite\\nvakreśvara nāce, prabhu lāgilā gāite
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then ordered Vakreśvara Paṇḍita to dance, and as he began to dance, the Lord began to sing.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু সঙ্গে স্বরূপাদি কীর্তনীয়া গায় ।\\nদিক্বিদিক্ নাহি জ্ঞান প্রেমের বন্যায় ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu-saṅge svarūpādi kīrtanīyā gāya\\ndik-vidik nāhi jñāna premera vanyāya
verses.translation: Then devotees like Svarūpa Dāmodara and other kīrtana performers began to sing along with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Being inundated with ecstatic love, they lost all consideration of time and circumstance.

verses.devanagari: এই মত কতক্ষণ করি’ বন-লীলা ।\\nনরেন্দ্র-সরোবরে গেলা করিতে জলখেলা ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata kata-kṣaṇa kari' vana-līlā\\nnarendra-sarovare gelā karite jala-khelā
verses.translation: After thus performing pastimes in the garden for some time, they all went to a lake called Narendra-sarovara and there enjoyed sporting in the water.

verses.devanagari: জলক্রীড়া করি’ পুনঃ আইলা উদ্যানে ।\\nভোজনলীলা কৈলা প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণে ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: jala-krīḍā kari' punaḥ āilā udyāne\\nbhojana-līlā kailā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇe
verses.translation: After sporting in the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to the garden and accepted prasāda with the devotees.

verses.devanagari: নব দিন গুণ্ডিচাতে রহে জগন্নাথ ।\\nমহাপ্রভু ঐছে লীলা করে ভক্ত-সাথ ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: nava dina guṇḍicāte rahe jagannātha\\nmahāprabhu aiche līlā kare bhakta-sātha
verses.translation: For nine continuous days His Lordship Śrī Jagannātha-deva stayed at the Guṇḍicā temple. During this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also stayed there and performed the pastimes with His devotees that have already been described.

verses.devanagari: ‘জগন্নাথ-বল্লভ’ নাম বড় পুষ্পারাম ।\\nনব দিন করেন প্রভু তথাই বিশ্রাম ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: 'jagannātha-vallabha' nāma baḍā puṣpārāma\\nnava dina karena prabhu tathāi viśrāma
verses.translation: The garden of His pastimes was very large and was named Jagannātha vallabha. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took his rest there for nine days.

verses.devanagari: ‘হেরা-পঞ্চমী’র দিন আইল জানিয়া  ।\\nকাশীমিশ্রে কহে রাজা সযত্ন করিয়া ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'herā-pañcamī'ra dina āila jāniyā\\nkāśī-miśre kahe rājā sayatna kariyā
verses.translation: Knowing that the Herā-pañcamī festival was drawing near, King Pratāparudra attentively talked with Kāśī Miśra.

verses.devanagari: কল্য ‘হেরা-পঞ্চমী’ হবে লক্ষ্মীর বিজয়  ।\\nঐছে উৎসব কর যেন কভু নাহি হয় ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: kalya 'herā-pañcamī' habe lakṣmīra vijaya\\naiche utsava kara yena kabhu nāhi haya
verses.translation: "Tomorrow will be the function of Herā-pañcamī or Lakṣmī-vijaya. Hold this festival in a way that it has never been held before."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This Herā-pañcamī festival takes place five days after the Ratha-yātrā festival. Lord Jagannātha has left His wife, the goddess of fortune, and gone to Vṛndāvana, which is the Guṇḍicā temple. Due to separation from the Lord, the goddess of fortune decides to come to see the Lord at Guṇḍicā. The coming of the goddess of fortune to Guṇḍicā is celebrated by Herā-pañcamī. Sometimes this is misspelled as Harā-pañcamī the section known as
ativāḍī.
The word
herā
means "to see" and refers to the goddess of fortune going to see Lord Jagannātha. The word
pañcamī
means "the fifth day" and is used because this takes place on the fifth day of the moon.

verses.devanagari: মহোত্সব কর তৈছে বিশেষ সম্ভার ।\\nদেখি’ মহাপ্রভুর যৈছে হয় চমৎকার ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: mahotsava kara taiche viśeṣa sambhāra\\ndekhi' mahāprabhura yaiche haya camatkāra
verses.translation: King Pratāparudra said, "Hold this festival in such a gorgeous way that upon seeing it, Caitanya Mahāprabhu will be completely pleased and astonished.

verses.devanagari: ঠাকুরের ভাণ্ডারে আর আমার ভাণ্ডারে  ।\\nচিত্রবস্ত্র-কিঙ্কিণী, আর ছত্র-চামরে ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: ṭhākurera bhāṇḍāre āra āmāra bhāṇḍāre\\ncitra-vastra-kiṅkiṇī, āra chatra-cāmare
verses.translation: "Take as many printed cloths, small bells, umbrellas and cāmaras as there are in my storehouse and in the Deity's storehouse.

verses.devanagari: ধ্বজাবৃন্দ-পতাকা-ঘণ্টায় করহ মণ্ডন  ।\\nনানাবাদ্য-নৃত্য-দোলায় করহ সাজন ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: dhvajāvṛnda-patākā-ghaṇṭāya karaha maṇḍana\\nnānā-vādya-nṛtya-dolāya karaha sājana
verses.translation: "Collect all kinds of small and large flags and ringing bells. Then decorate the carrier and have various musical and dancing parties accompany it. In this way decorate the carrier attractively.

verses.devanagari: দ্বিগুণ করিয়া কর সব উপহার  ।\\nরথযাত্রা হৈতে যৈছে হয় চমৎকার ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: dviguṇa kariyā kara saba upahāra\\nratha-yātrā haite yaiche haya camatkāra
verses.translation: "You should also double the quantity of prasāda. Make so much that it will even surpass the Ratha-yātrā festival.

verses.devanagari: সেইত’ করিহ, — প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণ । স্বচ্ছন্দে আসিয়া যৈছে করেন দরশন ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: seita' kariha,-prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa\\nsvacchande āsiyā yaiche karena daraśana
verses.translation: "Arrange the festival in such a way that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu may freely go with His devotees to visit the Deity without difficulty."

verses.devanagari: প্রাতঃকালে মহাপ্রভু নিজগণ লঞা ।\\nজগন্নাথ দর্শন কৈল সুন্দরাচলে যাঞা ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ-kāle mahāprabhu nija-gaṇa lañā\\njagannātha darśana kaila sundarācale yāñā
verses.translation: In the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His personal associates with Him to see Lord Jagannātha at Sundarācala.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nSundarācala is the Guṇḍicā temple. The temple of Jagannātha at Jagannātha Purī is called Nīlācala, and the temple at Guṇḍicā is called Sundarācala.

verses.devanagari: নীলাচলে আইলা পুনঃ ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nদেখিতে উত্কণ্ঠা হেরা-পঞ্চমীর রঙ্গে ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: nīlācale āilā punaḥ bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge\\ndekhite utkaṇṭhā herā-pañcamīra raṅge
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal devotees returned to Nīlācala with great eagerness to see the Herā-pañcamī festival.

verses.devanagari: কাশীমিশ্র প্রভুরে বহু আদর করিয়া ।\\nস্বগণ-সহ ভাল-স্থানে বসাইল লঞা ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: kāśī-miśra prabhure bahu ādara kariyā\\nsvagaṇa-saha bhāla-sthāne vasāila lañā
verses.translation: Kāśī Miśra received Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great respect, and taking the Lord and His associates to a very nice place, he had them seated.

verses.devanagari: রসবিশেষ প্রভুর শুনিতে মন হৈল ।\\nঈষত্ হাসিয়া প্রভু স্বরূপে পুছিল ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: rasa-viśeṣa prabhura śunite mana haila\\nīṣat hāsiyā prabhu svarūpe puchila
verses.translation: After taking His seat, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to hear about a particular mellow of devotional service; therefore, mildly smiling, He began to question Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি জগন্নাথ করেন দ্বারকায় বিহার । সহজ প্রকট করে পরম উদার ॥১১৭॥\\nতথাপি বত্সর-মধ্যে হয় একবার ।\\nবৃন্দাবন দেখিতে তাঁর উৎকণ্ঠা অপার ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpi vatsara-madhye haya eka-bāra\\nvṛndāvana dekhite tāṅra utkaṇṭhā apāra
verses.translation: "Although Lord Jagannātha enjoys His pastimes at Dvārakā-dhāma and naturally manifests sublime liberality there, still, once a year, He becomes unlimitedly eager to see Vṛndāvana."

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবন-সম এই উপবন-গণ ।\\nতাহা দেখিবারে উৎকণ্ঠিত হয় মন ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvana-sama ei upavana-gaṇa\\ntāhā dekhibāre utkaṇṭhita haya mana
verses.translation: Pointing out the neighboring gardens, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "All these gardens exactly resemble Vṛndāvana; therefore Lord Jagannātha is very eager to see them again.

verses.devanagari: বাহির হইতে করে রথযাত্রা-ছল ।\\nসুন্দরাচলে যায় প্রভু ছাড়ি’ নীলাচল ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: bāhira ha-ite kare ratha-yātrā-chala\\nsundarācale yāya prabhu chāḍi' nīlācala
verses.translation: "Externally He gives the excuse that He wants to participate in the Ratha-yātrā festival, but actually He wants to leave Jagannātha Purī to go to Sundarācala, Guṇḍicā temple, the replica of Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: নানা-পুষ্পোদ্যানে তথা খেলে রাত্রি-দিনে ।\\nলক্ষ্মীদেবীরে সঙ্গে নাহি লয় কি কারণে ? ॥ ১২১ ॥
verses.transliteration: nānā-puṣpodyāne tathā khele rātri-dine\\nlakṣmīdevīre saṅge nāhi laya ki kāraṇe?
verses.translation: "The Lord enjoys His pastimes day and night in various flower gardens there. But why did He not take Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, with Him?"

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — শুন, প্রভু, কারণ ইহার ।\\nবৃন্দাবন-ক্রীড়াতে লক্ষ্মীর নাহি অধিকার ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,-śuna, prabhu, kāraṇa ihāra\\nvṛndāvana-krīḍāte lakṣmīra nāhi adhikāra
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "My dear Lord, please hear the reason for this. Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, cannot be admitted to the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবন-লীলায় কৃষ্ণের সহায় গোপীগণ ।\\nগোপীগণ বিনা কৃষ্ণের হরিতে নারে মন ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvana-līlāya kṛṣṇera sahāya gopī-gaṇa\\ngopī-gaṇa vinā kṛṣṇera harite nāre mana
verses.translation: "In the pastimes of Vṛndāvana, the only assistants are the gopīs. But for the gopīs, no one can attract the mind of Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — যাত্রা-ছলে কৃষ্ণের গমন  ।\\nসুভদ্রা আর বলদেব, সঙ্গে দুই জন ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,-yātrā-chale kṛṣṇera gamana\\nsubhadrā āra baladeva, saṅge dui jana
verses.translation: The Lord said, "Using the car festival as an excuse, Kṛṣṇa goes there with Subhadrā and Baladeva.

verses.devanagari: গোপী-সঙ্গে যত লীলা হয় উপবনে  ।\\nনিগূঢ় কৃষ্ণের ভাব কেহ নাহি জানে ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: gopī-saṅge yata līlā haya upavane\\nnigūḍha kṛṣṇera bhāva keha nāhi jāne
verses.translation: "All the pastimes with the gopīs that take place in those gardens are very confidential ecstasies of Lord Kṛṣṇa. No one knows them.

verses.devanagari: অতএব কৃষ্ণের প্রাকট্যে নাহি কিছু দোষ  ।\\nতবে কেনে লক্ষ্মীদেবী করে এত রোষ ? ১২৬ ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva kṛṣṇera prākaṭye nāhi kichu doṣa\\ntabe kene lakṣmīdevī kare eta roṣa?
verses.translation: "Since there is no fault at all in Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, why does the goddess of fortune become angry?"

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — প্রেমবতীর এই ত’ স্বভাব ।\\nকান্তের ঔদাস্য-লেশে হয় ক্রোধভাব ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,-premavatīra ei ta' svabhāva\\nkāntera audāsya-leśe haya krodha-bhāva
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "It is the nature of a girl afflicted by love to become immediately angry upon finding neglect on the part of her lover."

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে, খচিত যাহে বিবিধ রতন  ।\\nসুবর্ণের চৌদোলা করি’ আরোহণ ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle, khacita yāhe vividha ratana\\nsuvarṇera caudolā kari' ārohaṇa
verses.translation: While Svarūpa Dāmodara and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were talking, the procession of the goddess of fortune came by. She was riding upon a golden palanquin carried by four men and bedecked with a variety of jewels.

verses.devanagari: ছত্র-চামর-ধ্বজা পতাকার গণ  ।\\nনানাবাদ্য-আগে নাচে দেবদাসীগণ ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: chatra-cāmara-dhvajā patākāra gaṇa\\nnānā-vādya-āge nāce deva-dāsī-gaṇa
verses.translation: The palanquin was also surrounded by people carrying umbrellas, cāmara whisks and flags, and it was preceded by musicians and dancing girls.

verses.devanagari: তাম্বূল-সম্পুট, ঝারি, ব্যজন, চামর  ।\\nসাথে দাসী শত, হার দিব্য ভূষাম্বর ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: tāmbūla-sampuṭa, jhāri, vyajana, cāmara\\nsāthe dāsī śata, hāra divya bhūṣāmbara
verses.translation: The maidservants were carrying water pitchers, cāmara whisks and boxes for betel nuts. There were hundreds of maidservants, all attractively dressed with valuable necklaces.

verses.devanagari: অলৌকিক ঐশ্বর্য সঙ্গে বহুং পরিবার  ।\\nক্রুদ্ধ হঞা লক্ষ্মীদেবী আইলা সিংহদ্বার ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: alaukika aiśvarya saṅge bahu-parivāra\\nkruddha hañā lakṣmīdevī āilā siṁha-dvāra
verses.translation: In an angry mood, the goddess of fortune arrived at the main gate of the temple accompanied by many members of her family, all of whom exhibited uncommon opulence.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথের মুখ্য মুখ্য যত ভৃত্যগণে ।\\nলক্ষ্মীদেবীর দাসীগণ করেন বন্ধনে ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthera mukhya mukhya yata bhṛtya-gaṇe\\nlakṣmīdevīra dāsī-gaṇa karena bandhane
verses.translation: When the procession arrived, the maidservants of the goddess of fortune began to arrest all the principal servants of Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: বান্ধিয়া আনিয়া পাড়ে লক্ষ্মীর চরণে ।\\nচোরে যেন দণ্ড করি’ লয় নানা-ধনে ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: bāndhiyā āniyā pāḍe lakṣmīra caraṇe\\ncore yena daṇḍa kari' laya nānā-dhane
verses.translation: The maidservants bound the servants of Jagannātha, handcuffed them, and made them fall down at the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune. Indeed, they were arrested just like thieves who have all their riches taken away.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nWhen Lord Jagannātha starts His car festival, He gives assurance to the goddess of fortune that He will return the next day. When He does not return, the goddess of fortune, after waiting two or three days, begins to feel that her husband has neglected her. She naturally becomes quite angry. Gorgeously decorating herself and her associates, she comes out of the temple and stands before the main gate. All the principal servants of Lord Jagannātha are then arrested by her maidservants, brought before her and forced to fall down at her lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: অচেতনবৎ তারে করেন তাড়নে ।\\nনানামত গালি দেন ভণ্ড-বচনে ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: acetanavat tāre karena tāḍane\\nnānā-mata gāli dena bhaṇḍa-vacane
verses.translation: When the servants fall down before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, they almost fall unconscious. They are chastised and made the butt of jokes and loose language.

verses.devanagari: লক্ষ্মী-সঙ্গে দাসীগণের প্রাগল্ভ্য দেখিয়া ।\\nহাসে মহাপ্রভুর গণ মুখে হস্ত দিয়া ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmī-saṅge dāsī-gaṇera prāgalbhya dekhiyā\\nhāse mahāprabhura gaṇa mukhe hasta diyā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's associates saw such impudence exhibited by the maidservants of the goddess of fortune, they covered their faces with their hands and began to smile.

verses.devanagari: দামোদর কহে, — ঐছে মানের প্রকার ।\\nত্রিজগতে কাহাঁ নাহি দেখি শুনি আর ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: dāmodara kahe,-aiche mānera prakāra\\ntrijagate kāhāṅ nāhi dekhi śuni āra
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "There is no egoistic pride like this within the three worlds. At least I have neither seen nor heard of it.

verses.devanagari: মানিনী নিরুৎসাহে ছাড়ে বিভূষণ ।\\nভূমে বসি’ নখে লেখে, মলিন-বদন ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: māninī nirutsāhe chāḍe vibhūṣaṇa\\nbhūme vasi' nakhe lekhe, malina-vadana
verses.translation: "When a woman is neglected and disappointed, out of egoistic pride she gives up her ornaments and morosely sits down on the floor, marking lines on it with her nails.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে সত্যভামার শুনি এবম্বিধ মান ।\\nব্রজে গোপীগণের মান — রসের নিধান ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve satyabhāmāra śuni evaṁ-vidha māna\\nvraje gopī-gaṇera māna-rasera nidhāna
verses.translation: "I have heard of this kind of pride in Satyabhāmā, Kṛṣṇa's proudest Queen, and I have also heard of it in the gopīs of Vṛndāvana, who are the reservoirs of all transcendental mellows.

verses.devanagari: ইঁহো নিজ-সম্পত্তি সব প্রকট করিয়া ।\\nপ্রিয়ের উপর যায় সৈন্য সাজাঞা ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: iṅho nija-sampatti saba prakaṭa kariyā\\npriyera upara yāya sainya sājāña
verses.translation: "But in the case of the goddess of fortune, I see a different kind of pride. She manifests her own opulences and even goes with her soldiers to attack her husband."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
After seeing the impudence of the goddess of fortune, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī wanted to inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about the superexcellence of the
gopīs'
loving affairs. He therefore said, "My Lord, I never experienced anything like the behavior of the goddess of fortune. We sometimes see a beloved wife becoming proud of her position and then frustrated due to some neglect. She then gives up caring for her appearance, accepts dirty clothes and morosely sits on the floor and draws lines with her nails. We have heard of such egoistic pride in Satyabhāmā and the
gopīs
of Vṛndāvana, but what we see in the goddess of fortune here at Jagannātha Purī is completely different. She becomes very angry with her husband, and attacks Him with her great opulence."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — কহ ব্রজের মানের প্রকার ।\\nস্বরূপ কহে, — গোপীমান-নদী শতধার ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,-kaha vrajera mānera prakāra\\nsvarūpa kahe,-gopī-māna-nadī śata-dhāra
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Please tell me of the varieties of egoistic pride manifest in Vṛndāvana." Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "The pride of the gopīs is like a river flowing with hundreds of tributaries.

verses.devanagari: নায়িকার স্বভাব, প্রেমবৃত্তে বহু ভেদ ।\\nসেই ভেদে নানা-প্ৰকার মানের উদ্ভেদ ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: nāyikāra svabhāva, prema-vṛtte bahu bheda\\nsei bhede nānā-prakāra mānera udbheda
verses.translation: "The characteristics and modes of love are different in different women. Their jealous anger also takes on different varieties and qualities.

verses.devanagari: সম্যক্ গোপিকার মান না যায় কথন ।\\nএক-দুই-ভেদে করি দিগ্-দরশন ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: samyak gopikāra māna nā yāya kathana\\neka-dui-bhede kari dig-daraśana
verses.translation: "It is not possible to give a complete statement about the different types of jealous anger manifest by the gopīs, but a few principles may serve as an indication.

verses.devanagari: মানে কেহ হয় ‘ধীরা’, কেহ ত’ ‘অধীরা’ ।\\nএই তিন-ভেদে, কেহ হয় ‘ধীরাধীরা’ ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: māne keha haya 'dhīrā,' keha ta' 'adhīrā'\\nei tina-bhede, keha haya 'dhīrādhīrā'
verses.translation: "There are three types of women experiencing jealous anger: sober women, restless women and women both restless and sober.

verses.devanagari: ‘ধীরা’ কান্তে দূরে দেখি’ করে প্রত্যুত্থান ।\\nনিকটে আসিলে, করে আসন প্রদান ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'dhīrā' kānte dūre dekhi' kare pratyutthāna\\nnikaṭe āsile, kare āsana pradāna
verses.translation: "When a sober heroine sees her hero approaching from a distance, she immediately stands up to receive him. When he comes near, she immediately offers him a place to sit.

verses.devanagari: হৃদয়ে কোপ, মুখে কহে মধুর বচন ।\\nপ্রিয় আলিঙ্গিতে, তারে করে আলিঙ্গন ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: hṛdaye kopa, mukhe kahe madhura vacana\\npriya āliṅgite, tāre kare āliṅgana
verses.translation: "The sober heroine conceals her anger within her heart and externally speaks sweet words. When her lover embraces her, she also returns his embrace.

verses.devanagari: সরল ব্যবহার, করে মানের পোষণ ।\\nকিম্বা সোল্লুণ্ঠ-বাক্যে করে প্রিয়-নিরসন ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: sarala vyavahāra, kare mānera poṣaṇa\\nkimvā solluṇṭha-vākye kare priya-nirasana
verses.translation: "The sober heroine is very simple in her behavior. She keeps her jealous anger within her heart, but with mild words and smiles she refutes the advances of her lover.

verses.devanagari: ‘অধীরা’ নিষ্ঠুর-বাক্যে করয়ে ভর্ৎসন ।\\nকর্ণোৎপলে তাড়ে, করে মালায় বন্ধন ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: 'adhīrā' niṣṭhura-vākye karaye bhartsana\\nkarṇotpale tāḍe, kare mālāya bandhana
verses.translation: "The restless heroine, however, sometimes chastises her lover with cruel words, sometimes pulls his ear and sometimes binds him with a flower garland.

verses.devanagari: ‘ধীরাধীরা’ বক্র-বাক্যে করে উপহাস ।\\nকভু স্তুতি, কভু নিন্দা, কভু বা উদাস ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: 'dhīrādhīrā' vakra-vākye kare upahāsa\\nkabhu stuti, kabhu nindā, kabhu vā udāsa
verses.translation: "The heroine who is a combination of sobriety and restlessness always jokes with equivocal words. She sometimes praises her lover, sometimes blasphemes him and sometimes remains indifferent.

verses.devanagari: ‘মুগ্ধা’, ‘মধ্যা’, ‘প্রগল্ভা’, — তিন নায়িকার ভেদ ।\\n‘মুগ্ধা’ নাহি জানে মানের বৈদগ্ধ্য-বিভেদ ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'mugdhā', 'madhyā', 'pragalbhā',-tina nāyikāra bheda\\n'mugdhā' nāhi jāne mānera vaidagdhya-vibheda
verses.translation: "Heroines may also be classified as captivated, intermediate and impudent. The captivated heroine does not know very much about the cunning intricacies of jealous anger.

verses.devanagari: মুখ আচ্ছাদিয়া করে কেবল রোদন ।\\nকান্তের প্রিয়বাক্য শুনি’ হয় পরসন্ন ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: mukha ācchādiyā kare kevala rodana\\nkāntera priya-vākya śuni' haya parasanna
verses.translation: "The captivated heroine simply covers her face and goes on crying. When she hears sweet words from her lover, she is very satisfied.

verses.devanagari: ‘মধ্যা’ ‘প্ৰগল্ভা’ ধরে ধীরাদি-বিভেদ ।\\nতার মধ্যে সবার স্বভাবে তিন ভেদ ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: 'madhyā' 'pragalbhā' dhare dhīrādi-vibheda\\ntāra madhye sabāra svabhāve tina bheda
verses.translation: "Both the intermediate and impudent heroines can be classified as sober, restless and both sober and restless. All their characteristics can be further classified in three divisions.

verses.devanagari: কেহ ‘প্রখরা’, কেহ ‘মৃদু’, কেহ হয় ‘সমা’ ।\\nস্ব-স্বভাবে কৃষ্ণের বাড়ায় প্রেম-সীমা ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: keha 'prakharā', keha 'mṛdu', keha haya 'samā'\\nsva-svabhāve kṛṣṇera bāḍāya prema-sīmā
verses.translation: "Some of them are very talkative, some are mild, and some are equipoised. Each heroine, according to her own character, increases Śrī Kṛṣṇa's loving ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: প্রাখর্য, মার্দব, সাম্য স্বভাব নির্দোষ ।\\nসেই সেই স্বভাবে কৃষ্ণে করায় সন্তোষ ॥১৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: prākharya, mārdava, sāmya svabhāva nirdoṣa\\nsei sei svabhāve kṛṣṇe karāya santoṣa
verses.translation: "Although some of the gopīs are talkative, some mild and some equipoised, all of them are transcendental and faultless. They please Kṛṣṇa by their unique characteristics."

verses.devanagari: একথা শুনিয়া প্রভুর আনন্দ অপার ।\\n‘কহ, কহ, দামোদর’, — বলে বার বার ॥১৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: e-kathā śuniyā prabhura ānanda apāra\\n'kaha, kaha, dāmodara',-bale bāra bāra
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt unlimited happiness upon hearing these descriptions, and He again and again requested Svarūpa Dāmodara to continue speaking.

verses.devanagari: দামোদর কহে, — কৃষ্ণ রসিকশেখর ।\\nরস-আস্বাদক, রসময়-কলেবর ॥১৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: dāmodara kahe,-kṛṣṇa rasika-śekhara\\nrasa-āsvādaka, rasamaya-kalevara
verses.translation: Dāmodara Gosvāmī said, "Kṛṣṇa is the master of all transcendental mellows. He is the taster of transcendental mellows, and His body is composed of transcendental bliss.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমময়-বপু কৃষ্ণ ভক্ত-প্রেমাধীন ।\\nশুদ্ধপ্রেমে, রসগুণে, গোপিকা — প্ৰবীণ ॥১৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: premamaya-vapu kṛṣṇa bhakta-premādhīna\\nśuddha-preme, rasa-guṇe, gopikā-pravīṇa
verses.translation: "Kṛṣṇa is full of ecstatic love and always subordinate to the love of his devotees. The gopīs are very experienced in pure love and in the dealings of transcendental mellows.

verses.devanagari: গোপিকার প্রেমে নাহি রসাভাস-দোষ ।\\nঅতএব কৃষ্ণের করে পরম সন্তোষ ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: gopikāra preme nāhi rasābhāsa-doṣa\\nataeva kṛṣṇera kare parama santoṣa
verses.translation: "There is no flaw or adulteration in the love of the gopīs; therefore they give Kṛṣṇa the highest pleasure.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Rasābhāsa
occurs when one's relationship with Kṛṣṇa is adulterated. There are different types of
rasābhāsa
-first-, second-and third-class. The word
rāsa
means "mellow," and
ābhāsa
means "a shadow." If one tastes one kind of mellow and something extra is imposed, that is
uparasa.
If something is derived from the original mellow, it is called
anurasa.
If something is appreciated which is far removed from the original mellow, it is called
aparasa. Uparasa, anurasa
and
aparasa
are, respectively, first-, second-and third-class
rasābhāsas.
As stated in
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(4.9):
pūrvam evānuśiṣṭena vikalā rasa-lakṣaṇā
rasā eva rasābhāsā rasa-jñair anukīrtitāḥ
syus tridhoparasāś cānurasāś cāparasāś ca te
uttamā madhyamāḥ proktāḥ kaniṣṭhāś cety amī kramāt

verses.devanagari: এবং শশঙ্কাংশুবিরাজিতা নিশাঃ\\nস সত্যকামোঽনুরতাবলাগণঃ ।\\nসিষেব আত্মন্যবরুদ্ধ-সৌরতঃ\\nসর্বাঃ শরৎকাব্যকথারসাশ্রয়াঃ ॥১৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ śaśaṅkāṁśu-virājitā niśāḥ\\nsa satya-kāmo 'nuratābalā-gaṇaḥ\\nsiṣeva ātmany avaruddha-saurataḥ\\nsarvāḥ śarat-kāvya-kathā-rasāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: “ 'Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is the Absolute Truth, enjoyed His rāsa dance every night during the autumn season. He performed this dance in the moonlight and with full transcendental mellows. He used poetic words and surrounded Himself with women who were very much attracted to Him.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is a quotation from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.33.25). The
gopīs
are all transcendental spirit souls. One should never think that the
gopīs
and Kṛṣṇa have material bodies. Vṛndāvana-dhāma is also a spiritual abode, and there the days and nights, the trees, flowers, water and everything else are spiritual. There is not even a trace of material contamination. Kṛṣṇa, who is the Supreme Brahman and Supersoul, is not at all interested in anything material. His activities with the
gopīs
are all spiritual and take place within the spiritual world. They have nothing to do with the material world. Lord Kṛṣṇa's lusty desires and ail His dealings with the
gopīs
are on the spiritual platform. One has to be transcendentally realized before even considering relishing the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa with the
gopīs.
One who is on the mundane platform must first purify himself by following the regulative principles. Only then can he try to understand Kṛṣṇa and the
gopīs.
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī are here talking about the relationship between Kṛṣṇa and the
gopīs:
therefore the subject matter is neither mundane nor erotic. Being a
sannyāsī,
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very strict in His dealings with women. Unless the
gopīs
were on the spiritual platform, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would have never even mentioned them to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. Therefore these descriptions do not at all pertain to material activity.

verses.devanagari: ‘বামা’ এক গোপীগণ, ‘দক্ষিণা’ এক গণ ।\\nনানা-ভাবে করায় কৃষ্ণে রস আস্বাদন ॥১৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'vāmā' eka gopī-gaṇa, 'dakṣiṇā' eka gaṇa\\nnānā-bhāve karāya kṛṣṇe rasa āsvādana
verses.translation: "The gopīs can be divided into a left wing and a right wing. Both wings induce Kṛṣṇa to taste transcendental mellows by various manifestations of ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: গোপীগণ-মধ্যে শ্রেষ্ঠা রাধা-ঠাকুরাণী ।\\nনির্মল-উজ্জ্বল-রস-প্রেম-রত্নখনি ॥১৬০॥
verses.transliteration: gopī-gaṇa-madhye śreṣṭhā rādhā-ṭhākurāṇī\\nnirmala-ujjvala-rasa-prema-ratna-khani
verses.translation: "Of all the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is the chief. She is a jewel mine of ecstatic love and the source of all purified transcendental conjugal mellows.

verses.devanagari: বয়সে ‘মধ্যমা’তেঁহো স্বভাবেতে ‘সমা’ ।\\nগাঢ় প্রেমভাবে তেঁহো নিরন্তর ‘বামা’ ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: vayase 'madhyamā' teṅho svabhāvete 'samā'\\ngāḍha prema-bhāve teṅho nirantara 'vāmā'
verses.translation: "Rādhārāṇī is grown up, and Her character is equipoised. She is always deeply absorbed in ecstatic love and always feeling in the mood of a left-wing gopī.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The left wing and right wing of the
gopīs
has been explained by Rūpa Gosvāmī in
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi.
The left wing is described in this way:
mana-grahe sadodyuktā
tac-chaithilye ca kopanā
abhedyā nāyake prāyaḥ
krūrā vāmeti kīrtyate
"A
gopī
who is always eager to be jealously angered, who is very enthusiastic for that position, who immediately becomes angry when defeated, who is never under the control of a hero and who always opposes Him is called
vāmā,
or a leftwing
gopī.
"
Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī describes the right-wing
gopīs
in this way:
asahyā māna-nirbandhe
nāyake yukta-vādinī
sāmabhis tena bhedyā ca
dakṣiṇā parikīrtitā
"A
gopī
who cannot tolerate womanly anger, who speaks suitable words to the hero and who is satisfied by His sweet words is called a
dakṣiṇā,
or a right-wing
gopi."

verses.devanagari: বাম্য-স্বভাবে মান উঠে নিরন্তর ।\\nতার মধ্যে উঠে কৃষ্ণের আনন্দ-সাগর ॥১৬২॥
verses.transliteration: vāmya-svabhāve māna uṭhe nirantara\\ntāra madhye uṭhe kṛṣṇera ānanda-sāgara
verses.translation: "Because She is a left-wing gopī, Her womanly anger is always awakening, but Kṛṣṇa derives transcendental bliss from Her activities.

verses.devanagari: অহেরিব গতিঃ প্রেম্ণঃ স্বভাবকুটিলা ভবেৎ ।\\nঅতো হেতোরহেতোশ্চ যূনোর্মান উদঞ্চতি ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: aher iva gatiḥ premṇaḥ\\nsvabhāva-kuṭilā bhavet\\nato hetor ahetoś ca\\nyūnor māna udañcati
verses.translation: “ 'The progress of loving affairs between young couples is by nature crooked, like the movement of a snake. Because of this, two types of anger arise between young couples-anger with a cause and anger without a cause.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Śṛṅgāra-bheda-prakaraṇa
102).

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ বাড়ে প্রভুর আনন্দ-সাগর ।\\n‘কহ, কহ’ কহে প্রভু, বলে দামোদর ॥১৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' bāḍe prabhura ānanda-sāgara\\n'kaha, kaha' kahe prabhu, bale dāmodara
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these talks, His ocean of transcendental bliss increased. He therefore told Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Go on speaking, go on speaking." And thus Svarūpa Dāmodara continued.

verses.devanagari: ‘অধিরূঢ় মহাভাব’ — রাধিকার প্রেম ।\\nবিশুদ্ধ, নির্মল, যৈছে দশবাণ হেম ॥১৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: 'adhirūḍha mahābhāva'-rādhikāra prema\\nviśuddha, nirmala, yaiche daśa-vāṇa hema
verses.translation: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's love is a highly advanced ecstasy. All Her dealings are completely pure and devoid of material tinge. Indeed, Her dealings are ten times purer than gold.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের দর্শন যদি পায় আচম্বিতে ।\\nনানা-ভাব-বিভূষণে হয় বিভূষিতে ॥১৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera darśana yadi pāya ācambite\\nnānā-bhāva-vibhūṣaṇe haya vibhūṣite
verses.translation: "As soon as Rādhārāṇī gets a chance to see Kṛṣṇa, Her body is suddenly decorated with various ecstatic ornaments.

verses.devanagari: অষ্ট ‘সাত্ত্বিক’, হর্ষাদি ‘ব্যভিচারী’ যাঁর ।\\n‘সহজ প্রেম’, বিংশতি ‘ভাব’-অলঙ্কার ॥১৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: aṣṭa 'sāttvika', harṣādi 'vyabhicārī' yāṅra\\n'sahaja prema', viṁśati 'bhāva'-alaṅkāra
verses.translation: "The transcendental ornaments of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's body include the eight sāttvikas, or transcendental symptoms, the thirty-three vyabhicārībhāvas, beginning with harṣa, or jubilation in natural love, and the twenty bhāvas, or ecstatic emotional ornaments.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The thirty-three
vyabhicārī-bhāvas,
bodily symptoms manifest in ecstatic love, are as follows: (1)
nirveda,
indifference; (2)
viṣāda,
moroseness; (3)
dainya,
meekness; (4)
glāni,
a feeling that one is in a faulty position; (5)
śrama,
fatigue; (6)
mada,
madness; (7)
garva,
pride; (8)
śaṅkā,
doubt; (9)
trāsa,
shock; (10)
āvega,
intense emotion; (11)
unmāda,
craziness; (12)
apasmāra,
forgetfulness; (13)
vyādhi,
disease; (14)
moha,
bewilderment; (15)
mṛti,
death; (16)
ālasya,
laziness; (17)
jāḍya,
invalidity; (18)
vrīḍā,
shame; (19)
avahitthā,
concealment; (20)
smṛti,
remembrance; (21)
vitarka,
argument; (22)
cintā,
contemplation; (23)
mati,
attention; (24)
dhṛti,
forbearance; (25)
harṣa,
jubilation; (26)
autsukya,
eagerness; (27)
augrya,
violence; (28)
amarṣa,
anger; (29)
asūyā,
jealousy; (30)
cāpalya,
impudence; (31)
nidrā,
sleep; (32)
supti,
deep sleep and (33)
prabodha,
awakening.

verses.devanagari: ‘কিলকিঞ্চিত’, ‘কুট্টমিত’,‘বিলাস’,‘ললিত’ ।\\n‘বিব্বোক’, ‘মোট্টায়িত’, আর ‘মৌগ্ধ্য’, ‘চকিত’ ॥১৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: 'kila-kiñcita', 'kuṭṭamita', 'vilāsa', 'lalita'\\n'vivvoka', 'moṭṭāyita', āra 'maugdhya', 'cakita'
verses.translation: "Some of the symptoms critically explained in the following verses are kilakiñcita, kuṭṭamita, vilāsa, lalita, vivvoka, moṭṭāyita, maugdhya and cakita.

verses.devanagari: এত ভাবভূষায় ভূষিত শ্রীরাধার অঙ্গ ।\\nদেখিতে উথলে কৃষ্ণসুখাব্ধি-তরঙ্গ ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta bhāva-bhūṣāya bhūṣita śrī-rādhāra aṅga\\ndekhite uthale kṛṣṇa-sukhābdhi-taraṅga
verses.translation: "When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's body manifests the ornaments of many ecstatic symptoms, the ocean of Kṛṣṇa's happiness immediately displays transcendental waves.

verses.devanagari: কিলকিঞ্চিতাদি-ভাবের শুন বিবরণ ।\\nযে ভাব-ভূষায় রাধা হরে কৃষ্ণ-মন ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: kila-kiñcitādi-bhāvera śuna vivaraṇa\\nye bhāva-bhūṣāya rādhā hare kṛṣṇa-mana
verses.translation: "Now hear a description of different ecstasies, beginning with kila-kiñcita. With these ecstatic ornaments, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī enchants the mind of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: রাধা দেখি’ কৃষ্ণ যদি ছুঁইতে করে মন ।\\nদানঘাটি-পথে যবে বর্জেন গমন ॥১৭১॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā dekhi' kṛṣṇa yadi chuṅite kare mana\\ndāna-ghāṭi-pathe yabe varjena gamana
verses.translation: "When Śrī Kṛṣṇa sees Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and wants to touch Her body, He prohibits Her from going to the spot where one can cross the River Yamunā.

verses.devanagari: যবে আসি’ মানা করে পুষ্প উঠাইতে ।\\nসখী-আগে চাহে যদি গায়ে হাত দিতে ॥১৭২॥
verses.transliteration: yabe āsi' mānā kare puṣpa uṭhāite\\nsakhī-āge cāhe yadi gāye hāta dite
verses.translation: "Approaching Her, Kṛṣṇa prohibits Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī from picking flowers. He may also touch Her in front of Her friends.

verses.devanagari: এইসব স্থানে ‘কিলকিঞ্চিত’ উদ্গম ।\\nপ্রথমে ‘হর্ষ’ সঞ্চারী — মূল কারণ ॥১৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-saba sthāne 'kila-kiñcita' udgama\\nprathame 'harṣa' sañcārī-mūla kāraṇa
verses.translation: "At such times, the ecstatic symptoms of kila-kiñcita are awakened. First there is jubilation in ecstatic love, which is the root cause of these symptoms.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Whenever Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī leaves Her house, She is always well-dressed and attractive. It is Her womanly nature to attract Śrī Kṛṣṇa's attention, and upon seeing Her so attractively dressed, Śrī Kṛṣṇa desires to touch Her body. The Lord then finds some fault in Her and prohibits Her from going to a river crossing and stops Her from picking flowers. Such are the pastimes between Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Being a cowherd girl, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī regularly carries a container of milk and often goes to sell it on the other side of the Yamunā. To cross the river, She has to pay the boatman, and the spot where the boatman collects his fares is called the
dāna-ghāṭi.
Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa stops Her from going, telling Her, "First You have to pay the fee; then You will be allowed to go." This pastime is called
dāna-keli-līlā.
Similarly, if Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī wants to pick a flower, Śrī Kṛṣṇa claims to be the garden's proprietor and prohibits Her. This pastime is called
kila-kiñcita.
Rādhārāṇī's shyness arises due to Śrī Kṛṣṇa's prohibitions, and ecstatic loving bodily symptoms called
kila-kiñcita-bhāva
are manifest at this time. These ecstatic symptoms are explained in the following verse, which is from Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Anubhāva-prakaraṇa
44).

verses.devanagari: গর্বাভিলাষরুদিতস্মিতাসূয়াভয়ক্রুধাম্ ।\\nসঙ্করীকরণং হর্ষাদুচ্যতে কিলকিঞ্চিতম্ ॥১৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: garvābhilāṣa-rudita-\\nsmitāsūyā-bhaya-krudhām\\nsaṅkarī-karaṇaṁ harṣād\\nucyate kila-kiñcitam
verses.translation: “ 'Pride, ambition, weeping, smiling, envy, fear and anger are the seven ecstatic loving symptoms manifest by a jubilant shrinking away, and these symptoms are called kila-kiñcita-bhāva.'

verses.devanagari: আর সাত ভাব আসি’ সহজে মিলয় ।\\nঅষ্টভাব-সম্মিলনে ‘মহাভাব’ হয় ॥১৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: āra sāta bhāva āsi' sahaje milaya\\nasta-bhāva-sammilane 'mahābhāva' haya
verses.translation: "There are seven other transcendental ecstatic symptoms, and when they combine on the platform of jubilation, the combination is called mahābhāva.

verses.devanagari: গর্ব, অভিলাষ, ভয়, শুষ্করুদিত ।\\nক্রোধ, অসূয়া হয়, আর মন্দস্মিত ॥১৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: garva, abhilāṣa, bha ya, śuṣka-rudita\\nkrodha, asūyā haya, āra manda-smita
verses.translation: "The seven combined ingredients of mahābhāva are pride, ambition, fear, dry artificial crying, anger, envy and mild smiling.

verses.devanagari: নানা-স্বাদু অষ্টভাব একত্র মিলন ।\\nযাহার আস্বাদে তৃপ্ত হয় কৃষ্ণ-মন ॥১৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: nānā-svādu aṣṭa-bhāva ekatra milana\\nyāhāra āsvāde tṛpta haya kṛṣṇa-mana
verses.translation: "There are eight symptoms of ecstatic love on the platform of transcendental jubilation, and when they are combined and tasted by Kṛṣṇa, the Lord's mind is completely satisfied.

verses.devanagari: দধি, খণ্ড, ঘৃত, মধু, মরীচ, কর্পূর ।\\nএলাচি-মিলনে যৈছে রসালা মধুর ॥১৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: dadhi, khaṇḍa, ghṛta, madhu, marīca, karpūra\\nelāci-milane yaiche rasālā madhura
verses.translation: "Indeed, they are compared to a combination of yogurt, candy, ghee, honey, black pepper, camphor and cardamom, which, when mixed together, are very tasty and sweet.

verses.devanagari: এই ভাব-যুক্ত দেখি’ রাধাস্য-নয়ন ।\\nসঙ্গম হইতে সুখ পায় কোটি-গুণ ॥১৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei bhāva-yukta dekhi' rādhāsya-nayana\\nsaṅgama ha-ite sukha pāya koṭi-guṇa
verses.translation: "Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is thousands upon thousands of times more satisfied when He sees Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's face light up from this combination of ecstatic love than He is by direct union with Her.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is further explained in the following verse from the
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Anubhāva-prakaraṇa
46) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: অন্তঃস্মেরতয়োজ্জ্বলা জলকণব্যাকীর্ণপক্ষ্মাঙ্কুরা\\nকিঞ্চিৎপাটলিতাঞ্চলা রসিকতোৎসিক্তা পুরঃ কুঞ্চতী ।\\nরুদ্ধায়াঃ পথি মাধবেন মধুরব্যাভুগ্নতোরোত্তরা\\nরাধায়াঃ কিলকিঞ্চিতস্তবকিনী দৃষ্টিঃ শ্রিয়ং বঃ ক্রিয়াৎ ॥১৮০॥
verses.transliteration: antaḥ smeratayojjvalā jala-kaṇa-vyākīrṇa-pakṣmāṅkurā\\nkiñcit pāṭalitāñcalā rasikatotsiktā puraḥ kuñcatī\\nruddhāyāḥ pathi mādhavena madhura-vyābhugna-torottarā\\nrādhāyāḥ kila-kiñcita-stavakinī dṛṣṭiḥ śriyaṁ vaḥ kriyāt
verses.translation: “ 'May the sight of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's kila-kiñcita ecstasy, which is like a bouquet, bring good fortune to all. When Śrī Kṛṣṇa blocked Rādhārāṇī's way to the dāna-ghāṭi, there was laughter within Her heart. Her eyes grew bright, and fresh tears flowed from Her eyes, reddening them. Due to Her sweet relationship with Kṛṣṇa, Her eyes were enthusiastic, and when Her crying subsided, She appeared even more beautiful.'

verses.devanagari: বাষ্পব্যাকুলিতারুণাঞ্চলচলন্নেত্রং রসোল্লাসিতং\\nহেলোল্লাসচলাধরং কুটিলিতভ্রূযুগ্মমুদ্যৎস্মিতম্ ।\\nরাধায়াঃ কিলকিঞ্চিতাঞ্চিতমসৌ বীক্ষ্যাননং সঙ্গমা-\\nদানন্দং তমবাপ কোটিগুণিতং যোঽভূন্ন গীর্গোচরঃ ॥১৮১॥
verses.transliteration: bāṣpa-vyākulitāruṇāñcala-calan-netraṁ rasollāsitaṁ\\nhelollāsa-calādharaṁ kuṭilita-bhrū-yugmam udyat-smitam\\nrādhāyāḥ kila-kiñcitāñcitam asau vīkṣyānanaṁ saṅgamād\\nānandaṁ tam avāpa koṭi-guṇitaṁ yo 'bhūn na gīr-gocaraḥ
verses.translation: “ 'Agitated by tears, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's eyes were tinged with red, just like the eastern horizon at sunrise. Her lips began to move with jubilation and lusty desire. Her eyebrows curved, and Her lotus-like face smiled mildly. Seeing Rādhārāṇī's face exhibit such emotion, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa felt a million times happier than when He embraced Her. Indeed, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's happiness is not at all mundane.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Govinda-līlāmṛta
(9.18).

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’প্রভু হৈলা আনন্দিত মন ।\\nসুখাবিষ্ট হঞা স্বরূপে কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ॥১৮২॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' prabhu hailā ānandita mana\\nsukhāviṣṭa hañā svarūpe kailā āliṅgana
verses.translation: Upon hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy, and, being absorbed in this happiness, He embraced Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: ‘বিলাসাদি’-ভাব-ভূষার কহ ত’ লক্ষণ ।\\nযেই ভাবে রাধা হরে গোবিন্দের মন ? ॥ ১৮৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: 'vilāsādi'-bhāva-bhūṣāra kaha ta' lakṣaṇa\\nyei bhāve rādhā hare govindera mana?
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then asked Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Please speak of the ecstatic ornaments decorating the body of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, by which She enchants the mind of Śrī Govinda."

verses.devanagari: তবে ত’ স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি কহিতে লাগিলা ।\\nশুনি’ প্ৰভুর ভক্তগণ মহাসুখ পাইলা ॥১৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabe ta' svarūpa-gosāñi kahite lāgilā\\nśuni' prabhura bhakta-gaṇa mahā-sukha pāilā
verses.translation: Being thus requested, Svarūpa Dāmodara began to speak. All the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were very happy to hear him.

verses.devanagari: রাধা বসি’ আছে, কিবা বৃন্দাবনে যায় । তাহাঁ যদি আচম্বিতে কৃষ্ণ-দরশন পায় ॥১৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā vasi' āche, kibā vṛndāvane yāya\\ntāhāṅ yadi ācambite kṛṣṇa-daraśana pāya
verses.translation: "Sometimes when Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is sitting or when She is going to Vṛndāvana, She sometimes sees Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: দেখিতে নানা-ভাব হয় বিলক্ষণ  ।\\nযে বৈলক্ষণ্যের নাম ‘বিলাস’-ভূষণ ॥১৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: dekhite nānā-bhāva haya vilakṣaṇa\\nse vailakṣaṇyera nāma 'vilāsa'-bhūṣaṇa
verses.translation: "The symptoms of various ecstasies that become manifest at that time are called vilāsa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is described in the following verse, taken from the
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Anubhāva-prakaraṇa
31).

verses.devanagari: গতিস্থানাসনাদীনাং মুখনেত্রাদিকর্মণাম্ ।\\nতাৎকালিকন্তু বৈশিষ্ট্যং বিলাসঃ প্রিয়সঙ্গজম্ ॥১৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: gati-sthānāsanādīnāṁ\\nmukha-netrādi-karmaṇām\\ntātkālikaṁ tu vaiśiṣṭyaṁ\\nvilāsaḥ priya-saṅgajam
verses.translation: “ 'The various symptoms manifested in a woman's face, eyes, and the other parts of her body and the way she moves, stands or sits when she meets her beloved are called vilāsa.' "

verses.devanagari: লজ্জা, হর্ষ, অভিলাষ, সম্ভ্রম, বাম্য, ভয় ।\\nএত ভাব মিলি’ রাধায় চঞ্চল করয় ॥১৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: lajjā, harṣa, abhilāṣa, sambhrama, vāmya, bhaya\\neta bhāva mili' rādhāya cañcala karaya
