verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "Timidity, jubilation, ambition, respect, fear and the characteristics of the left-wing gopīs were all ecstatic symptoms combined to agitate Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is explained in the following verse found in the
Govinda-līlāmṛta
(9.11).

verses.devanagari: পুরঃ কৃষ্ণালোকাৎ স্থগিতকুটিলাস্যা গতিরভূৎ\\nতিরশ্চীনং কৃষ্ণাম্বরদরবৃতং শ্রীমুখমপি ।\\nচলত্তারং স্ফারং নয়নযুগমাভুগ্নমিতি সা\\nবিলাসাখ্য-স্বালঙ্করণবলিতাসীৎ প্রিয়মুদে ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: puraḥ kṛṣṇālokāt sthagita-kuṭilāsyā gatir abhūt\\ntiraścīnaṁ kṛṣṇāmbara-dara-vṛtaṁ śrī-mukham api\\ncalat-tāraṁ sphāraṁ nayana-yugam ābhugnam iti sā\\nvilāsākhya-svālaṅkaraṇa-valitāsīt priya-mude
verses.translation: “ 'When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī saw Lord Kṛṣṇa just before Her, Her progress stopped, and She assumed an attitude of opposition. Although Her face was slightly covered by a blue garment, Her two starry eyes were agitated, being wide and curved. Thus She was decorated with the ornaments of vilāsa, and Her beauty increased to give pleasure to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead.'

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-আগে রাধা যদি রহে দাণ্ডাঞা ।\\nতিন-অঙ্গ-ভঙ্গে রহে ভ্রূ নাচাঞা ॥১৯০॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-āge rādhā yadi rahe dāṇḍāñā\\ntina-aṅga-bhaṅge rahe bhrū nācāñā
verses.translation: "When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī stands before Kṛṣṇa, She stands bent in three places-Her neck, waist and legs-and Her eyebrows dance.

verses.devanagari: মুখে-নেত্রে হয় নানা-ভাবের উদ্গার ।\\nএই কান্তা-ভাবের নাম ‘ললিত’-অলঙ্কার ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: mukhe-netre haya nānā-bhāvera udgāra\\nei kāntā-bhāvera nāma 'lalita'-alaṅkāra
verses.translation: "When there is an awakening of various ecstatic features on Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's face and in Her eyes, the lalita ornaments are manifest.

verses.devanagari: বিন্যাস-ভঙ্গিরঙ্গানাং ভ্রূবিলাস-মনোহরা ।\\nসুকুমারা ভবেদ্যত্র ললিতং তদুদাহৃতম্ ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: vinyāsa-bhaṅgir aṅgānāṁ\\nbhrū-vilāsa-manoharā\\nsukumārā bhaved yatra\\nlalitaṁ tad udāhṛtam
verses.translation: “ 'When the bodily features are delicate and expertly curved, and when the eyebrows are very beautifully agitated, the ornament of charm, called lalita alaṅkāra, is manifest.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Anubhāva-prakaraṇa
56).

verses.devanagari: ললিত-ভূষিত রাধা দেখে যদি কৃষ্ণ ।\\nদুঁহে দুঁহা মিলিবারে হয়েন সতৃষ্ণ ॥১৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: lalita-bhūṣita rādhā dekhe yadi kṛṣṇa\\nduṅhe duṅhā milibāre hayena satṛṣṇa
verses.translation: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa happens to see Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī decorated with these lalita ornaments, They both anxiously want to meet one another.

verses.devanagari: হ্রিয়া তির্যগ্-গ্রীবা-চরণ-কটি-ভঙ্গী-সুমধুরা\\nচলচ্চিল্লী-বল্লী-দলিত-রতিনাথোর্জিত-ধনুঃ ।\\nপ্রিয়-প্রেমোল্লাসোল্লসিত-ললিতালালিত-তনুঃ\\nপ্রিয়প্রীত্যৈ সাসীদুদিতললিতালঙ্কৃতিযুতা ॥১৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: hriyā tiryag-grīvā-caraṇa-kaṭi-bhaṅgī-sumadhurā\\ncalac-cillī-vallī-dalita-ratināthorjita-dhanuḥ\\npriya-premollāsollasita-lalitālālita-tanuḥ\\npriya-prītyai sāsīd udita-lalitālaṅkṛti-yutā
verses.translation: “ 'When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was decorated with the ornament of lalita-alaṅkāra, just to increase Śrī Kṛṣṇa's love, an attractive curve was manifest by Her neck, knees and waist. This was brought about by Her timidity and apparent desire to avoid Kṛṣṇa. The flickering movements of Her eyebrows could conquer the powerful bow of Cupid. To increase the joy of Her beloved's love, Her body was decorated with the ornaments of lalita-alaṅkāra.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is quoted from
Govinda-līlāmṛta
(9.14).

verses.devanagari: লোভে আসি’ কৃষ্ণ করে কঞ্চুকাকর্ষণ ।\\nঅন্তরে উল্লাস, রাধা করে নিবারণ ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: lobhe āsi' kṛṣṇa kare kañcukākarṣaṇa\\nantare ullāsa, rādhā kare nivāraṇa
verses.translation: "When Kṛṣṇa comes forward and greedily snatches at the border of Rādhārāṇī's sari, She is actually very pleased within, but overtly She tries to stop Him.

verses.devanagari: বাহিরে বামতা-ক্রোধ, ভিতরে সুখ মনে ।\\n‘কুট্টমিত’-নাম এই ভাব-বিভূষণে ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: bāhire vāmatā-krodha, bhitare sukha mane\\n'kuṭṭamita'-nāma ei bhāva-vibhūṣaṇe
verses.translation: "This ecstatic dress of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's is called kuṭṭamita. When it is manifest, She externally tries to avoid Kṛṣṇa, and She apparently becomes angry, although She is very happy within.

verses.devanagari: স্তনাধরাদিগ্রহণে হৃৎপ্রীতাবপি সম্ভ্রমাৎ ।\\nবহিঃক্রোধো ব্যথিতবৎ প্রোক্তং কুট্টমিতং বুধৈঃ ॥১৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: stanādharādi-grahaṇe\\nhṛt-prītāv api sambhramāt\\nbahiḥ krodho vyathitavat\\nproktaṁ kuṭṭamitaṁ budhaiḥ
verses.translation: “ 'When the border of Her sari and the cloth veiling Her face are caught, She externally appears offended and angry, but within Her heart She is very happy. Learned scholars call this attitude kuṭṭamita.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Anubhāva-prakaraṇa
49).

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-বাঞ্ছা পূর্ণ হয়, করে পাণি-রোধ ।\\nঅন্তরে আনন্দ রাধা, বাহিরে বাম্য-ক্রোধ ॥১৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-vāñchā pūrṇa haya, kare pāṇi-rodha\\nantare ānanda rādhā, bāhire vāmya-krodha
verses.translation: "Although Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was checking Her sari with Her hand, internally She was thinking, 'Let Kṛṣṇa satisfy His desires.' In this way She was very pleased within, although She externally displayed opposition and anger.

verses.devanagari: ব্যথা পাঞা’ করে যেন শুষ্ক রোদন ।\\nঈষৎ হাসিয়া কৃষ্ণে করেন ভর্ৎসন ॥১৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: vyathā pāñā' kare yena śuṣka rodana\\nīṣat hāsiyā kṛṣṇe karena bhartsana
verses.translation: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī externally displays a kind of dry crying, as if She is offended. Then She mildly smiles and admonishes Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: পাণিরোধমবিরোধিতবাঞ্ছং ভর্ৎসনাশ্চ মধুরস্মিতগর্ভাঃ ।\\nমাধবস্য কুরুতে করভোরুর্হারি শুষ্করুদিতঞ্চ মুখেঽপি ॥২০০॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇi-rodham avirodhita-vāñchaṁ\\nbhartsanāś ca madhura-smita-garbhāḥ\\nmādhavasya kurute karabhorur\\nhāri śuṣka-ruditaṁ ca mukhe 'pi
verses.translation: “ 'Actually She has no desire to stop Kṛṣṇa's endeavor to touch Her body with His hands, yet Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, whose thighs are like the trunk of a baby elephant, protests His advances and, sweetly smiling, admonishes Him. At such times She cries without tears on Her charming face.'

verses.devanagari: এইমত আর সব ভাব-বিভূষণ ।\\nযাহাতে ভূষিত রাধা হরে কৃষ্ণ মন ॥২০১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata āra saba bhāva-vibhūṣaṇa\\nyāhāte bhūṣita rādhā hare kṛṣṇa mana
verses.translation: "In this way, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is ornamented and decorated with various ecstatic symptoms, which attract the mind of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: অনন্ত কৃষ্ণের লীলা না যায় বর্ণন ।\\nআপনে বর্ণেন যদি ‘সহস্রবদন’ ॥২০২॥
verses.transliteration: ananta kṛṣṇera līlā nā yāya varṇana\\nāpane varṇena yadi 'sahasra-vadana'
verses.translation: "It is not at all possible to describe the unlimited pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, even though He Himself describes them in His incarnation of Sahasra-vadana, the thousand-mouthed Śeṣa Nāga."

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাস হাসিয়া কহে, — শুন, দামোদর ।\\nআমার লক্ষ্মীর দেখ সম্পত্তি বিস্তর ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsa hāsiyā kahe,-śuna, dāmodara\\nāmāra lakṣmīra dekha sampatti vistara
verses.translation: This time, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura smiled and told Dāmodara Paṇḍita, "My dear sir, please hear! Just see how opulent my goddess of fortune is!

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনের সম্পদ্ দেখ, — পুষ্প-কিসলয় ।\\nগিরিধাতু-শিখিপিচ্ছ-গুঞ্জাফল-ময় ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvanera sampad dekha,-puṣpa-kisalaya\\ngiridhātu-śikhipiccha-guñjāphala-maya
verses.translation: "As far as Vṛndāvana's opulence is concerned, it consists of a few flowers and twigs, some minerals from the hills, a few peacock feathers and the plant known as guñjā.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবন দেখিবারে গেলা জগন্নাথ ।\\nশুনি’ লক্ষ্মী-দেবীর মনে হৈল আসোয়াথ ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvana dekhibāre gelā jagannātha\\nśuni' lakṣmī-devīra mane haila āsoyātha
verses.translation: "When Jagannātha decided to see Vṛndāvana, He went there, and upon hearing this, the goddess of fortune experienced restlessness and jealousy.

verses.devanagari: এত সম্পত্তি ছাড়ি, কেনে গেলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nতাঁরে হাস্য করিতে লক্ষ্মী করিলা সাজন ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta sampatti chāḍi' kene gelā vṛndāvana\\ntāṅre hāsya karite lakṣmī karilā sājana
verses.translation: "She wondered, 'Why did Lord Jagannātha give up so much opulence and go to Vṛndāvana?' To make Him a laughingstock, the goddess of fortune made arrangements for much decoration.

verses.devanagari: “তোমার ঠাকুর, দেখ এত সম্পত্তি ছাড়ি’  ।\\nপত্র-ফল-ফুল-লোভে গেলা পুষ্পবাড়ী ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: "tomāra ṭhākura, dekha eta sampatti chāḍi'\\npatra-phala-phula-lobhe gelā puṣpa-bāḍī
verses.translation: "Then the maidservants of the goddess of fortune said to the servants of Lord Jagannātha, 'Why did your Lord Jagannātha abandon the great opulence of the goddess of fortune and, for the sake of a few leaves, fruits and flowers, go see the flower garden of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī?

verses.devanagari: এই কর্ম করে কাহাঁ বিদগ্ধ-শিরোমণি ? লক্ষ্মীর অগ্রেতে নিজ প্রভুরে দেহ’ আনি’ ।।” ২০৮ ॥২০৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei karma kare kāhāṅ vidagdha-śiromaṇi?\\nlakṣmīra agrete nija prabhure deha' āni' "
verses.translation: “ 'Your master is so expert at everything, but why does He do such things? Please bring your master before the goddess of fortune.'

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ মহালক্ষ্মীর সব দাসীগণে  ।\\nকটি-বস্ত্রে বান্ধি’ আনে প্রভুর নিজগণে ॥২০৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' mahā-lakṣmīra saba dāsī-gaṇe\\nkaṭi-vastre bāndhi' āne prabhura nija-gaṇe
verses.translation: "In this way all the maidservants of the goddess of fortune arrested the servants of Jagannātha, bound them around the waist and brought them before the goddess of fortune.

verses.devanagari: লক্ষ্মীর চরণে আনি’ করায় প্রণতি  ।\\nধন-দণ্ড লয়, আর করায় মিনতি ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīra caraṇe āni' karāya praṇati\\ndhana-daṇḍa laya, āra karāya minati
verses.translation: "When all the maidservants brought Lord Jagannātha's servants before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, the Lord's servants were fined and forced to submit.

verses.devanagari: রথের উপরে করে দণ্ডের তাড়ন ।\\nচোর-প্রায় করে জগন্নাথের সেবকগণ ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: rathera upare kare daṇḍera tāḍana\\ncora-prāya kare jagannāthera sevaka-gaṇa
verses.translation: "All the maidservants began to beat the Ratha car with sticks, and they treated the servants of Lord Jagannātha almost like thieves.

verses.devanagari: সব ভৃত্যগণ কহে, — যোড় করি’ হাত ।\\n‘কালি আনি দিব তোমার আগে জগন্নাথ’ ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: saba bhṛtya-gaṇa kahe,-yoḍa kari' hāta\\n'kāli āni diba tomāra āge jagannātha,
verses.translation: "Finally all of Lord Jagannātha's servants submitted to the goddess of fortune with folded hands, assuring her that they would bring Lord Jagannātha before her the very next day.

verses.devanagari: তবে শান্ত হঞা লক্ষ্মী যায় নিজ ঘর ।\\nআমার লক্ষ্মীর সম্পদ্ — বাক্য অগোচর ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe śānta hañā lakṣmī yāya nija ghara\\nāmāra lakṣmīra sampad-vākya-agocara
verses.translation: "Being thus pacified, the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. Just see! My goddess of fortune is opulent beyond all description."

verses.devanagari: দুগ্ধ আউটি’ দধি মথে তোমার গোপীগণে ।\\nআমার ঠাকুরাণী বৈসে রত্নসিংহাসনে ॥২১৪॥
verses.transliteration: dugdha āuṭi' dadhi mathe tomāra gopī-gaṇe\\nāmāra ṭhākurāṇī vaise ratna-siṁhāsane
verses.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura continued to address Svarūpa Dāmodara: "Your gopīs are engaged in boiling milk and churning it to turn it into yogurt, but my mistress, the goddess of fortune, sits on a throne made of jewels and gems."

verses.devanagari: নারদ-প্রকৃতি শ্রীবাস করে পরিহাস ।\\nশুনি’ হাসে মহাপ্রভুর যত নিজ-দাস ॥২১৫॥
verses.transliteration: nārada-prakṛti śrīvāsa kare parihāsa\\nśuni' hāse mahāprabhura yata nija-dāsa
verses.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, who was enjoying the mood of Nārada Muni, thus made jokes. Hearing him, all the personal servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to smile.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — শ্রীবাস, তোমাতে নারদ-স্বভাব ।\\nঐশ্বর্যভাবে তোমাতে, ঈশ্বর-প্রভাব ॥২১৬॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,-śrīvāsa, tomāte nārada-svabhāva\\naiśvarya-bhāve tomāte, īśvara-prabhāva
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "My dear Śrīvāsa, your nature is exactly like that of Nārada Muni. The Supreme Personality of Godhead's opulence is having a direct influence upon you.

verses.devanagari: ইঁহো দামোদর-স্বরূপ — শুদ্ধ-ব্রজবাসী ।\\nঐশ্বর্য না জানে ইঁহো শুদ্ধপ্রেমে ভাসি’ ॥২১৭॥
verses.transliteration: iṅho dāmodara-svarūpa-śuddha-vrajavāsī\\naiśvarya nā jāne iṅho śuddha-preme bhāsi'
verses.translation: "Svarūpa Dāmodara is a pure devotee of Vṛndāvana. He does not even know what opulence is, for he is simply absorbed in pure devotional service."

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — শ্রীবাস, শুন সাবধানে ।\\nবৃন্দাবনসম্পদ্ তোমার নাহি পড়ে মনে ? ॥ ২১৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,-śrīvāsa, śuna sāvadhāne\\nvṛndāvana-sampad tomāra nāhi paḍe mane?
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara then retorted, "My dear Śrīvāsa, please hear me with attention. You have forgotten the transcendental opulence of Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনে সাহজিক যে সম্পৎসিন্ধু ।\\nদ্বারকা-বৈকুণ্ঠ-সম্পত্ — তার এক বিন্দু ॥২১৯॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvane sāhajika ye sampat-sindhu\\ndvārakā-vaikuṇṭha-sampat-tāra eka bindu
verses.translation: "The natural opulence of Vṛndāvana is just like an ocean. The opulence of Dvārakā and Vaikuṇṭha is not even to be compared to a drop.

verses.devanagari: পরম পুরুষোত্তম স্বয়ং ভগবান্ ।\\nকৃষ্ণ যাহাঁ ধনী তাহাঁ বৃন্দাবন-ধাম ॥২২০॥
verses.transliteration: parama puruṣottama svayaṁ bhagavān\\nkṛṣṇa yāhāṅ dhanī tāhāṅ vṛndāvana-dhāma
verses.translation: "Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead full of all opulences, and His complete opulences are exhibited only in Vṛndāvana-dhāma.

verses.devanagari: চিন্তামণিময় ভূমি রত্নের ভবন ।\\nচিন্তামণিগণ — দাসী-চরণ-ভূষণ ॥২২১॥
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇi-maya bhūmi ratnera bhavana\\ncintāmaṇi-gaṇa dāsī-caraṇa-bhūṣaṇa
verses.translation: "Vṛndāvana-dhāma is made of transcendental touchstone. Its entire surface is the source of all valuable jewels, and the cintāmaṇi stone is used to decorate the lotus feet of the maidservants of Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: কল্পবৃক্ষ-লতার — যাহাঁ সাহজিক-বন ।\\nপুষ্প-ফল বিনা কেহ না মাগে অন্য ধন ॥২২২॥
verses.transliteration: kalpavṛkṣa-latāra-yāhāṅ sāhajika-vana\\npuṣpa-phala vinā keha nā māge anya dhana
verses.translation: "Vṛndāvana is a natural forest of desire trees and creepers, and the inhabitants do not want anything but the fruits and flowers of those desire trees.

verses.devanagari: অনন্ত কামধেনু তাহাঁ ফিরে বনে বনে ।\\nদুগ্ধমাত্র দেন, কেহ না মাগে অন্য ধনে ॥২২৩॥
verses.transliteration: ananta kāma-dhenu tāhāṅ phire vane vane\\ndugdha-mātra dena, keha nā māge anya dhane
verses.translation: "In Vṛndāvana there are cows that fulfill all desires [kāma-dhenus], and their number is unlimited. They graze from forest to forest and deliver only milk. The people want nothing else.

verses.devanagari: সহজ লোকের কথা — যাহাঁ দিব্য-গীত ।\\nসহজ গমন করে, — যৈছে নৃত্য-প্ৰতীত ॥২২৪॥
verses.transliteration: sahaja lokera kathā-yāhāṅ divya-gīta\\nsahaja gamana kare,-yaiche nṛtya-pratīta
verses.translation: "In Vṛndāvana, the natural speech of the people sounds like music, and their natural motion resembles a dance.

verses.devanagari: সর্বত্র জল — যাহাঁ অমৃত-সমান ।\\nচিদানন্দ জ্যোতিঃ স্বাদ্য — যাহাঁ মূর্তিমান্ ॥২২৫॥
verses.transliteration: sarvatra jala-yāhāṅ amṛta-samāna\\ncid-ānanda jyotiḥ svādya-yāhāṅ mūrtimān
verses.translation: "The water in Vṛndāvana is nectar, and the brahmajyoti effulgence, which is full of transcendental bliss, is directly perceived there in its form.

verses.devanagari: লক্ষ্মী জিনি’ গুণ যাহাঁ লক্ষ্মীর সমাজ ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-বংশী করে যাহাঁ প্রিয়সখী-কায ॥২২৬॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmī jini' guṇa yāhāṅ lakṣmīra samāja\\nkṛṣṇa-vaṁśī kare yāhāṅ priya-sakhī-kāya
verses.translation: "The gopīs there are also goddesses of fortune, and they surpass the goddess of fortune who abides in Vaikuṇṭha. In Vṛndāvana, Lord Kṛṣṇa is always playing His transcendental flute, which is His dear companion.

verses.devanagari: শ্রিয়ঃ কান্তাঃ কান্তঃ পরমপুরুষঃ কল্পতরবো\\nদ্রুমা ভূমিশ্চিন্তামণিগণময়ী তোয়মমৃতম্ ।\\nকথা গানং নাট্যং গগনমপি বংশী প্রিয়সখী\\nচিদানন্দং জ্যোতিঃ পরমপি তদাস্বাদ্যমপি চ ॥২২৭॥
verses.transliteration: śriyaḥ kāntāḥ kāntaḥ parama-puruṣaḥ kalpa-taravo\\ndrumā bhūmiś cintāmaṇi-gaṇa-mayī toyam amṛtam\\nkathā gānaṁ nāṭyaṁ gamanam api vaṁśī priya-sakhī\\ncid-ānandaṁ jyotiḥ param api tad āsvādyam api ca
verses.translation: “ 'The damsels of Vṛndāvana, the gopīs, are super goddesses of fortune. The enjoyer in Vṛndāvana is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa. The trees there are all wish-fulfilling trees, and the land is made of transcendental touchstone. The water is all nectar, the talking is singing, the walking is dancing, and the constant companion of Kṛṣṇa is His flute. The effulgence of transcendental bliss is experienced everywhere. Therefore Vṛndāvana-dhāma is the only relishable abode.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Brahma-saṁhitā
(5.56).

verses.devanagari: চিন্তামণিশ্চরণভূষণমঙ্গনানাং\\nশৃঙ্গারপুষ্পতরবস্তরবঃ সুরাণাম্ ।\\nবৃন্দাবনে ব্রজধনং ননু কামধেনু-\\nবৃন্দানি চেতি সুখসিন্ধুরহো বিভূতিঃ ॥২২৮॥
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇiś caraṇa-bhūṣaṇam aṅganānāṁ\\nśṛṅgāra-puṣpa-taravas taravaḥ surāṇām\\nvṛndāvane vraja-dhanaṁ nanu kāma-dhenu-\\nvṛndāni ceti sukha-sindhur aho vibhūtiḥ
verses.translation: “ 'The anklets on the damsels of Vraja-bhūmi are made of cintāmaṇi stone. The trees are wish-fulfilling trees, and they produce flowers with which the gopīs decorate themselves. There are also wish-fulfilling cows [kāma dhenus], which deliver unlimited quantities of milk. These cows constitute the wealth of Vṛndāvana. Thus Vṛndāvana's opulence is blissfully exhibited.' "
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis is a verse written by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’প্রেমাবেশে নৃত্য করে শ্রীনিবাস ।\\nকক্ষতালি বাজায়, করে অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ॥২২৯॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' premāveśe nṛtya kare śrīnivāsa\\nkakṣa-tāli bājāya, kare aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa
verses.translation: Śrīvāsa then began to dance in ecstatic love. He vibrated sounds by slapping his armpits with the palms of his hands, and he laughed very loudly.

verses.devanagari: রাধার শুদ্ধরস প্রভু আবেশে শুনিল ।\\nসেই রসাবেশে প্রভু নৃত্য আরম্ভিল ॥২৩০॥
verses.transliteration: rādhāra śuddha-rasa prabhu āveśe śunila\\nsei rasāveśe prabhu nṛtya ārambhila
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these discussions about the pure transcendental mellow of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Absorbed in transcendental ecstasy, the Lord began to dance.

verses.devanagari: রসাবেশে প্রভুর নৃত্য, স্বরূপের গান ।\\n‘বল’ ‘বল’ বলি’ প্রভু পাতে নিজ-কাণ ॥২৩১॥
verses.transliteration: rasāveśe prabhura nṛtya, svarūpera gāna\\n'bala' 'bala' bali' prabhu pāte nija-kāṇa
verses.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in ecstatic love and Svarūpa Dāmodara was singing, the Lord said, "Go on singing! Go on singing!" The Lord then extended His own ears.

verses.devanagari: ব্রজরস-গীত শুনি’ প্রেম উথলিল ।\\nপুরুষোত্তম-গ্রাম প্রভু প্রেমে ভাসাইল ॥২৩২॥
verses.transliteration: vraja-rasa-gīta śuni' prema uthalila\\npuruṣottama-grāma prabhu preme bhāsāila
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love was awakened by hearing the songs of Vṛndāvana. In this way He inundated Puruṣottama, Jagannātha Purī, with love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: লক্ষ্মী-দেবী যথাকালে গেলা নিজ-ঘর ।\\nপ্রভু নৃত্য করে, হৈল তৃতীয় প্ৰহর ॥২৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmī-devī yathā-kāle gelā nija-ghara\\nprabhu nṛtya kare, haila tṛtīya prahara
verses.translation: Finally the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. In due course of time, as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, afternoon arrived.

verses.devanagari: চারি সম্প্রদায় গান করি’ বহু শ্রান্ত হৈল ।\\nমহাপ্রভুর প্রেমাবেশ দ্বিগুণ বাড়িল ॥২৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: cāri sampradāya gāna kari' bahu śrānta haila\\nmahāprabhura premāveśa dviguṇa bāḍila
verses.translation: After much singing, all four saṅkīrtana parties grew fatigued, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love increased twofold.

verses.devanagari: রাধা-প্রেমাবেশে প্রভু হৈলা সেই মূর্তি ।\\nনিত্যানন্দ দূরে দেখি’ করিলেন স্তুতি ॥২৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā-premāveśe prabhu hailā sei mūrti\\nnityānanda dūre dekhi' karilena stuti
verses.translation: While dancing absorbed in Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared in Her very form. Seeing this from a distant place, Nityānanda Prabhu offered prayers.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ দেখিয়া প্রভুর ভাবাবেশ ।\\nনিকটে না আইসে, রহে কিছু দূরদেশ ॥২৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda dekhiyā prabhura bhāvāveśa\\nnikaṭe nā āise, rahe kichu dūra-deśa
verses.translation: Seeing the ecstatic love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu did not approach but remained a little distance away.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ বিনা প্রভুকে ধরে কোন্ জন ।\\nপ্রভুর আবেশ না যায়, না রহে কীর্তন ॥২৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda vinā prabhuke dhare kon jana\\nprabhura āveśa nā yāya, nā rahe kīrtana
verses.translation: Only Nityānanda Prabhu could catch Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the ecstatic mood of the Lord would not stop. At the same time, kīrtana could not be continued.

verses.devanagari: ভঙ্গি করি’ স্বরূপ সবার শ্রম জানাইল ।\\nভক্তগণের শ্রম দেখি’ প্রভুর বাহ্য হৈল ॥২৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṅgi kari' svarūpa sabāra śrama jānāila\\nbhakta-gaṇera śrama dekhi' prabhura bāhya haila
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara then informed the Lord that all the devotees were fatigued. Seeing this situation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to His external senses.

verses.devanagari: সব ভক্ত লঞা প্রভু গেলা পুষ্পোদ্যানে ।\\nবিশ্রাম করিয়া কৈলা মাধ্যাহ্নিক স্নানে ॥২৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: saba bhakta lañā prabhu gelā puṣpodyāne\\nviśrāma kariyā kailā mādhyāhnika snāne
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then entered the flower garden with all His devotees. After resting there for some time, He finished His afternoon bath.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথের প্রসাদ আইল বহু উপহার ।\\nলক্ষ্মীর প্রসাদ আইল বিবিধ প্রকার ॥২৪০॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthera prasāda āila bahu upahāra\\nlakṣmīra prasāda āila vividha prakāra
verses.translation: Then there arrived in large quantities a variety of food that had been offered to Śrī Jagannātha and a variety that had been offered to the goddess of fortune.

verses.devanagari: সবা লঞা নানা-রঙ্গে করিলা ভোজন ।\\nসন্ধ্যা স্নান করি’ কৈল জগন্নাথ দরশন ॥২৪১॥
verses.transliteration: sabā lañā nānā-raṅge karilā bhojana\\nsandhyā snāna kari' kaila jagannātha daraśana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu finished His afternoon lunch, and after His evening bath, He went to see Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথ দেখি’ করেন নর্তন-কীর্তন ।\\nনরেন্দ্র জলক্রীড়া করে লঞা ভক্তগণ ॥২৪২॥
verses.transliteration: jagannātha dekhi' karena nartana-kīrtana\\nnarendre jala-krīḍā kare lañā bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: As soon as He saw Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to chant and dance. Afterward, accompanied by His devotees, the Lord enjoyed sporting in the lake called Narendra-sarovara.

verses.devanagari: উদ্যানে আসিয়া কৈল বন-ভোজন ।\\nএইমত ক্রীড়া কৈল প্রভু অষ্টদিন ॥২৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: udyāne āsiyā kaila vana-bhojana\\nei-mata krīḍā kaila prabhu aṣṭa-dina
verses.translation: Then, entering the flower garden, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His meal. In this way He continuously performed all kinds of pastimes for eight days.

verses.devanagari: আর দিনে জগন্নাথের ভিতর-বিজয় ।\\nরথে চড়ি’ জগন্নাথ চলে নিজালয় ॥২৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: āra dine jagannāthera bhitara-vijaya\\nrathe caḍi' jagannātha cale nijālaya
verses.translation: The next day Lord Jagannātha came out from the temple and, riding on the car, returned to His own abode.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ববৎ কৈল প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণ ।\\nপরম আনন্দে করেন নর্তন-কীর্তন ॥২৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavat kaila prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa\\nparama ānande karena nartana-kīrtana
verses.translation: As previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees again chanted and danced with great pleasure.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথের পুনঃ পাণ্ডু-বিজয় হইল ।\\nএক গুটি পট্টডোরী তাঁহা টুটি’ গেল ॥২৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthera punaḥ pāṇḍu-vijaya ha-ila\\neka guṭi paṭṭa-ḍorī tāṅhā ṭuṭi' gela
verses.translation: During the Pāṇḍu-vijaya, Lord Jagannātha was carried, and while He was being carried, a bunch of silken ropes broke.

verses.devanagari: পাণ্ডু-বিজয়ের তুলি ফাটি-ফুটি যায় ।\\nজগন্নাথের ভরে তুলা উড়িয়া পলায় ॥২৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍu-vijayera tuli phāṭi-phuṭi yāya\\njagannāthera bhare tulā uḍiyā palāya
verses.translation: When the Jagannātha Deity is carried, at intervals He is placed on cotton pads. When the ropes broke, the cotton pads also broke due to the weight of Lord Jagannātha, and the cotton floated in the air.

verses.devanagari: কুলীনগ্রামী রামানন্দ, সত্যরাজ খাঁন  ।\\nতাঁরে আজ্ঞা দিল প্রভু করিয়া সম্মান ॥২৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: kulīna-grāmī rāmānanda, satyarāja khāṅna\\ntāṅre ājñā dila prabhu kariyā sammāna
verses.translation: Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān were present from Kulīna-grāma, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, with great respect, gave them the following orders.

verses.devanagari: এই পট্টডোরীর তুমি হও যজমান  ।\\nপ্রতিবৎসর আনিবে ‘ডোরী’ করিয়া নির্মাণ ॥২৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei paṭṭa-ḍorīra tumi hao yajamāna\\nprati-vatsara ānibe 'ḍorī' kariyā nirmāṇa
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān to become the worshipers of these ropes and every year bring silken ropes from their village.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nIt is understood that silken rope was being manufactured by the local inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma; therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked Rāmānanda Vasu and Satyarāja Khān to get ropes every year for Lord Jagannātha's service.

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ দিল তাঁরে ছিণ্ডা পট্টডোরী ।\\nইহা দেখি’ করিবে ডোরী অতি দৃঢ় করি’ ॥২৫০॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' dila tāṅre chiṇḍā paṭṭa-ḍorī\\nihā dekhi' karibe ḍorī ati dṛḍha kari'
verses.translation: After telling them this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed them the broken silken ropes, saying, "Just look at this sample. You must make ropes that are much stronger."

verses.devanagari: এই পট্টডোরীতে হয় ‘শেষ’-অধিষ্ঠান ।\\nদশ-মূর্তি হঞা যেঁহো সেবে ভগবান্ ॥২৫১॥
verses.transliteration: ei paṭṭa-ḍorīte haya 'śeṣa'-adhiṣṭhāna\\ndaśa-mūrti hañā yeṅho seve bhagavān
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān that this rope was the abode of Lord Śeṣa, who expands Himself into ten forms and serves the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
For a description of Śeṣa Nāga, refer to
Ādi-līlā
(5.123-124).

verses.devanagari: ভাগ্যবান্ সত্যরাজ বসু রামানন্দ ।\\nসেবা-আজ্ঞা পাঞা হৈল পরম-আনন্দ ॥২৫২॥
verses.transliteration: bhāgyavān satyarāja vasu rāmānanda\\nsevā-ājñā pāñā haila parama-ānanda
verses.translation: After receiving orders from the Lord for the rendering of service, the fortunate Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu were highly pleased.

verses.devanagari: প্রতি বৎসর গুণ্ডিচাতে ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nপট্টডোরী লঞা আইসে অতি বড় রঙ্গে ॥২৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: prati vatsara guṇḍicāte bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge\\npaṭṭa-ḍorī lañā āise ati baḍa raṅge
verses.translation: Every year thereafter, when the Guṇḍicā temple was being cleansed, Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu would come with other devotees and with great pleasure bring silken rope.

verses.devanagari: তবে জগন্নাথ যাই’ বসিলা সিংহাসনে ।\\nমহাপ্রভু ঘরে আইলা লঞা ভক্তগণে ॥২৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabe jagannātha yāi' vasilā siṁhāsane\\nmahāprabhu ghare āilā lañā bhakta-gaṇe
verses.translation: Thus Lord Jagannātha returned to His temple and sat on His throne while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with His devotees.

verses.devanagari: এইমত ভক্তগণে যাত্রা দেখাইল ।\\nভক্তগণ লঞা বৃন্দাবন-কেলি কৈল ॥২৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata bhakta-gaṇe yātrā dekhāila\\nbhakta-gaṇa lañā vṛndāvana-keli kaila
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed the Ratha-yātrā ceremony to His devotees and performed the Vṛndāvana pastimes with them.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্য-গোসাঞির লীলা — অনন্ত, অপার ।\\n‘সহস্র-বদন’ যার নাহি পায় পার ॥২৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-gosāñira līlā-ananta, apāra\\n'sahasra-vadana' yāra nāhi pāya pāra
verses.translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited and endless. Even Sahasravadana, Lord Śeṣa, cannot reach the limits of His pastimes.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥২৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Fourteenth Chapter, describing the Herā-pañcamī-yātrā.

sections.title: Chapter 15: The Lord Accepts Prasāda at the House of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya

verses.devanagari: সার্বভৌমগৃহে ভুঞ্জন্ স্বনিন্দকমমোঘকম্ ।\\nঅঙ্গীকুর্বন্ স্ফুটাং চক্রে গৌরঃ স্বাং ভক্তবশ্যতাম্ ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: sārvabhauma-gṛhe bhuñjan\\nsva-nindakam amoghakam\\naṅgīkurvan sphuṭāṁ cakre\\ngauraḥ svāṁ bhakta-vaśyatām
verses.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was accepting prasāda at the house of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Amogha criticized Him. At that time the Lord also showed how much He was obliged to His devotees.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

verses.devanagari: জয় শ্রীচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত-শ্রোতাগণ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত — যাঁর প্রাণধন ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: jaya śrī-caitanya-caritāmṛta-śrotā-gaṇa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta—yāṅra prāṇa-dhana
verses.synonyms:
jaya
—all glories;
śrī-caitanya-caritāmṛta-śrotā-gaṇa
—to the listeners of
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta
;
caitanya-caritāmṛta
—
Caitanya-caritāmṛta
;
yāṅra
—of whom;
prāṇa-dhana
—the life and soul.
verses.translation: All glories to the listeners of Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta who have accepted it as their life and soul.

verses.devanagari: এইমত মহাপ্ৰভু ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nনীলাচলে রহি’ করে নৃত্যগীত-রঙ্গে ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata mahāprabhu bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge\\nnīlācale rahi' kare nṛtya-gīta-raṅge
verses.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Jagannātha Purī, He constantly enjoyed chanting and dancing with His devotees.

verses.devanagari: প্রথমাবসরে জগন্নাথ-দরশন ।\\nনৃত্যগীত করে দণ্ডপরণাম, স্তবন ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: prathamāvasare jagannātha-daraśana\\nnṛtya-gīta kare daṇḍa-paraṇāma, stavana
verses.translation: In the beginning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the Deity of Lord Jagannātha in the temple. He offered Him obeisances and prayers and danced and sang before Him.

verses.devanagari: ‘উপলভোগ’ লাগিলে করে বাহিরে বিজয় ।\\nহরিদাস মিলি’ আইসে আপন নিলয় ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'upala-bhoga' lāgile kare bāhire vijaya\\nharidāsa mili' āise āpana nilaya
verses.translation: After visiting the temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would remain outside during the upala-bhoga offering. He would then go meet Haridāsa Ṭhākura and return to His residence.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
At noon, when there was an
upala-bhoga
offering in a place called
bhoga-vardhana-khaṇḍa,
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go outside the temple. Before going outside, He used to stand near the Garuḍa-stambha column and offer His obeisances and prayers. Afterwards, the Lord would visit Siddha-bakula, where Haridāsa Ṭhākura lived. After visiting with Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the Lord would return to His own place at the abode of Kāśī Miśra.

verses.devanagari: ঘরে বসি’ করে প্রভু নাম সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nঅদ্বৈত আসিয়া করে প্ৰভুর পূজন ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: ghare vasi' kare prabhu nāma saṅkīrtana\\nadvaita āsiyā kare prabhura pūjana
verses.translation: Sitting in His room, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would chant on His beads, and Advaita Prabhu would come there to worship the Lord.

verses.devanagari: সুগন্ধি-সলিলে দেন পাদ্য, আচমন ।\\nসর্বাঙ্গে লেপয়ে প্রভুর সুগন্ধি চন্দন ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: sugandhi-salile dena pādya, ācamana\\nsarvāṅge lepaye prabhura sugandhi candana
verses.translation: While worshiping Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Advaita Ācārya would offer Him scented water to wash His mouth and feet. Then Advaita Ācārya would smear very fragrant sandalwood pulp all over His body.

verses.devanagari: গলে মালা দেন, মাথায় তুলসী-মঞ্জরী ।\\nযোড়-হাতে স্তুতি করে পদে নমস্করি’ ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: gale mālā dena, māthāya tulasī-mañjarī\\nyoḍa-hāte stuti kare pade namaskari'
verses.translation: Śrī Advaita Prabhu would also place a flower garland around the Lord's neck and tulasī flowers [mañjarīs] on His head. Then, with folded hands, Advaita Ācārya would offer obeisances and prayers unto the Lord.

verses.devanagari: পূজা-পাত্রে পুষ্প-তুলসী শেষ যে আছিল ।\\nসেই সব লঞা প্রভু আচার্যে পূজিল ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: pūjā-pātre puṣpa-tulasī śeṣa ye āchila\\nsei saba lañā prabhu ācārye pūjila
verses.translation: After being worshiped by Advaita Ācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would take the dish containing flowers and tulasī and, with whatever paraphernalia remained, would also worship Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: “যোঽসি সোঽসি নমোঽস্তু তে” এই মন্ত্র পড়ে ।\\nমুখবাদ্য করি’ প্রভু হাসায় আচার্যেরে ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: "yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te" ei mantra paḍe\\nmukha-vādya kari' prabhu hāsāya ācāryere
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would worship Advaita Ācārya by chanting the mantra, "Whatever You are, You are—but I offer My respects unto You." In addition, the Lord would make some sounds within His mouth that would make Advaita Ācārya laugh.

verses.devanagari: এইমত অন্যোন্যে করেন নমস্কার ।\\nপ্রভুরে নিমন্ত্রণ করে আচার্য বার বার ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata anyonye karena namaskāra\\nprabhure nimantraṇa kare ācārya bāra bāra
verses.translation: In this way both Advaita Ācārya and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would offer Their respectful obeisances unto one another. Then Advaita Ācārya would extend invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again and again.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যের নিমন্ত্রণ — আশ্চর্য-কথন ।\\nবিস্তারি’ বর্ণিয়াছেন দাস-বৃন্দাবন ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryera nimantraṇa—āścarya-kathana\\nvistāri' varṇiyāchena dāsa-vṛndāvana
verses.translation: Indeed, Śrī Advaita Ācārya's invitation is another wonderful story. It has been very vividly described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: পুনরুক্তি হয়, তাহা না কৈলুঁ বর্ণন ।\\nআর ভক্তগণ করে প্রভুরে নিমন্ত্রণ ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: punarukti haya, tāhā nā kailuṅ varṇana\\nāra bhakta-gaṇa kare prabhure nimantraṇa
verses.translation: Since Advaita Ācārya's invitation has been described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, I shall not repeat the story. However, I shall say that other devotees also extended invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: এক এক দিন এক এক ভক্তগৃহে মহোত্সব ।\\nপ্ৰভু-সঙ্গে তাহাঁ ভোজন করে ভক্ত সব ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: eka eka dina eka eka bhakta-gṛhe mahotsava\\nprabhu-saṅge tāhāṅ bhojana kare bhakta saba
verses.translation: Every day one devotee after another would invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the other devotees to lunch and would also hold a festival.

verses.devanagari: চারিমাস রহিলা সবে মহাপ্রভু-সঙ্গে ।\\nজগন্নাথের নানা যাত্রা দেখে মহারঙ্গে ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: cāri-māsa rahilā sabe mahāprabhu-saṅge\\njagannāthera nānā yātrā dekhe mahā-raṅge
verses.translation: All the devotees remained at Jagannātha Purī for four continuous months, and they observed all Lord Jagannātha's festivals with great pleasure.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণজন্মযাত্রা-দিনে নন্দ-মহোত্সব  ।\\nগোপবেশ হৈলা প্রভু লঞা ভক্ত সব ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-janma-yātrā-dine nanda-mahotsava\\ngopa-veśa hailā prabhu lañā bhakta saba
verses.translation: The devotees also celebrated the festival of Janmāṣṭamī, Kṛṣṇa's birthday, which is also called Nanda-mahotsava, the festival of Nanda Mahārāja. At that time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees dressed themselves as cowherd boys.

verses.devanagari: দধিদুগ্ধ-ভার সবে নিজ-স্কন্ধে করি’  ।\\nমহোত্সব-স্থানে আইলা বলি ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: dadhi-dugdha-bhāra sabe nija-skandhe kari'\\nmahotsava-sthāne āilā bali 'hari' 'hari'
verses.translation: Having dressed up like cowherd boys, all the devotees carried pots of milk and yogurt balanced on rods over their shoulders. Thus they all arrived at the festival grounds chanting the holy name of Hari.

verses.devanagari: কানাঞি-খুটিয়া আছেন ‘নন্দ’-বেশ ধরি’ ।\\nজগন্নাথ মাহাতি হঞাছেন ‘ব্রজেশ্বরী’ ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: kānāñi-khuṭiyā āchena 'nanda'-veśa dhari'\\njagannātha-māhāti hañāchena 'vrajeśvarī'
verses.translation: Kānāñi Khuṭiyā dressed himself like Nanda Mahārāja, and Jagannātha Māhāti dressed himself as mother Yaśodā.

verses.devanagari: আপনে প্ৰতাপরুদ্র, আর মিশ্র-কাশী ।\\nসার্বভৌম, আর পড়িছা-পাত্র তুলসী ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: āpane pratāparudra, āra miśra-kāśī\\nsārvabhauma, āra paḍichā-pātra tulasī
verses.translation: At that time, King Pratāparudra was also personally present with Kāśī Miśra, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Tulasī Paḍichāpātra.

verses.devanagari: ইঁহা-সবা লঞা প্রভু করে নৃত্য-রঙ্গ ।\\nদধি-দুগ্ধ হরিদ্রা-জলে ভরে সবার অঙ্গ ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: iṅhā-sabā lañā prabhu kare nṛtya-raṅga\\ndadhi-dugdha haridrā-jale bhare sabāra aṅga
verses.translation: As usual, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced jubilantly. Everyone was covered with milk, yogurt and yellow turmeric water.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত কহে, — সত্য কহি, না করিহ কোপ ।\\nলগুড় ফিরাইতে পার, তবে জানি গোপ ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: advaita kahe,—satya kahi, nā kariha kopa\\nlaguḍa phirāite pāra, tabe jāni gopa
verses.translation: It was at this time that Śrīla Advaita Ācārya said, "Please do not be angry. I speak the truth. I shall know whether You are a cowherd boy only if You can wheel this rod about."

verses.devanagari: তবে লগুড় লঞা প্রভু ফিরাইতে লাগিলা ।\\nবার বার আকাশে ফেলি’ লুফিয়া ধরিলা ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe laguḍa lañā prabhu phirāite lāgilā\\nbāra bāra ākāśe pheli' luphiyā dharilā
verses.translation: Accepting Advaita Ācārya's challenge, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took a big rod and began to wheel it around and around. Again and again He threw the rod into the sky and caught it when it fell.

verses.devanagari: শিরের উপরে, পৃষ্ঠে, সম্মুখে, দুই-পাশে ।\\nপাদমধ্যে ফিরায় লগুড়, — দেখি’ লোক হাসে ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: śirera upare, pṛṣṭhe, sammukhe, dui-pāśe\\npāda-madhye phirāya laguḍa,—dekhi' loka hāse
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wheeled and threw the rod, sometimes over His head, sometimes behind His back, sometimes in front of Him, sometimes to His side and sometimes between His legs. Indeed, all the people laughed to see this.

verses.devanagari: অলাত-চক্রের প্রায় লগুড় ফিরায় ।\\nদেখি’ সর্বলোক-চিত্তে চমত্কার পায় ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: alāta-cakrera prāya laguḍa phirāya\\ndekhi' sarva-loka-citte camatkāra pāya
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu whirled the rod in a circle like a firebrand, the heart of everyone who saw it was astonished.

verses.devanagari: এইমত নিত্যানন্দ ফিরায় লগুড় ।\\nকে বুঝিবে তাঁহা দুঁহার গোপভাব গূঢ় ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata nityānanda phirāya laguḍa\\nke bujhibe tāṅhā duṅhāra gopa-bhāva gūḍha
verses.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu also played at whirling the rod. Who can understand how They were ecstatically immersed in the deep emotions of the cowherd boys?

verses.devanagari: প্রতাপরুদ্রের আজ্ঞায় পড়িছা-তুলসী  ।\\nজগন্নাথের প্রসাদ-বস্ত্র এক লঞা আসি ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: pratāparudrera ājñāya paḍichā-tulasī\\njagannāthera prasāda-vastra eka lañā āsi
verses.translation: Following the orders of Mahārāja Pratāparudra, the temple superintendent named Tulasī brought one of Lord Jagannātha's used cloths.

verses.devanagari: বহুমূল্য বস্ত্র প্রভু মস্তকে বান্ধিল  ।\\nআচার্যাদি প্রভুর গণেরে পরাইল ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: bahu-mūlya vastra prabhu-mastake bāndhila\\nācāryādi prabhura gaṇere parāila
verses.translation: This valuable cloth was wrapped around the head of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The other devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, also had cloths wrapped about their heads.

verses.devanagari: কানাঞি-খুটিয়া, জগন্নাথ, — দুইজন ।\\nআবেশে বিলাইল ঘরে ছিল যত ধন ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: kānāñi-khuṭiyā, jagannātha,—dui-jana\\nāveśe bilāila ghare chila yata dhana
verses.translation: In ecstasy, Kānāñi Khuṭiyā, who was dressed as Nanda Mahārāja, and Jagannātha Māhāti, who was dressed as mother Yaśodā, distributed all the riches they had stocked at home.

verses.devanagari: দেখি’ মহাপ্ৰভু বড় সন্তোষ পাইলা ।\\nমাতাপিতা-জ্ঞানে দুঁহে নমস্কার কৈলা ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: dekhi' mahāprabhu baḍa santoṣa pāilā\\nmātā-pitā-jñāne duṅhe namaskāra kailā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was greatly satisfied to see this. Accepting them both as His father and mother, He offered them obeisances.

verses.devanagari: পরম-আবেশে প্রভু আইলা নিজ-ঘর ।\\nএইমত লীলা করে গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: parama-āveśe prabhu āilā nija-ghara\\nei-mata līlā kare gaurāṅga-sundara
verses.translation: In great ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, known as Gaurāṅga-sundara, performed various pastimes.

verses.devanagari: বিজয়া-দশমী — লঙ্কা-বিজয়ের দিনে  ।\\nবানর-সৈন্য কৈলা প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণে ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: vijayā-daśamī—laṅkā-vijayera dine\\nvānara-sainya kailā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇe
verses.translation: On the victory day celebrating the conquest of Laṅkā-a day known as Vijayā-daśamī-Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dressed up all His devotees like monkey soldiers.

verses.devanagari: হনুমান্-আবেশে প্রভু বৃক্ষশাখা লঞা  ।\\nলঙ্কা-গড়ে চড়ি’ ফেলে গড় ভাঙ্গিয়া ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: hanumān-āveśe prabhu vṛkṣa-śākhā lañā\\nlaṅkā-gaḍe caḍi' phele gaḍa bhāṅgiyā
verses.translation: Displaying the emotions of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took up a large tree branch, and, mounting the walls of the Laṅkā fort, began to dismantle it.

verses.devanagari: ‘কাহাঁরে রাব্ণা’ প্রভু কহে ক্রোধাবেশে ।\\n‘জগন্মাতা হরে পাপী, মারিমু সবংশে ।।’ ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'kāhāṅre rāvṇā' prabhu kahe krodhāveśe\\njagan-mātā hare pāpī, mārimu savaṁśe'
verses.translation: In the ecstasy of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu angrily said, "Where is the rascal Rāvaṇa? He has kidnapped the universal mother, Sītā. Now I shall kill him and all his family."

verses.devanagari: গোসাঞির আবেশ দেখি’ লোকে চমত্কার ।\\nসর্বলোক ‘জয়’ ‘জয়’ বলে বার বার ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: gosāñira āveśa dekhi' loke camatkāra\\nsarva-loka jaya' jaya' bale bāra bāra
verses.translation: Everyone became very astonished to see the emotional ecstasy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and everyone began to chant, "All glories! All glories!" again and again.

verses.devanagari: এইমত রাসযাত্রা, আর দীপাবলী ।\\nউত্থান-দ্বাদশীযাত্রা দেখিলা সকলি ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata rāsa-yātrā, āra dīpāvalī\\nutthāna-dvādaśī-yātrā dekhilā sakali
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees participated in all the festivals known as Rāsa-yātrā, Dīpāvalī and Utthāna-dvādaśī.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The Dīpāvalī festival takes place on the dark-moon night in the month of Kārttika (October-November). The Rāsa-yātrā, or
rāsa
dancing of Kṛṣṇa, takes place on the full-moon night of the same month. Utthāna-dvādaśī takes place the day after Ekādaśī in the waxing fortnight of the moon in the same month. All the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu participated in all these festivals.

verses.devanagari: একদিন মহাপ্রভু নিত্যানন্দে লঞা ।\\nদুই ভাই যুক্তি কৈল নিভৃতে বসিয়া ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina mahāprabhu nityānande lañā\\ndui bhāi yukti kaila nibhṛte vasiyā
verses.translation: One day the two brothers, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Nityānanda Prabhu, consulted one another, sitting together in a solitary place.

verses.devanagari: কিবা যুক্তি কৈল দুঁহে, কেহ নাহি জানে ।\\nফলে অনুমান পাছে কৈল ভক্তগণে ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: kibā yukti kaila duṅhe, keha nāhi jāne\\nphale anumāna pāche kaila bhakta-gaṇe
verses.translation: No one could understand what the brothers discussed between Themselves, but later all the devotees could guess what the subject matter was.

verses.devanagari: তবে মহাপ্রভু সব ভক্তে বোলাইল ।\\nগৌড়দেশে যাহ সবে বিদায় করিল ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: tabe mahāprabhu saba bhakte bolāila\\ngauḍa-deśe yāha sabe vidāya karila
verses.translation: Thereafter, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called for all the devotees and asked them to return to Bengal. In this way, He bade farewell to them.

verses.devanagari: সবারে কহিল প্রভু — প্রত্যব্দ আসিয়া ।\\nগুণ্ডিচা দেখিয়া যাবে আমারে মিলিয়া ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: sabāre kahila prabhu—pratyabda āsiyā\\nguṇḍicā dekhiyā yābe āmāre miliyā
verses.translation: Bidding farewell to all the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested them to return to Jagannātha Purī every year to see Him and then see the cleansing of the Guṇḍicā temple.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যেরে আজ্ঞা দিল করিয়া সম্মান ।\\n‘আ-চণ্ডাল আদি কৃষ্ণভক্তি দিও দান’ ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryere ājñā dila kariyā sammāna\\n'ā-caṇḍāla ādi kṛṣṇa-bhakti dio dāna'
verses.translation: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Advaita Ācārya, "Give Kṛṣṇa consciousness, devotion to Kṛṣṇa, even to the lowest of men [caṇḍālas]."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's order to all His devotees.
Kṛṣṇa-bhakti,
devotion to Kṛṣṇa, is open to everyone, even low-class men like
caṇḍālas.
One should follow this order in the disciplic succession stemming from Śrī Advaita and Nityānanda Prabhu and distribute Kṛṣṇa consciousness without discrimination throughout the world.
There are different kinds of men, beginning with the
brāhmaṇa
and going down to the lowest platform known as
caṇḍāla.
Whatever one's position, everyone in this Age of Kali needs to be enlightened in Kṛṣṇa consciousness. That is the greatest need of the day. Everyone is acutely feeling the pangs of material existence. Even in the ranks and files of the American Senate, the pinpricks of material existence are felt, so much so that April 30, 1974, was actually set aside as Prayer Day. Thus everyone is feeling the resultant pinpricks of Kali-yuga brought about by human society's indulging in illicit sex, meat-eating, gambling and intoxication. Now is the time for the members of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness to distribute
kṛṣṇa-bhakti
all over the world and thus follow the orders of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord has ordered everyone to become a
guru
(Cc. Madhya 7.128):
āmāra ājñāya guru hañā tāra' ei deśa.
Everyone in every town and village should be enlightened by the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Kṛṣṇa consciousness should be distributed to everyone indiscriminately. In this way, the entire world will be peaceful and happy, and everyone will glorify Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, as He desires.
The word
caṇḍāla
actually refers to a dog-eater, who is considered the lowest of men. Even
caṇḍālas
can be enlightened in Kṛṣṇa consciousness due to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's benedictions.
Kṛṣṇa-bhakti
is not the monopoly of a certain caste. Everyone is eligible to receive this great benediction given by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Everyone should be given a chance to receive it and be happy.
The word
dāna,
meaning "charity," is also significant in this verse. Whoever engages in the distribution of Kṛṣṇa consciousness is a charitable person. Professional men recite
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
and discuss
kṛṣṇa-bhakti
for an exchange of money. They cannot distribute such exalted transcendental property to everyone and anyone. Only pure devotees who have no motive other than serving Kṛṣṇa can give such transcendentally valuable benedictions out of charity.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দে আজ্ঞা দিল, — ‘যাহ গৌড়দেশে ।\\nঅনর্গল প্রেমভক্তি করিহ প্রকাশে ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: nityānande ājñā dila,—'yāha gauḍa-deśe\\nanargala prema-bhakti kariha prakāśe
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Nityānanda Prabhu, "Go to Bengal and, without restriction, manifest devotional service to the Lord, Kṛṣṇa consciousness."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus ordered Nityānanda Prabhu to deliver all the Bengalis to devotional service. In
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 9.32) it is said:
māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśritya
ye 'pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyās tathā śūdrās
te 'pi yānti parāṁ gatim
"O son of Pṛthā, those who take shelter in Me, though they be of lower birth-women,
vaiśyas
[merchants], as well as
śūdras
[workers]—can approach the supreme destination." Whoever takes to Kṛṣṇa consciousness and follows the regulative principles can return home, back to Godhead.
In his
Anubhāṣya,
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura writes: "There is a class of so-called devotees called
prākṛta-sahajiyās
who think that Nityānanda Prabhu is an ordinary human being. They have spread the news that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Nityānanda Prabhu to return to Bengal from Orissa just to marry and beget children. This is certainly a great offense against Nityānanda Prabhu."
Such an offense is called
pāṣaṇḍa-buddhi,
or an atheistic remark. Offenders consider Nityānanda Prabhu to be like one of them, an ordinary human being. They do not know of Nityānanda Prabhu's identity with the
viṣṇu-tattva.
Thinking Nityānanda Prabhu to be an ordinary human being is the business of mental speculators known as
kuṇapātma-vādīs.
These people accept the material body, which is a bag of three material elements (
kuṇape tri-dhātuke
), as themselves. They think that Nityānanda Prabhu's body was similarly material and that it was meant for sense gratification. Whoever thinks in this way is a candidate for the darkest regions of hell. Those who hanker after women and money, who are self-interested and have the mentality of merchants, can certainly discover many things with their fertile brains and speak against the authorized revealed scriptures. They also engage in some moneymaking businesses to cheat innocent people, and they try to support their business programs by making such offensive statements. Actually Nityānanda Prabhu, being the expansion of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, is the most munificent incarnation. No one should consider Him an ordinary human being or an entity like the
prajāpatis,
who were ordered by Brahmā to increase generation. Nityānanda Prabhu should not be considered instrumental for sense gratification. Although professional so-called preachers support this, such statements are not found in any authorized revealed scriptures. Actually there is no support for these statements made by
sahajiyās
or other professional distributors of
kṛṣṇa-bhakti.

verses.devanagari: রামদাস, গদাধর আদি কত জনে ।\\nতোমার সহায় লাগি’ দিলু তোমার সনে ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: rāma-dāsa, gadādhara ādi kata jane\\ntomāra sahāya lāgi' dilu tomāra sane
verses.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu was given assistants like Rāmadāsa, Gadādhara dāsa and several others. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I give them to You to assist You.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যে মধ্যে আমি তোমার নিকট যাইব ।\\nঅলক্ষিতে রহি’ তোমার নৃত্য দেখিব’ ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: madhye madhye āmi tomāra nikaṭa yāiba\\nalakṣite rahi' tomāra nṛtya dekhiba'
verses.translation: "I shall also go to see You at intervals. Keeping Myself invisible, I shall watch You dance."

verses.devanagari: শ্রীবাস-পণ্ডিতে প্রভু করি’ আলিঙ্গন । কণ্ঠে ধরি’ কহে তাঁরে মধুর বচন ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsa-paṇḍite prabhu kari' āliṅgana\\nkaṇṭhe dhari' kahe tāṅre madhura vacana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then embraced Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita and, with His arm about his neck, began to speak to him in sweet words.

verses.devanagari: তোমার ঘরে কীর্তনে আমি নিত্য নাচিব । তুমি দেখা পাবে, আর কেহ না দেখিব ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra ghare kīrtane āmi nitya nāciba\\ntumi dekhā pābe, āra keha nā dekhiba
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "Perform congregational chanting daily, and be assured that I shall also dance in your presence. You will be able to see this dancing, but not others.

verses.devanagari: এই বস্ত্র মাতাকে দিহ’, এই সব প্রসাদ  ।\\nদণ্ডবৎ করি’ আমার ক্ষমাইহ অপরাধ ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei vastra mātāke diha', ei saba prasāda\\ndaṇḍavat kari' āmāra kṣamāiha aparādha
verses.translation: "Take this prasāda of Lord Jagannātha's and this cloth and deliver them to My mother, Śacīdevī. After offering her obeisances, please request her to excuse My offenses.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর সেবা ছাড়ি’ আমি করিয়াছি সন্ন্যাস । ধর্ম নহে, করি আমি নিজ ধর্ম-নাশ ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra sevā chāḍi' āmi kariyāchi sannyāsa\\ndharma nahe, kari āmi nija dharma-nāśa
verses.translation: "I have given up the service of My mother and have accepted the sannyāsa order. Actually I should not have done this, for by so doing, I have destroyed My religious principles.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর প্রেমবশ আমি, তাঁর সেবা — ধর্ম  ।\\nতাহা ছাড়ি’ করিয়াছি বাতুলের কর্ম ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra prema-vaśa āmi, tāṅra sevā—dharma\\ntāhā chāḍi' kariyāchi vātulera karma
verses.translation: "I am subordinate to the love of My mother, and it is My duty to serve her in return. Instead of doing so, I have accepted this renounced order. Certainly this is the act of a madman.

verses.devanagari: বাতুল বালকের মাতা নাহি লয় দোষ  ।\\nএই জানি’ মাতা মোরে না করয় রোষ ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: vātula bālakera mātā nāhi laya doṣa\\nei jāni' mātā more nā karaya roṣa
verses.translation: "A mother is not offended by her mad son, and, knowing this, My mother is not offended by Me.

verses.devanagari: কি কায সন্ন্যাসে মোর, প্রেম নিজ-ধন  ।\\nযে-কালে সন্ন্যাস কৈলুঁ, ছন্ন হৈল মন ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: ki kāya sannyāse mora, prema nija-dhana\\nye-kāle sannyāsa kailuṅ, channa haila mana
verses.translation: "I had no business in accepting this renounced order and sacrificing My love for My mother, which is My real property. Actually I was in a crazy state of mind when I accepted sannyāsa.

verses.devanagari: নীলাচলে আছোঁ মুঞি তাঁহার আজ্ঞাতে  ।\\nমধ্যে মধ্যে আসিমু তাঁর চরণ দেখিতে ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: nīlācale āchoṅ muñi tāṅhāra ājñāte\\nmadhye madhye āsimu tāṅra caraṇa dekhite
verses.translation: "I am staying here at Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, to comply with her orders. However, at intervals I shall go see her lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: নিত্য যাই’ দেখি মুঞি তাঁহার চরণে ।\\nস্ফূর্তি-জ্ঞানে তেঁহো তাহা সত্য নাহি মানে ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: nitya yāi' dekhi muñi tāṅhāra caraṇe\\nsphūrti-jñāne teṅho tāhā satya nāhi māne
verses.translation: "Indeed, I go there daily to see her lotus feet. She is able to feel My presence, although she does not believe it to be true.

verses.devanagari: একদিন শাল্যন্ন, ব্যঞ্জন পাঁচ-সাত ।\\nশাক, মোচা-ঘণ্ট, ভৃষ্ট-পটোল-নিম্বপাত ॥৫৪॥\\nলেম্বু-আদাখণ্ড, দধি, দুগ্ধ, খণ্ড-সার ।\\nশালগ্ৰামে সমর্পিলেন বহু উপহার ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: lembu-ādā-khaṇḍa, dadhi, dugdha, khaṇḍa-sāra\\nśālagrāme samarpilena bahu upahāra
verses.translation: "One day My mother, Śacī, offered food to Śālagrāma Viṣṇu. She offered rice cooked from śāli paddies, various kinds of vegetables, spinach, curry made of banana flowers, fried paṭola with nimba leaves, pieces of ginger with lemon, and also yogurt, milk, sugar candy and many other foods.

verses.devanagari: প্রসাদ লঞা কোলে করেন ক্রন্দন ।\\nনিমাইর প্রিয় মোর — এসব ব্যঞ্জন ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: prasāda lañā kole karena krandana\\nnimāira priya mora—e-saba vyañjana
verses.translation: "Taking the food upon her lap, Mother was crying to think that all that food was very dear to her Nimāi.

verses.devanagari: নিমাঞি নাহিক এথা, কে করে ভোজন ।\\nমোর ধ্যানে অশ্রুজলে ভরিল নয়ন ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: nimāñi nāhika ethā, ke kare bhojana\\nmora dhyāne aśru-jale bharila nayana
verses.translation: "My mother was thinking, 'Nimāi is not here. Who will accept all this food?' As she meditated upon Me in this way, her eyes filled with tears.

verses.devanagari: শীঘ্র যাই’ মুঞি সব করিনু ভক্ষণ  ।\\nশূন্যপাত্র দেখি’ অশ্রু করিয়া মার্জন ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: śīghra yāi' muñi saba karinu bhakṣaṇa\\nśūnya-pātra dekhi' aśru kariyā mārjana
verses.translation: "While she was thus thinking and crying, I immediately went there with great haste and ate everything. Seeing the dish empty, she wiped her tears away.

verses.devanagari: ‘কে অন্ন-ব্যঞ্জন খাইল, শূন্য কেনে পাত ? বালগোপাল কিবা খাইল সব ভাত ? ৫৯ ।। কিবা মোর কথায় মনে ভ্রম হঞা গেল ! কিবা কোন জন্তু আসি’ সকল খাইল ? ৬০ ।। কিবা আমি অন্নপাত্রে ভ্রমে না বাড়িল !’ এত চিন্তি’ পাক-পাত্র যাঞা দেখিল ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'ke anna-vyañjana khāila, śūnya kene pāta?\\nbālagopāla kibā khāila saba bhāta?
verses.translation: "She then began to wonder who had eaten all that food. 'Why is the plate empty?' she wondered, doubting that Bāla-gopāla had eaten it all.

verses.devanagari: কিবা মোর কথায় মনে ভ্রম হঞা গেল !\\nকিবা কোন জন্তু আসি’ সকল খাইল ? ৬০ ॥
verses.transliteration: kibā mora kathāya mane bhrama hañā gela!\\nkibā kona jantu āsi' sakala khāila?
verses.translation: "She began to wonder whether there was actually anything on the plate in the first place. Then again she thought that some animal might have come and eaten everything.

verses.devanagari: কিবা আমি অন্নপাত্রে ভ্রমে না বাড়িল !’\\nএত চিন্তি’ পাক-পাত্র যাঞা দেখিল ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: kibā āmi anna-pātre bhrame nā bāḍila!'\\neta cinti' pāka-pātra yāñā dekhila
verses.translation: "She thought, 'Perhaps by mistake I did not put any food on the plate.' So thinking, she went into the kitchen and saw the pots.

verses.devanagari: অন্নব্যঞ্জনপূর্ণ দেখি’ সকল ভাজনে ।\\nদেখিয়া সংশয় হৈল কিছু চমৎকার মনে ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: anna-vyañjana-pūrṇa dekhi' sakala bhājane\\ndekhiyā saṁśaya haila kichu camatkāra mane
verses.translation: "When she saw that all the pots were still filled with rice and vegetables, there was some doubt in her mind, and she was astonished.

verses.devanagari: ঈশানে বোলাঞা পুনঃ স্থান লেপাইল ।\\nপুনরপি গোপালকে অন্ন সমর্পিল ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: īśāne bolāñā punaḥ sthāna lepāila\\npunarapi gopālake anna samarpila
verses.translation: "Thus wondering, she called Īśāna, the servant, and had the place cleaned again. She then offered another plate to Gopāla.

verses.devanagari: এইমত যবে করেন উত্তম রন্ধন ।\\nমোরে খাওয়াইতে করে উৎকণ্ঠায় রোদন ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata yabe karena uttama randhana\\nmore khāoyāite kare utkaṇṭhāya rodana
verses.translation: "Now whenever she prepares some good cooked food and wants to feed it to Me, she cries in great anxiety.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর প্রেমে আনি’ আমায় করায় ভোজনে ।\\nঅন্তরে মানয়ে সুখ, বাহ্যে নাহি মানে ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra preme āni' āmāya karāya bhojane\\nantare mānaye sukha, bāhye nāhi māne
verses.translation: "Being obliged by her love, I am brought there to eat. Mother knows all these things internally and feels happiness, but externally she does not accept them.

verses.devanagari: এই বিজয়া-দশমীতে হৈল এই রীতি ।\\nতাঁহাকে পুছিয়া তাঁর করাইহ প্ৰতীতি ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei vijayā-daśamīte haila ei rīti\\ntāṅhāke puchiyā tāṅra karāiha pratīti
verses.translation: "Such an incident took place on the last Vijayā-daśamī day. You can ask her about this incident and thus make her believe that I actually go there."

verses.devanagari: এতেক কহিতে প্রভু বিহ্বল হইলা ।\\nলোক বিদায় করিতে প্রভু ধৈর্য ধরিলা ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: eteka kahite prabhu vihvala ha-ilā\\nloka vidāya karite prabhu dhairya dharilā
verses.translation: While describing all this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a little overwhelmed, but just to finish bidding farewell to the devotees, He remained patient.

verses.devanagari: রাঘব পণ্ডিতে কহেন বচন সরস ।\\n‘তোমার শুদ্ধ প্রেমে আমি হই’ তোমার বশ ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: rāghava paṇḍite kahena vacana sarasa\\n'tomāra śuddha preme āmi ha-i' tomāra vaśa'
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next spoke some relishable words to Rāghava Paṇḍita. He said, "I am obliged to you due to your pure love for Me."

verses.devanagari: ইঁহার কৃষ্ণসেবার কথা শুন, সর্বজন  ।\\nপরম পবিত্র সেবা অতি সর্বোত্তম ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: iṅhāra kṛṣṇa-sevāra kathā śuna, sarva-jana\\nparama-pavitra sevā ati sarvottama
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed everyone, "Just hear about the pure devotional service rendered to Kṛṣṇa by Rāghava Paṇḍita. Indeed, Rāghava Paṇḍita's service is supremely pure and highly accomplished.

verses.devanagari: আর দ্রব্য রহু — শুন নারিকেলের কথা  ।\\nপাঁচ গণ্ডা করি’ নারিকেল বিকায় তথা ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: āra dravya rahu—śuna nārikelera kathā\\npāṅca gaṇḍā kari' nārikela vikāya tathā
verses.translation: "Apart from other commodities, just hear about his coconut offering. A coconut is sold at the rate of five gaṇḍās each.

verses.devanagari: বাটিতে কত শত বৃক্ষে লক্ষ লক্ষ ফল  ।\\nতথাপি শুনেন যথা মিষ্ট নারিকেল ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: vāṭite kata śata vṛkṣe lakṣa lakṣa phala\\ntathāpi śunena yathā miṣṭa nārikela
verses.translation: "Although he already has hundreds of trees and millions of fruits, he is still very eager to hear about the place where sweet coconut is available.

verses.devanagari: এক এক ফলের মূল্য দিয়া চারিচারি পণ  ।\\nদশক্রোশ হৈতে আনায় করিয়া যতন ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: eka eka phalera mūlya diyā cāri-cāri paṇa\\ndaśa-krośa haite ānāya kariyā yatana
verses.translation: "He collects coconut with great endeavor from a place twenty miles away, and he gives four paṇas each for them.

verses.devanagari: প্রতিদিন পাঁচ-সাত ফল ছোলাঞা  ।\\nসুশীতল করিতে রাখে জলে ডুবাইঞা ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: prati-dina pāṅca-sāta phala cholāñā\\nsuśītala karite rākhe jale ḍubāiñā
verses.translation: "Every day five to seven coconuts are clipped and put into water to keep cool.

verses.devanagari: ভোগের সময় পুনঃ ছুলি’ সংস্করি’ । কৃষ্ণে সমর্পণ করে মুখ ছিদ্র করি’ ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: bhogera samaya punaḥ chuli' saṁskari'\\nkṛṣṇe samarpaṇa kare mukha chidra kari'
verses.translation: "At the time of offering bhoga, the coconuts are again clipped and cleansed. After holes are made in them, they are offered to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ সেই নারিকেল-জল পান করি’ ।\\nকভু শূন্য ফল রাখেন, কভু জল ভরি’ ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa sei nārikela-jala pāna kari'\\nkabhu śūnya phala rākhena, kabhu jala bhari'
verses.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa used to drink the juice from these coconuts, and sometimes the coconuts were left drained of juice. At other times the coconuts were filled with juice.

verses.devanagari: জলশূন্য ফল দেখি’ পণ্ডিত — হরষিত ।\\nফল ভাঙ্গি’ শস্যে করে সৎপাত্র পূরিত ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: jala-śūnya phala dekhi' paṇḍita—haraṣita\\nphala bhāṅgi' śasye kare sat-pātra pūrita
verses.translation: "When Rāghava Paṇḍita saw that the juice had been drunk from the coconuts, he was very pleased. He would then break the coconut, take out the pulp and put it on another plate.

verses.devanagari: শস্য সমর্পণ করি’ বাহিরে ধেয়ান ।\\nশস্য খাঞা কৃষ্ণ করে শূন্য ভাজন ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: śasya samarpaṇa kari' bāhire dheyāna\\nśasya khāñā kṛṣṇa kare śūnya bhājana
verses.translation: "After offering the pulp, he would meditate outside the temple door. In the meantime, Lord Kṛṣṇa, having eaten the pulp, would leave the plate empty.

verses.devanagari: কভু শস্য খাঞা পুনঃ পাত্র ভরে শাঁসে ।\\nশ্রদ্ধা বাড়ে পণ্ডিতের, প্রেমসিন্ধু ভাসে ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu śasya khāñā punaḥ pātra bhare śāṁse\\nśraddhā bāḍe paṇḍitera, prema-sindhu bhāse
verses.translation: "Sometimes, after eating the pulp, Kṛṣṇa would fill the plate again with new pulp. In this way, Rāghava Paṇḍita's faith increases, and he floats in an ocean of love.

verses.devanagari: এক দিন ফল দশ সংস্কার করিয়া ।\\nভোগ লাগাইতে সেবক আইল লঞা ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka dina phala daśa saṁskāra kariyā\\nbhoga lāgāite sevaka āila lañā
verses.translation: "One day it so happened that about ten coconuts were properly clipped and brought by a servant to offer to the Deity.

verses.devanagari: অবসর নাহি হয়, বিলম্ব হইল ।\\nফল-পাত্র-হাতে সেবক দ্বারে ত’ রহিল ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: avasara nāhi haya, vilamba ha-ila\\nphala-pātra-hāte sevaka dvāre ta' rahila
verses.translation: "When the coconuts were brought, there was little time to offer them because it was already late. The servant, holding the container of coconuts, remained standing at the door.

verses.devanagari: দ্বারের উপর ভিতে তেঁহো হাত দিল ।\\nসেই হাতে ফল ছুঁইল, পণ্ডিত দেখিল ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: dvārera upara bhite teṅho hāta dila\\nsei hāte phala chuṅila, paṇḍita dekhila
verses.translation: "Rāghava Paṇḍita then saw that the servant touched the ceiling above the door and then touched the coconuts with the same hand.

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিত কহে, — দ্বারে লোক করে গতায়াতে ।\\nতার পদধূলি উড়ি’ লাগে উপর ভিতে ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍita kahe,—dvāre loka kare gatāyāte\\ntāra pada-dhūli uḍi' lāge upara bhite
verses.translation: "Rāghava Paṇḍita then said, 'People are always coming and going through that door. The dust from their feet blows up and touches the ceiling.

verses.devanagari: সেই ভিতে হাত দিয়া ফল পরশিলা ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-যোগ্য নহে, ফল অপবিত্র হৈলা ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: sei bhite hāta diyā phala paraśilā\\nkṛṣṇa-yogya nahe, phala apavitra hailā
verses.translation: “ 'After touching the ceiling above the door, you have touched the coconuts. Now they are no longer fit to be offered to Kṛṣṇa because they are contaminated.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura states that Rāghava Paṇḍita was not simply a crazy fellow suffering from some cleansing phobia. He did not belong to the mundane world. In lower consciousness, accepting something to be spiritual when it is actually material is called
bhauma-ijya-dhīḥ.
Rāghava Paṇḍita was an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, and everything he saw was related to the service of the Lord. He was always absorbed in the transcendental thought of how he could always serve Kṛṣṇa with everything. Sometimes neophytes, devotees on the lower platform, try to imitate Rāghava Paṇḍita on the platform of material purity and impurity. Such imitation will not help anyone. As explained in
Caitanya-caritāmṛta,
(
Antya-līlā
4.174):
bhadrābhadra-vastu-jñāna nāhika 'prākṛte'.
On the transcendental platform there is no higher or lower, pure or impure. On the material platform, distinction is made between good and bad, but on the spiritual platform everything is of the same quality.
'dvaite' bhadrābhadra-jñāna, saba—'manodharma'
'ei bhāla, ei manda',—ei saba 'bhrama'
"In the material world, conceptions of good and bad are all mental speculations. Therefore, saying, 'This is good, and this is bad, is all a mistake."(Cc. Antya 4.176)

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ ফল ফেলে প্রাচীর লঙ্ঘিয়া ।\\nঐছে পবিত্র প্রেম-সেবা জগৎ জিনিয়া ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' phala phele prācīra laṅghiyā\\naiche pavitra prema-sevā jagat jiniyā
verses.translation: "Such was the service of Rāghava Paṇḍita. He did not accept the coconuts but threw them over the wall. His service is purely based on unalloyed love, and it conquers the whole world.

verses.devanagari: তবে আর নারিকেল সংস্কার করাইল ।\\nপরম পবিত্র করি’ ভোগ লাগাইল ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: tabe āra nārikela saṁskāra karāila\\nparama pavitra kari' bhoga lāgāila
verses.translation: "Thereafter, Rāghava Paṇḍita had other coconuts gathered, cleansed and clipped, and with great attention he offered them to the Deity to eat.

verses.devanagari: এইমত কলা, আম্র, নারঙ্গ, কাঁঠাল  ।\\nযাহা যাহা দূর-গ্রামে শুনিয়াছে ভাল ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata kalā, āmra, nāraṅga, kāṅṭhāla\\nyāhā yāhā dūra-grāme śuniyāche bhāla
verses.translation: "In this way he collected excellent bananas, mangoes, oranges, jackfruits and whatever first-class fruits from distant villages he had heard about.

verses.devanagari: বহুমূল্য দিয়া আনি’ করিয়া যতন  ।\\nপবিত্র সংস্কার করি’ করে নিবেদন ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: bahu-mūlya diyā āni' kariyā yatana\\npavitra saṁskāra kari' kare nivedana
verses.translation: "All these fruits were collected from distant places and were bought at a high price. After trimming them with great care and purity, Rāghava Paṇḍita offered them to the Deity.

verses.devanagari: এই মত ব্যঞ্জনের শাক, মূল, ফল  ।\\nএত মত চিড়া, হুড়ুম, সন্দেশ সকল ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata vyañjanera śāka, mūla, phala\\nei mata ciḍā, huḍuma, sandeśa sakala
verses.translation: "Thus with great care and attention Rāghava Paṇḍita would prepare spinach, other vegetables, radishes, fruits, chipped rice, powdered rice and sweetmeats.

verses.devanagari: এইমত পিঠা-পানা, ক্ষীর-ওদন  ।\\nপরম পবিত্র, আর করে সর্বোত্তম ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata piṭhā-pānā, kṣīra-odana\\nparama pavitra, āra kare sarvottama
verses.translation: "He prepared cakes, sweet rice, concentrated milk and everything else with great attention, and the cooking conditions were purified so that the food was first class and tasteful.

verses.devanagari: কাশম্দি, আচার আদি অনেক প্রকার  ।\\nগন্ধ, বস্ত্র, অলঙ্কার, সর্ব দ্রব্য-সার ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: kāśamdi, ācāra ādi aneka prakāra\\ngandha, vastra, alaṅkāra, sarva dravya-sāra
verses.translation: "Rāghava Paṇḍita would also offer all kinds of pickles, such as kāśamdi. He offered various scents, garments, ornaments and the best of everything.

verses.devanagari: এইমত প্রেমের সেবা করে অনুপম  ।\\nযাহা দেখি’ সর্বলোকের জুড়ায় নয়ন ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata premera sevā kare anupama\\nyāhā dekhi' sarva-lokera juḍāna nayana
verses.translation: "Thus Rāghava Paṇḍita would serve the Lord in an incomparable way. Everyone was very satisfied just to see him."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ রাঘবেরে কৈল আলিঙ্গনে ।\\nএইমত সম্মানিল সর্ব ভক্তগণে ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' rāghavere kaila āliṅgane\\nei-mata sammānila sarva bhakta-gaṇe
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then mercifully embraced Rāghava Paṇḍita. The Lord also offered all the other devotees a reception with similar respect.

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দ সেনে কহে করিয়া সম্মান  ।\\nবাসুদেব-দত্তের তুমি করিহ সমাধান ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: śivānanda sene kahe kariyā sammāna\\nvāsudeva-dattera tumi kariha samādhāna
verses.translation: The Lord also respectfully told Śivānanda Sena, "Take care of Vāsudeva Datta very nicely.

verses.devanagari: পরম উদার ইঁহো, যে দিন যে আইসে  ।\\nসেই দিনে ব্যয় করে, নাহি রাখে শেষে ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: parama udāra iṅho, ye dina ye āise\\nsei dine vyaya kare, nāhi rākhe śeṣe
verses.translation: "Vāsudeva Datta is very liberal. Every day, whatever income he receives, he spends. He does not keep any balance.

verses.devanagari: ‘গৃহস্থ’ হয়েন ইঁহো, চাহিয়ে সঞ্চয় ।\\nসঞ্চয় না কৈলে কুটুম্ব-ভরণ নাহি হয় ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: 'gṛhastha' hayena iṅho, cāhiye sañcaya\\nsañcaya nā kaile kuṭumba-bharaṇa nāhi haya
verses.translation: "Being a householder, Vāsudeva Datta needs to save some money. Because he is not doing so, it is very difficult for him to maintain his family.

verses.devanagari: ইহার ঘরের আয়-ব্যয় সব — তোমার স্থানে ।\\n‘সরখেল’ হঞা তুমি করিহ সমাধানে ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: ihāra gharera āya-vyaya saba—tomāra sthāne\\n'sara-khela' hañā tumi kariha samādhāne
verses.translation: "Please take care of Vāsudeva Datta's family affairs. Become his manager and make the proper adjustments.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nBoth Vāsudeva Datta and Śivānanda Sena were living in the same neighborhood, which is presently called Kumārahaṭṭa or Hālisahara.

verses.devanagari: প্রতিবর্ষে আমার সব ভক্তগণ লঞা ।\\nগুণ্ডিচায় আসিবে সবায় পালন করিয়া ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: prati-varṣe āmāra saba bhakta-gaṇa lañā\\nguṇḍicāya āsibe sabāya pālana kariyā
verses.translation: "Come every year and bring all My devotees with you to the Guṇḍicā festival. I also request you to maintain all of them."

verses.devanagari: কুলীনগ্ৰামীরে কহে সম্মান করিয়া ।\\nপ্রত্যব্দ আসিবে যাত্রায় পট্টডোরী লঞা ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: kulīna-grāmīre kahe sammāna kariyā\\npratyabda āsibe yātrāya paṭṭa-ḍorī lañā
verses.translation: The Lord then with great respect extended an invitation to all the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma, asking them to come every year and bring silken rope to carry Lord Jagannātha during the Ratha-yātrā festival.

verses.devanagari: গুণরাজ-খাঁন কৈল শ্রীকৃষ্ণবিজয় ।\\nতাহাঁ একবাক্য তাঁর আছে প্রেমময় ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: guṇarāja-khāṅna kaila śrī-kṛṣṇa-vijaya\\ntāhāṅ eka-vākya tāṅra āche premamaya
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "Guṇarāja Khān of Kulīna-grāma compiled a book named Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vijaya in which there is a sentence revealing the author's ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vijaya is a book of poems considered to be the first poetry book written in Bengal. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura states that this book was compiled in the Bengali
śakābda
year 1395. After seven years, it was completed (1402
śakābda
). This book was written in plain language, and even half-educated Bengalis and women could read it very clearly. Even ordinary men with little knowledge of the alphabet could read this book and understand it. Its language is not very ornamental, and sometimes the poetry is not very sweet to hear. Although according to the sonnet style each line should contain fourteen syllables, there are sometimes sixteen, twelve and thirteen syllables in his verse. Many words used in those days could be understood only by local inhabitants, yet this book is still so popular that no book store is complete without it. It is very valuable for those who are interested in advancing in Kṛṣṇa consciousness.
Śrī Guṇarāja Khān was one of the topmost Vaiṣṇavas, and he has translated the Tenth and Eleventh Cantos of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
for the understanding of the common man. The book
Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vijaya
was highly praised by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and it is very valuable for all Vaiṣṇavas. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura gives a genealogical table and family history of Guṇarāja Khān. When a Bengali emperor named Ādiśūra first came from Kānyakubja, or Kānowj, he brought with him five
brāhmaṇas
and five
kāyasthas.
Since the king is supposed to be accompanied by his associates, the
brāhmaṇas
accompanied the King to help him in higher spiritual matters. The
kāyasthas
were to render other services. In the northern Indian high country, the
kāyasthas
are accepted as
śūdras,
but in Bengal the
kāyasthas
are considered among the higher castes. It is a fact that the
kāyasthas
came to Bengal from northern India, specifically from Kānyakubja, or Kānowj. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that the
kāyasthas
who came from Kānyakubja were high-class men. Of them, Daśaratha Vasu was a great personality, and the thirteenth generation of his family included Guṇarāja Khān.
His real name was Mālādhara Vasu, but the title Khān was given to him by the Emperor of Bengal. Thus he became known as Guṇarāja Khān. Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura gives the following genealogical table of Guṇarāja Khān: (1) Daśaratha Vasu; (2) Kuśala; (3) Śubhaśaṅkara; (4) Haṁsa; (5) Śaktirāma (Bāgāṇḍā), Muktirāma (Māinagara) and Alaṅkāra (Baṅgaja); (6) Dāmodara; (7) Anantarāma; (8) Guṇīnāyaka and Vīṇānāyaka. The twelfth generation included Bhagīratha, and the thirteenth Mālādhara Vasu, or Guṇarāja Khān. Śrī Guṇarāja Khān had fourteen sons, of whom the second son, Lakṣmīnāthavasu, received the title Satyarāja Khān. His son was Śrī Rāmānanda Vasu; therefore Rāmānanda Vasu belonged to the fifteenth generation. Guṇarāja Khān was a very well known and wealthy man. His palace, fort and temples are still existing, and from these we can deduce that the opulence of Guṇarāja Khān was certainly very great. Śrī Guṇarāja Khān never cared for the artificial aristocracy introduced by Ballāl Sena.

verses.devanagari: “নন্দনন্দন কৃষ্ণ — মোর প্রাণনাথ” ।\\nএই বাক্যে বিকাইনু তাঁর বংশের হাত ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: "nandanandana kṛṣṇa—mora prāṇa-nātha"\\nei vākye vikāinu tāṅra vaṁśera hāta
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, is my life and soul.' By this statement I am sold into the hands of the descendants of Guṇarāja Khān.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The full verse referred to here is:
eka-bhāve vanda hari yoḍa kari' hāta
nandanandana kṛṣṇa—mora prāṇa-nātha
"With folded hands I offer my prayers unto Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, who is my life and soul."

verses.devanagari: তোমার কি কথা, তোমার গ্রামের কুক্কুর ।\\nসেহ মোর প্রিয়, অন্যজন রহু দূর ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra ki kathā, tomāra grāmera kukkura\\nsei mora priya, anya-jana rahu dūra
verses.translation: "To say nothing of you, even a dog living in your village is very dear to Me. What, then, to speak of others?"

verses.devanagari: তবে রামানন্দ, আর সত্যরাজ খাঁন  ।\\nপ্রভুর চরণে কিছু কৈল নিবেদন ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: tabe rāmānanda, āra satyarāja khāṅna\\nprabhura caraṇe kichu kaila nivedana
verses.translation: After this, Rāmānanda Vasu and Satyarāja Khān both submitted questions at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: গৃহস্থ বিষয়ী আমি, কি মোর সাধনে  ।\\nশ্রীমুখে আজ্ঞা কর প্রভু — নিবেদি চরণে ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhastha viṣayī āmi, ki mora sādhane\\nśrī-mukhe ājñā kara prabhu—nivedi caraṇe
verses.translation: Satyarāja Khān said, "My dear Lord, being a householder and a materialistic man, I do not know the process of advancing in spiritual life. I therefore submit myself unto Your lotus feet and request You to give me orders."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহেন, — ‘কৃষ্ণসেবা’, ‘বৈষ্ণব-সেবন’ ।\\n‘নিরন্তর কর কৃষ্ণনাম-সংকীর্তন’ ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahena,—'kṛṣṇa-sevā', 'vaiṣṇava-sevana'\\n'nirantara kara kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtana'
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Without cessation continue chanting the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Whenever possible, serve Him and His devotees, the Vaiṣṇavas."

verses.devanagari: সত্যরাজ বলে, — বৈষ্ণব চিনিব কেমনে ?\\nকে বৈষ্ণব, কহ তাঁর সামান্য লক্ষণে ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: satyarāja bale,—vaiṣṇava ciniba kemane?\\nke vaiṣṇava, kaha tāṅra sāmānya lakṣaṇe
verses.translation: Upon hearing this, Satyarāja said, "How can I recognize a Vaiṣṇava? Please let me know what a Vaiṣṇava is. What are his common symptoms?"

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “যাঁর মুখে শুনি একবার ।\\nকৃষ্ণনাম, সেই পূজ্য, — শ্রেষ্ঠ সবাকার ।।” ॥ ১০৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"yāṅra mukhe śuni eka-bāra\\nkṛṣṇa-nāma, sei pūjya,—śreṣṭha sabākāra"
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Whoever chants the holy name of Kṛṣṇa just once is worshipable and is the topmost human being.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that simply by chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa once, a person becomes perfect. Such a person is understood to be a Vaiṣṇava. With such faith and belief, one may begin a life of Kṛṣṇa consciousness, but an ordinary person cannot chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa with such faith. This is confirmed by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī in his
Upadeśāmṛta: kṛṣṇeti yasya giri taṁ manasādriyeta.
